items.name: 45度山羊挺身(手臂置于胸前)(侧面视角)
items.nameEn: 45 degree hyperextension (arms in front of chest) (side pov)
items.description: A back extension on a 45 degree bench viewed from the side, targeting the lower back, glutes and hamstrings.
steps: Set the pad at hip height and hook your heels under the roller.
Cross your arms over your chest and keep your body straight.
Lower your torso with a flat back until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Raise back up until your body is in line, without overarching.
Move slowly and squeeze your glutes at the top.

items.name: 45度挺身(双臂在胸前)
items.nameEn: 45 degree hyperextension (arms in front of chest)
items.description: A back extension on a 45 degree bench with arms crossed at the chest. It strengthens the lower back and glutes.
steps: Set the pad at hip height and hook your heels under the rollers.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Lower your torso with a straight back.
Raise yourself until your body forms a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top and lower slowly.

items.name: 45度背部伸展
items.description: A back extension on an angled bench that strengthens the lower back and glutes. Hinging at the hips keeps the movement safe and smooth.
steps: Set the pad at hip level and hook your heels under the rollers.
Cross your arms over your chest or hold them behind your head.
Lower your torso with a straight spine until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Raise your torso by squeezing your glutes and lower back.
Stop when your body forms a straight line.
Avoid over-arching at the top.

items.name: 45度背部伸展肩胛内收
items.description: On a 45 degree bench you lift your torso and pull your shoulder blades together. It works the lower back and upper back at once.
steps: Set up on the 45 degree bench with your hips on the pad and your feet locked in.
Cross your arms or hold them out wide.
Raise your torso until your body forms a straight line.
At the top, pull your shoulder blades together.
Lower back down slowly without rounding.
Do not overarch at the top.

items.name: L型引体向上
items.description: A pull-up with the legs held out straight in an L shape. It trains the lats, biceps and core.
steps: 正手握住引体向上杆，握距略宽于肩宽。
双臂完全伸展，身体伸直。
收紧背阔肌和二头肌，将身体拉向杠铃杆，保持肘部靠近身体。
继续拉，直到下巴位于杠铃上方。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将身体放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: pvc管前架拉伸
items.description: A pipe-assisted stretch for the lats, shoulders and wrists that helps you get into a comfortable front rack position.
steps: Stand tall holding a PVC pipe across your upper chest in a front rack grip.
Lift your elbows forward and up as high as you comfortably can.
Keep your chest up and your lower back from arching.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
Lower the elbows and repeat.

items.name: 三椅间抬高反向划船
items.description: A harder inverted row with the feet elevated on a third chair. It builds the back and arms.
steps: Set a bar across two stable chairs and place a third chair at your feet.
Lie under the bar and grip it overhand.
Put your heels on the third chair.
Pull your chest to the bar.
Lower slowly to straight arms.
Keep your body in a straight line.

items.name: 三椅间抬高反手握反向划船
items.nameEn: elevated inverted underhand grip row between 3 chairs
items.description: An inverted row with an underhand grip and elevated feet. It emphasises the lats and biceps.
steps: Set a bar across two stable chairs and a third chair at your feet.
Lie under the bar and grip it underhand.
Place your heels on the third chair.
Pull your chest to the bar with elbows close.
Lower slowly to straight arms.
Keep your body straight.

items.name: 上举背部拉伸
items.description: Reaching both arms up and slightly back lengthens the lats and upper back. A simple stretch to open your sides.
steps: Stand tall and reach both arms overhead with your palms facing each other.
Reach up and lean slightly back, keeping your lower back relaxed and your ribs down.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

items.name: 上犬式
items.description: A yoga pose where you lift your chest and thighs off the floor on straight arms. It opens the chest and strengthens the back.
steps: 脸朝下躺在地板上，双腿伸到身后。
将双手放在下肋骨旁边的地板上，手指指向前方。
双手用力按在地板上，伸直手臂，将躯干和大腿抬离地面。
向后和向下转动肩膀，打开胸部，将目光转向天花板。
保持这个姿势几次呼吸，然后慢慢将身体放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 上背部拉伸
items.description: Reach your arms forward and round your upper back to open up the space between your shoulder blades. It stretches the upper back.
steps: 站直，双脚分开与肩同宽。
将双臂伸直在身前，与地面平行。
手指交叉，手掌旋转远离身体。
慢慢地将手臂举过头顶，保持它们伸直并彼此平行。
当你举起手臂时，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
保持拉伸 15-30 秒，然后松开并重复。

items.name: 下犬式脊柱灵活性练习
items.description: A downward dog flowing with gentle spine movement. It loosens the back and hamstrings.
steps: Start in a downward facing dog.
Bend one knee, then the other, pedaling gently.
Shift your hips side to side.
Let your spine twist a little.
Keep your hands pressed into the floor.
Breathe slowly.

items.name: 下背部卷曲
items.description: Lie face down and lift your chest off the floor in a curling motion. It strengthens the lower back with a gentle bodyweight movement.
steps: 平躺，双腿伸直，双臂放在身体两侧。
收紧臀肌和腿筋，慢慢将上半身抬离地面，向上弯曲背部。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 不等高引体向上
items.description: A pull-up with the hands at different heights or one hand doing more work. It gently trains one-arm pulling strength.
steps: Hang from the bar with one hand higher or on a towel and the other lower.
Brace your core and pull your chest up.
Lead with the working arm and pull your chin toward the bar.
Lower yourself under control.
Switch the hand positions on the next set.

items.name: 中背部夹肘
items.description: A simple drill that squeezes the elbows back to engage the mid back. It trains the muscles between the shoulder blades.
steps: Stand or sit tall with your hands by your head or elbows bent in front.
Pull your elbows back and down.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Hold for a second at the end.
Return slowly to the start.
Keep your neck relaxed.

items.name: 中背部拉伸
items.description: A stretch that rounds the middle back and spreads the shoulder blades. It relieves tension from sitting or rowing.
steps: Stand or sit and clasp your hands in front of you.
Straighten your arms and push them forward.
Round your upper back and tuck your chin.
Feel the stretch between your shoulder blades.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release slowly and repeat.

items.name: 交替死悬
items.description: Hang from a bar and shift your weight from side to side. It decompresses the shoulders and stretches the lats.
steps: Grab a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, hands about shoulder width apart.
Hang with your arms long and your body relaxed.
Shift your weight toward one hand, letting that side stretch.
Shift to the other side and keep alternating.
Hold the hang for 20-30 seconds in total.

items.name: 交替超人式
items.description: A face-down lift of opposite arm and leg to strengthen the lower back and glutes.
steps: Lie face down with arms extended in front.
Lift one arm and the opposite leg together.
Hold for a second.
Lower and switch to the other side.
Keep your neck neutral and move with control.

items.name: 交替超人式 v. 2
items.description: Lifting opposite arm and leg while face down to strengthen the lower back and glutes.
steps: Lie face down with arms extended overhead.
Raise your right arm and left leg.
Hold briefly and lower.
Raise your left arm and right leg.
Keep your neck neutral and move smoothly.

items.name: 仰卧下背拉伸
items.description: A lying stretch hugging both knees toward your chest to release the lower back.
steps: Lie on your back.
Pull both knees toward your chest.
Wrap your arms around your shins.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release slowly.

items.name: 仰卧下背拉伸(屈膝)
items.description: A gentle lying stretch that draws the knee toward your chest to ease the lower back.
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent.
Pull one knee toward your chest with both hands.
Keep your lower back relaxed on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs.

items.name: 仰卧单腿踢
items.description: A face-down move kicking one heel toward the glute while the chest stays lifted.
steps: Lie face down and prop yourself on your forearms.
Keep your chest lifted.
Kick one heel toward your glute twice.
Lower and switch legs.
Keep your hips down.

items.name: 仰卧单臂从Y滑到T
items.nameEn: lying single arm slide from y to t
items.description: A prone shoulder drill where one arm slides from a Y shape to a T shape. It wakes up the mid back and shoulder blades.
steps: Lie face down with your arms overhead in a Y.
Lift one arm slightly off the floor.
Slide it out and down into a T position.
Hold for a moment.
Slide it back to the Y.
Switch arms after each set.

items.name: 仰卧双腿踢
items.description: A face-down Pilates move that opens the chest and strengthens the back.
steps: Lie face down with your hands clasped behind your back.
Kick both heels toward your glutes.
Lift your chest and extend your arms back.
Lower down.
Repeat smoothly.

items.name: 仰卧地面屈膝划船
items.nameEn: lying floor row with bent knee
items.description: A row done lying on the floor, pulling against an anchored handle or towel, with knees bent. It works the back and biceps with no equipment.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Hold a secure anchor, such as a towel around a sturdy post, with arms straight.
Pull your body toward your hands by driving the elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly to straight arms.
Keep your hips on or near the floor.

items.name: 仰卧地面滑行
items.description: Floor slide that improves shoulder mobility and activates the upper back.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and arms in a goalpost position.
Keep your back and wrists on the floor.
Slide your arms up overhead.
Return slowly to the start.
Move within your comfortable range.

items.name: 仰卧挺身保持
items.description: A prone hold that lifts the chest and legs, building lower back endurance.
steps: Lie face down with your arms extended.
Lift your chest, arms and legs a few inches.
Keep your neck neutral.
Squeeze your glutes and hold for 15-30 seconds.
Lower slowly.

items.name: 仰卧胸椎灵活性拉伸
items.description: A lying rotation stretch for the upper back.
steps: Lie on your side with knees bent and arms in front.
Lift your top arm and open it toward the other side.
Follow your hand with your eyes.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return to the start.
Switch sides.

items.name: 伸展上背部拉伸
items.description: Reaching your arms out as you round your upper back stretches the muscles between and around your shoulder blades.
steps: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and reach both arms forward at chest height.
Round your upper back and spread your shoulder blades apart as you reach farther.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

items.name: 侧卧地面拉伸
items.description: Lie on your side and reach overhead to open up the side of your torso. It stretches the lats and the muscles between your ribs.
steps: 侧躺，双腿伸直，下臂伸直过头顶。
弯曲上面的膝盖，将脚放在下面的腿前面的地面上。
将上臂伸过头顶，抓住稳定的东西，例如墙壁或一件家具。
慢慢地将下面的腿抬离地面，保持伸直，直到感觉到身体一侧有拉伸感。
保持拉伸 20-30 秒，然后慢慢将腿放下。
在另一侧重复。

items.name: 侧向背阔肌拉伸
items.description: Bending sideways with an arm overhead lengthens the lat and the side of your trunk. A quick stretch for the flanks.
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and raise one arm overhead.
Lean to the opposite side from the raised arm, reaching over without twisting.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

items.name: 俯卧A字
items.description: Lying face down, arms form an A shape and lift. It strengthens the upper back and shoulder blade muscles.
steps: Lie face down with your arms out at about 45 degrees, palms down.
Rest your forehead lightly or look at the floor.
Lift your arms and chest slightly while squeezing your shoulder blades.
Hold for a second.
Lower with control and repeat.

items.name: 俯卧T字
items.description: Lying face down, arms out to the sides in a T and lifted. It trains the muscles between the shoulder blades.
steps: Lie face down with arms straight out to the sides, thumbs up.
Keep your neck neutral.
Lift your arms off the floor by squeezing your shoulder blades.
Hold briefly.
Lower slowly.

items.name: 俯卧W字
items.description: Lying face down, you pull the arms into a W shape. It builds the rear shoulders and mid back.
steps: Lie face down with elbows bent and hands by your head.
Keep your neck neutral.
Lift your elbows and hands off the floor, pulling the shoulder blades together.
Hold for a second.
Lower with control.

items.name: 俯卧W转T
items.description: Lying face down, you move from a W to a T shape. It trains the back of the shoulders and upper back.
steps: Lie face down in a W with elbows bent.
Lift your arms slightly off the floor.
Straighten your arms out to the sides into a T.
Pull back to the W while keeping your shoulder blades squeezed.
Repeat smoothly.

items.name: 俯卧W转Y
items.description: Lying face down, you move from a W to a Y shape. It works the upper back and lower traps.
steps: Lie face down in a W with elbows bent.
Lift your arms slightly off the floor.
Reach your arms forward and wide into a Y.
Pull back into the W with your shoulder blades squeezed.
Keep your neck relaxed and repeat.

items.name: 俯卧Y到T到W
items.nameEn: lying prone y to t to w
items.description: A prone sequence of arm positions that strengthens the upper back and shoulder blade muscles.
steps: Lie face down with your forehead near the floor and arms extended overhead in a Y.
Lift your arms slightly and hold.
Move them out to a T, then bend the elbows into a W.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Reverse the order and repeat.

items.name: 俯卧Y字上举
items.description: Lie face down and lift your arms overhead in a Y. It builds the lower traps and the muscles that support the shoulder blades.
steps: Lie face down with arms stretched overhead in a Y.
Turn your thumbs up.
Lift your arms, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Hold briefly at the top.
Lower with control.

items.name: 俯卧Y字上举
items.description: Lying face down, you lift your arms into a Y shape to strengthen the muscles that stabilise your shoulder blades.
steps: Lie face down with your arms stretched overhead in a Y shape.
Keep your forehead near the floor and your neck long.
Lift your arms off the floor by squeezing your shoulder blades.
Pause for a second at the top.
Lower your arms slowly and repeat.

items.name: 俯卧单臂斜方肌上举
items.description: A raise lying face down on a bench or floor with one arm. It targets the lower and middle traps and shoulder blade control.
steps: Lie face down with one arm hanging or reaching overhead, thumb up.
Keep your forehead down and neck relaxed.
Lift your arm in a Y shape by squeezing your shoulder blade down and back.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch arms.

items.name: 俯卧撑起天鹅式
items.description: A Pilates back extension on your belly that lifts the chest and strengthens the spine.
steps: Lie face down with hands beside your chest and legs together.
Press your pubic bone into the mat and engage your glutes.
Press through your hands to lift your chest.
Keep your neck long and shoulders away from your ears.
Lower slowly with control and repeat.

items.name: 俯卧眼镜蛇式双手交扣
items.description: A face-down hold with your hands clasped behind you. It trains the back extensors and opens the chest.
steps: Lie face down with your hands clasped behind your lower back.
Keep your neck long and look at the floor.
Lift your chest off the floor.
Reach your hands toward your feet.
Hold for 15-30 seconds.
Lower slowly and rest.

items.name: 俯卧眼镜蛇式掌心置于大腿下
items.description: A face-down hold where you lift your chest with your palms tucked under your thighs. It builds lower back and upper back endurance.
steps: Lie face down with your palms under your thighs.
Keep your neck long and look at the floor.
Lift your chest off the ground using your back muscles.
Squeeze your glutes.
Hold for 15-30 seconds.
Lower slowly and rest.

items.name: 俯卧背伸
items.description: A face-down lift of your chest off the floor. It strengthens the lower back muscles.
steps: Lie face down with your hands beside your head.
Keep your legs straight and your feet on the floor.
Lift your chest using your lower back.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your neck in line with your spine.

items.name: 俯卧背伸并推起
items.description: A lying back extension where you also press your arms forward at the top. It adds shoulder work to a back extension.
steps: Lie face down with your hands near your shoulders.
Lift your chest off the floor.
Press your arms forward in front of you.
Pull them back to your shoulders.
Lower your chest slowly.
Keep your neck long throughout.

items.name: 俯身背部伸展肩胛内收
items.nameEn: bent over back extension scapular adduction
items.description: From a bent over position you raise your torso and squeeze the shoulder blades together. It strengthens the whole back chain.
steps: Stand and hinge forward with a flat back and your arms hanging.
Keep your knees softly bent.
Raise your torso toward upright.
At the top, pull your shoulder blades together.
Lower back to the bent over position slowly.
Keep your neck in line with your spine.

items.name: 倒立耸肩
items.description: Hanging inverted, you move your shoulder blades to lift the body slightly. It builds the traps and scapular control.
steps: Set up under a bar or rings and hang with straight arms.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Pull your shoulder blades down and back to rise a little.
Hold briefly, then lower to a full hang.
Repeat for controlled reps.

items.name: 倒立耸肩(双杠)
items.description: Hanging from parallel bars, you shrug your shoulder blades up and down. It builds the traps and shoulder control.
steps: Grip the parallel bars and hang in an inverted position with arms straight.
Keep your body stable and your elbows locked.
Draw your shoulder blades down and together, pulling your body up a little.
Lower back to a full hang under control.
Repeat for controlled reps.

items.name: 凳上反向划船
items.description: A bodyweight row hanging beneath a bench or bar, pulling your chest up. Trains the upper back and biceps.
steps: 设置一张长凳，其高度应让您的身体可以自由地悬挂在其下方。
面朝上躺在地上，头朝向长凳。
向上伸手，正手握住长凳，握距略宽于肩宽。
调整身体位置，使脚后跟着地，手臂完全伸展。
当你将胸部拉向长凳时，启动你的核心并将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作的最高点停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低身体回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 凳上引体向上
items.description: A bodyweight bench pull-up variation hanging beneath a bar. Works the lats and biceps.
steps: 将自己置于与胸部同高的横杆或坚固的水平表面下方。
正手握住杠铃或杠铃表面，握距略宽于肩宽。
双臂完全伸展，身体伸直。
将肩胛骨挤压在一起并弯曲肘部，将胸部拉向杠铃或地面。
继续拉，直到下巴位于杆或表面上方。
有控制地降低自己回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 凳上跪姿背阔肌拉伸
items.description: A kneeling stretch with the arms on a bench that opens the lats and shoulders.
steps: Kneel in front of a bench and place both elbows on top of it.
Keep your hands together or hold a light stick.
Sit your hips back and let your chest sink toward the floor.
Keep your lower back relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.
Come back up carefully.

items.name: 前屈背部拉伸
items.description: A standing forward fold that lengthens the back and the backs of the legs.
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Hinge forward at the hips with soft knees.
Let your arms and head hang down.
Relax your neck and shoulders.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Roll up slowly to stand.

items.name: 前水平举次数
items.description: A rep-based version of the front lever, pulling the body in a horizontal line from a bar. It trains the lats, upper back and core.
steps: 正手握住引体向上杆，手掌背向自己。
启动你的核心并将肩胛骨向下拉和向后拉。
保持身体挺直，抬起双腿直至与地面平行。
尽可能长时间地保持这个姿势，目标是 10-20 秒。
慢慢地将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 前锯肌靠墙滑动
items.description: Sliding the forearms up a wall to wake up the serratus anterior. It helps with shoulder blade movement.
steps: Stand facing a wall with your forearms resting on it.
Keep your elbows at shoulder width.
Press into the wall and slide your arms up as high as you can.
Keep your ribs down and neck relaxed.
Slide back down slowly and repeat.

items.name: 剥猫式
items.description: A ring or bar move where you tuck up, pass the legs through the arms and then roll over the bar. It trains the back and shoulder mobility.
steps: 首先，将双臂完全伸展，身体放松地悬挂在杆上。
收紧核心并抬起双腿，使膝盖靠近胸部。
继续将双腿举过头顶，让身体穿过手臂。
一旦双腿完全伸过头顶，就开始将它们放回起始位置。
当你降低双腿时，让你的身体通过手臂向后移动，直到你再次完全伸展手臂悬挂。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 动态背部拉伸
items.description: A moving stretch for the back and sides that warms up the spine and shoulders.
steps: Stand with feet wider than hips and arms overhead.
Reach up and over to one side.
Return to center and reach to the other side.
Let your torso rotate slightly as you go.
Move smoothly for the reps.

items.name: 动物休息式瑜伽体式
items.description: A resting yoga pose that gently stretches the back and hips, similar to child pose.
steps: Kneel on a mat and sit back toward your heels.
Fold forward and stretch your arms ahead.
Rest your forehead on the floor.
Breathe deeply and hold for 30-60 seconds.
Release slowly.

items.name: 单腿上弓式
items.nameEn: one legged upward bow pose eka pada urdhva dhanurasana
items.description: A wheel pose with one leg lifted into the air. It adds balance and strength demand to the backbend.
steps: Come into wheel pose with hands and feet pressing down.
Shift weight onto one foot.
Lift the other leg toward the ceiling.
Keep your hips high and level.
Hold briefly, lower, then switch legs.

items.name: 单臂引体向上
items.description: An advanced pull-up using only one arm. Builds big lat and biceps strength and takes lots of practice.
steps: 面向引体向上杆站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
抬起手，用反握方式抓住杠铃，一只手握住杠铃，另一只手握住手腕以提供支撑。
悬挂在杠上，手臂完全伸展，保持身体伸直，核心肌群参与。
弯曲肘部并挤压背部肌肉，将自己拉向杠铃。
继续拉，直到下巴高于杠铃，然后慢慢降低回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂重复。

items.name: 单臂背阔肌拉伸
items.description: Reaching one arm overhead and leaning to the side stretches a single lat. Good for finding tight spots on each side.
steps: Stand tall and hold a pole or frame with one hand above head height.
Lean away from the arm and sit your hips slightly back to feel a stretch along your side.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

items.name: 单臂靠墙
items.description: Stand facing a wall and press one arm into it while you lean in. It switches on the lats and shoulder with no equipment.
steps: 面向墙壁站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
将一只手臂伸直到身前，将手掌靠在墙上。
启动你的核心，身体向前倾斜，保持手臂伸直，背部平坦。
用手掌慢慢推向墙壁，激活背阔肌。
保持该姿势几秒钟，然后松开并用另一只手臂重复该动作。

items.name: 原地甩臂
items.description: An arm swing from a stationary stance. It warms up the shoulders and upper back.
steps: Stand with feet shoulder width apart and arms at your sides.
Swing your arms up and back in a throwing motion.
Rotate through your torso slightly.
Keep the movement smooth and rhythmic.
Switch arms or alternate.
Continue for 20-30 seconds.

items.name: 双手悬挂背部拉伸(用肋木)
items.nameEn: two handed hang back stretch (with training wall bars)
items.description: Hanging from wall bars with both hands lets gravity stretch your lats and decompress your back. Great after heavy pulling days.
steps: Grip a wall bar overhead with both hands and walk your feet out slightly.
Let your body hang and sink your hips back, relaxing your upper back and shoulders.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

items.name: 双力臂
items.description: You pull yourself above a bar and then press up into a dip position. Trains the lats, chest and arms in a powerful transition.
steps: 首先悬挂在引体向上杆上，手掌背向自己，手臂完全伸展。
启动核心肌群，将身体拉向杠铃杆，以胸部为主导。
当你到达动作的最高点时，改变你的握力，使你的手掌朝向你。
继续将自己向上拉，直到胸部位于杠铃上方并且手臂完全弯曲。
通过慢慢降低自己回到起始位置来反转动作。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 双杠上推(垂直杆)
items.description: A muscle-up on a vertical bar, pulling up and then pressing over the top. It trains the lats, chest and triceps in one flowing move.
steps: 首先悬挂在垂直杆上，手掌背对自己，手臂完全伸展。
启动核心肌群，将身体拉向杠铃杆，以胸部为主导。
当你站起来时，稍微向后倾斜，并将肘部移向身体两侧。
继续拉，直到胸部到达杠铃并且肘部完全弯曲。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢降低回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 双杠架宽握引体向上
items.nameEn: wide grip pull up on dip cage
items.description: Wide-grip pull-up performed on the dip cage that emphasises the lats.
steps: Grab the wide handles with your palms facing forward.
Hang with your arms fully extended.
Pull yourself up by driving your elbows down and back.
Pause when your chin clears the bar.
Lower slowly to a full hang.

items.name: 双杠架锤式握引体向上
items.nameEn: hammer grip pull up on dip cage
items.description: Pull-up with palms facing each other on the dip cage handles, hitting the lats and arms.
steps: Grab the neutral grip handles with your palms facing each other.
Hang with your arms fully extended.
Pull your chest toward the handles by driving your elbows down.
Pause with your chin above the bars.
Lower slowly to a full hang.

items.name: 双脚触脚尖(男)
items.description: A standing forward bend reaching both hands toward the toes. It loosens the hamstrings and lower back.
steps: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双臂向两侧伸展。
腰部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直，膝盖稍微弯曲。
双手向下伸向脚趾，保持双腿伸直。
在底部停顿片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 双腿倒手杖式
items.nameEn: two legged inverted staff pose dwi pada viparita dandasana
items.description: A supported deep backbend resting on your forearms. It stretches the chest and spine.
steps: Start in a headstand or lie on your back with elbows on the floor.
Arch your back and bring your feet toward the floor.
Keep your forearms firm.
Stay in the backbend, breathing steadily.
Hold briefly, then come out carefully.

items.name: 反向划船
items.description: Lying beneath a bar with a straight body, you pull your chest to the bar. It builds the upper back and biceps.
steps: 在腰部高度设置一个杠铃或使用悬挂训练器。
面向杠铃或悬吊训练器站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
正手握住杠铃或手柄，握距略宽于肩宽。
向后倾斜，保持身体挺直，脚后跟着地。
将胸部拉向杠铃或手柄，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 反向划船 v. 2
items.description: Hanging beneath a bar, you pull your chest up with a straight body. This version changes the grip or angle. It builds the upper back and biceps.
steps: 在史密斯机上在腰部高度设置一根杠铃或使用悬挂训练器。
面向杠铃或悬吊训练器站立，用正手握法抓住它，双手与肩同宽。
双脚向前走，向后倾斜，直到身体呈轻微角度。
保持身体挺直，将胸部向上拉向杠铃或手柄，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢降低回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 反向划船滑行
items.description: A bodyweight row where your feet slide along the floor as you pull. It builds the lats and mid back.
steps: Lie under a bar or rings and grab with an overhand grip.
Keep your body straight with heels on a slick surface.
Pull your chest toward the bar while your feet slide forward.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly with control.

items.name: 反向宽握划船
items.description: An inverted row with a wide grip. The wide hands shift the work to the upper back and rear shoulders.
steps: Lie under a bar and grab it with a wide overhand grip.
Keep your body in a straight line, heels on the floor.
Pull your chest up toward the bar.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower under control to straight arms.

items.name: 反手引体向上
items.description: A pull-up with an underhand grip. Puts extra emphasis on the biceps along with the lats.
steps: 双手分开与肩同宽，反握抓住引体向上杆。
悬挂在杠上，双臂完全伸展，身体伸直。
调动背部肌肉，将身体拉向杠铃杆，以胸部为主导。
继续拉，直到下巴位于杠铃上方。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将身体放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 反手引体向上(窄距平行握)
items.description: A chin-up on a bar with a narrow parallel grip and the palms facing in. It works the lats, upper back and biceps.
steps: 用狭窄的平行握距悬挂在引体向上杆上，手掌朝向您。
收紧背部肌肉，将身体拉向杠铃杆，保持肘部靠近身体。
继续拉，直到下巴位于杠铃上方。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将身体放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 反握反向划船
items.description: A bodyweight row hanging under a bar with an underhand grip. Builds the back and biceps.
steps: Lie under a bar set at about waist height and grip it with palms facing you.
Hang with your body straight and heels on the floor.
Pull your chest toward the bar, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower with control until your arms are straight.

items.name: 反握反向背部划船
items.description: A bodyweight row under a low bar with an underhand grip. It builds the back and biceps.
steps: Set a bar at waist height and lie under it, gripping it with palms facing you.
Straighten your body from heels to head.
Pull your chest up to the bar, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower yourself under control until your arms are straight.
Keep your hips up the whole time.

items.name: 反握引体向上
items.description: Hang from a bar with an underhand grip and pull until your chin clears it. A classic builder of the lats and biceps.
steps: 悬挂在引体向上杆上，手掌朝向自己，双手与肩同宽。
启动核心肌群，将身体拉向杠铃杆，以胸部为主导。
继续拉，直到下巴位于杠铃上方。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将身体放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 反握引体向上(下蹲姿势)
items.description: A chin-up from a low bar while sitting in a squat, using your legs to share the work.
steps: Set a low bar and grip it with palms facing you.
Sit into a deep squat beneath it.
Pull your chest to the bar.
Lower back down.
Use your legs as little as possible.

items.name: 反握引体向上(等长与离心)
items.description: A chin-up variation focused on holding at the top and lowering slowly to build strength.
steps: Jump or step up so your chin is above the bar.
Hold the top position for a few seconds.
Lower yourself slowly over several seconds.
Reset on the floor.
Repeat for the reps.

items.name: 反握窄距引体向上
items.description: Chin-up style pull-up with a close underhand grip that puts extra work on the biceps along with the lats.
steps: Grip the bar with palms facing you, hands close together.
Hang with arms straight and shoulders pulled down.
Pull your elbows down and in until your chin is above the bar.
Lower under control to full arm extension.
Keep your legs still and avoid swinging.

items.name: 吉隆达胸骨引体
items.description: A chin-up variation where you pull toward the sternum. It builds the lats, upper back and biceps.
steps: 面向高杠站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
向上伸手，正手握住杠铃，握距略宽于肩宽。
悬挂在杠上，双臂完全伸展，身体伸直。
用你的背阔肌和二头肌将你的胸部拉向杠铃杆，以胸骨为主导。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢降低回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 吊带反向划船
items.description: Hanging from straps with a straight body, you row your chest up. It trains the upper back and biceps.
steps: 在胸部高度设置悬挂训练器或带子。
面向锚点站立，并用正手握住手柄。
双脚向前走，向后倾斜，直到身体呈一定角度。
保持身体挺直并启动核心。
将胸部拉向手柄，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 后仰杆拉伸
items.description: Hang from a bar with your body leaning back to stretch your lats and shoulders.
steps: Hold a bar with an overhand grip.
Lean your body back and let your arms and shoulders lengthen.
Relax your ribs and breathe slowly.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Step out of the stretch carefully.

items.name: 后撤步下拉
items.description: A step back with a downward arm pull that fires up the lats and legs.
steps: Stand tall with your arms overhead.
Step one foot back.
Pull your elbows down and in as if doing a pulldown.
Return your arms and foot to start.
Alternate legs at a steady pace.

items.name: 后水平举
items.description: A gymnastics hold hanging from a bar with the body horizontal and facing down. It trains the upper back, shoulders and core.
steps: 首先，用正手握法悬挂在引体向上杆上，双手分开的距离略大于肩宽。
启动你的核心并将肩胛骨向下拉和向后拉。
弯曲膝盖并将其向胸部靠拢。
慢慢抬起双腿，保持伸直，直到身体与地面平行。
保持这个姿势几秒钟，然后慢慢地将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 向前伸展上背部拉伸
items.description: Reaching forward with rounded shoulders opens up the space between your shoulder blades. It helps relieve a tight upper back.
steps: Stand or sit and clasp your hands or hold a support in front of you at chest height.
Round your upper back and push your hands forward while dropping your head between your arms.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

items.name: 四点支撑游泳式
items.description: A quadruped Pilates move with opposite arm and leg lifts for back stability.
steps: Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back.
Flutter them in small, quick pulses.
Keep your spine neutral and your hips level.
Switch sides and repeat.

items.name: 固定杆背部拉伸
items.description: Hold a fixed bar and sit your hips back to stretch your back and lats. It opens the upper body.
steps: Grip a fixed bar or post at about hip height.
Step back until your arms are straight.
Sink your hips back and let your chest drop.
Feel the stretch along your back and sides.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.

items.name: 地面T字上举
items.description: Lying face down, you lift your arms out to the sides into a T. It strengthens the mid and upper back.
steps: Lie face down with your arms out to the sides in a T.
Keep your forehead near the floor.
Turn your thumbs up toward the ceiling.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together and lift your arms.
Pause for a second.
Lower slowly and repeat.

items.name: 地面T字上举 v. 2
items.description: A face-down raise with the arms out to form a T. It strengthens the muscles between the shoulder blades.
steps: Lie face down with your arms out to the sides in a T.
Keep your forehead near the floor and neck neutral.
Lift your arms off the floor by pinching your shoulder blades.
Hold for a second at the top.
Lower with control.

items.name: 地面W形举臂
items.description: A prone raise that moves the arms into a W shape to strengthen the muscles between the shoulder blades.
steps: Lie face down with arms bent and elbows out to the sides.
Rest your forehead lightly on the floor.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together and lift your arms and chest slightly.
Form a W shape with your arms and hold for a second.
Lower slowly and repeat.

items.name: 地面反向划船滑行
items.description: An inverted row where you pull your body along the floor on sliders. It trains the back with core demand.
steps: Lie under a bar or lower support with sliders under your heels.
Grab the bar overhand.
Pull your chest toward the bar.
Keep your body straight.
Lower slowly.
Keep your hips up.

items.name: 地面挺身 v. 2
items.description: A face-down back lift that strengthens the spine and glutes.
steps: Lie face down with arms extended in front.
Lengthen your neck.
Lift your arms, chest and legs off the floor.
Hold briefly.
Lower slowly.

items.name: 地面毛巾滑动下拉
items.description: Slide your hands along the floor on a towel, from overhead down toward your sides. It teaches a pulldown pattern for the lats.
steps: Kneel or lie face down with your hands on towels on a smooth floor.
Start with your arms extended overhead.
Press down and pull your arms back toward your hips, sliding the towels.
Squeeze your lats at the end.
Slide the hands back overhead with control.
Keep your core braced.

items.name: 坐姿下背部拉伸
items.description: Seated on a chair, you lean forward to stretch the lower back. Hold it gently and breathe slowly.
steps: 坐在椅子边缘，双脚平放在地面上。
将双手放在大腿上或椅子两侧以获得支撑。
从臀部开始慢慢向前倾斜，保持背部挺直。
感受下背部的拉伸并保持 20-30 秒。
慢慢回到起始位置并重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 坐姿下躯干伸肌侧屈肌拉伸
items.nameEn: seated lower trunk extensor lateral flexor stretch
items.description: Seated, you fold forward and sideways to stretch both the lower back and the side of your trunk. It targets one side at a time.
steps: Sit tall on a chair or bench with your feet flat on the floor.
Fold forward and reach your hands toward one foot, letting your trunk bend slightly to that side.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

items.name: 坐姿下躯干伸肌拉伸
items.description: Seated and folding forward, you stretch the muscles along your lower back. A gentle way to ease lower back tightness.
steps: Sit on the floor or a bench with your knees slightly bent and your feet flat.
Round your back and fold your chest toward your thighs, letting your arms hang down.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

items.name: 坐姿侧伸拉伸
items.description: Seated, reaching over to the side stretches your lats and obliques. It is easy on the hips and good for desk breaks.
steps: Sit tall with your legs crossed or your feet flat and place one hand on the floor beside you.
Reach your other arm up and over your head toward the side, lengthening along your flank.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

items.name: 坐姿俯身背部拉伸
items.description: Sitting and bending over lets your upper body hang to stretch your whole back. A relaxed stretch to release tension.
steps: Sit on a bench or chair with your feet flat and your knees apart.
Bend forward from your hips and let your head and arms hang between your knees.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

items.name: 坐姿反手引体向上
items.description: A seated chin-up where your legs help a little while you pull up with an underhand grip. It builds back and arm strength.
steps: Sit under a bar with an underhand grip, shoulder-width apart.
Extend your legs in front of you.
Pull your chin toward the bar.
Squeeze your back and biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

items.name: 坐姿反手引体向上(低杠位置)
items.description: A seated chin-up using a low bar with an underhand grip. It lets you train the lats and biceps with a reduced load.
steps: Set a bar at a low height and sit under it.
Grab it with an underhand grip, arms extended.
Extend your legs in front with heels on the floor.
Pull your chest toward the bar.
Lower slowly to straight arms.

items.name: 坐姿夹背
items.description: Squeezing your shoulder blades together while seated. It strengthens the upper back and improves posture.
steps: Sit tall with arms at your sides or elbows bent.
Draw your shoulder blades back and together.
Hold the squeeze for 2-3 seconds.
Release slowly.
Keep your neck relaxed.
Repeat for your reps.

items.name: 坐姿并脚前伸拉伸
items.nameEn: sitting feet together reach forward stretch
items.description: Sitting with your soles together and reaching forward stretches your back and inner thighs. A gentle hip and back opener.
steps: Sit on the floor with the soles of your feet together and your knees falling out.
Hold your feet and fold forward from your hips, keeping your spine long.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

items.name: 坐姿引体向上
items.description: A pull-up from a seated position with your legs assisting. It builds lats and arms while reducing the load.
steps: Sit under a bar and grab it with an overhand grip.
Extend your legs in front of you.
Pull your chest up toward the bar.
Squeeze your back at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

items.name: 坐姿引体向上(低杠位置)
items.description: A seated pull-up on a low bar. It reduces the load compared with a full pull-up, which is good for building strength.
steps: Set a bar low and sit beneath it.
Grab it with an overhand grip, a little wider than your shoulders.
Extend your legs in front with heels on the floor.
Pull your chest to the bar.
Lower under control.

items.name: 坐姿引体向上(双腿垫高)
items.description: A seated pull-up with your feet raised on a bench, which increases the load. It builds the back and arms.
steps: Place your feet on a bench and sit under a bar.
Grab it with an overhand grip, arms extended.
Pull your chest up toward the bar.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the top.
Lower slowly to straight arms.

items.name: 坐姿突击队员引体向上
items.description: A seated pull-up with a staggered grip, pulling your head to alternating sides of the bar. It trains the lats and grip.
steps: Sit under a bar and grab it with one hand in front of the other.
Extend your legs in front of you.
Pull your body up and bring your head to one side.
Lower under control.
Alternate sides each rep or each set.

items.name: 坐姿等长保持引体向上
items.description: Holding the top of a pull up while seated helps you build pulling strength. It works the lats and arms.
steps: Set up a bar so you can sit under it.
Grab the bar with an overhand grip.
Pull yourself up until your chin is above the bar.
Hold the top position.
Hold for 5-10 seconds.
Lower down slowly.

items.name: 坐姿肩胛内收
items.description: A seated drill squeezing the shoulder blades together. It strengthens the muscles that support good posture.
steps: Sit tall with arms relaxed at your sides or held in front.
Keep your neck relaxed.
Pull your shoulder blades together and slightly down.
Hold the squeeze for 2-3 seconds.
Release slowly and repeat.

items.name: 坐姿肩胛内收 v. 2
items.description: A variation of the seated shoulder blade squeeze with the arms held out. It strengthens the upper back and posture muscles.
steps: Sit tall with elbows bent and hands by your ribs.
Keep your neck relaxed.
Draw your elbows back and pinch your shoulder blades together.
Hold for 2-3 seconds.
Return slowly and repeat.

items.name: 坐姿背后上举
items.description: Lifting your arms behind your back while seated. It strengthens the upper back and rear shoulders.
steps: Sit tall with hands clasped behind your back.
Straighten your arms.
Lift your hands slightly away from your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly.
Keep your chest lifted.

items.name: 坐姿脉冲夹背
items.description: Small pulses while squeezing your shoulder blades together seated. It strengthens the upper back.
steps: Sit tall with elbows bent.
Draw your shoulder blades together.
Pulse your elbows back in small movements.
Keep your shoulders down.
Maintain the squeeze throughout.
Continue for 20-30 seconds.

items.name: 坐姿菱形肌拉伸
items.description: A seated stretch that opens the space between the shoulder blades. It relieves tightness in the upper back.
steps: Sit tall and clasp your hands in front of your chest.
Push your arms forward and round your upper back.
Tuck your chin slightly and spread the shoulder blades apart.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
Release slowly and repeat.

items.name: 大幅转体背部拉伸
items.description: A standing or seated rotation that opens the back and the side of the trunk. Good for easing stiffness through the spine.
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and arms out in front.
Slowly rotate your upper body to one side, leading with the arms.
Keep your hips facing forward as much as you can.
Turn until you feel a comfortable stretch through the back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Return to center and repeat on the other side.

items.name: 天鹅俯冲
items.description: A rocking Pilates move on your belly that builds back extensor strength and control.
steps: Lie face down with your hands under your shoulders and legs together.
Press up into a swan, lifting your chest off the mat.
Let your arms float forward as you rock your chest and legs up.
Rock back and forth in a smooth, controlled rhythm.
Keep your neck long and your abs gently drawn in.

items.name: 婴儿式
items.description: Fold forward over your knees with arms extended on the floor. A restful stretch for the back, hips and shoulders.
steps: Kneel on the floor with big toes touching and knees apart.
Sit your hips back toward your heels.
Fold forward and slide your arms out in front of you.
Rest your forehead on the floor and relax your shoulders.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.

items.name: 婴儿式转眼镜蛇式
items.description: A yoga flow that moves from a resting child pose into a gentle backbend, mobilising the spine.
steps: Start in child pose, knees apart, arms stretched forward.
Shift forward and lower your chest toward the floor.
Slide forward and press into your hands to lift your chest into cobra.
Keep your hips down and your shoulders away from your ears.
Hold for a few breaths.
Push back into child pose and repeat.

items.name: 宽握反手引体向上
items.description: A chin-up with a wider underhand grip. It hits the lats and biceps.
steps: Hang from a bar with an underhand grip wider than shoulders.
Brace your core.
Pull until your chin is over the bar.
Squeeze your back at the top.
Lower slowly to a full hang.

items.name: 宽握坐姿引体向上
items.description: A wide-grip pull from a seated start position. It trains the lats and upper back with a lower starting load than a full pull-up.
steps: Sit under a pull-up bar and take a wide overhand grip.
Hang with arms extended and your chest lifted.
Pull your elbows down and toward your ribs to bring your chest toward the bar.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower yourself slowly to full arm extension.

items.name: 宽握引体向上
items.description: A pull-up on a wide overhand grip, pulling your chin above the bar. It targets the lats and upper back.
steps: 悬挂在引体向上杆上，手掌背向自己，双手之间的距离比肩宽。
启动你的核心并将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
将身体向上拉向杠铃，直到下巴位于杠铃上方。
有控制地降低身体回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 宽握颈后引体向上
items.description: A pull-up on a wide overhand grip, pulling to the back of your neck or upper chest. It targets the lats and upper back.
steps: 正手宽握抓住引体向上杆，双手间距略宽于肩宽。
悬挂在杠上，双臂完全伸展，身体伸直。
调动背部肌肉，将身体拉向杠铃杆，以胸部为主导。
继续拉，直到下巴位于杠铃上方。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将身体放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 对角弯腰保持
items.description: A standing diagonal bend held for a stretch through the back and side of the body.
steps: Stand with feet wider than your hips.
Reach one arm overhead and toward the opposite foot.
Bend diagonally, keeping your hips facing forward.
Reach only as far as is comfortable.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Return to standing and switch sides.

items.name: 小狗式
items.description: A half child's pose with arms reaching forward and hips high. Opens the shoulders and the back.
steps: Start on hands and knees with your hips over your knees.
Walk your hands forward and lower your chest toward the floor.
Keep your hips high above your knees.
Rest your forehead down and hold for 5 slow breaths.
Walk your hands back to return.

items.name: 屈膝反向划船
items.description: A bodyweight row beneath a bar with knees bent to make it easier. Builds the upper back and biceps.
steps: 在腰部高度设置一根横杆，然后躺在其下方。
正手握住杠铃，握距略宽于肩宽。
调整身体位置，使脚后跟着地，身体伸直。
将肩胛骨挤压在一起，将胸部向上拉向杠铃。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将身体放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 屈臂反手引体向上
items.description: A chin-up holding the arms bent at the top. It builds strength in the lats and biceps.
steps: Hang from a bar with an underhand, shoulder-width grip.
Pull yourself up until your chin clears the bar.
Keep your elbows bent and your body still.
Hold briefly at the top.
Lower slowly until just short of straight arms.

items.name: 山羊挺身
items.description: Using a hyperextension bench, you lower and raise your torso. It strengthens the lower back, glutes and hamstrings.
steps: 调整过度伸展凳，使大腿上部放在垫子上并且双脚固定。
双臂交叉放在胸前或将双手放在脑后。
将上半身压向地面，同时保持背部挺直。
在底部停顿片刻，然后抬起上半身，直到与双腿成一直线。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 山羊挺身 v. 2
items.description: Back extension on a bench that strengthens the lower back, glutes and hamstrings.
steps: Set the pad at hip level and hook your heels under the rollers.
Cross your arms over your chest and keep your body straight.
Bend forward at the hips with a flat back.
Lift your torso until it forms a straight line with your legs.
Do not overarch at the top, then lower with control.

items.name: 山羊挺身(凳上)
items.description: Lying face-down on a bench, you raise your torso and lower it. It builds the lower back, glutes and hamstrings.
steps: 调整过度伸展凳，使臀部舒适地放在垫子上，并且双脚固定。
双臂交叉放在胸前或将双手放在脑后。
慢慢地将上半身降低到地面，同时保持背部挺直。
在底部停顿片刻，然后抬起上半身，直到与双腿成一直线。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 左右引体
items.description: You pull yourself up to one side of the bar, then slide across to the other. Builds the lats, arms and grip.
steps: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，膝盖稍微弯曲。
正手握住引体向上杆，双手之间的距离略大于肩宽。
悬挂在杠上，双臂完全伸展，身体放松。
弯曲肘部并将下巴朝向杠铃杆，将自己拉起，同时保持身体挺直。
一旦你的下巴高于杠铃，就将自己放低回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 平行杠屈膝反向划船
items.nameEn: parallel bars bent knee inverted row
items.description: Easier bodyweight row under parallel bars with knees bent.
steps: Lie under parallel bars and grab them.
Bend your knees with feet on the floor.
Keep your body straight from shoulders to knees.
Pull your chest to the bars.
Lower slowly.

items.name: 床单反向划船
items.description: A bodyweight row using a bed sheet looped around a sturdy anchor, such as a closed door.
steps: Anchor a bed sheet securely and hold both ends.
Lean back with your body straight.
Pull your chest toward your hands.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower yourself slowly.

items.name: 床单后三角肌划船
items.nameEn: rear delt row with bed sheet
items.description: A rowing pattern that uses a bed sheet anchored around a door handle or post to work the upper back.
steps: Loop a bed sheet around a sturdy anchor and hold the ends.
Lean back with your arms straight.
Pull your hands toward your chest, elbows flared out.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Return slowly.

items.name: 开书式拉伸
items.description: A lying rotation that opens the chest and mid back, good for thoracic mobility and tight shoulders.
steps: Lie on your side with your knees bent and stacked, arms straight in front of you.
Keep your knees together and lift the top arm up and over.
Rotate your chest open toward the ceiling, following your hand with your eyes.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Return the arm and repeat, then switch sides.

items.name: 弓步引体向上
items.description: A wide pull-up where you pull toward one hand while the other arm stays straight. It builds lat strength on the way to the one arm pull-up.
steps: 首先，用正手握法悬挂在引体向上杆上，握距略宽于肩宽。
启动你的核心并将肩胛骨向下拉和向后拉。
当你站起来时，弯曲一只手臂并将肘部移向身体一侧，同时保持另一只手臂伸直。
继续拉，直到下巴位于杠铃上方并且弯曲的手臂完全弯曲。
有控制地放低自己，伸直弯曲的手臂并在另一侧重复该动作。
每次重复时交替进行。

items.name: 引体向上
items.description: You hang from a bar with an overhand grip and pull your chin above it. A classic builder for the lats and upper back.
steps: 悬挂在引体向上杆上，手掌背向自己，手臂完全伸展。
启动你的核心并将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
弯曲肘部并将胸部拉向杠铃杆，将身体向上拉向杠铃杆。
在动作的最高点暂停，然后慢慢降低身体回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 引体向上(中立握)
items.description: You hang from a bar with a neutral grip and pull your chin above it. Works the lats and biceps with a shoulder friendly grip.
steps: 用中立握法（手掌相对）悬挂在引体向上杆上，双臂完全伸展。
启动你的核心并将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
弯曲肘部并将肘部向下推向臀部，将身体向上拉向杠铃。
继续拉，直到下巴位于杠铃上方。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后有控制地慢慢将身体放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 引体向上(离心)
items.description: Slow lowering phase of a pull-up that builds strength for full pull-ups.
steps: Jump or step up so your chin is above the bar.
Grip the bar slightly wider than your shoulders.
Lower yourself slowly over 3-5 seconds.
Stop at a full hang with straight arms.
Step back up and repeat.

items.name: 引体向上顶端保持
items.description: Holding the top of a pull-up with your chin above the bar. It builds strength and grip in the finish position.
steps: Grab a pull-up bar and pull yourself up.
Bring your chin above the bar.
Squeeze your shoulder blades down and back.
Hold for 5-15 seconds.
Lower yourself slowly.
Keep your body still.

items.name: 徒手侧卧肩外旋
items.nameEn: bodyweight side lying shoulder external rotation
items.description: A side-lying outward shoulder rotation with no weight. It trains rotator cuff control.
steps: Lie on your side with a small towel under the top elbow.
Bend the elbow to 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm up toward the ceiling.
Pause, then lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

items.name: 徒手俯卧Y字
items.description: Lie face down and raise your arms into a Y shape. It strengthens the lower traps and shoulder stabilizers.
steps: Lie face down with your arms extended overhead in a Y.
Turn your thumbs toward the ceiling.
Lift your arms off the floor, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Hold briefly at the top.
Lower with control and repeat.

items.name: 徒手双杠上推 v. 2
items.description: An advanced pull-up that transitions into a dip above a bar. It builds serious pulling and pushing strength.
steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with a false or standard grip.
Pull explosively, bringing the bar toward your lower chest.
Lean forward and rotate your wrists over the bar.
Press up until your arms are fully straight.
Lower yourself back down with control.

items.name: 徒手杰斐逊弯举
items.description: A slow forward bend that rolls through the spine one segment at a time. It builds back and hamstring mobility.
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Tuck your chin and roll down one vertebra at a time.
Let your arms hang toward the floor.
Reach only as far as is comfortable.
Reverse slowly to stand.
Move with control and keep the load light.

items.name: 徒手站姿肩胛划船
items.description: A standing drill where you squeeze your shoulder blades together with no weight. It wakes up the mid back and helps posture.
steps: Stand tall with your arms out in front or at your sides.
Keep your arms mostly straight.
Pull your shoulder blades back and together.
Hold the squeeze for a second.
Release slowly.
Avoid shrugging your shoulders to your ears.

items.name: 徒手站姿背部拉伸
items.description: A standing stretch that opens up the back. It is a gentle way to loosen tight muscles along the spine.
steps: Stand tall with feet hip width apart.
Clasp your hands in front of you and press your arms forward.
Round your upper back and tuck your chin slightly.
Feel the stretch between your shoulder blades and along the spine.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release slowly and stand tall.

items.name: 徒手站姿胸椎推举
items.description: A standing movement that presses the arms overhead to open up the thoracic spine. It improves upper back extension.
steps: Stand with your feet hip width apart.
Clasp your hands in front of your chest.
Press your arms up and slightly back while lifting your chest.
Extend through your upper back without flaring your ribs.
Return to the start under control.
Repeat for smooth, slow reps.

items.name: 徒手站姿过头耸肩
items.description: A shrug done with your arms overhead. It wakes up the upper traps and builds shoulder awareness.
steps: Stand tall and raise your arms straight overhead.
Keep your ribs down and core tight.
Shrug your shoulders up toward your ears.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly and repeat.

items.name: 徒手耸肩
items.description: A shoulder shrug without weight for warming up or light trap work.
steps: Stand tall with arms by your sides.
Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Hold for a second.
Lower them slowly.
Avoid rolling your shoulders.

items.name: 悬垂肩胛耸肩
items.description: A hang from a bar where you pull your shoulder blades down and up. It strengthens the upper back and improves shoulder control.
steps: Hang from a pull up bar with straight arms.
Relax your shoulders up toward your ears.
Pull your shoulder blades down, lifting your body slightly.
Pause briefly.
Relax back to the hang.
Keep your elbows straight.

items.name: 悬挂带划船
items.description: A bodyweight row with suspension handles, leaning back and pulling the chest to the hands. It trains the back and biceps.
steps: 将悬挂训练器设置在适当的高度。
面向锚点站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
正手握住手柄，手掌相对。
向后倾斜，保持身体挺直，脚后跟着地。
将胸部拉向手柄，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 战绳拉
items.description: A rope pull that brings the rope toward you, working the back, arms and grip with a conditioning effect.
steps: Anchor the rope and hold the ends in a staggered stance.
Lean back slightly with your core tight.
Pull the rope toward you hand over hand.
Keep your chest tall and drive with your legs.
Return smoothly and repeat.

items.name: 手走式背阔肌拉伸
items.description: Walk your hands out and sit your hips back to stretch the lats. It opens the sides of the back.
steps: Stand and hinge forward to place your hands on the floor.
Walk your hands out in front of you.
Sit your hips back and press your chest down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Walk your hands back in and stand up.

items.name: 抬肘反向俯卧撑
items.description: A floor push-up variation that lifts the upper body with elbows close to your sides. Works the upper back and posture muscles.
steps: 首先，脸朝下躺在地上，双腿伸展，双手直接放在肩膀下方。
收紧核心并用手掌按压，将上半身抬离地面，保持肘部靠近身体两侧。
在顶部暂停片刻，挤压上背部肌肉。
慢慢地将身体放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 拍背环抱拉伸
items.description: Swing your arms across your body, wrapping them around the trunk. It loosens the upper back and shoulders.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Swing your arms wide.
Wrap them around your body so the hands slap your upper back.
Open them wide again.
Keep it loose and rhythmic.

items.name: 推伸触及
items.description: A quadruped drill that threads one arm under the body to free up the upper back and shoulders.
steps: Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Slide one arm under your body, palm up, reaching across.
Let your shoulder and head lower toward the floor.
Hold briefly, then pull the arm back.
Reach it up toward the ceiling, following with your eyes.
Repeat, then switch sides.

items.name: 摆动式双杠上推
items.description: A pull-up bar move where you use a swing to get above the bar and then press out. Trains lats, arms and chest, and needs good control.
steps: 首先，用正手握法悬挂在引体向上杆上，双手分开的距离略大于肩宽。
启动你的核心并使用摆动动作来产生动力。
当你向前挥杆时，将胸部拉向杠铃，用背阔肌和二头肌开始动作。
继续向上运动，直到胸部到达杠铃，然后向下推杠铃并伸展手臂，过渡到双臂屈伸姿势。
弯曲手臂并控制下降，将自己放回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 摇摆
items.description: A rocking move on the stomach that stretches the front and strengthens the back.
steps: Lie face down and reach back to hold your ankles.
Lift your chest and legs.
Rock forward and back.
Keep your movement smooth.
Lower down to finish.

items.name: 撞头
items.description: A gentle bending drill that works the back and hips. The motion loosens your spine and posterior chain.
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hands behind your head.
Soften your knees.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back.
Nod your head slightly and return to standing.
Move at a smooth pace.
Keep your neck relaxed.

items.name: 斜向拉伸
items.description: A standing side-leaning stretch that opens up the lats and the side of the torso.
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Raise one arm overhead and keep the other hand resting on your hip.
Lean slowly toward the opposite side, lengthening along the raised arm.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
Return to upright and switch sides.

items.name: 桌下反向划船
items.description: Pull your chest up to the underside of a sturdy table to train the back and arms using your own weight.
steps: Lie under a sturdy table and grip the edge with both hands.
Extend your legs with heels on the floor and body in a straight line.
Pull your chest toward the table edge, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower with control until your arms are straight.
Keep your hips up the whole time.

items.name: 桌下屈膝反向划船
items.nameEn: inverted row bent knee under table
items.description: An easier inverted row with bent knees, pulling up to a sturdy table to build back strength.
steps: Lie under a sturdy table and grip the edge with both hands.
Bend your knees and plant your feet on the floor.
Lift your hips so your body forms a line from knees to shoulders.
Pull your chest to the table edge, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly and repeat.

items.name: 桥式瑜伽拉伸
items.description: A deep backbend where you press up from the floor, opening the chest and hips and strengthening the back of the body.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat near your hips.
Place your hands beside your head, palms down, fingers toward your shoulders.
Press through hands and feet to lift your hips and chest.
Straighten your arms as far as is comfortable and relax your neck.
Hold for 15-30 seconds, then lower slowly.

items.name: 棍棒背阔肌拉伸
items.description: A standing stretch that uses a stick to pull the arm overhead and open up the side of your back. Good for tight lats and overhead mobility.
steps: Stand tall and grip the stick with both hands, one end held high.
Reach the stick overhead and lean gently away from the higher hand.
Keep your hips square and your ribs from flaring out.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling the stretch along your side and back.
Return to upright and switch sides.

items.name: 椅上坐姿猫牛式拉伸
items.nameEn: sitting cat cow stretch on a chair
items.description: A gentle spinal stretch you can do on a chair. It moves your back through flexion and extension to ease stiffness.
steps: Sit tall on a chair with your hands on your knees and feet flat.
Inhale, arch your back and lift your chest.
Exhale, round your spine and tuck your chin.
Move slowly between the two positions.
Repeat for 8-10 breaths.

items.name: 椅上坐姿过头拉伸
items.nameEn: seated overhead stretch on a chair
items.description: A simple seated stretch that opens up the sides of your back and shoulders.
steps: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Interlace your fingers and raise your arms overhead.
Turn your palms to the ceiling and reach up tall.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.

items.name: 椅间反向划船
items.description: A bodyweight row under a sturdy support between two chairs for the upper back and arms.
steps: Set a sturdy bar or table edge between two stable chairs and lie under it.
Grip the support with straight arms and your body in a plank line.
Pull your chest toward the support.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your hips up the whole time.

items.name: 椅间反手握反向划船
items.nameEn: inverted underhand grip row between chairs
items.description: An inverted row with an underhand grip on a bar between two chairs.
steps: Set a bar across two stable chairs.
Lie under it and grip underhand.
Keep your legs straight with heels on the floor.
Pull your chest to the bar.
Lower slowly.
Keep your body in a line.

items.name: 椅间坐姿引体向上
items.description: A seated pull-up using a bar between two chairs, with the legs assisting.
steps: Set a bar across two sturdy chairs.
Sit on the floor beneath it and grip the bar.
Keep your legs bent for light help.
Pull your chest toward the bar.
Lower with control.
Use your legs as little as possible.

items.name: 椅间屈膝反向划船
items.nameEn: inverted row with bent knee between chairs
items.description: A home row where you hang under a bar or broom handle set across two chairs, knees bent to make it easier. It trains the back and biceps.
steps: Set a sturdy bar across two stable chairs and lie underneath it.
Grip the bar overhand, arms straight, knees bent and feet flat.
Keep your body in a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Pull your chest up toward the bar, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight again.
Make sure the chairs cannot slide.

items.name: 椅间屈膝引体向上
items.nameEn: pull up with bent knee between chairs
items.description: A beginner-friendly pull-up built from a bar across two chairs, with the feet on the floor and knees bent. It builds lats and arm pulling strength.
steps: Set a sturdy bar across two stable chairs, high enough to sit under.
Sit or lie beneath it and grip the bar slightly wider than your shoulders.
Keep your knees bent with feet on the floor for light help.
Pull your chest toward the bar by driving elbows down.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Use your legs as little as you can.

items.name: 死悬垂拉伸
items.description: Hanging from a bar to stretch the lats and shoulders. It also decompresses the spine.
steps: Grab a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, hands shoulder width apart.
Hang with your arms straight and feet off the floor.
Relax your shoulders and let your body lengthen.
Breathe steadily.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.

items.name: 毛巾俯身划船
items.description: A row using a towel for resistance. It trains your back and arms with no equipment.
steps: Hold a towel with both hands and stretch it taut.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back.
Pull the towel toward your chest while pulling it apart.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly.

items.name: 毛巾单臂划船
items.description: A one-arm row using a towel while hinged forward. Trains the upper back and builds grip strength.
steps: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，膝盖微曲，单手握住毛巾。
腰部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
完全伸展手臂，让毛巾挂在您面前。
将毛巾拉向胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将毛巾放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

items.name: 毛巾坐姿划船
items.description: A seated row using a towel for resistance. It trains your lats and upper back.
steps: Sit with your legs extended and loop a towel around your feet.
Hold the ends with arms straight.
Pull the towel toward your lower ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Extend your arms slowly.

items.name: 毛巾滑行地面下拉 v. 2
items.nameEn: sliding floor pulldown on towel v. 2
items.description: A floor pulldown where you slide your hands on a towel from overhead to your sides. It works the lats without any equipment.
steps: Kneel with your hands on a towel placed on a smooth floor, arms stretched forward.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Pull your elbows down and back as your hands slide toward you.
Squeeze your lats at the bottom.
Slide back out slowly to the start.

items.name: 毛巾超人式划船
items.description: Lie face down with a towel held taut overhead, lift your chest and pull the towel toward you, training the upper back and spine.
steps: Lie face down with arms extended overhead, holding a towel taut.
Lift your chest and arms slightly off the floor.
Pull the towel down toward your upper chest, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Extend your arms forward again with control.
Keep your neck neutral and repeat.

items.name: 洛基引体向上下拉
items.description: A pull-up bar move that mixes a pull-up with a controlled pulldown. Builds the lats, upper back and arms.
steps: 站在引体向上杆前，双脚分开与肩同宽。
向上伸手，正手握住杠铃，握距略宽于肩宽。
悬挂在杠上，双臂完全伸展，身体伸直。
调动背部肌肉，将身体拉向杠铃杆，以胸部为主导。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将身体放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 混合握引体向上
items.description: A chin-up with one hand overhand and one underhand. Builds the lats, biceps and grip, and you switch hands between sets.
steps: 反握（手掌朝向自己）抓住引体向上杆，双手之间的距离略大于肩宽。
悬挂在杠上，双臂完全伸展，双脚离开地面。
调动背部肌肉，将身体拉向杠铃杆，以胸部为主导。
继续拉，直到下巴位于杠铃上方。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后有控制地慢慢将身体放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 游泳式
items.description: A prone Pilates exercise with alternating arm and leg flutters that trains the back and glutes.
steps: Lie face down with arms extended overhead and legs long.
Lift your arms, chest and legs slightly off the mat.
Flutter opposite arm and leg up and down in a quick, small rhythm.
Keep your abs drawn in and your neck long.
Continue for 20-30 seconds, then rest.

items.name: 游泳打腿
items.description: Lying face down, you flutter your legs like a swimmer. It works the lower back and glutes.
steps: Lie face down with your arms extended in front.
Lift your chest and legs slightly off the floor.
Kick your legs up and down in small, fast alternations.
Keep your neck long.
Breathe steadily.
Continue for 20-30 seconds.

items.name: 游泳者髋部
items.description: A prone floor move where opposite arm and leg lift in alternation, training the back and glutes.
steps: Lie face down with your arms extended overhead and your legs straight.
Lift your chest slightly and brace your glutes.
Raise one arm and the opposite leg a few inches.
Switch sides in a controlled flutter.
Keep your neck neutral and breathe steadily.

items.name: 爆发式推离
items.description: An explosive push away from a wall or support to train the upper back.
steps: Stand facing a wall and lean in with arms extended.
Push away from the wall forcefully.
Retract your shoulder blades as you reach back.
Return to the wall with control.
Keep your core tight.
Reset between reps.

items.name: 牛式瑜伽体式
items.description: A gentle spinal extension from all fours that wakes up the back and often pairs with cat pose.
steps: Start on hands and knees, with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips.
Inhale and let your belly drop toward the floor.
Lift your chest and tailbone while your gaze goes slightly forward.
Keep your shoulders away from your ears.
Hold for 3-5 breaths.
Return to a neutral spine.

items.name: 犁式瑜伽姿势
items.description: An inverted yoga pose where the legs are lowered behind the head. It stretches the spine, shoulders and hamstrings.
steps: Lie on your back with your arms by your sides.
Lift your legs and hips up and over, supporting your lower back with your hands if needed.
Lower your toes toward the floor behind your head.
Keep your neck relaxed and do not turn your head.
Hold for 15-30 seconds, then roll down slowly one vertebra at a time.

items.name: 狮身人面式
items.description: Lie face down and prop yourself up on your forearms with your chest lifted. It gently extends the spine and opens the chest.
steps: 面朝下躺在地上，前臂平放在地板上，肘部直接位于肩膀下方。
收紧核心肌群，将胸部抬离地面，将前臂和脚趾保持在地板上。
保持这个姿势几秒钟，确保颈部保持在中立位置。
慢慢地将胸部放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 猫式
items.description: Round your spine upward from hands and knees to stretch the back. A gentle way to loosen the spine and wake up the core.
steps: Start on all fours with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips.
Exhale and press the floor away as you round your back toward the ceiling.
Tuck your chin toward your chest and draw your belly in.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.
Inhale and return to a neutral back.

items.name: 猫式拉伸
items.description: A gentle spinal stretch on hands and knees, rounding the back like a cat. It loosens the spine.
steps: Start on hands and knees with hands under shoulders.
Tuck your chin and round your back toward the ceiling.
Draw your belly button in and hold for a few breaths.
Return to a neutral spine.
Repeat slowly, holding the rounded position 15-20 seconds.

items.name: 猫牛式拉伸
items.description: A gentle spinal flow between arching and rounding the back to loosen the spine.
steps: Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Inhale and drop your belly, lifting your chest and tailbone into cow.
Exhale and round your back toward the ceiling into cat.
Tuck your chin and pull your belly in.
Move slowly between the two positions.
Repeat for 10-12 breaths.

items.name: 环绕世界超人式
items.description: A superman hold where the arms sweep in a circle. It works the lower back, glutes and shoulders.
steps: Lie face down with your arms extended overhead.
Lift your chest, arms and legs off the floor.
Sweep your arms out to the sides toward your hips.
Return them overhead in a wide arc.
Keep your legs lifted.
Lower to the floor to rest.

items.name: 电梯式撑起
items.description: A bodyweight hinge forward and back up again with the hands on the hips. It works the upper back and the muscles along the spine.
steps: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，膝盖稍微弯曲。
将双手放在臀部或交叉放在胸前。
保持背部挺直，腰部慢慢向前弯曲，将上半身向地面降低。
在底部停顿片刻，然后慢慢抬起上半身回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 盘腿坐姿前伸拉伸
items.nameEn: sitting cross legged reach forward stretch
items.description: Sitting cross-legged and reaching forward opens your lower back and hips. It is a calm stretch that suits cooldowns.
steps: Sit on the floor with your legs crossed and your back tall.
Walk your hands forward along the floor and fold from your hips until you feel a stretch.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

items.name: 离心单臂引体向上
items.description: A slow lowering phase of a one-arm pull-up. It builds the strength needed for the full move.
steps: Get into the top position of a pull-up, with one hand on the bar and the other assisting or at rest.
Let go of any help and shift your weight onto the working arm.
Lower yourself as slowly as you can until your arm is straight.
Keep your body tight and avoid swinging.
Step back up to the top and repeat, then switch arms.

items.name: 穿针式
items.description: A gentle twist from hands and knees. Loosens the upper back and shoulders.
steps: Start on hands and knees.
Slide one arm under your chest and rest your shoulder on the floor.
Keep your hips over your knees.
Hold for 5 slow breaths.
Return and switch arms.

items.name: 突击队员引体向上
items.description: A pull-up with a staggered, side-on grip that you pull to alternating sides of the bar. It builds lats, arms and grip.
steps: Grab the bar with one hand in front of the other, palms facing each other, and hang with arms straight.
Brace your core and pull your body up, moving your head to one side of the bar.
Get your chin or shoulder level with the bar.
Lower under control to a full hang.
Switch which side your head passes on each rep, or each set.

items.name: 窄握上半程引体向上
items.description: A partial pull-up with a narrow grip, done in the top half of the range. It focuses on the upper phase of the pull.
steps: Grab a pull-up bar with a narrow grip and pull up to the top position.
Lower yourself to about halfway.
Pull back up until your chin clears the bar.
Keep your chest up and your elbows close.
Avoid swinging.
Repeat for your reps.

items.name: 窄握反握引体向上
items.description: A chin-up with your hands close together on an underhand grip. It works the lats and puts extra load on the biceps.
steps: 抓住引体向上杆，手掌朝向自己，双手与肩同宽。
悬挂在杠上，双臂完全伸展，双脚离开地面。
收紧背部肌肉，将身体拉向杠铃杆，保持肘部靠近身体。
继续拉，直到下巴位于杠铃上方。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将身体放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 窄握坐姿反手引体向上
items.description: A seated chin-up with a narrow underhand grip, using your legs for some help. It builds the lats and biceps.
steps: Sit under a low bar with your hands close together, palms facing you.
Extend your legs in front with heels on the floor.
Pull your chest up toward the bar.
Squeeze your back and arms at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

items.name: 窄握引体向上
items.description: Pull-up using a narrow overhand grip to emphasise the lower lats and arms.
steps: Grip the bar with hands a few centimetres apart, palms facing away.
Hang with straight arms and engage your shoulders.
Pull yourself up until your chin passes the bar.
Lower slowly to a full hang.
Keep your core tight and avoid swinging.

items.name: 站姿上举背部旋转拉伸
items.nameEn: standing reach up back rotation stretch
items.description: Reaching one arm up and rotating your trunk stretches the lats and the muscles around your spine. It also gives your mid back some rotation.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and reach one arm overhead.
Rotate your upper body gently away from the raised arm and reach up and over.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

items.name: 站姿侧向拉伸
items.description: A standing side bend that stretches the lats and the muscles along the side of the torso. It loosens up the sides and improves mobility.
steps: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，膝盖稍微弯曲。
将双臂伸直至两侧，与地面平行。
慢慢将上半身向一侧倾斜，感觉侧面和背阔肌有拉伸感。
保持拉伸 15-30 秒。
返回起始位置并在另一侧重复。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 站姿弓步拉弓
items.description: A standing movement that rotates the torso and draws one arm back like pulling a bow. It mobilises the upper back and shoulders.
steps: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，膝盖稍微弯曲。
将双臂伸直至前方，与肩同高，与地面平行。
将躯干向右旋转，保持双臂伸展，背部挺直。
旋转时，向前伸展右臂，向后伸展左臂，模仿拉弓弦的动作。
保持该姿势片刻，然后回到起始位置。
重复该动作，这次将躯干向左旋转，左臂向前伸展，右臂向后伸展。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

items.name: 站姿毛巾外旋滑动
items.nameEn: standing external rotation slide with towel
items.description: A towel slide that rotates the shoulder outward. It strengthens the back of the shoulder.
steps: Stand side-on to a wall with a towel under your forearm.
Keep your elbow at 90 degrees, tucked at your side.
Slide your hand outward along the wall.
Return slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

items.name: 站姿毛巾靠墙前锯肌滑动
items.nameEn: standing wall serratus slide with towel
items.description: A towel slide up the wall that works the muscle along the ribs. It supports healthy shoulder blade motion.
steps: Stand facing a wall with a towel under your forearm on the wall.
Keep your elbow bent and your body upright.
Slide your arm upward along the wall.
Reach the top without shrugging.
Slide back down slowly and switch arms.

items.name: 站姿海豹式瑜伽体式
items.description: A standing back-bending pose that opens the chest and front of the hips and stretches the abdomen.
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart and your hands on your lower back.
Lengthen through your spine.
Lift your chest and gently arch backward.
Keep your neck relaxed and your legs strong.
Hold for 15-30 seconds, then come back up slowly.

items.name: 站姿肩胛旋转
items.description: A standing drill that moves the shoulder blades in circles. It improves shoulder mobility and control.
steps: Stand tall with arms relaxed at your sides.
Lift your shoulders up toward your ears.
Roll them back, then down.
Bring them forward and up again in a circle.
Reverse the direction after several reps.

items.name: 站姿肩胛旋转(正视)
items.description: A standing shoulder blade rotation that warms up the upper back and improves control of the scapulae.
steps: Stand tall with your arms at your sides.
Lift your shoulders gently up.
Roll them back and down in a smooth circle.
Reverse the direction.
Keep your neck relaxed.
Repeat for the planned reps.

items.name: 站姿背后毛巾外旋
items.nameEn: standing external rotation behind back with towel
items.description: Holding a towel behind your back to rotate the shoulder outward. It improves shoulder control.
steps: Stand tall holding a towel behind your back with both hands.
Keep the lower hand still and pull the upper hand away.
Rotate the upper shoulder outward.
Hold briefly and release.
Finish your reps, then switch hands.

items.name: 站姿背部伸展与屈曲
items.description: A standing movement where you arch and then round your back. It warms up your spine.
steps: Stand with your feet hip width apart and hands on your hips.
Gently arch your back and look slightly up.
Round your back and tuck your chin.
Move slowly between positions.
Stay within a comfortable range.

items.name: 站姿背部旋转拉伸
items.description: Rotating through your trunk while standing stretches your back and obliques. It is a quick way to loosen up your torso.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms at chest height.
Rotate your upper body to one side, keeping your hips facing forward.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

items.name: 站姿骨盆后倾
items.description: Stand and tilt your pelvis back and forth to move your lower back. It loosens the lower back and teaches pelvic control.
steps: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，膝盖稍微弯曲。
将双手放在臀部或垂在身体两侧。
调动核心肌肉并向前倾斜骨盆，将下背部推向身后的墙壁。
保持该位置几秒钟，然后松开并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 等长保持窄握反手引体向上
items.nameEn: isometric hold close grip chin up
items.description: A close grip chin-up held at the top or halfway. It builds pulling strength and grip.
steps: Grip the bar with palms facing you and hands close together.
Pull yourself up until your chin is over the bar.
Hold for 5 to 15 seconds.
Keep your shoulders down and core tight.
Lower slowly under control.
Rest and repeat.

items.name: 箱子单腿辅助引体向上
items.nameEn: box single leg assisted pull up
items.description: A pull-up with only one foot on a box for assistance. It is a step closer to a full pull-up.
steps: Place a box under a pull-up bar.
Grip the bar and rest one foot on the box.
Pull up until your chin clears the bar.
Push lightly with the foot on the box.
Lower slowly.
Switch the assisting leg on the next set.

items.name: 箱子辅助引体向上
items.description: A pull-up with your feet on a box for light assistance. It helps you build up to full pull-ups.
steps: Place a box under a pull-up bar.
Grip the bar and rest one or both feet on the box.
Pull up until your chin clears the bar.
Use your legs as little as possible.
Lower slowly.
Keep your core tight.

items.name: 绕杠反握引体向上
items.description: A chin-up variation where you pull your body around the bar rather than straight over it. It challenges lats, biceps and grip.
steps: Grab the bar with an underhand grip and hang with straight arms.
Brace your core and pull your elbows down.
Pull your chest toward the bar, sweeping your head around one side.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower with control back to a full hang.
Alternate the side you pass on each rep.

items.name: 老派反向挺身
items.description: A classic reverse hyper lift on a bench, raising the legs behind you. It trains the lower back and glutes.
