steps: Lie face down over a bench with your hips at the edge.
Hold the bench and keep your legs hanging down.
Lift your legs behind you until your body is straight.
Pause and squeeze your glutes.
Lower slowly without swinging.

items.name: 耸肩(双杠)
items.description: A shrug performed supported on parallel bars. It lifts and lowers the shoulders to train the traps.
steps: Support yourself on parallel bars with straight arms.
Let your shoulders sink down.
Push up to elevate your shoulders toward your ears.
Pause at the top.
Lower with control.
Keep your elbows locked.

items.name: 肩倒立瑜伽姿势
items.description: An inverted yoga pose balanced on the shoulders. It builds shoulder and core control and stretches the neck-side muscles.
steps: Lie on your back and lift your legs overhead, supporting your lower back with your hands.
Walk your hands up toward your shoulder blades.
Raise your legs straight up so your body forms a line over your shoulders.
Keep your neck long and still, and do not turn your head.
Hold for 15-30 seconds, then lower slowly.

items.name: 肩宽中立握引体向上
items.nameEn: shoulder width neutral grip pull up
items.description: Pull-up with palms facing each other at shoulder width, a joint-friendly grip that builds the lats and arms.
steps: Grab neutral-grip handles about shoulder width apart and hang with arms straight.
Brace your core and pull your shoulder blades down.
Pull your chest toward your hands until your chin clears the bar.
Lower yourself slowly to a full hang.
Avoid swinging or kicking.

items.name: 肩宽握引体向上
items.description: A pull-up with hands about shoulder-width apart. Builds the lats, upper back and biceps.
steps: 握距与肩同宽，抓住引体向上杆，手掌背向自己。
双臂完全伸展，自由悬挂。
启动背部肌肉，将身体向上拉向杠铃，直到下巴位于杠铃上方。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将身体放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 肩胛上提下沉
items.description: A drill where you shrug your shoulders up and then press them down. It builds control of the shoulder blades.
steps: Stand or sit tall with your arms at your sides.
Shrug your shoulders up toward your ears.
Hold for a second.
Press your shoulders down away from your ears.
Move slowly through the full range.
Keep your arms relaxed and your head still.

items.name: 肩胛后缩前伸
items.description: A shoulder blade drill where you pull the blades together and then spread them apart. It improves control of the scapulae.
steps: Stand or sit tall with your arms forward at shoulder height.
Pull your shoulder blades together behind you.
Hold for a moment.
Then push your hands forward and let the blades spread apart.
Move slowly between the two positions.
Keep your neck relaxed and your ribs down.

items.name: 肩胛引体 v. 2
items.description: Hang from a bar and move only your shoulder blades. It builds the shoulder control you need for solid pull-ups.
steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, arms straight.
Let your shoulders relax up toward your ears.
Pull your shoulder blades down and together to lift your body a few centimetres.
Keep your elbows locked straight the whole time.
Pause briefly, then lower slowly back to the full hang.

items.name: 肩胛引体向上
items.description: Hanging from a bar, you pull your shoulder blades down without bending your arms. Builds shoulder control and the lower traps.
steps: 首先悬挂在引体向上杆上，手掌背向自己，手臂完全伸展。
通过向下拉和向后拉动肩胛骨来缩回肩胛骨。
启动背部肌肉，将身体拉向杠铃杆，重点是将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作的最高点停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低身体回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 肩胛引体摆动
items.description: A scapular pull-up with a gentle swing. It builds shoulder blade control and grip.
steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with straight arms.
Pull your shoulder blades down without bending your elbows.
Swing your body forward and back in a small arc.
Keep the motion controlled.
Lower to a full hang and repeat.

items.name: 肩胛臂屈伸
items.description: A scapular dip, moving the shoulder blades while your arms stay straight. Strengthens the traps and shoulder stabilisers.
steps: 首先站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，双臂在身前伸展。
稍微弯曲膝盖，髋部向前转动，保持背部挺直。
弯曲肘部并缩回肩胛骨来降低身体，就像你试图在它们之间挤一支铅笔一样。
在底部停顿片刻，然后双手用力，伸展肘部，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 肩部绕圈
items.description: A simple warm-up where you roll the shoulders in circles to loosen the upper back and shoulder joints.
steps: Stand tall with your arms relaxed by your sides.
Lift your shoulders up toward your ears.
Roll them back and down in a smooth circle.
Complete several slow circles.
Reverse the direction and repeat.

items.name: 背部拉伸
items.description: A simple stretch to lengthen the back and ease tightness.
steps: Stand or sit tall and clasp your hands in front of you.
Press your arms forward and round your upper back.
Let your head drop gently.
Breathe slowly into your back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.

items.name: 背部放松
items.description: A gentle resting position that lets the back relax and lengthen after training.
steps: Get into a comfortable resting position, such as kneeling with your torso folded forward.
Rest your arms in a relaxed position.
Let your back round and release.
Breathe slowly into your lower back.
Hold for 30-60 seconds.

items.name: 背部胸肌拉伸
items.description: A stretch for the chest and front of the shoulder with your arms reached behind you. It opens up the pecs and lats.
steps: 站直，双脚分开与肩同宽。
将双臂伸直在身前，与地面平行。
双臂交叉在身体前方，右臂放在左臂上方。
手指交叉，手掌旋转远离身体。
慢慢抬起手臂并远离身体，感觉背部和胸部有拉伸感。
保持拉伸 15-30 秒，然后放松。
在另一侧重复。

items.name: 背靠墙肩胛滑动
items.description: Sliding your shoulder blades along a wall to improve their control. It helps shoulder blade mobility and posture.
steps: Stand with your back flat against a wall and your elbows bent at your sides.
Press your forearms and head lightly into the wall.
Slide your arms up the wall while keeping your shoulder blades down.
Stop before your back arches.
Slide down slowly and repeat.

items.name: 胸椎桥式
items.description: A bridge-like drill that opens the upper back and shoulders while rotating the spine.
steps: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and one hand behind you.
Lift your hips toward the ceiling.
Reach your free arm up and over, rotating your chest toward the ceiling.
Open your chest as far as feels comfortable.
Return to the start under control.
Repeat for reps, then switch sides.

items.name: 脉冲划船
items.description: A rowing movement with small pulses at the top of the pull. It builds endurance in your upper back.
steps: Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back and arms hanging.
Pull your elbows back and squeeze your shoulder blades.
Pulse in short movements at the top.
Lower your arms under control.
Keep your neck neutral.

items.name: 脊柱前伸 v. 2
items.description: A seated Pilates stretch that rounds the spine forward to lengthen the back and hamstrings.
steps: Sit tall with legs extended hip-width apart and arms reaching forward.
Draw your belly in and flex your feet.
Curl forward one vertebra at a time, reaching over an imaginary ball.
Hold for a breath at the bottom.
Roll back up to tall sitting and repeat.

items.name: 脊柱拉伸
items.description: Sit with your legs out in front of you and lean back on your hands. It gives the spine and front of the torso a gentle stretch.
steps: 坐在地上，双腿在身前伸展。
将双手放在身后的地面上，手指指向身体。
启动你的核心并慢慢向后倾斜，保持背部挺直。
继续向后倾斜，直到感觉到脊柱被拉伸。
保持伸展几秒钟，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 自我辅助反向上拉
items.description: A pullover-style move hanging under a bar, with the legs helping a bit. It builds the lats and shoulder strength.
steps: Set a sturdy bar at hip height or lower and hang beneath it with an overhand grip.
Keep your feet on the floor to help as needed.
Pull your chest toward the bar and let your hips rise.
Continue to rotate your torso up and over the bar toward your hands, as your range allows.
Reverse slowly back to the start.
Use your legs only as needed.

items.name: 自重站姿划船
items.description: A standing, bent-over row pulling a bar or handles toward your body with an overhand grip. It builds the upper back and the muscles that retract the shoulder blades.
steps: 站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，膝盖稍微弯曲。
正手握住杆或手柄，手掌朝下。
保持背部挺直，核心参与。
将杠铃或手柄拉向身体，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作的最高点停顿片刻。
慢慢释放并伸展双臂回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 自重站姿划船(用毛巾)
items.description: A standing row done with both hands on a towel, pulling toward your chest. It trains the upper back and shoulder blade squeeze with no gear.
steps: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手握住毛巾放在身前。
稍微弯曲膝盖，髋部向前转动，保持背部挺直。
将毛巾拉向胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在最高点停顿片刻，然后慢慢释放张力，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 自重站姿单臂划船
items.description: A standing one arm row from a hip hinge, pulling a weight toward your chest one side at a time. Good for the upper back and lats.
steps: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，膝盖稍微弯曲，一手握住哑铃。
臀部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
让哑铃垂直悬挂在您面前，手臂完全伸展。
将哑铃向上拉向胸部，保持肘部靠近身体。
在动作的最高点将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。

items.name: 自重站姿单臂划船(用毛巾)
items.nameEn: bodyweight standing one arm row (with towel)
items.description: A standing one arm row using a towel as the handle, pulled toward the chest. It trains the upper back with very little equipment.
steps: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，膝盖微曲，单手握住毛巾。
臀部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
将毛巾拉向胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将毛巾放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换到另一只手臂。

items.name: 自重站姿窄握划船
items.description: A bent-over standing row with a close grip, pulling the hands toward your body. It builds the upper back and the muscles that squeeze the shoulder blades together.
steps: 站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，膝盖稍微弯曲。
腰部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
将双臂伸直在身前，紧紧抓住杆或手柄。
将杠铃或手柄拉向身体，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作的最高点停顿片刻，然后慢慢松开并回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 自重站姿窄握单臂划船
items.nameEn: bodyweight standing close-grip one arm row
items.description: A standing, bent-over one arm row with a close grip, working the muscles between and around the shoulder blades. A light handheld weight keeps the pull honest.
steps: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，膝盖稍微弯曲，一只手握住哑铃，握姿中立。
臀部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
将哑铃向上拉向胸部，保持肘部靠近身体并将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。

items.name: 自重蹲姿划船
items.description: A squat paired with a pulling motion on a sturdy anchor or suspension trainer. It trains the legs and upper back in one flowing movement.
steps: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，伸直手臂抓住坚固的物体或悬挂训练器。
将身体降低至蹲姿，保持背部挺直，膝盖位于脚趾后面。
从蹲姿开始，将身体向上拉向物体或悬挂训练器，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将身体放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 自重蹲姿划船(用毛巾)
items.description: A squat combined with a towel row, so legs and upper back work together. You pull the towel toward your chest as you sink down.
steps: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，手掌朝下，将毛巾放在身前。
弯曲膝盖，将身体降低至蹲姿，保持背部挺直，挺胸。
当你下蹲时，同时将毛巾拉向胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在深蹲底部停顿片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置，同时伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 虎式瑜伽体式
items.description: A hands-and-knees pose where one leg extends back and the spine arches, mobilising the back and hips.
steps: Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Round your back and draw one knee toward your nose.
Then extend that leg back and up while lifting your chest.
Move smoothly with your breath.
Do your reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 蝗虫式瑜伽姿势(钢铁人式)
items.description: A yoga pose on your belly where you lift legs and chest at once. It strengthens the lower back and glutes.
steps: Lie face down with your arms along your sides and palms facing up.
Press your pelvis into the floor and engage your glutes.
Lift your chest, arms and legs off the floor together.
Look slightly forward and keep your neck long.
Hold for 10-20 seconds, then lower slowly and rest.

items.name: 蝴蝶式后滚
items.description: Rock back and forth on your spine with legs in a butterfly position. It massages the back and loosens the hips.
steps: Sit with the soles of your feet together and knees open.
Hold your feet or ankles.
Roll back slowly along your spine.
Roll forward to sit up again.
Repeat smoothly for 8 to 10 reps.

items.name: 超人式
items.description: A floor extension that lifts arms and legs to strengthen the lower back.
steps: Lie face down with arms extended in front.
Lift your arms, chest and legs off the floor together.
Squeeze your glutes and lower back.
Hold for 1-2 seconds.
Lower slowly.
Keep your neck neutral.

items.name: 超人式W
items.description: Face down, lift your chest and legs with arms in a W. It builds the lower back and upper back.
steps: Lie face down with elbows bent and hands by your head.
Squeeze your glutes.
Lift your chest, arms and legs slightly off the floor.
Pull your shoulder blades together and hold for a second.
Lower slowly.

items.name: 超人式W转Y
items.description: Lying face down, lift your body and move your arms from a W to a Y. It trains the whole back side.
steps: Lie face down, arms in a W with elbows bent.
Lift your chest and legs slightly off the floor.
Reach your arms forward into a Y.
Return to the W while keeping the lift.
Lower fully after your reps.

items.name: 超人式划船
items.description: A prone superman with a rowing motion of the arms. It targets the upper back and the muscles along the spine.
steps: Lie face down with arms extended in front.
Lift your chest and arms slightly off the floor.
Pull your elbows back toward your ribs as if rowing.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Extend your arms forward again.
Keep your neck neutral.

items.name: 超人式脉冲
items.description: Lie face down and lift arms and legs with small pulses. It strengthens the lower back and glutes.
steps: Lie face down with arms extended in front.
Lift your arms, chest and legs a few inches.
Pulse them up and down in small movements.
Keep your neck neutral.
Lower and rest after your set.

items.name: 跪姿单臂伸展滚动抬起
items.nameEn: kneeling one arm reach roll lift
items.description: A kneeling drill where one arm reaches, rolls and lifts to open the upper back and shoulders.
steps: Start on hands and knees with hands under shoulders.
Reach one arm forward along the floor.
Roll that arm up and across, rotating your chest.
Lift it toward the ceiling, following your hand with your eyes.
Return and repeat, then switch arms.

items.name: 跪姿肩胛俯卧撑
items.description: A kneeling push up that moves only the shoulder blades, strengthening the muscles that stabilize them.
steps: Kneel in a plank position with straight arms.
Keep your elbows locked.
Let your chest sink by pinching your shoulder blades together.
Push the floor away to spread them apart.
Keep your core braced.

items.name: 跪姿背部旋转
items.description: Rotating the upper back from a kneeling position. It improves spinal rotation and loosens the mid back.
steps: Kneel on all fours with one hand behind your head.
Keep your hips still and your core lightly braced.
Rotate your elbow down toward the other arm, then open toward the ceiling.
Follow the elbow with your eyes.
Do your reps, then switch sides.

items.name: 跪姿背部旋转拉伸
items.description: Kneeling on all fours and rotating through your trunk mobilises and stretches your mid back. Slow and controlled works best.
steps: Start on your hands and knees with your hands under your shoulders.
Place one hand behind your head and rotate your elbow up toward the ceiling.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

items.name: 跪姿背阔肌拉伸
items.description: Kneel and reach your arms overhead, then lean to one side. It stretches the lat and the side of your torso.
steps: 跪在地上，膝盖分开与臀部同宽，脚趾向后。
将双臂伸过头顶，手指交叉。
保持背部挺直，慢慢向右侧倾斜，感受左侧背阔肌的拉伸。
保持伸展动作 20-30 秒，然后回到起始位置。
在左侧重复该拉伸动作，向左侧倾斜，感受右侧背阔肌的拉伸。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

items.name: 跪姿胸椎旋转
items.description: A kneeling rotation that opens up the mid back. Good for loosening your upper spine before training or after sitting.
steps: Kneel on all fours with your hands under your shoulders.
Place one hand behind your head.
Rotate your upper body and point that elbow toward the ceiling.
Follow your elbow with your eyes and keep your hips square.
Return and touch the elbow toward the opposite arm.
Do your reps, then switch sides.

items.name: 跪姿胸椎灵活性拉伸
items.description: A kneeling thoracic rotation stretch.
steps: Kneel on all fours.
Place one hand behind your head.
Rotate your elbow up toward the ceiling.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return to start.
Switch sides.

items.name: 跪姿胸椎灵活性练习
items.description: A kneeling rotation drill for upper back mobility.
steps: Kneel on all fours.
Place one hand behind your head.
Rotate your elbow toward the opposite arm.
Open up and rotate toward the ceiling.
Follow your elbow with your eyes.
Do your reps, then switch sides.

items.name: 跪姿躯干旋转后飞鸟穿线
items.nameEn: kneeling rotation torso rear fly to thread through
items.description: A kneeling thoracic mobility move combining a rear fly and a thread-the-needle reach.
steps: Start on hands and knees.
Place one hand behind your head and rotate your torso open, elbow to the ceiling.
Return and thread that arm under your chest.
Let your shoulder reach toward the floor.
Keep your hips still.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

items.name: 跪姿辅助滑行反手引体向上
items.description: A kneeling, assisted chin up where you slide on the floor to reduce the load. It helps you build toward full chin ups.
steps: Kneel below a bar and grab it with an underhand grip.
Place a towel or slider under your knees.
Pull your chest toward the bar.
Use your legs lightly to help.
Lower slowly to straight arms.
Keep your shoulders away from your ears.

items.name: 跳跃引体向上
items.description: A pull-up that uses a small jump to help you up, then a slow lowering phase. Good for building pulling strength.
steps: Stand under a pull-up bar and grip it slightly wider than your shoulders.
Bend your knees and jump up, pulling your chin above the bar.
Pause for a moment at the top.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight.
Reset on the floor and repeat.

items.name: 轮式(上弓式)
items.description: A deep backbend pressing up from the floor. It opens the chest and shoulders and strengthens the back and legs.
steps: Lie on your back, knees bent, hands beside your head with fingers toward your feet.
Press into hands and feet and lift your hips.
Straighten your arms as you lift the crown of your head off the floor.
Press your chest toward the wall behind.
Hold for a few breaths, then lower slowly.

items.name: 轮式瑜伽姿势
items.description: A deep yoga backbend with hands and feet on the floor and the body arched upward. It opens the chest and strengthens the back.
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat near your hips.
Place your palms beside your head with fingers pointing toward your shoulders.
Press through your hands and feet to lift your hips and then your head.
Straighten your arms as far as comfortable and keep your thighs parallel.
Hold for 5-15 seconds, then lower slowly with your chin tucked.

items.name: 长杠杆仰卧背部伸展
items.description: A prone back extension with the arms stretched long overhead. It strengthens the lower back and glutes.
steps: Lie face down with your arms extended overhead.
Squeeze your glutes to stabilize.
Lift your chest and arms off the floor.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower with control.
Keep your neck neutral by looking down.

items.name: 门框自重划船
items.description: A row done by holding both sides of a doorframe and leaning back. It trains the back and arms.
steps: Stand in a doorway and grip both sides of the frame firmly.
Lean back with arms straight and feet close to the frame.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Pull your chest toward the frame, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower with control.
Use a sturdy frame and a non-slip grip.

items.name: 静态姿势仰卧靠垫
items.nameEn: static position lying back with pad
items.description: Hold a lying position on your back with a pad as a reference for setup and posture.
steps: Place a pad on the floor or bench.
Lie on your back with your head supported.
Keep your spine neutral.
Relax your arms at your sides.
Hold the position and breathe.

items.name: 静态姿势俯卧
items.description: Hold a face-down position to practice setting up for prone exercises.
steps: Lie face down on a mat.
Extend your legs and rest your forehead down.
Keep your arms alongside your body.
Keep your hips relaxed.
Hold and breathe.

items.name: 静态姿势坐姿靠垫
items.nameEn: static position seated back with pad
items.description: Sit with your back against a pad to hold a proper seated posture.
steps: Sit on the seat with your back against the pad.
Keep your feet flat on the floor.
Press your back gently into the pad.
Keep your shoulders relaxed.
Hold the position and breathe.

items.name: 静态姿势坐姿靠背
items.description: Hold an upright seated posture with no pad.
steps: Sit tall with feet flat on the floor.
Keep your back straight.
Place your hands on your thighs.
Relax your shoulders.
Hold and breathe.

items.name: 靠墙单臂背阔肌拉伸
items.nameEn: single arm lat stretch against wall
items.description: Stretch one side of your back by reaching an arm overhead against a wall. It lengthens the lat and side of the torso.
steps: Stand beside a wall and place one hand on it above head height.
Step your feet back slightly.
Press your hips away and lean your chest down toward the floor.
Feel the stretch along your side and under the armpit.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch arms.

items.name: 靠墙对侧手臂与腿抬起
items.nameEn: opposite arm and leg raise against wall
items.description: A wall-supported raise of the opposite arm and leg. It trains balance and lower back stability.
steps: Stand facing a wall in a bent over position with your hands on it.
Brace your core.
Lift one arm and the opposite leg at the same time.
Hold for a second without twisting.
Lower and repeat on the other side.

items.name: 面朝下雪天使
items.description: Lying face down, you sweep your arms and legs like a snow angel. It works the muscles along your back.
steps: Lie face down with arms by your sides and legs together.
Lift your chest and arms slightly off the floor.
Sweep your arms out and overhead while opening your legs.
Bring them back to the start in the same arc.
Repeat in a smooth rhythm.
Keep your neck long and look at the floor.

items.name: 颈后引体向上
items.description: A pull-up where you pull toward the back of your neck. Challenges the upper back and shoulders, so keep it controlled.
steps: 正手握住引体向上杆，握距略宽于肩宽。
悬挂在杠上，双臂完全伸展，身体伸直。
收紧背部肌肉，将身体拉向杠铃杆，保持肘部靠近身体。
继续拉，直到下巴位于杠铃上方。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将身体放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 高杠反向划船
items.description: An inverted row on a high bar, which makes the pull more upright and easier. It builds the back and arms.
steps: Set a bar at about chest height and grab it overhand.
Walk your feet forward until your arms are straight.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Pull your chest toward the bar.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower yourself slowly.

items.name: 360度大回环
items.description: A rotating movement that swings the arms and torso in a full circle. It gets the heart rate up and loosens the trunk.
steps: 站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，膝盖稍微弯曲。
将双臂伸直在身前，与地面平行。
启动你的核心并以圆周运动摆动你的手臂，同时旋转你的躯干。
继续圆周运动，摆动手臂并旋转躯干，达到所需的重复次数。
记住在整个练习过程中保持呼吸。

items.name: 之字形跳
items.description: Hopping diagonally forward in a zigzag pattern. It trains agility and lower leg power.
steps: Stand with your knees slightly bent.
Hop forward and to one side.
Land softly on both feet.
Hop forward and to the other side.
Keep your hops light and quick.
Continue for 20-30 seconds.

items.name: 交替出拳
items.description: Alternating punches at a steady pace to raise the heart rate.
steps: Stand with a staggered stance and fists up.
Punch forward with one arm, rotating your torso slightly.
Pull it back as you punch with the other.
Keep your core tight.
Keep a steady rhythm for 30-60 seconds.
Rest briefly and repeat.

items.name: 交替高跳
items.description: Springy hops from one foot to the other with a high knee. It raises your heart rate and trains leg power.
steps: Stand tall with your arms ready to swing.
Hop off one foot and drive the opposite knee up.
Land softly on the ball of your foot.
Switch legs on the next hop.
Swing your arms in rhythm with your legs.
Keep a quick, bouncy pace.

items.name: 侧向折返跑
items.description: A lateral shuttle run at speed to raise the heart rate.
steps: Stand with knees bent in an athletic stance.
Shuffle to one side in quick steps.
Touch the floor or change direction.
Shuffle back the other way.
Keep your chest up.
Keep up the pace for 30-60 seconds.

items.name: 侧滑步高抬腿
items.description: A lateral shuffle where each step brings the knee high. It raises your heart rate and builds agility.
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Shuffle sideways for a few steps.
Lift your knees high with each step.
Stay light on your feet and pump your arms.
Change direction and continue for 30-60 seconds.

items.name: 倒退跑
items.description: Running backwards at a comfortable pace. It raises your heart rate and strengthens the quads and calves.
steps: Find a clear, flat area or treadmill at a low speed.
Stand tall with your arms bent.
Run backwards, landing on the balls of your feet.
Glance over your shoulder from time to time.
Keep a steady, controlled pace.
Slow down gradually to finish.

items.name: 冲刺跑
items.description: A run on a self-powered curved treadmill where your effort sets the speed. It is a hard cardio workout for the legs and lungs.
steps: Step onto the curved treadmill and hold the handles.
Lean slightly forward and begin to run.
Drive your knees and push the belt back with each stride.
Keep a steady rhythm, or alternate sprints and rest.
Land on the balls of your feet.
Slow down gradually to finish.

items.name: 冲刺跑
items.description: Short, all-out running efforts. It builds speed and conditioning.
steps: Warm up well with jogging and dynamic stretches.
Start in a staggered stance and lean slightly forward.
Drive your arms and knees as you accelerate.
Run at maximum effort for 10-30 seconds.
Slow down gradually and rest fully before the next sprint.

items.name: 划船(划船机)
items.description: Steady rowing on an indoor machine for full-body cardio conditioning.
steps: Sit on the machine, strap in your feet and grab the handle with straight arms.
Push through your legs first, then lean back slightly.
Pull the handle to your lower ribs with elbows close.
Reverse the order: arms out, hips hinge, then knees bend to slide forward.
Keep a smooth rhythm for 10-30 minutes at a comfortable pace.

items.name: 前后步
items.description: A stepping drill moving forward and back with the legs alternating. It raises the heart rate and warms up the legs.
steps: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
右脚向前迈出一步，弯曲膝盖，将身体降低到弓步位置。
用右脚蹬地，然后回到起始位置。
用左脚重复该动作，每一步交替双腿。
继续来回走动，保持稳定的步伐。
重复所需的持续时间或重复次数。

items.name: 前后滑步
items.description: Quick shuffling steps forward and back build footwork and conditioning. It keeps your heart rate up.
steps: Stand in an athletic stance with soft knees.
Shuffle forward a few steps on the balls of your feet.
Shuffle back to the start without crossing your feet.
Keep your hips low and your chest up.
Move quickly but stay balanced.
Repeat for a set time.

items.name: 剪刀跳(男)
items.description: A quick jumping drill where the legs cross in front of each other in the air. It raises your heart rate and builds light, springy legs.
steps: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
跳离地面，同时将右腿交叉到左腿前面。
落地时，快速换腿，将左腿交叉在右腿前面。
继续交替双腿并尽可能快地跳跃。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 半蹲(男)
items.description: A shallow squat that bends the knees only partway. It is a gentle leg exercise good for warming up or high rep sets.
steps: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
弯曲膝盖并降低身体，就像坐回椅子上一样。
保持挺胸，将体重放在脚后跟上。
在底部停顿片刻，然后推动脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 半蹲跳(男)
items.description: A shallow squat followed by a jump, with the arms swinging for momentum. It trains the leg power and gets the heart rate up.
steps: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
弯曲膝盖并将身体降低至蹲姿。
爆发性跳跃，伸展臀部和膝盖，同时摆动手臂以获得动力。
脚掌轻轻落地，然后立即进入下一个重复动作。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 单腿后踢臀
items.description: A hopping drill where you flick one heel up to your glutes. It warms up the hamstrings and raises your heart rate.
steps: Stand on one leg with the other foot lifted.
Hop lightly on your standing foot.
Kick your free heel toward your glutes each hop.
Land softly on the ball of your foot.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 原地快速小跑
items.description: Trot in place at a quick pace to warm up and get your heart rate up.
steps: Stand tall with arms bent at your sides.
Lift your knees and run lightly on the spot.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Pump your arms with each step.
Keep the pace for 30-60 seconds or longer.

items.name: 原地慢跑
items.description: Jogging on the spot as a warm-up or light cardio. It raises your heart rate without equipment.
steps: Stand tall with your arms bent.
Jog in place, lifting your knees.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep a steady pace.
Continue for 1-5 minutes.

items.name: 原地踏步
items.description: A low-impact cardio move where you march in place to raise your heart rate and warm up the legs.
steps: Stand tall with your arms bent at your sides.
Lift one knee up toward hip height.
Lower it and lift the other knee.
Swing your arms in rhythm with your steps.
Keep a steady pace for 1-3 minutes.

items.name: 双腿后踢臀
items.description: A bouncy jump where both heels flick up toward your glutes. It gets your heart rate up and warms up the hamstrings.
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and arms relaxed.
Jump up off both feet.
Kick both heels up toward your glutes while you are in the air.
Land softly on the balls of your feet with slightly bent knees.
Go straight into the next jump at a steady rhythm.

items.name: 后踢腿跑
items.description: A running drill where your heels flick up toward your glutes. It warms up the hamstrings and raises your heart rate.
steps: Stand tall with your arms bent at your sides.
Jog on the spot or move forward slowly.
Kick each heel up toward your glute.
Stay on the balls of your feet and keep your knees pointing down.
Pump your arms in rhythm.
Continue for 20-40 seconds.

items.name: 固定自行车行走
items.description: Easy, steady pedaling on a stationary bike at a walking-like pace. It builds endurance and warms up the legs.
steps: 调整固定自行车上的座椅高度和位置，以确保正确对齐。
将脚放在踏板上，并用带子（如果有）将其固定。
以舒适的速度开始踩踏，保持背部挺直，核心参与。
保持稳定的节奏，并根据需要增加阻力水平。
继续踩踏您的有氧运动所需的持续时间。
通过逐渐降低步速和阻力水平来冷静下来。
锻炼后伸展腿部肌肉，以防止紧绷并促进恢复。

items.name: 固定自行车骑行 v. 3
items.description: Steady pedalling on a stationary bike at a pace that suits you. Builds endurance and leg conditioning.
steps: 调整座椅高度和位置以确保正确对齐。
将脚放在踏板上，并用带子（如果有）将其固定。
以舒适的速度开始踩踏板。
保持稳定的节奏并根据需要增加阻力。
调动核心肌肉以保持稳定性和正确的姿势。
继续踩踏板达到所需的锻炼时间。
逐渐减小阻力并减速，然后完全停止。
锻炼后伸展双腿并放松。

items.name: 固定自行车骑行 v. 4
items.description: A stationary bike session at a brisk pace, similar to running in effort, to build heart and leg endurance.
steps: Adjust the seat so your knees stay slightly bent at the bottom of the stroke.
Hold the handles and sit tall.
Start pedalling at an easy pace to warm up.
Raise the speed to a brisk rhythm you can sustain.
Keep your upper body relaxed.
Continue for 10-30 minutes, then slow down to cool off.

items.name: 坡度跑步机行走
items.description: A walk on a treadmill with an incline, which makes the glutes and calves work harder. A steady, low impact cardio option.
steps: 将跑步机的倾斜度调整到您想要的强度。
站在跑步机上，双脚分开与肩同宽。
开始以舒适的步伐行走，确保保持正确的姿势。
在整个练习过程中，调动核心肌肉并保持背部挺直。
继续在倾斜跑步机上行走，完成有氧运动所需的时间。
逐渐降低跑步机的坡度和速度，使其冷却后再停止。

items.name: 垂直登山者
items.description: A standing take on the mountain climber with fast knee drives. It lifts your heart rate and works the core.
steps: Stand tall with hands raised in front of you at chest height.
Drive one knee up toward your hands.
Switch legs quickly, running in place.
Stay on the balls of your feet.
Keep a steady, brisk pace.

items.name: 小步幅跑
items.description: A run with short, quick strides. It raises the heart rate and builds foot speed.
steps: 找一个空地或跑步机来进行锻炼。
站直，双脚分开与臀部同宽。
开始原地慢跑，抬起膝盖并挥动手臂。
几秒钟后，开始小步前进，保持快速的步伐。
继续小步跑所需的时间或距离。

items.name: 弹力带辅助短跑跑步
items.description: A sprinting drill with band assistance to practice fast leg turnover.
steps: Anchor a band behind you and loop it around your waist.
Lean forward into a sprint position.
Drive your knees and pump your arms.
Stay light on your feet.
Repeat for short bursts.

items.name: 快走
items.description: A fast-paced walk that lifts your heart rate without the impact of running. Easy on the joints and good for steady fitness.
steps: Stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Start walking at a pace faster than a stroll.
Swing your arms naturally with elbows bent.
Land on your heel and roll through to your toes.
Keep breathing steadily and stay able to talk.
Walk for 20-45 minutes.

items.name: 快速小步跑
items.description: Running on the spot with very fast, small steps. It's a classic warm-up and speed drill.
steps: Stand tall with your knees slightly bent.
Run on the spot as fast as you can with small steps.
Stay on the balls of your feet.
Pump your arms.
Keep your chest up.
Continue for 20-30 seconds.

items.name: 快速脚步进出跑
items.description: Run in place with feet moving in and out quickly. It boosts your heart rate.
steps: Stand tall with feet together.
Jog in place.
Quickly move your feet in and out.
Stay light on your toes.
Continue for the set time.

items.name: 战斗单车冲刺
items.description: A hard-effort ride on an air bike that gets your heart rate up and trains the legs and arms.
steps: Adjust the seat height and sit on the bike.
Grip the handles and push and pull with your arms.
Pedal at a steady, strong pace.
Increase the effort for intervals.
Keep your breathing controlled.
Ride for a set time or distance.

items.name: 战绳低波浪
items.description: Alternating or double low waves with heavy ropes that spike your heart rate and work the shoulders, arms and core.
steps: Hold one rope end in each hand and stand in a quarter squat.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Whip the ropes down and up so waves travel low along the floor.
Keep the waves even and your hips stable.
Work for 20-30 seconds at a hard pace.
Rest, then repeat for several rounds.

items.name: 战绳力量砸绳
items.description: An explosive overhead rope slam that builds conditioning and power through the whole body.
steps: Hold a rope end in each hand and stand in an athletic stance.
Raise both ropes overhead while rising onto your toes.
Slam them down hard while dropping into a squat.
Keep your back flat and your core braced.
Reset and repeat at a steady, powerful pace.
Work in bursts of 15-30 seconds.

items.name: 战绳半跪姿
items.description: Rope waves from a half kneeling stance. It raises the heart rate and burns the shoulders and arms.
steps: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward and hold a rope end in each hand.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Make fast alternating waves with your arms.
Keep the rhythm steady for a set time.
Switch the front leg for the next set.

items.name: 战绳坐姿
items.description: Seated battle rope waves that raise your heart rate while working the arms and core.
steps: Sit tall on the floor or a bench holding the ends of the ropes.
Brace your core.
Whip the ropes up and down in alternating waves.
Keep a steady fast rhythm for 20-30 seconds.
Rest, then repeat.

items.name: 户外骑自行车
items.description: Cycling outdoors at an easy to moderate pace. It is a low-impact way to build endurance.
steps: Adjust your saddle so your leg is almost straight at the bottom of the pedal stroke.
Wear a helmet and check your brakes.
Start at an easy pace to warm up.
Pedal smoothly at a steady, comfortable rhythm for 20-60 minutes.
Cool down with a few minutes of easy pedalling.

items.name: 拳击手滑步
items.description: A light-footed shuffle used by boxers to keep the heart rate up.
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, knees soft.
Shift your weight from foot to foot.
Stay on the balls of your feet.
Keep your hands up like a guard.
Keep it light and quick for 30-60 seconds.
Rest briefly and repeat.

items.name: 推进跑
items.description: A push-up that flows into fast alternating knee drives in the plank position. It raises the heart rate and trains the chest and core.
steps: 从俯卧撑位置开始，双手分开与肩同宽，身体呈一条直线。
弯曲肘部，将胸部压向地面，保持身体伸直。
用手推动以伸展手臂并返回到起始位置。
快速将一个膝盖靠近胸部，然后快速切换并将另一只膝盖靠近胸部。
继续尽可能快地交替膝盖，同时保持良好的姿势。
继续所需的持续时间或重复次数。

items.name: 斜躺自行车步行
items.description: A relaxed walking-style pedal motion on a recumbent bike that builds leg endurance with the back well supported.
steps: Sit on the recumbent bike and adjust the seat so your knees stay slightly bent at full extension.
Place your feet on the pedals and hold the handles.
Pedal at an easy, walking-like pace.
Keep your back against the backrest and breathe steadily.
Continue for 15-30 minutes.
Cool down by slowing the pedalling gradually.

items.name: 方块跳
items.description: A quick hopping drill where you jump around the corners of an imaginary square. It builds foot speed, agility and leg power.
steps: Imagine a square on the floor and stand at one corner.
Hop on both feet to the next corner, staying light on your toes.
Keep hopping around the square in order.
Land softly with slightly bent knees.
Reverse direction halfway through your set.

items.name: 有氧弓步
items.description: Lunges done at a brisk pace to lift your heart rate while working the legs.
steps: Stand tall with your hands on your hips or swinging with the movement.
Step forward and lower into a lunge.
Push off the front foot and return to standing.
Switch legs and keep a quick rhythm.
Keep your torso upright throughout.

items.name: 杠杆踏步机
items.description: Climb on a lever stepper machine at a steady pace. It raises your heart rate and works the legs and glutes.
steps: Step onto the pedals and hold the handles lightly for balance.
Push one pedal down while the other rises, keeping a smooth rhythm.
Stand tall and keep your knees pointing forward.
Continue at a comfortable pace for several minutes, adjusting resistance as needed.
Slow down gradually before stepping off.

items.name: 椭圆交叉训练机骑行
items.description: Pedalling a cycle cross trainer with arms and legs moving together. Steady, low-impact cardio.
steps: 调整座椅高度并将自己放在自行车交叉训练机上。
将脚放在踏板上并抓住车把。
开始以平稳且受控的动作踩踏。
保持稳定的步伐并根据需要增加阻力。
继续踩踏您的有氧运动所需的持续时间。

items.name: 椭圆机步行
items.description: Smooth walking-style motion on an elliptical cross trainer. Low-impact cardio that builds endurance.
steps: 将椭圆机的阻力水平和倾斜度调整到您想要的设置。
踩上机器的踏板并轻轻握住手柄。
首先用脚向下压，然后将手柄拉向身体。
继续这个动作，交替推和拉，以模拟行走或跑步动作。
在整个练习过程中保持稳定的步伐并保持核心参与。
继续进行有氧运动所需的持续时间。
下车前逐渐降低机器的强度和速度。

items.name: 椭圆机步行
items.description: A steady, low-impact walk on the elliptical that builds endurance and works the legs without pounding the joints.
steps: Step onto the pedals and hold the handles.
Start walking forward in a smooth rhythm.
Stand tall and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Set a resistance and pace you can keep up while breathing steadily.
Continue for 15-45 minutes.
Slow down for a minute before you step off.

items.name: 椭圆机滑雪
items.description: A ski-style stride on the elliptical that keeps your heart rate up and works the whole body.
steps: Step onto the elliptical and hold the handles.
Start striding in a smooth, ski-like rhythm, swinging your arms with your legs.
Stay upright and keep your core engaged.
Hold a steady pace for your chosen time.
Slow down gradually to finish.

items.name: 椭圆机行走 v. 7
items.description: Steady walking motion on an elliptical trainer. It is a low-impact way to raise your heart rate and build endurance.
steps: Step onto the pedals and hold the handles lightly.
Start moving in a smooth, walking-style stride.
Stand tall with your shoulders relaxed and core braced.
Choose a moderate resistance and keep a steady pace.
Continue for 10 to 30 minutes, depending on your fitness, then cool down slowly.

items.name: 步行
items.description: Plain walking at an easy to brisk pace, a simple way to build endurance and stay active.
steps: Stand tall with your shoulders relaxed and your gaze ahead.
Start walking with a natural stride.
Swing your arms gently opposite to your legs.
Land softly on your heel and roll through to the toes.
Keep a pace that lets you breathe comfortably.
Walk for 20-60 minutes.

items.name: 步行波浪机
items.description: A low-impact cardio machine session that works the legs in a smooth walking motion to raise your heart rate.
steps: Step onto the machine and hold the handles lightly.
Start moving your legs in a smooth walking rhythm.
Keep your posture tall and your core lightly braced.
Pick a pace that lets you breathe steadily.
Keep going for 10-30 minutes depending on your fitness.
Slow down for the last minute before stepping off.

items.name: 水中单车
items.description: Pedal your legs in the water as if cycling. It raises your heart rate with low impact.
steps: Stand in chest-deep water, holding the pool edge.
Lift your knees alternately.
Pedal at a steady rhythm.
Keep your core tight.
Continue for several minutes.

items.name: 水疗原地行走
items.description: Gentle walking in place in chest-deep water, a low-impact way to move the legs and raise your heart rate.
steps: Stand in waist-to-chest-deep water with your feet hip width apart.
Lift one knee up in front of you, then lower it and lift the other.
Swing your arms naturally and keep your posture tall.
Walk at a relaxed, steady pace without leaning forward.
Continue for 2-5 minutes at an easy to moderate effort.

items.name: 滑冰跳
items.description: A side-to-side hop that mimics a speed skater, landing on one foot at a time. It builds leg power and balance.
steps: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
稍微弯曲膝盖，向右跳，右脚着地。
落地时，将左腿摆动到右腿后面，并用左脚趾敲击地面。
立即向左侧跳跃，左脚着地。
落地时，将右腿摆动到左腿后面，并用右脚趾敲击地面。
继续交替两侧，跳跃并用每条腿敲击地面。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 滑步
items.description: Quick lateral steps in an athletic stance. It builds agility, coordination and leg endurance.
steps: Stand with your feet slightly wider than your shoulders and knees bent.
Keep your chest up and your weight on your toes.
Step sideways without crossing your feet.
Move quickly for a few steps.
Change direction and shuffle back.
Stay low throughout.

items.name: 滑雪步
items.description: A side-to-side hopping drill that imitates a skier. It raises the heart rate and builds leg stamina.
steps: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
稍微弯曲膝盖并保持背部挺直。
跳到右侧，右脚着地，同时将左腿摆动到右腿后面。
立即向左侧跳，左脚着地，同时将右腿摆动到左腿后面。
继续从一侧到另一侧交替跳跃，模仿滑雪动作。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 滚轮跑
items.description: A fast running motion while holding on to a wheel. It raises your heart rate and challenges the core and shoulders.
steps: 从平板支撑位置开始，双手放在方向盘上，身体伸直。
启动你的核心并通过伸展双臂开始向前滚动轮子。
继续滚动，直到身体完全伸展并且手臂举过头顶。
使用你的核心和手臂将轮子拉回你的身体，从而扭转运动。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 熊爬
items.description: A crawl on hands and feet with the knees hovering off the floor. It works the shoulders, core and legs together.
steps: 从四肢着地开始，双手直接放在肩膀下方，膝盖直接放在臀部下方。
将膝盖稍微抬离地面，保持背部平坦并收紧核心。
同时向前移动右手和左脚，然后是左手和右脚。
继续向前爬行，手脚交替动作。
在整个练习过程中保持稳定的节奏并保持核心紧张。
继续所需的距离或时间。

items.name: 登山者
items.description: From a high plank, you drive your knees toward your chest one after another. Works the core, shoulders and gets your heart rate up.
steps: 从高平板支撑位置开始，双手直接放在肩膀下方，身体呈一条直线。
启动你的核心并将你的右膝盖靠近你的胸部，然后快速切换并将你的左膝盖靠近你的胸部。
继续以跑步动作交替双腿，保持臀部较低，核心肌群参与。
在整个练习过程中保持稳定的节奏和均匀的呼吸。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 登山者跳
items.description: A mountain climber with a jump between the feet. It raises your heart rate and works the core.
steps: Start in a high plank.
Drive one knee toward your chest.
Switch legs with a small jump.
Keep your hips low.
Maintain a fast, steady pace.
Rest when your form slips.

items.name: 直排轮滑
items.description: Gliding on inline skates for steady cardio that also works the legs and balance.
steps: Put on skates, helmet and pads, and stand with your knees slightly bent.
Push one skate out to the side and glide on the other.
Alternate pushes with a relaxed arm swing.
Keep your chest up and your weight over the skates.
Skate at a steady pace for 10-30 minutes.
Slow down gradually to stop.

items.name: 肘触膝扭转
items.description: A standing move where you twist to bring an elbow toward the opposite knee. It raises your pulse and works the sides of your waist.
steps: Stand tall with your hands behind your head.
Lift one knee up and across your body.
Twist your torso to meet the knee with the opposite elbow.
Return to standing.
Alternate sides at a steady pace.
Keep your chest lifted and breathe evenly.

items.name: 行走(器械)
items.description: Easy walking on a machine or track at a steady pace, great for warming up or building a base of aerobic fitness.
steps: Step onto the machine and set a comfortable speed.
Stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Swing your arms naturally as you walk.
Land on your heel and roll through to your toes.
Walk for 10-30 minutes at a pace where you can still talk.
Slow down gradually at the end.

items.name: 行走(高抬腿)
items.description: Walking while lifting your knees high. It warms up the legs and gets your heart pumping.
steps: Stand tall with your arms relaxed.
Lift one knee to hip height.
Step down and lift the other knee.
Swing your arms naturally.
Keep a steady rhythm for the set duration.

items.name: 行走踢腿
items.description: Walk while kicking each leg up. It warms the legs.
steps: Stand tall.
Step forward and kick the opposite leg up.
Alternate legs.
Swing your arms.
Continue for the set time.

items.name: 负重背包跑步
items.description: Running with a loaded backpack to raise the effort. It builds endurance and leg strength.
steps: Strap a snug backpack with a modest load on your back.
Start with an easy jog on flat ground.
Keep your torso tall and your steps light.
Maintain a pace where you can breathe steadily.
Cut back the load if your form suffers.
Run for 10-20 minutes.

items.name: 跑步
items.description: A running style move that gets your heart rate up. Keep a steady pace for as long as you like.
steps: 首先站直，双脚分开与臀部同宽。
启动你的核心并保持上半身放松。
开始原地慢跑，将膝盖抬向胸部，然后轻轻落在脚掌上。
保持稳定的步伐并继续慢跑所需的时间或距离。
记住在整个练习过程中深呼吸并保持良好的姿势。
items.unlockText: 连续 35 分钟（5 公里折算）

items.name: 跑步(器械)
items.description: A running style move that gets your heart rate up. Keep a steady pace for as long as you like.
steps: 首先站直，双脚分开与臀部同宽。
启动你的核心并保持上半身放松。
开始原地慢跑，将膝盖抬向胸部，然后轻轻落在脚掌上。
保持稳定的步伐并继续慢跑所需的时间或距离。
记住在整个练习过程中深呼吸并保持良好的姿势。

items.name: 跑步加半蹲
items.description: Alternate running in place with a shallow knee bend to keep the heart rate up while the legs work.
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Jog on the spot for a few steps.
Pause into a shallow knee bend, hips back and chest up.
Stand tall and go straight back into running.
Repeat for 30-60 seconds.

items.name: 跑步加半蹲跳
items.description: Combine running in place with a half squat jump for a cardio drill that also trains the legs.
steps: Stand tall and run on the spot for a few steps.
Drop into a half squat with your chest up.
Jump up, swinging your arms.
Land softly with bent knees and go back to running.
Repeat for 30-60 seconds.

items.name: 跑步加开合跳
items.description: Run in place and throw in a jumping jack every few steps for a full-body cardio burst.
steps: Stand tall and start jogging on the spot.
After a few steps, jump your feet wide while raising your arms overhead.
Jump your feet back together and lower the arms.
Resume running and repeat the pattern.
Keep your landings soft and keep going for 30-60 seconds.

items.name: 跑步机倒退走
items.description: Walking backwards at a gentle pace on a treadmill. It works the quads and gets your heart rate up in a joint-friendly way.
steps: Set the treadmill to a very slow speed and hold the handrails.
Turn to face away from the direction of the belt.
Step back gently, landing on the toes first.
Keep your chest tall and take small steps.
Continue for several minutes at a comfortable pace.

items.name: 跑步机步行
items.description: Walking on a treadmill lets you control speed and incline for steady, low-impact cardio.
steps: Step onto the belt and hold the rails while you start at a slow speed.
Increase to a comfortable walking pace.
Let go of the rails and swing your arms naturally.
Keep your head up and your steps even.
Add some incline if you want more challenge.
Walk for 20-45 minutes and slow down before stepping off.

items.name: 跑步机跑步
items.description: Running at a steady pace on a treadmill to build endurance and burn energy.
steps: Step onto the belt and clip the safety key to your clothing.
Start at a walk and raise the speed gradually to a comfortable jog.
Keep your chest tall and your arms swinging loosely at your sides.
Land softly under your hips and keep your steps quick.
Run for 10-30 minutes at a pace where you can still breathe steadily.
Slow to a walk for a few minutes to cool down.

items.name: 跑跳结合
items.description: Run in place and add a hop to lift the heart rate and wake up the legs.
steps: Stand tall with feet under your hips.
Run on the spot at a steady pace, pumping your arms.
Every few steps, hop off one foot and land softly.
Stay light on the balls of your feet.
Keep going for 30-60 seconds at a pace you can hold.

items.name: 跳步
items.description: A simple skipping step with a hop on each foot. A playful way to warm up and lift your heart rate.
steps: Stand tall and relaxed.
Step forward and hop on the same foot.
Switch and hop on the other foot.
Swing the opposite arm forward with each step.
Stay light on the balls of your feet.
Keep a steady rhythm.

items.name: 跳箱左右移动
items.description: A quick-footed drill where you hop side to side over a box. It builds agility, lower leg stamina and conditioning.
steps: Stand next to a low box or step on one side.
Place the foot closest to it on top.
Hop across, landing the other foot on the box as the first foot goes down.
Keep your steps light and quick.
Continue shuffling side to side at a steady pace.

items.name: 跳跃上台阶
items.description: A step up with an explosive jump at the top, which builds leg power and raises your heart rate.
steps: Stand facing a sturdy box or step.
Place one foot on top.
Drive through it and jump up into the air.
Land softly on the box and step back down.
Switch legs and keep a steady rhythm.

items.name: 跳跃高抬膝触碰
items.description: A hopping drill where you drive a knee up and tap it with your hand. It raises the heart rate and builds coordination.
steps: Stand tall with one hand held out in front at waist height.
Hop on one leg while driving the opposite knee up to tap your hand.
Land softly and quickly switch legs.
Keep your chest upright.
Continue at a lively pace for 20-30 seconds.

items.name: 踏步机步行
items.description: Stepping on a stepmill at a steady pace. A tough, low-impact cardio workout for legs and glutes.
steps: 将步进机调整到舒适的水平。
走上机器，将双手放在扶手上以获得支撑。
开始行走时，将一只脚放在台阶上，然后将另一只脚放在台阶上，双腿交替。
保持直立姿势并锻炼核心肌肉。
继续步行所需的时间或距离。
当您对锻炼感到更加舒适时，逐渐增加强度或速度。
完成练习后记得冷静下来并伸展身体。

items.name: 踢腿侧跳
items.description: A lively jump that ends with a kick out to the side. It lifts your heart rate and trains leg power.
steps: Stand tall with your knees slightly bent.
Jump up off both feet.
Kick one leg out to the side at the top.
Land softly on both feet with soft knees.
Repeat, alternating the kicking leg.
Keep a controlled, bouncy rhythm.

items.name: 连续小跳
items.description: Quick, low hops on the spot that keep your feet barely off the floor. They warm up the calves and ankles and build bouncy reactive strength.
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and arms relaxed at your sides.
Hop up a few centimetres by pushing through the balls of your feet.
Land softly on the balls of your feet and rebound straight away.
Keep your knees almost straight and your chest tall.
Continue for 20-30 seconds at a quick, steady rhythm.

items.name: 靠墙冲刺
items.description: Leaning into a wall, you drive your knees in a fast running pattern. It practises sprint posture and builds speed.
steps: Place your hands on a wall and lean forward with a straight body line.
Brace your core.
Drive one knee up while the other leg stays extended.
Switch legs quickly in a running rhythm.
Keep your hips level.
Go hard for 10-20 seconds, then rest.

items.name: 靠墙高抬腿
items.description: A high-knee run in place with the hands on a wall for support. It raises the heart rate and trains the hip flexors.
steps: 面向墙壁站立，双脚分开与臀部同宽。
将双手放在墙上以获得支撑。
启动你的核心并将右膝抬向胸部，同时将左脚保持在地面上。
快速换腿，将左膝抬向胸部，然后将右脚放低。
继续交替双腿进行跑步动作，将膝盖尽可能抬高。
在整个练习过程中保持快节奏并保持上半身稳定。
重复所需的持续时间或重复次数。

items.name: 高抬腿冲刺
items.description: Running in place at full speed with your knees driving high. A quick way to raise your heart rate and warm up your legs.
steps: Stand tall with your arms bent at your sides.
Start running in place, driving each knee up to hip height.
Pump your arms in rhythm with your legs.
Stay on the balls of your feet and keep your chest up.
Go hard for 20 to 30 seconds, then rest.

items.name: 高抬腿后踢腿
items.description: A cardio drill alternating high knee lifts with heel flicks to the buttocks. It warms up the legs and lifts your heart rate.
steps: Stand tall with your arms ready to pump.
Run in place and drive your knees up high.
Switch to kicking your heels toward your buttocks.
Alternate between the two patterns.
Stay light on your feet.
Keep going for 30-60 seconds.

items.name: 高抬腿跑
items.description: A running-in-place move with high knees. It raises the heart rate.
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Run in place, driving your knees up toward waist height.
Pump your arms in rhythm.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep your chest tall.
Continue for 30-60 seconds.

items.name: 高抬腿跳步
items.description: A bouncy skip with high knee lifts. It warms up the legs and raises your heart rate.
steps: Stand tall and relaxed.
Skip forward, driving one knee up high.
Hop lightly on the other foot.
Swing the opposite arm forward with each knee.
Alternate legs in a smooth rhythm.
Keep your chest up and land softly.

items.name: 高抬腿踏步跑
items.description: A light, springy trot with high knees, like a pony. It's a fun cardio warm-up.
steps: Stand tall and relaxed.
Move forward in a bouncy trot.
Lift each knee up with a springy step.
Stay on the balls of your feet.
Swing your arms in rhythm.
Continue for 30-60 seconds.

items.name: 高抬腿转后踢腿
items.description: A running-in-place drill that alternates a high knee with a heel kick to raise your heart rate.
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Drive one knee up to hip height.
Lower it and kick the same heel toward your glutes.
Alternate sides at a steady, light pace.
Keep your core braced and stay on the balls of your feet.

items.name: 高抬膝弓步蹲
items.description: Step into a lunge and drive the knee high to raise the heart rate.
steps: Stand tall.
Step forward into a lunge.
Push off and drive the back knee up high.
Step back and repeat on the other side.
Keep your pace steady for 30-60 seconds.

items.name: 高抬膝行走弓步
items.description: A walking lunge with a high knee between each step. It raises your heart rate and trains the legs.
steps: 双脚分开与臀部同宽站立。
将右膝尽可能高地抬向胸部，同时用左腿保持平衡。
右脚向前迈出一步，身体降低成弓步姿势，双膝弯曲成 90 度角。
用右脚推出，并将左膝抬向胸部。
左脚向前迈出一步，将身体降低至弓步位置。
继续交替双腿并向前冲刺，保持核心参与并保持稳定的步伐。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 高抬膝触碰
items.description: Fast knee-drive drill where you tap your knees to your hands, great for warming up and raising the heart rate.
steps: Stand tall with hands out in front at waist height.
Drive one knee up to tap your hand.
Lower it and switch quickly to the other knee.
Stay light on the balls of your feet.
Keep a fast, steady pace for time.

items.name: 高抬膝转体
items.description: A running-in-place move where you twist to bring the elbow to the lifted knee. It raises your heart rate and engages the trunk.
steps: Stand tall with your hands behind your head.
Lift one knee high and twist your torso to meet it with the opposite elbow.
Lower and switch sides.
Keep a quick, steady rhythm.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Go for 30-60 seconds.

items.name: W形俯卧撑
items.description: A push-up variation with the hands placed in a W shape. It focuses on the chest and shoulders.
steps: Get into a plank and place your hands in a W position.
Keep your body straight from head to heels.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Keep your elbows angled slightly out.
Press back up.
Repeat without letting your hips sag.

items.name: 上斜俯卧撑
items.description: You perform a push-up with hands elevated. It makes the push-up easier and trains the chest, shoulders and triceps.
steps: 将双手放在较高的表面上，例如长凳或台阶上，双手之间的距离略宽于肩宽。
将双腿伸到身后，放在脚掌上，从头到脚跟形成一条直线。
弯曲肘部，将胸部向升高的表面降低，保持身体呈一条直线。
在底部暂停片刻，然后伸直手臂将自己推回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 上斜俯卧撑(凳上)
items.description: Push-up with hands elevated on a bench, an easier version of the push-up.
steps: Place hands on a bench slightly wider than shoulders.
Walk your feet back into a straight line.
Lower your chest to the bench.
Press back up.
Keep your core tight.

items.name: 上斜俯卧撑(箱上)
items.description: An incline push-up with the hands on a box. It trains the chest, shoulders and triceps with less load than a floor push-up.
steps: 将双手放在盒子或高架表面的边缘，距离略宽于肩宽。
将双腿伸到身后，放在脚掌上，从头到脚跟形成一条直线。
弯曲肘部，将胸部向箱子方向降低，保持身体呈一条直线。
在底部暂停片刻，然后伸直手臂将自己推回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 上斜俯卧撑深度跳
items.description: An incline push-up with a drop and explosive rebound. It builds chest power and quickness.
steps: 找到一个较高的表面，例如长凳或台阶，并将双手与肩同宽放在边缘。
双脚向后退一步，保持身体从头到脚跟呈一条直线。
将胸部向水面边缘降低，弯曲肘部并保持身体对齐。
推动手掌以伸展手臂并返回到起始位置。
从水面边缘跳下，膝盖稍微弯曲，轻轻落地。
重复俯卧撑和深度跳跃达到所需的重复次数。

items.name: 上斜反握俯卧撑
items.description: An incline push-up with your palms facing back. It trains the chest and shoulders in a different way.
steps: 将双手放在长凳或高架表面的边缘，距离略宽于肩宽。
将双腿伸到身后，放在脚掌上，从头到脚跟形成一条直线。
弯曲肘部，将胸部向长凳方向降低，使其靠近身体两侧。
在底部暂停片刻，然后伸展双臂将自己推回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 上斜拍肩
items.description: A plank on an incline where you tap each shoulder, building core and shoulder stability.
steps: Place your hands on a bench or box and extend into a plank position.
Spread your feet slightly wider for balance.
Lift one hand and tap the opposite shoulder.
Keep your hips level and body in a straight line.
Alternate sides at a steady pace.

items.name: 上斜肩胛俯卧撑
items.description: An incline push-up where you retract your shoulder blades. Strengthens the serratus anterior and upper back.
steps: 设置一个 45 度角的上斜凳。
将双手放在长凳上，距离略比肩宽。
将双脚放在地面上，距离与臀部同宽。
将胸部向长凳方向降低，保持肘部内收。
当你降低时，缩回肩胛骨，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
推动手掌以伸展手臂并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 下斜俯卧撑
items.description: A push-up with the feet raised on a surface. The incline puts more load on the upper chest and shoulders.
steps: 将双手放在地面上，距离略宽于肩宽，双脚放在稳定的表面上。
保持身体从头到脚呈一条直线，锻炼核心肌肉。
弯曲肘部，使胸部靠近地面，使胸部靠近地面。
推动手掌以伸展手臂并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 下斜俯卧撑(跪姿)
items.description: A push-up from your knees with the lower body elevated, shifting the work to the upper chest and shoulders.
steps: Kneel with your knees on a bench or step and hands on the floor.
Keep a straight line from head to knees.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up.
Keep your core tight and your elbows at about 45 degrees.

items.name: 下斜拍肩
items.description: A plank with your feet raised where you tap alternate shoulders. It trains shoulder strength and core stability.
steps: Place your feet on a bench and your hands on the floor under your shoulders.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Lift one hand and tap the opposite shoulder.
Return it and tap with the other hand.
Keep your hips from rocking.

items.name: 下斜跪姿箱上俯卧撑
items.nameEn: decline kneeling push up on box
items.description: A kneeling push-up with the hands on a box, so the body slopes downward. It's an easier push-up that still stresses the chest and shoulders.
steps: Place a sturdy box in front of you and kneel on the floor.
Put your hands on the box edge, slightly wider than your shoulders.
Form a straight line from head to knees.
Lower your chest to the box with elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your hips from sagging.

items.name: 下斜钻石俯卧撑
items.description: A diamond push-up with your feet raised. It shifts the load toward the triceps and upper chest.
steps: Place your feet on a bench and your hands close together under your chest.
Form a diamond with your thumbs and index fingers.
Lower your chest toward your hands.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Push back up to straight arms.

items.name: 交叉俯卧撑
items.description: A push up where one hand crosses over toward the other side. It adds an uneven challenge for the chest and core.
steps: Start in a high plank.
Lower into a push up.
Push up and cross one hand over toward the other side.
Place it down and repeat.
Alternate the crossing hand.

items.name: 伪俯撑俯卧撑
items.description: A push-up with your hands near your hips and your body leaning forward. It strongly loads shoulders and chest.
steps: Start in a plank with your hands turned out beside your lower ribs.
Lean your shoulders forward beyond your hands.
Lower your chest with your elbows close to your body.
Press up while keeping the lean.
Keep your core braced.

items.name: 侧卧胸部拉伸
items.description: Lying on your side, you open one arm backward to stretch the chest. It loosens tight pecs.
steps: Lie on your side with your knees bent and arms in front of you.
Lift your top arm and open it back like a book.
Let your chest rotate open.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return and switch sides.

items.name: 侧向屈膝俯卧撑
items.description: A push-up with the knees bent and turned to one side, adding a gentle twist to the trunk. It trains the chest and the obliques.
steps: Start in a push-up position with your knees bent and both hands under your shoulders.
Rotate your knees and hips slightly to one side.
Lower your chest to the floor with your elbows at about 45 degrees.
Push back up to the start.
Keep your core tight and your hips from sagging.
Switch the side of your knees between sets.

items.name: 俯卧撑
items.description: The classic push-up from a high plank. Works the chest, shoulders, triceps and core in one move.
steps: 从高位平板支撑开始，双手分开略宽于肩宽，双脚并拢。
弯曲肘部，调动核心力量，将身体压向地面，保持身体呈一条直线。
当你的胸部刚好高于地面时，暂停片刻，然后伸直手臂，将自己推回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 俯卧撑(用俯卧撑支架)
items.description: A push-up on handles that lets you go a little deeper and keeps the wrists neutral. It trains the chest, shoulders and triceps.
steps: Place the handles shoulder-width apart and grip them in a plank position.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your chest until it is between the handles, elbows about 45 degrees from your body.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your core tight and your hips from sagging.

items.name: 俯卧撑(膝碰胸)
items.description: A push-up where you pull a knee toward your chest on each rep. It adds core and conditioning work.
steps: Start in a plank with your hands under your shoulders.
Lower into a push-up.
Press back up.
Drive one knee toward your chest.
Return that foot to the plank.
Alternate legs each rep.

items.name: 俯卧撑(跪姿)
items.description: An easier push-up variation from the knees that builds chest, shoulder and arm strength.
steps: Kneel on the floor with your hands slightly wider than shoulder width.
Keep your body in a straight line from your head to your knees.
Lower your chest toward the floor by bending your elbows.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your core tight and your hips from sagging.

items.name: 俯卧撑(靠墙)
items.description: A push-up against a wall, a gentle version for beginners. Works the chest, shoulders and triceps.
steps: 面向墙壁站立，距离大约一臂距离。
将双手放在墙上，与肩同高，距离略宽于肩宽。
后退几英尺，保持身体挺直，双脚分开与臀部同宽。
弯曲肘部，将胸部向墙壁降低，保持身体呈一条直线。
推回起始位置，伸直手臂。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 俯卧撑(靠墙) v. 2
items.description: A push-up against a wall, a gentle version for beginners. Works the chest, shoulders and triceps.
steps: 面向墙壁站立，距离大约一臂距离。
将双手放在墙上，与肩同高，距离略宽于肩宽。
双脚向后退一步，保持与臀部同宽。
收紧核心肌群，保持身体从头到脚跟呈一条直线。
弯曲肘部，将胸部向墙壁降低，保持身体挺直。
暂停片刻，然后将自己推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 俯卧撑加双杠臂屈伸
items.nameEn: push up and triceps dip on parallel bars
items.description: A combined move on parallel bars that pairs a push-up with a dip. It works the chest and triceps.
steps: Place hands on parallel bars and support yourself in a plank.
Lower into a push-up with your elbows out.
Press back up to a plank.
Shift your hands to the edge of the bars, body upright.
Dip down and press up, then repeat the cycle.

items.name: 俯卧撑屈体触脚尖
items.description: A push up followed by a pike with a reach to the toes. It trains the chest, shoulders and core.
steps: Start in a high plank.
Do a push up.
Lift your hips into a pike.
Reach one hand to the opposite toe.
Return to plank and alternate.

items.name: 俯卧撑开合跳
items.description: A push up combined with a jumping jack leg motion. It raises your heart rate while training chest and shoulders.
steps: Start in a high plank with your feet together.
Lower into a push up with control.
Push back up and jump your feet wide.
Jump your feet back together.
Keep your body straight and move rhythmically.

items.name: 俯卧撑手挪动
items.description: A push up where your hands shift one at a time to walk in and out. It adds shoulder stability to the chest drill.
steps: Start in a high plank.
Lower into a push up.
Step one hand wider, then the other.
Do another push up.
Step your hands back in.

items.name: 俯卧撑拉
items.description: A push-up combined with a pulling motion, adding upper-back work to a classic chest exercise.
steps: Start in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders.
Lower your chest to the floor in a push-up.
Press back up to the top.
Drag one hand across the floor as if pulling yourself forward.
Alternate sides and keep your core tight.

items.name: 俯卧撑结束姿势(动作检查)
items.description: A side-by-side form check for the bottom position of a push-up, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
steps: Start in a high plank and lower yourself under control.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your chest nearly touches the floor, elbows angled back, and hips stay in line.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

items.name: 俯卧撑触脚尖
items.description: A push up followed by a hand reaching to the opposite toe. It adds core and mobility work to the chest drill.
steps: Start in a high plank.
Lower your chest and push back up.
Lift your hips and reach one hand to the opposite foot.
Return to plank.
Alternate hands each rep.

items.name: 俯卧撑起始姿势(动作检查)
items.description: A side-by-side form check for the starting position of a push-up, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
steps: Set your hands on the floor under your shoulders and extend your legs back.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your body forms one straight line from head to heels with hands under the shoulders.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

items.name: 俯卧撑转侧平板支撑 v. 2
items.nameEn: push up to side plank v. 2
items.description: A push-up that finishes by rotating into a side plank. It trains the chest and trunk.
steps: Start in a high plank.
Lower into a push-up.
Push up and rotate into a side plank, raising one arm.
Return to plank.
Alternate sides each rep.

items.name: 俯卧撑转触膝
items.description: A push up where you pull a knee toward your elbow after each rep. It adds a core challenge to a standard push up.
steps: Start in a push up position with a straight body.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up to straight arms.
Bring one knee toward the same side elbow.
Return the foot and repeat on the other side.
Keep your hips level and your core braced.

items.name: 全俯撑俯卧撑
items.description: A push-up from the planche position with the feet off the ground. It is an elite bodyweight move for the chest, shoulders and triceps.
steps: 从俯卧撑位置开始，双手分开略宽于肩宽。
收紧核心肌群，将身体放低至地面，保持肘部靠近身体两侧。
当你降低身体高度时，身体向前倾斜，双脚离开地面，用双手保持平衡。
继续降低身体，直到胸部略高于地面。
用手推动并伸展双臂，将身体抬回到起始位置。
在整个运动过程中，从头部到脚后跟保持一条直线。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 击掌俯卧撑
items.description: An explosive push-up with a clap in mid-air. It builds power in the chest, shoulders and triceps.
steps: 从高平板支撑位置开始，双手分开略宽于肩宽。
弯曲肘部，将身体降低到地面，保持核心参与。
爆发性地推动手掌，将身体推离地面。
在半空中时，拍手，然后回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 击胸俯卧撑(男)
items.description: A push-up where one hand taps the chest at the bottom of each rep, alternating sides. It adds a stability challenge to the chest and triceps.
steps: 从高平板支撑位置开始，双手分开略宽于肩宽，身体呈一条直线。
弯曲肘部，使肘部靠近身体两侧，将身体降低到地面。
当你降低身体时，用右手拍打胸部。
将自己推回到起始位置。
重复这个动作，这次用左手敲击胸部。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

items.name: 前平板支撑到俯卧撑
items.description: A move that moves from forearm plank to full push-up position, training the chest, arms and core.
steps: Start in a forearm plank with elbows under shoulders.
Place one hand on the floor and press up, then the other.
Reach a high plank with straight arms.
Lower back to your forearms one arm at a time.
Alternate the leading arm each rep and keep your hips level.

items.name: 加强俯卧撑
items.description: A push-up finished with an extra shove that spreads the shoulder blades at the top. It trains the chest and the serratus muscles that stabilise the shoulder blades.
steps: 从高位平板支撑开始，双手分开略宽于肩宽，身体从头到脚跟呈一条直线。
弯曲肘部，使肘部靠近身体两侧，将身体降低到地面。
一旦你的胸部刚好高于地面，用力推动你的手臂，伸展你的手臂并抬起你的上半身。
在动作的最高点，将上背部推向天花板，从而伸展肩胛骨。
暂停片刻，然后通过缩回肩胛骨并将身体放回起始位置来反转动作。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 动态胸部拉伸(男)
items.description: A dynamic chest stretch, swinging the arms out and across the chest. It loosens the chest and shoulders.
steps: 站直，双脚分开与肩同宽。
将双臂伸直至两侧，与地面平行。
慢慢地将双臂向前伸，交叉在身体前面。
感受胸部肌肉的伸展。
保持拉伸 10-30 秒。
返回起始位置并重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 半跪姿pvc管胸肌活动拉伸
items.nameEn: half kneeling pvc pec mobilization stretch
items.description: A chest opener using a PVC pipe from a half-kneeling position. It loosens tight pecs and the front of the shoulder.
steps: Kneel on one knee and grip a pipe or stick with one hand while the other arm reaches out.
Place the working forearm against a wall or post.
Gently rotate your torso away until you feel a stretch across your chest.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.

items.name: 单侧射箭式俯卧撑
items.description: A push up where one arm does most of the work while the other extends out to the side. It builds unilateral chest and arm strength.
steps: Start in a wide push up position with hands well outside your shoulders.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Shift your weight to one arm and bend that elbow while the other arm stays straight.
Lower your chest toward the bent arm side.
Push back up and shift to the centre.
Alternate or complete reps on one side, then switch.

items.name: 单臂俯卧撑
items.description: An advanced push-up using one arm. Works the chest, shoulder, triceps and core.
steps: 从俯卧撑位置开始，双手分开与肩同宽，一只手比另一只手稍宽。
弯曲肘部，保持背部挺直，调动核心力量，将身体降低至地面。
当你降低身体时，将你的重心转移到一侧，并将另一只手臂抬离地面，将其笔直延伸到一侧。
推动胸部和三头肌，将身体抬回到起始位置，同时将伸出的手臂放回地面。
重复该动作，每次重复时交替伸展手臂。

items.name: 单臂俯卧撑(跪姿)
items.description: A one-arm push-up from the knees, a stepping stone toward the full single-arm version. It builds chest and trunk strength.
steps: Kneel and place one hand under your shoulder, with the other arm behind your back.
Spread your knees a bit wider for balance.
Keep a straight line from your head to your knees.
Lower your chest toward the floor with control.
Press back up without twisting your hips.
Switch arms and repeat.

items.name: 单臂俯卧撑(靠墙支撑)
items.description: An easier one-arm push-up using a wall, building the strength and stability needed for the full floor version.
steps: Stand facing a wall at arm's length and place one hand on it at chest height.
Keep your other arm behind your back or at your side.
Bend your elbow to lower your chest toward the wall, body in a straight line.
Press back to the start.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

items.name: 单臂肩胛俯卧撑
items.description: A small push-up movement with one arm that moves only the shoulder blades. It builds control of the serratus anterior.
steps: Start in a plank with one hand on the floor, the other behind your back or on your hip.
Keep your elbow locked straight.
Let your chest sink slightly between your shoulder blades.
Push the floor away to round your upper back slightly.
Finish the reps, then switch arms.

items.name: 双杠深俯卧撑
items.nameEn: deep push up on parallel bars
items.description: A push-up between parallel bars that lets you sink deeper than the floor allows. It gives the chest a greater stretch.
steps: Grip two parallel bars and hold a straight plank position.
Keep your elbows at about 45 degrees.
Lower your chest below the level of your hands.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your body in one line throughout.

items.name: 双臂交叉
items.description: A dynamic arm swing across the chest that warms up the pecs and shoulders.
steps: Stand tall with your arms out to the sides at shoulder height.
Swing both arms forward and cross them in front of your chest.
Open them back out and squeeze your shoulder blades slightly.
Alternate which arm is on top.
Keep a steady, relaxed rhythm.

items.name: 反向胸部拉伸
items.description: Clasping your hands behind your back and lifting them stretches the chest and front of the shoulders. It is a classic posture reset.
steps: Stand tall and clasp your hands behind your back with straight arms.
Lift your hands up and away from your body while opening your chest.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

items.name: 史密斯杠上斜俯卧撑
items.nameEn: incline push up on a smith bar
items.description: A push-up with your hands on a Smith bar, making it easier than a floor push-up while still training your chest.
steps: Set the Smith bar at about waist height and rack it securely.
Place your hands on the bar slightly wider than your shoulders.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Lower your chest to the bar.
Push back up to straight arms.

items.name: 后侧胸肌拉伸 v. 2
items.description: A back-clasped chest opener that lengthens the pecs and the front of the shoulders.
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Clasp your hands together behind your back.
Straighten your arms and lift them gently away from your body.
Open your chest and pull your shoulder blades together.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.
Release and repeat.

items.name: 四柱支撑式(查图兰加)
items.description: A low push-up hold from plank. It builds triceps, chest and core strength.
steps: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders.
Shift forward slightly.
Bend your elbows straight back to about 90 degrees.
Keep your body in one line, elbows close to your ribs.
Hold briefly, then press back up.

items.name: 坐姿胸部蚌式开合
items.description: Sit tall and open your elbows wide like a clam to stretch the front of the chest and shoulders.
steps: Sit tall with your fingers lightly behind your head.
Start with your elbows pointing forward.
Slowly open your elbows out and back as far as is comfortable.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.

items.name: 坐姿过头直臂拉伸
items.nameEn: seated over head straight arm stretch
items.description: A seated overhead reach that stretches the chest and shoulders. It helps open up the upper body after desk time.
steps: Sit tall on a chair or bench.
Interlace your fingers and straighten your arms.
Raise them overhead with palms facing up.
Lift your chest and reach slightly back.
Breathe normally and hold for 20 to 30 seconds.
Release slowly.

items.name: 墙角胸部拉伸
items.description: Using a wall corner to lean into, you stretch both sides of the chest at once. The corner lets you control the depth easily.
steps: Stand facing a wall corner and place a forearm on each wall at about shoulder height.
Step one foot forward and lean your chest into the corner until you feel a stretch.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

items.name: 增强式俯卧撑
items.description: A push-up that you drive explosively so your hands leave the floor. It builds fast pressing power in the chest, shoulders and triceps.
steps: 从高平板支撑位置开始，双手分开略宽于肩宽。
弯曲肘部，将胸部压向地面，保持身体呈一条直线。
爆发性地推离地面，利用胸部肌肉将上半身推离地面。
双手回到起始位置，轻轻落地。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 增强式俯卧撑 v. 2
items.description: An explosive push-up variation where your hands leave the floor, building upper-body power.
steps: Start in a high plank with hands under your shoulders.
Lower your chest toward the floor with control.
Explode upward so your hands leave the ground.
Land softly with slightly bent elbows.
Reset your body line and repeat.

items.name: 婴儿式俯卧撑
items.description: A push-up performed from a kneeling child's pose position. It trains the chest and triceps with a gentle range.
steps: Kneel and sit back on your heels with your arms stretched forward.
Place your hands on the floor at chest height.
Shift forward and lower your chest between your hands.
Push the floor away to rise.
Sit back to the starting pose and repeat.

items.name: 宽距俯卧撑
items.description: A push-up with your hands placed wider than your shoulders. It puts more emphasis on the chest and less on the triceps.
steps: 从高平板支撑位置开始，双手分开比肩宽。
保持身体从头到脚呈一条直线。
弯曲肘部，将胸部压向地面，使其靠近身体两侧。
推动手掌以伸展手臂并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 宽距俯卧撑(靠墙)
items.description: A beginner-friendly standing push-up against a wall with a wide hand position to emphasise the chest.
steps: Stand facing a wall and place your hands on it, wider than your shoulders.
Step your feet back so your body leans in a straight line.
Bend your elbows to bring your chest toward the wall.
Push back to the start.
Keep your hips in line with your shoulders.

items.name: 宽转窄俯卧撑
items.description: A push-up where the hands move from a wide to a narrow position between reps. It shifts the load from chest to triceps.
steps: Start in a high plank with your hands wider than your shoulders.
Lower your chest to the floor with your body in a straight line.
Push back up to the top.
Walk your hands in to a narrow, close position.
Repeat a push-up, then step your hands back out wide.

items.name: 屈膝收腿俯卧撑
items.description: A push-up with a knee tuck toward the chest at the top. It combines upper body pressing with an ab crunch.
steps: Start in a push-up position with a straight body.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up.
Pull one knee toward your chest.
Return the leg and repeat on the other side.
Keep your hips level.

items.name: 屈臂胸部拉伸
items.description: Pressing a bent arm against a wall or frame stretches the chest and front shoulder. Changing the arm height shifts which part you feel.
steps: Stand beside a wall or doorframe and place your forearm on it with your elbow bent to 90 degrees.
Step forward and turn your body away until you feel the stretch across your chest.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

items.name: 弓箭手俯卧撑
items.description: A wide push-up that shifts the weight to one arm while the other arm stays straight. It trains the chest and triceps on the way to one arm push-ups.
steps: 从俯卧撑位置开始，双手分开略宽于肩宽。
将一只手臂伸直至一侧，与地面平行。
弯曲肘部降低身体，保持背部挺直，核心参与。
推回到起始位置。
在另一侧重复上述步骤，将另一只手臂伸出到一侧。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

items.name: 徒手推拉
items.description: A bodyweight movement of pushing and pulling against your own resistance. It trains the chest and arms.
steps: 从俯卧撑位置开始，双手分开略宽于肩宽，身体呈一条直线。
弯曲肘部，将胸部压向地面，保持身体伸直。
推动手掌以伸展手臂并返回到起始位置。
从俯卧撑位置开始，弯曲肘部，将胸部拉向地面，保持身体伸直。
推动手掌以伸展手臂并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 徒手斯文德推举
items.description: Press your palms together hard in front of your chest and push them forward and back. It needs no equipment and fires the inner chest.
steps: Stand or sit tall with your palms together at chest height.
Squeeze your palms hard against each other.
Push your hands straight out in front of you.
Bring them back to your chest while still squeezing.
Keep your shoulders down and repeat.

items.name: 徒手站姿飞鸟
items.description: A standing fly motion without weights, squeezing the arms together. It teaches chest engagement and works as a warm-up.
steps: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your arms out wide with slightly bent elbows.
Brace your core and keep your chest proud.
Sweep your arms together in front of your chest.
Squeeze your pecs hard for a second.
Open your arms back out with control.

items.name: 悬挂带俯卧撑
items.description: A push-up with the hands in suspension handles, so the body has to stay stable. It trains the chest, shoulders, triceps and core.
steps: 找到一个悬挂训练器并将其调整到合适的高度。
背对锚点站立，并用正手握住手柄。
双脚向前走，身体向前倾斜，直到悬架训练器支撑您的体重。
保持身体从头到脚跟伸直，核心部位收紧，胸部朝手柄方向降低。
推动你的胸部和手臂回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
