items.name: 手摇车
items.description: Cranking pedals with your hands on an upper body ergometer. Gets your heart rate up using the arms and shoulders.
steps: 将座椅高度和车把位置调整至舒适的水平。
坐在测力计上，背部挺直，双脚放在踏板上。
双手抓住手柄，并将手臂呈 90 度角。
开始用手踩踏板，以受控的动作推拉手柄。
继续踩踏所需的持续时间或重复次数。

items.name: 扭转俯卧撑
items.description: A push up with a rotation at the top. It trains the chest and arms and adds core work.
steps: Start in a high plank with hands under your shoulders.
Lower your chest to the floor.
Push up and rotate one arm toward the ceiling.
Return the hand to the floor.
Alternate sides each rep.

items.name: 抬单腿俯卧撑
items.description: A push-up performed with one leg lifted. It challenges the chest, shoulders and core stability.
steps: Start in a push-up position.
Lift one leg off the floor.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up without twisting your hips.
Keep your body in a line.
Switch the lifted leg every set.

items.name: 抬单臂俯卧撑
items.description: A push-up where you lift one arm out to the side at the top. Challenges the core and shoulder stability.
steps: 从俯卧撑位置开始，双手分开略宽于肩宽，双脚并拢。
将一只手臂伸直至一侧，与地面平行。
弯曲肘部，将身体降低到地面，保持背部挺直，核心参与。
推回起始位置，使用胸部肌肉抬起身体。
另一只手臂伸出，重复上述动作。

items.name: 抬高俯卧撑
items.description: A push-up with your hands on a raised surface. It is easier than a floor push-up and a good way to build chest strength.
steps: Place your hands on a bench or box slightly wider than your shoulders.
Step back so your body forms a straight line.
Lower your chest to the edge with your elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your hips from sagging.

items.name: 指关节俯卧撑
items.description: A push up on your knuckles to keep wrists straight. It builds chest and arm strength.
steps: Make fists and place them under your shoulders.
Keep your body straight.
Lower your chest.
Press up.
Keep wrists neutral.
Brace your core.

items.name: 指尖俯卧撑
items.description: A push up supported on your fingertips. It challenges the hands and forearms as well as the chest.
steps: Get into a high plank on your fingertips.
Keep your body straight.
Lower your chest to the floor.
Press up.
Reduce the range if your fingers tire.

items.name: 挺胸双手背后(保持)
items.description: A standing chest stretch with the hands clasped behind your back. It opens the front of the chest.
steps: Stand tall and clasp your hands behind your back.
Straighten your arms.
Lift your chest and gently raise your hands.
Feel the stretch across the chest and shoulders.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release slowly.

items.name: 改良印度式俯卧撑(男)
items.description: A modified hindu push-up that flows from a pike through a low dive to a lifted chest. It trains the chest, shoulders and triceps while opening up the spine.
steps: 从俯卧撑位置开始，双手分开略宽于肩宽，双脚分开与臀部同宽。
将身体向地面降低，弯曲肘部并保持核心参与。
当你降低身体时，将你的重心向后转移，并将臀部向上抬向天花板，与你的身体形成一个倒V形。
继续降低身体，直到胸部刚好高于地面，然后反向运动，将臀部向下推，并伸展手臂回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 旋转俯卧撑
items.description: A push-up with a rotation and arm reach at the top. It works the chest and trunk.
steps: Start in a push-up position.
Lower your chest to the floor.
Press up and rotate, reaching one arm toward the ceiling.
Return the hand to the floor.
Lower again for the next rep.
Alternate sides.

items.name: 时钟俯卧撑
items.description: A push-up that moves around like a clock, with an arm reaching out to the side on each rep. It works the chest, shoulders and core.
steps: 从高平板支撑位置开始，双手直接放在肩膀下方，身体呈一条直线。
弯曲肘部，使肘部靠近身体两侧，将身体降低到地面。
当你下降时，将你的身体向左旋转，将你的左臂伸直到侧面。
向上推回到起始位置，同时将身体旋转到中心。
重复俯卧撑，这次将身体向右旋转，并将右臂向侧面伸出。
每次重复时继续交替进行。

items.name: 杠杆式毛巾俯卧撑
items.description: A push-up with your hands on towels, adding instability for the chest and shoulders.
steps: Place your hands on towels on the floor in a plank.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up.
Keep your elbows at about 45 degrees.
Repeat for the planned reps.

items.name: 椅上坐姿上斜推胸
items.nameEn: seated incline chest press on a chair
items.description: A seated press angled upward to emphasise the upper chest.
steps: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Start with your hands near your chest.
Press them diagonally up and forward until your arms are straight.
Lower back to the chest slowly.

items.name: 椅上坐姿下斜推胸
items.nameEn: seated decline chest press on a chair
items.description: A seated press angled downward to bias the lower chest.
steps: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Start with your hands at chest height.
Press them diagonally down and forward until your arms are straight.
Return slowly to the chest and repeat.

items.name: 椅上坐姿交叉出拳
items.nameEn: seated cross body punch on a chair
items.description: A seated punching drill that raises your heart rate and works the chest, shoulders and trunk.
steps: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Raise your fists to guard position.
Punch one arm across your body, rotating the trunk slightly.
Pull it back and punch with the other arm.
Keep a quick, smooth rhythm.

items.name: 椅上坐姿交替动态胸部拉伸
items.nameEn: seated alternate dynamic chest stretch on a chair
items.description: A seated dynamic stretch that opens the chest by alternating arms.
steps: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Open one arm out to the side and rotate the trunk slightly.
Feel the stretch across your chest.
Return and switch arms in a smooth rhythm.

items.name: 椅上坐姿夹肩胛胸部拉伸
items.nameEn: seated squeeze shoulder blades chest stretch on a chair
items.description: Sit on a chair and squeeze your shoulder blades together to open the chest. It eases tight pecs from desk posture.
steps: Sit tall on a chair with your feet flat.
Reach your hands behind you and clasp them or hold the chair back.
Pull your shoulder blades together and lift your chest.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without arching your lower back.
Relax and repeat.

items.name: 椅上坐姿展开与下摆
items.nameEn: seated open up and under swing on a chair
items.description: A seated swing that opens the chest and then sweeps the arms underneath, warming up the trunk and shoulders.
steps: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Swing both arms open to the sides.
Rotate and sweep them under and across your body.
Open back out and alternate directions with a smooth rhythm.

items.name: 椅上坐姿手臂交叉
items.nameEn: seated arm crossover on a chair
items.description: A seated arm crossover that works the chest and warms up the shoulders.
steps: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Open your arms wide to the sides at shoulder height.
Sweep them together so they cross in front of your chest.
Open back out and alternate which arm is on top.

items.name: 椅上坐姿手臂交叉与挺胸
items.nameEn: seated arm crossover and chest out on a chair
items.description: A seated stretch that crosses the arms and then opens the chest. It loosens the upper body.
steps: Sit tall on a chair.
Cross your arms in front of your chest and hug yourself.
Open your arms wide and push your chest out.
Hold the open position for 5-10 seconds.
Repeat.

items.name: 椅上坐姿推胸
items.nameEn: seated chest press on a chair
items.description: A seated pressing motion done with bodyweight tension to work the chest and triceps.
steps: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Bring your hands to chest height and press your palms together.
Press forward until your arms are straight.
Draw them back to your chest slowly.

items.name: 椅上坐姿祈祷式夹胸
items.nameEn: sitting prayer chest squeeze on a chair
items.description: Seated, you press your palms together in front of your chest. It trains the chest with no equipment.
steps: Sit tall on a chair.
Bring your palms together in front of your chest.
Press your palms firmly into each other.
Hold for 10-15 seconds.
Release and repeat.

items.name: 椅上坐姿肘部夹胸飞鸟
items.nameEn: seated elbow chest fly on a chair
items.description: A seated chest fly with bent elbows that squeezes the pecs by pressing the arms together.
steps: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Raise your elbows to chest height with forearms up.
Squeeze your elbows together in front of you.
Open them out again under control.
Keep your shoulders away from your ears.

items.name: 椅上坐姿蝴蝶机夹胸
items.nameEn: seated pec dec on a chair
items.description: A seated pec dec motion without a machine, squeezing the chest by bringing the forearms together.
steps: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Raise your forearms in front of you with elbows bent at shoulder height.
Squeeze your forearms together.
Open them back to the sides under control.

items.name: 椅子推撑
items.description: A push-up variation with hands on a sturdy chair. It makes pressing easier while still training chest and arms.
steps: Place a stable chair against a wall and set your hands on the seat edge.
Walk your feet back until your body is straight.
Lower your chest toward the seat, elbows at about 45 degrees.
Push back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your core tight and hips level.

items.name: 横向移动俯卧撑
items.description: A push-up combined with side steps. It trains the chest and shoulders with extra coordination.
steps: Start in a high plank.
Do one push-up.
Step your hands and feet to the side.
Do another push-up.
Alternate direction after a set.

items.name: 毛巾侧向俯卧撑
items.description: A push-up variation where one hand slides on a towel, shifting load to one side of the chest.
steps: Start in a push-up position with one hand on a towel on the floor.
Slide that hand out to the side.
Lower your chest toward the other hand.
Push back up.
Slide the towel hand back in.
Switch sides.

items.name: 毛巾地面飞鸟
items.description: A floor fly sliding hands on towels for a bodyweight chest isolation move.
steps: Kneel or get into a plank with your hands on towels.
Slide your hands out wide to the sides.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Squeeze your chest to slide your hands back together.
Keep your core tight.
Do not let your hips sag.

items.name: 海豹俯卧撑
items.description: A push-up where your hands lift off the floor and reach out at the top. It builds chest and back strength together.
steps: Lie face down with your hands under your shoulders and legs straight.
Push your upper body up with your arms like a seal.
Keep your hips on the floor and your core tight.
Lower slowly to the floor.
Repeat for smooth, controlled reps.

items.name: 爆发式俯卧撑
items.description: A push-up pushed fast enough for your hands to leave the floor. Builds upper-body power.
steps: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Push up explosively so your hands lift off.
Land softly with bent elbows.
Go straight into the next rep.
Keep your body in a straight line.

items.name: 直杠胸部臂屈伸
items.description: A chest dip on a bar, leaning forward and crossing your ankles. Targets the chest and triceps.
steps: 手掌朝下，双臂完全伸展，抓住双杠。
弯曲膝盖并交叉脚踝。
弯曲手臂，降低身体，直到肩膀低于肘部。
伸直手臂，将自己推回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 直臂向后胸部拉伸
items.description: Reaching straight arms backward opens your chest and the front of your shoulders. Simple, quick and good between sets or after a desk session.
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and reach both straight arms behind you.
Lift your arms slightly and open your chest without leaning back.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

items.name: 眼镜蛇俯卧撑
items.description: A push-up that flows into a cobra-style chest opening at the top. It trains the chest and arms and works the back and spine.
steps: Start in a push-up position with hands under your shoulders.
Lower your chest to the floor with elbows tucked.
Press up and keep going, letting your hips sink forward.
Lift your chest and look slightly up, like a cobra.
Return to the plank by lifting your hips back.
Keep the movement smooth and controlled.

items.name: 离心俯卧撑
items.description: Push-up focusing on the slow lowering phase to build strength for full reps.
steps: Start at the top of a push-up with straight arms.
Brace your core and keep a straight line.
Lower your chest to the floor over 3-5 seconds.
Drop to your knees or reset at the bottom.
Return to the top and repeat.

items.name: 离手俯卧撑
items.description: A push-up where you lift your hands at the bottom, removing momentum and building chest strength.
steps: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders.
Lower your whole body to the floor.
Lift your hands off the floor briefly.
Place them back and press up.
Keep your body in a straight line.

items.name: 穿越式俯卧撑
items.description: A push up followed by a quick kick of one leg through underneath your body. It builds chest strength with coordination.
steps: Start in a push up position with hands under your shoulders.
Lower your chest and press back up.
Lift one hand and rotate, sweeping the opposite leg through underneath you.
Return the leg and hand to the starting position.
Repeat the push up and kick on the other side.
Stay controlled and keep your core braced.

items.name: 站姿单臂胸部拉伸
items.description: Place one arm against a wall and turn away to open the chest. It eases tight pecs.
steps: Stand next to a wall or door frame.
Place your forearm or hand on the wall at shoulder height.
Slowly turn your body away from the arm.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch arms and repeat.

items.name: 站姿毛巾内旋滑动
items.nameEn: standing internal rotation slide with towel
items.description: A towel slide that rotates the shoulder inward. It works the rotator cuff gently.
steps: Stand side-on to a wall with a towel under your forearm.
Bend your elbow to 90 degrees against your side.
Slide your hand across your body along the wall.
Return slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

items.name: 站姿毛巾向前滑动推举
items.nameEn: standing forward slide press with towel
items.description: A towel slid forward along a wall that presses the arm out. It builds gentle shoulder control.
steps: Stand facing a wall and place a towel under your hand against it.
Keep your elbow bent and the hand at chest height.
Slide the towel forward as your arm straightens.
Slide it back slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

items.name: 站姿胸部拉伸(用训练肋木)
items.nameEn: standing chest stretch (with training wall bars)
items.description: Holding a wall bar and turning away from it stretches your chest and shoulder. The bars let you pick the exact height that suits you.
steps: Stand beside wall bars and grip a bar at about shoulder height with one hand.
Slowly turn your body away from the bars until you feel a stretch across your chest.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

items.name: 站姿靠门框胸部拉伸
items.description: Doorway stretch for the chest and front of the shoulders.
steps: Stand in a doorway with your forearm against the frame, elbow at shoulder height.
Step through gently with the opposite foot.
Turn away until you feel a chest stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.

items.name: 等长保持俯卧撑
items.description: A push-up held in place at the top or bottom. It builds chest, arm and core strength.
steps: Start in a straight-arm plank with hands under your shoulders.
Lower halfway down until your elbows are bent.
Hold the position for 10 to 20 seconds.
Keep your body straight from head to heels.
Press back up.
Rest and repeat.

items.name: 等长保持宽距俯卧撑
items.nameEn: isometric hold wide hand push up
items.description: A wide-grip push-up held halfway down. It builds chest strength under tension.
steps: Start in a push-up position with hands wider than your shoulders.
Lower your chest until your elbows are bent.
Hold this position for 10 to 20 seconds.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Press back up to the start.
Rest and repeat.

items.name: 等长夹胸
items.description: Press your palms or arms together in front of your chest and hold the squeeze. A simple way to feel and train the chest with no equipment.
steps: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，膝盖稍微弯曲。
将双臂伸直在身前，与地面平行，手掌相对。
尽可能用力挤压胸部肌肉，同时保持手臂伸直。
保持这个姿势几秒钟，专注于收缩胸部肌肉。
释放挤压并放松胸部肌肉。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 等长雨刷
items.description: Lying on your back, you hold your arms up and move them like windshield wipers. It works the chest, shoulders and core.
steps: 首先平躺在垫子或长凳上。
将手臂伸直至两侧，与身体垂直。
启动你的核心并将双腿抬离地面，保持它们并拢并伸直。
慢慢地将双腿向一侧降低，目标是用脚接触地面，同时保持控制。
暂停片刻，然后用核心力量将双腿抬回到起始位置。
重复该动作，这次将双腿降低到另一侧。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

items.name: 肘部后拉拉伸
items.description: Pulling your elbows behind you to open up the chest and front of the shoulders.
steps: Stand tall with your hands behind your head and elbows pointing out.
Draw your elbows back and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lift your chest slightly.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Relax and repeat.

items.name: 肩胛俯卧撑
items.description: A scapular push-up, protracting and retracting the shoulder blades. Strengthens the serratus anterior and upper back.
steps: 从高平板支撑位置开始，双手直接放在肩膀下方，身体呈一条直线。
将胸部压向地面，保持肘部靠近身体。
当你下降时，将肩胛骨挤压在一起并将胸部向前推。
在底部停顿片刻，然后推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 胸部及前肩拉伸
items.nameEn: chest and front of shoulder stretch
items.description: A stretch for the chest and the fronts of the shoulders with the hands clasped. It loosens the chest.
steps: 站直，双脚分开与肩同宽。
将双臂伸直至前方，与肩同高。
双臂交叉在身体前方，右臂放在左臂上方。
手指交叉并将手掌压在一起。
轻轻地将肩胛骨挤压在一起，然后将双手向前推，感觉胸部和肩膀前部有拉伸感。
保持拉伸 20-30 秒，然后放松。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 胸部双杠臂屈伸
items.description: A bodyweight dip with a forward lean on parallel bars. It targets the lower chest, triceps and shoulders.
steps: 将自己置于双杠上，双臂完全伸展，身体伸直。
弯曲肘部，降低身体，直到肩膀低于肘部。
伸直手臂，将自己推回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 胸部双杠臂屈伸(引体向上双杠架)
items.description: A chest dip done on a dip station with a forward lean. It works the lower chest, triceps and front shoulders.
steps: 将倾斜杆调整到您可以舒适地握住它们的高度。
站在杠铃之间，将双手放在每个杠铃上，距离略宽于肩宽。
跳起来并伸直双臂，将体重支撑在杠上。
弯曲膝盖并将脚踝交叉在身后。
弯曲肘部降低身体，保持胸部向上，肩膀向下。
继续降低，直到肩膀低于肘部或直到您感到胸部有拉伸感。
推动手掌并伸展肘部，将身体抬回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 腕部全幅俯卧撑
items.description: A full push-up focusing on wrist position and control. It builds the chest while preparing the wrists for load.
steps: Start in a plank with your hands under your shoulders.
Spread your fingers and keep your wrists stacked.
Lower your chest to the floor under control.
Press back to the top.
Keep your body straight from head to heels.

items.name: 自重跪姿俯卧撑划船
items.description: A kneeling push-up combined with a row that works the chest and back together.
steps: Start in a kneeling push-up position with your hands on the floor, or on light dumbbells.
Lower your chest to the floor.
Push back up.
Pull one elbow toward your ribs.
Return that hand to the floor and alternate sides.
Keep your hips level.

items.name: 落地俯卧撑
items.description: A push-up that drops to the knees and presses back up. It trains the chest and triceps.
steps: 从高平板支撑位置开始，双手分开略宽于肩宽。
将胸部压向地面，保持肘部靠近身体。
当你的胸部刚好高于地面时，迅速将膝盖放在地上。
伸展双臂，将自己推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 蚱蜢俯卧撑
items.description: A push-up where one knee swings under the body toward the opposite elbow. It combines chest work with core and hip mobility.
steps: Start in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders.
Lower your chest toward the floor and bring one knee toward the opposite elbow.
Push back up while returning the leg.
Repeat with the other leg.
Keep your core tight.
Move at a steady pace.

items.name: 螺旋俯卧撑
items.description: A push-up where you twist the hips and body as you descend. It adds trunk rotation to a standard chest exercise.
steps: Start in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders.
Lower your chest toward the floor while rotating your hips slightly to one side.
Push up and return to the centre.
Repeat to the other side.
Keep your core braced and your legs together.
Move smoothly and do not let your hips sag.

items.name: 触肩俯卧撑
items.description: From a high plank, you tap one shoulder with the opposite hand. Works the shoulders and core stability.
steps: 从高位平板支撑开始，双手分开略宽于肩宽，身体从头到脚跟呈一条直线。
弯曲肘部，使肘部靠近身体两侧，将身体降低到地面。
当你向后推时，将右手抬离地面并轻拍左肩。
将右手放回地面并重复俯卧撑，这次抬起左手并拍打右肩。
每次重复俯卧撑时，继续交替拍肩。
在整个练习过程中保持核心稳定并避免臀部过度旋转。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 超人式俯卧撑
items.description: A push-up in which you lift the opposite arm and leg at the top, like Superman. It trains the chest, back and core stability.
steps: 从高位平板支撑开始，双手分开略宽于肩宽，双脚并拢。
收紧核心，将身体降低到地面，保持肘部靠近身体两侧。
当你降低身体时，同时将右臂和左腿抬离地面，笔直向外伸展。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后放下手臂和腿，同时将自己推回起始位置。
重复该动作，这次抬起左臂和右腿。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

items.name: 超人式胸部拉伸
items.description: A face-down stretch with arms reaching out, opening the chest and front of the shoulders.
steps: Lie face down on the floor with your arms extended out wide.
Gently lift your chest off the floor.
Draw your shoulder blades together and back.
Keep your neck in a neutral position.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then relax.

items.name: 趴下俯卧撑
items.description: A push-up that starts from lying flat on the floor each rep, so every rep begins from a dead stop and builds pressing strength.
steps: Lie face down with your hands under your shoulders.
Brace your core and glutes.
Push your body up into a straight plank.
Lower yourself all the way down until your chest rests on the floor.
Relax briefly, then push up again.

items.name: 跪姿俯卧撑(男)
items.description: A beginner-friendly push-up with the knees on the floor. It builds chest, shoulder and triceps strength with less load than a standard push-up.
steps: 首先跪在地上，双手与肩同宽，手指指向前方。
将双腿伸到身后，放在脚掌上，使身体从头到脚跟形成一条直线。
弯曲肘部，保持核心靠近身体两侧，将身体压向地面。
继续降低，直到胸部刚好高于地面，然后伸直手臂，将其推回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 跪姿俯卧撑胸前回拉
items.description: A knee push-up followed by a pullback of the hips. It trains the chest and adds a mobility element.
steps: Start in a knee push-up position.
Lower your chest to the floor.
Press back up.
Push your hips back toward your heels.
Return to the start.
Keep your core tight.

items.name: 跪姿俯卧撑至婴儿式
items.nameEn: kneeling push up to child pose
items.description: A knee push-up that ends by sitting your hips back into child pose, building the chest and giving the back a stretch.
steps: Start on your hands and knees with hands slightly wider than your shoulders.
Lower your chest toward the floor, elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press back up to the start.
Push your hips back onto your heels and reach your arms forward into child pose.
Return to the start and repeat.

items.name: 跪姿增强式俯卧撑
items.description: An explosive push-up from the knees. It builds pressing power.
steps: Kneel in a push-up position with hands under shoulders.
Keep a straight line from knees to head.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Push up explosively so your hands leave the floor.
Land softly with bent elbows.
Go straight into the next rep.

items.name: 跪姿宽距俯卧撑
items.description: A kneeling push-up with the hands wider apart. It puts more emphasis on the chest.
steps: Kneel on a mat and place your hands wider than your shoulders.
Keep a straight line from head to knees.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up to straight arms.
Keep your core tight.
Do not let your hips sag.

items.name: 跪姿改良印度俯卧撑
items.description: An easier knee-supported version of the hindu push up. The flowing dip and sweep trains the chest, shoulders and triceps and opens the spine.
steps: Start on your knees and hands with hips high, like a pike.
Bend your elbows and swoop your chest down and forward close to the floor.
Push through your arms to glide your chest up and forward, arching slightly.
Reverse the path, pushing your hips back up to the start.
Move smoothly and keep your core engaged.

items.name: 跪姿旋转俯卧撑
items.description: A kneeling push-up that ends with a rotation and one arm reaching up. It trains the chest and trunk control.
steps: Start in a kneeling push-up position, hands under shoulders.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press up and rotate your torso, lifting one arm toward the ceiling.
Look at your raised hand for a moment.
Bring the hand back down and lower for the next rep.
Alternate sides each rep.

items.name: 跪姿眼镜蛇俯卧撑
items.description: A kneeling version of the cobra push-up that is easier on the arms and core. It works the chest and gently extends the spine.
steps: Kneel on a mat and place your hands under your shoulders.
Keep a straight line from head to knees.
Lower your chest to the floor with elbows close.
Press up and let your hips sink forward, lifting your chest into a cobra.
Shift your hips back to the start.
Repeat smoothly.

items.name: 跪姿胸部拉伸
items.description: Kneeling with your arms reaching forward onto a support lets your chest sink down. It stretches the chest and shoulders.
steps: Kneel in front of a bench or chair and rest your forearms or hands on it.
Sit your hips back and let your chest drop toward the floor until you feel the stretch.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

items.name: 跪姿触肩俯卧撑
items.description: A kneeling push-up followed by a quick shoulder tap with each hand. It builds the chest and shoulder stability.
steps: Start in a kneeling push-up position with hands under your shoulders.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up to straight arms.
Lift one hand and tap the opposite shoulder, then switch.
Keep your hips steady and repeat.

items.name: 跪姿错位俯卧撑
items.description: A push-up from your knees with hands set at staggered heights. It builds the chest in a more manageable way.
steps: Kneel and place your hands on the floor, one slightly forward of the other.
Keep your body straight from knees to head.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up.
Keep your elbows at about 45 degrees.
Switch hand positions on the next set.

items.name: 过头直臂拉伸
items.description: Straight arms overhead lengthen the chest, shoulders and sides of your back. A simple full-reach stretch.
steps: Stand tall and raise both straight arms overhead with your palms facing forward.
Reach up and slightly back, keeping your ribs down and your core lightly braced.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

items.name: 过头胸部拉伸
items.description: Reaching both arms overhead and back opens the front of your chest and shoulders. It is an easy stretch to undo hunched posture.
steps: Stand tall and interlace your fingers, then raise your arms overhead.
Press your arms slightly back and lift your chest without arching your lower back.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

items.name: 钻石推举
items.description: A narrow push-up variation with the hands close together, putting extra load on the triceps and inner chest.
steps: Start in a plank position with your hands under your chest, thumbs and index fingers forming a diamond.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your chest toward your hands, elbows tracking back close to your ribs.
Pause briefly just above your hands.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your core tight so your hips do not sag.

items.name: 门框胸部拉伸
items.description: Doorway stretch that opens up the chest and the fronts of your shoulders.
steps: Stand in a doorway with forearms on the frame, elbows at 90 degrees.
Step one foot forward.
Lean gently through the door until you feel a stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Breathe slowly and step back.

items.name: 靠墙下斜俯卧撑
items.description: A push-up with the feet up the wall and hands on the floor. The raised feet put more load on the upper chest and shoulders.
steps: Place your hands on the floor and walk your feet up a wall behind you.
Set your hands under your shoulders in a straight body line.
Lower your chest toward the floor with elbows tucked.
Press back up to straight arms.
Keep your core tight and your hips level.
Walk your feet down to finish.

items.name: 韩式臂屈伸
items.description: A deep dip variation performed on parallel bars with a different hand and body position. It trains the chest and triceps.
steps: 将自己定位在两个双杠之间，双臂伸展并支撑体重。
弯曲肘部降低身体，直到上臂与地面平行。
暂停片刻，然后伸直手臂，将自己推回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 高平行杠宽握胸部臂屈伸
items.nameEn: wide-grip chest dip on high parallel bars
items.description: A wide-grip dip on high parallel bars, leaning forward. Targets the chest and shoulders.
steps: 将自己置于双杠上，双臂完全伸展，身体悬浮在空中。
稍微向前倾，弯曲肘部降低身体，直到胸部位于杠铃上方。
暂停片刻，然后伸直手臂，将自己推回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 高杠上斜俯卧撑
items.description: With your hands on a high bar, you do an easier incline push up. A great stepping stone toward floor push ups.
steps: Set a bar at about waist or chest height.
Place your hands on it slightly wider than your shoulders.
Walk your feet back so your body is in a straight line.
Lower your chest to the bar.
Press back up to straight arms.
Keep your core and glutes tight.

items.name: 鱼式
items.description: Lie on your back and lift your chest into a gentle arch. It opens the chest and front of the neck and shoulders.
steps: Lie on your back with legs straight and arms at your sides, palms down.
Press your forearms into the floor and lift your chest.
Arch your upper back and lower the crown of your head lightly toward the floor.
Keep your legs relaxed and breathe deeply into the chest.
Hold for 15-30 seconds, then lower slowly.

items.name: 鸟狗式俯卧撑
items.description: A push up combined with extending an opposite arm and leg. It builds the chest while testing core balance.
steps: Start in a high plank.
Lower into a push up with elbows about 45 degrees from your body.
Press back up.
Lift one arm and the opposite leg and hold briefly.
Return and alternate sides each rep.

items.name: 1 2 棍棒训练
items.description: A quick footwork drill that builds agility and coordination with fast, light steps.
steps: Stand in an athletic stance with knees slightly bent.
Take quick steps in the set pattern, one then two.
Stay on the balls of your feet.
Keep your arms bent and swinging naturally.
Repeat for 20-30 seconds with sharp, light steps.

items.name: 123折返训练
items.description: A cone drill with a set number of steps forward and back to sharpen speed and quick direction changes.
steps: Set a cone line a few yards apart.
Sprint to the first cone and touch it, then back to the start.
Sprint to the second cone and back.
Go to the third cone and back.
Stay low when turning.
Rest, then repeat.

items.name: 8字跑
items.description: A run in a figure-eight around two cones, which builds agility, balance and quick turns.
steps: Set two cones about 5 yards apart.
Start next to one cone in an athletic stance.
Run a figure-eight around both cones.
Lean into the turns and keep your hips low.
Run for 20-30 seconds, then change direction.

items.name: L形训练
items.description: A cone drill run in an L shape that sharpens sprinting, backpedaling and quick cuts.
steps: Place three cones in an L shape, about 5 yards apart.
Sprint from the start cone to the second and touch it.
Backpedal to the start.
Sprint to the second again, turn around the cone and weave around the third.
Return to the start along the same line.
Stay low through turns.

items.name: T形训练
items.description: A cone drill in a T shape that trains sprinting, side shuffling and backpedaling.
steps: Set four cones in a T with the top cones 5 yards apart.
Sprint forward to the center cone and touch it.
Shuffle sideways to the left cone and touch it.
Shuffle across to the right cone, then back to the middle.
Backpedal to the start.
Keep your hips low and feet from crossing.

items.name: X形训练
items.description: A cone drill in an X pattern that mixes sprints, shuffles and backpedals for agility.
steps: Set four cones in a square, with a center point.
Sprint diagonally from one corner through the center to the opposite corner.
Shuffle sideways along one edge to the next corner.
Backpedal or sprint diagonally again.
Stay low through turns and repeat.

items.name: 三腿下犬式
items.description: Downward dog with one leg lifted behind you. Stretches the back of the legs while building shoulder and hip stability.
steps: Start in downward dog with hands shoulder-width apart.
Press your hands into the floor and lengthen your spine.
Lift one leg straight up behind you, keeping your hips square.
Hold for 5 slow breaths.
Lower and switch legs.

items.name: 下犬式
items.nameEn: downward facing dog adho mukha svanasana
items.description: An inverted V shape that stretches the back of the legs and spine while loading the shoulders. A classic yoga staple.
steps: Start on hands and knees with hands slightly ahead of shoulders.
Tuck your toes and lift your hips up and back.
Straighten your legs as far as comfortable and press your chest toward your thighs.
Spread your fingers and push the floor away.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.

items.name: 下犬式
items.description: A classic yoga pose that stretches the back of the legs and shoulders.
steps: Start on hands and knees.
Tuck your toes and lift your hips up and back.
Press your chest toward your thighs.
Keep your arms straight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower down gently.

items.name: 下犬式触脚尖
items.description: A downward dog with alternating hand-to-toe taps. It stretches the hamstrings and calves.
steps: Start in a downward facing dog, hips high.
Press your chest toward your thighs.
Reach one hand back to touch the opposite foot.
Return the hand and switch sides.
Keep your hips high.
Move slowly with steady breathing.

items.name: 世界上最棒的拉伸
items.description: A multi-part warm-up combining a lunge, a rotation and a hamstring stretch.
steps: Step into a long lunge with both hands on the floor inside your front foot.
Drop your hips low.
Rotate your chest toward the front leg and raise that arm.
Return the hand to the floor and straighten the front leg.
Switch sides and repeat.

items.name: 交叉屈体跳
items.description: A jump where you tuck the knees and cross the feet in the air, great for conditioning and leg power.
steps: Stand tall with feet shoulder width apart.
Jump up and pull your knees toward your chest.
Cross your feet in the air.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Uncross on the next jump, alternating the crossing foot.
Keep a steady quick rhythm.

items.name: 交叉开合跳
items.description: A jumping-jack variation where the arms and legs cross in front of the body. It raises your heart rate and coordination.
steps: Stand with your feet together and your arms at your sides.
Jump your feet apart while raising your arms overhead.
Jump back crossing your arms and one leg in front.
Alternate which leg crosses on the next rep.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep a steady rhythm for 30-60 seconds.

items.name: 交叉开合跳
items.description: A jumping jack variation where the arms and legs cross over each other.
steps: Stand with feet together and arms at your sides.
Jump your feet apart while the arms swing overhead.
Jump and cross one foot in front and the arms across your chest.
Alternate which side crosses.
Keep a quick but controlled pace.

items.name: 交叉开合跳
items.description: A jumping jack where your arms and legs cross over each other at the center. It raises your heart rate and warms up the whole body.
steps: Stand with your feet together and arms by your sides.
Jump your feet apart while raising your arms overhead.
Jump again, crossing your legs and your arms in front of you.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep a steady rhythm and continue for 30-60 seconds.

items.name: 交替腿弯举加出拳
items.description: A cardio combination of heel-to-glute kicks and punches that works the hamstrings and arms together.
steps: Stand tall with your fists in front of your chin.
Curl one heel up toward your glute.
Punch forward as you curl the leg.
Lower the leg and repeat on the other side.
Keep a steady rhythm and stay light on your feet.

items.name: 交替跨步
items.description: A low-impact move stepping one leg out at a time, raising your heart rate while working the legs.
steps: Stand with feet together and hands in front of your chest.
Step one foot out to the side.
Bring it back and step the other foot out.
Keep your knees slightly bent.
Keep a steady rhythm for 30-60 seconds.

items.name: 仰卧全身拉伸
items.description: Lying flat and reaching long through your arms and legs gives your whole body a gentle stretch. A nice reset after training.
steps: Lie on your back with your arms overhead and your legs straight.
Reach your fingertips up and your toes down, as if you want to get taller.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

items.name: 低位开合跳
items.description: Jumping jacks performed from a squat position. They raise your heart rate and burn the legs.
steps: Start in a half squat with hands in front of your chest.
Jump your feet out wide, staying low.
Jump them back together and keep your knees bent.
Keep your chest up and weight on your heels.
Stay in the squat throughout.
Keep a steady pace for 30-60 seconds.

items.name: 侧向熊爬
items.description: A bear crawl moving sideways on hands and toes. It builds shoulder stability, core control and leg endurance.
steps: Get on hands and toes with knees just off the floor.
Keep your back flat.
Step the hand and foot on one side out, then bring the other pair along.
Move several steps one way, then return.
Stay low and keep your hips steady.

items.name: 侧向登山者
items.description: A mountain climber where the knees drive toward the elbows on the side. It raises your heart rate and works the obliques and hips.
steps: Start in a high plank with hands under your shoulders.
Drive one knee out toward the same-side elbow.
Return that foot and switch quickly to the other leg.
Keep your hips low and your core tight.
Continue at a brisk pace for the set time.

items.name: 侧向绳梯训练
items.description: A sideways run through an agility ladder to build lateral speed and foot coordination.
steps: Stand sideways at the start of an agility ladder.
Step both feet into the first square, one at a time.
Move sideways to the next square with quick steps.
Keep your hips low and your feet light.
Finish the ladder, then repeat facing the other way.

items.name: 侧踢波比跳
items.description: A burpee that finishes with a side kick. It's a tough full-body conditioning move.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Drop your hands to the floor and jump your feet back to a plank.
Do a push-up, then jump your feet back in.
Stand up and kick one leg out to the side.
Land and go straight into the next rep.
Alternate kicking sides.

items.name: 冥想
items.description: Seated stillness with a tall spine. Calms the mind and trains upright posture.
steps: Sit comfortably cross-legged, with hips slightly higher than your knees.
Lengthen your spine and relax your shoulders.
Rest your hands on your knees.
Close your eyes and settle into easy breathing.
Stay for 3-10 minutes.

items.name: 出拳上步
items.description: A shadow-boxing drill pairing a forward step with a punch for cardio and coordination.
steps: Stand in a boxing stance with fists up.
Step forward with your lead foot.
Throw a punch as you step.
Return to your stance.
Alternate sides and keep a steady rhythm.

items.name: 分腿开合跳
items.description: A jumping move where your legs split front and back while your arms swing. It's a light, fast cardio burst.
steps: Stand tall with your arms at your sides.
Jump one foot forward and the other back as you swing opposite arms.
Land softly with soft knees.
Jump again and switch legs.
Keep your torso upright.
Continue at a steady pace for 30-45 seconds.

items.name: 前后螃蟹步
items.description: A walk on hands and feet facing up. It works the arms, glutes and core.
steps: Sit with hands behind you and feet flat, then lift your hips.
Keep your chest open and hips high.
Walk forward with alternating hands and feet.
Then walk backward the same way.
Keep your core braced.

items.name: 前踢腿
items.description: A dynamic kick that warms up the hamstrings and hip flexors and builds coordination.
steps: Stand tall with your arms at your sides.
Kick one straight leg up in front of you.
Lower it under control.
Switch legs in a smooth rhythm.
Keep your torso upright.

items.name: 半拜日式
items.description: A shortened sun salutation that keeps the upright flow. Gently warms the spine and legs.
steps: Stand in mountain pose and sweep your arms overhead.
Fold forward with a long spine.
Lift halfway up with a flat back.
Fold again and rise up with your arms overhead.
Lower your hands to your heart and repeat.

items.name: 单腿平衡交叉出拳
items.description: Cross punches thrown while balancing on one leg, which trains balance, rotation and core control.
steps: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend and fists up.
Brace your core.
Throw a cross punch, rotating your hips and shoulders.
Pull your fist back to guard.
Keep your standing foot steady.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 原地踏步抬臂
items.description: Stepping in place while raising your arms, a gentle cardio drill.
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Step in place, lifting your knees.
Raise your arms overhead as you step.
Lower them as you continue.
Keep a steady rhythm for 30-60 seconds.

items.name: 双平板开合跳接四次登山者
items.nameEn: double plank jack to 4 mountain climber
items.description: Conditioning combo of two plank jacks followed by four mountain climbers.
steps: Start in a high plank.
Jump your feet wide and together twice.
Do four mountain climbers, driving your knees alternately.
Keep your hips level.
Flow through the sequence at a steady pace.

items.name: 双摇跳绳
items.description: A skipping move where the rope passes twice under your feet for each jump, great for conditioning and coordination.
steps: Hold the rope handles at your hips with your elbows close.
Stand tall and start with a few normal jumps.
Jump a little higher and spin the rope faster with your wrists.
Let the rope pass twice under your feet before landing.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep your jumps small and your body upright.

items.name: 双摇跳绳
items.description: Jumping rope with two passes of the rope per jump. It is great conditioning that builds coordination.
steps: Hold a jump rope with the handles at your hips.
Jump slightly higher than normal.
Spin the rope fast with your wrists so it passes twice under your feet.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Rest between short rounds as needed.

items.name: 后踢过头推举
items.description: A dynamic combo of a backward leg kick with an overhead arm press. It works the shoulders and glutes together and raises your heart rate.
steps: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your hands at shoulder height.
Press both hands straight overhead as you kick one leg back.
Squeeze the glute at the top without arching your lower back.
Bring the hands and foot back to the start.
Switch legs and repeat at a lively pace.
Keep your core tight throughout.

items.name: 哑铃上方波比跳
items.description: A burpee where you jump sideways over a dumbbell each rep, raising the heart rate and working the whole body.
steps: Stand beside a dumbbell lying on the floor.
Squat down, place your hands on the floor, jump your feet back and do a push up.
Jump your feet forward under your hips.
Jump up and sideways over the dumbbell, landing softly.
Turn and repeat in the other direction at a steady pace.

items.name: 哑铃波比
items.description: A burpee with dumbbells that finishes with an overhead press. It builds strength and endurance.
steps: 从站立位置开始，双脚分开与肩同宽，每只手各拿一个哑铃。
将身体降低至蹲姿，将哑铃放在您面前的地面上。
将双脚踢回到俯卧撑位置，保持身体呈一条直线。
进行俯卧撑，弯曲肘部并将胸部降低到地面。
将脚向后跳向双手，以蹲姿着地。
爆发性地站起来，将哑铃从地上举起，放到肩膀上。
将哑铃举过头顶，充分伸展手臂。
将哑铃放回到肩膀上，然后重复整个序列，达到所需的重复次数。

items.name: 团身跳
items.description: An explosive vertical jump where you pull your knees into your chest at the top. Great for power and conditioning.
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and arms ready.
Dip into a quarter squat and swing your arms back.
Jump explosively and tuck both knees toward your chest.
Extend your legs again before landing.
Land softly on bent knees and reset before the next jump.

items.name: 团身跳 v. 2
items.description: An explosive jump where you pull your knees toward your chest in the air. It builds power and gets your heart rate up quickly.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart and arms ready.
Dip into a quarter squat and swing your arms up.
Jump as high as you can and pull your knees toward your chest.
Land softly on the balls of your feet with bent knees.
Reset briefly and repeat.

items.name: 增强式开合跳
items.description: A jumping jack with a squat landing. The extra depth makes it harder on the legs and your heart.
steps: Stand with your feet together.
Jump your feet wide and land in a quarter squat.
Swing your arms out as you land.
Jump your feet back together.
Land softly each time.
Keep a quick, controlled pace.

items.name: 增强式敏捷训练
items.description: A mix of quick hops and direction changes that builds explosive power and agility.
steps: Set out a few markers within a small area.
Stand in an athletic stance on the balls of your feet.
Hop or step quickly between the markers in changing directions.
Land softly with bent knees.
Work for 20-30 seconds, rest, then repeat.

items.name: 壶铃波比跳
items.description: A burpee that adds a kettlebell for extra load, giving you a hard full-body conditioning move.
steps: Stand with a kettlebell on the floor between your feet.
Squat down and place your hands on the floor beside it, or on the handle if you prefer.
Jump your feet back into a plank.
Lower your chest, push up, then jump your feet back in.
Grab the kettlebell and stand, then press or swing it overhead if you like.
Return it to the floor and repeat.

items.name: 大力士芬戈尔手指
items.description: A strongman grip challenge based on the legend of Fingal's fingers. It tests hand and forearm strength.
steps: Set up the implement in front of you.
Grip it firmly with both hands.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Lift it using your legs and hips.
Hold it steady for a moment.
Lower it under control.

items.name: 尺蠖爬行加登山者
items.description: Combo of an inchworm walk-out followed by mountain climbers for a full-body workout.
steps: Stand tall, then hinge forward and walk your hands out to a plank.
Brace your core and keep a straight line.
Drive your knees to your chest alternately for several reps.
Walk your hands back to your feet.
Stand up and repeat.

items.name: 山式
items.description: The basic standing pose with a tall, balanced posture. A base for most other poses.
steps: Stand with your feet together or hip-width apart.
Spread your toes and press evenly through both feet.
Lengthen your spine and draw your shoulders back and down.
Let your arms hang with palms forward.
Hold for 5 slow breaths.

items.name: 左右跳 v. 2
items.description: You hop from one side to the other over an imaginary line. It builds lateral agility, leg power and conditioning.
steps: Stand on two feet with your knees slightly bent.
Hop sideways to one side, landing softly on the balls of your feet.
Immediately hop back to the other side.
Keep your chest up and your hips low.
Use your arms for balance and rhythm.
Go for a set time or a set number of reps.

items.name: 左右跳绳
items.description: Jump rope while hopping side to side to raise your heart rate and improve agility.
steps: Hold the rope handles and stand tall.
Swing the rope overhead.
Hop side to side over the rope.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep a steady rhythm.

items.name: 平板支撑行走上撑
items.description: Moving between a forearm and a high plank, building core and arm endurance.
steps: Start in a forearm plank.
Place one hand and then the other on the floor to rise to a high plank.
Lower one forearm and then the other back down.
Keep your hips steady.
Alternate the leading arm each rep.

items.name: 平板支撑跳
items.description: A jumping plank drill that raises your heart rate and challenges the core.
steps: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders.
Jump both feet out wide.
Jump them back together.
Keep your hips level and core tight.
Move at a steady pace.

items.name: 平板支撑跳入深蹲
items.description: A fast move from a plank to a squat jump position, raising the heart rate and training the legs and core.
steps: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders.
Jump both feet forward, landing outside your hands in a wide squat.
Stand or hop up briefly if you like, then lower your hands.
Jump your feet back to the plank.
Keep a tight core and land softly.

items.name: 庆祝式提膝
items.description: Fast alternating knee drives with arms pumping overhead, a fun cardio drill.
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Drive one knee up as you raise your arms in a victory pose.
Lower and switch.
Keep a quick, bouncy rhythm.
Land lightly and work for 30 seconds.

items.name: 开合步
items.description: A low-impact version of the jumping jack where you step out instead of jumping.
steps: Stand with feet together and arms at your sides.
Step one foot out to the side while raising your arms overhead.
Step it back as you lower your arms.
Repeat on the other side.
Keep a steady pace for 30-60 seconds.

items.name: 开合跳
items.description: The classic jump where your arms and legs swing out and back. A simple full-body warm-up that raises your heart rate fast.
steps: Stand with your feet together and your arms at your sides.
Jump your feet apart as you swing your arms overhead.
Jump back to the start position.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep a steady rhythm.
Continue for 30-60 seconds.

items.name: 开合跳(男)
items.description: A jumping jack, hopping the feet apart while the arms go overhead and back again. A classic warm-up and cardio move.
steps: 双脚并拢站立，双臂放在身体两侧。
跳起来，分开双脚，将手臂举过头顶。
当你落地时，迅速跳回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 开合跳波比
items.description: A burpee with a jumping jack at the end. It raises your heart rate and trains the whole body.
steps: 从站立位置开始，双脚分开与肩同宽。
将身体降低至蹲姿，将双手放在身前的地面上。
双脚向后踢，以俯卧撑姿势落地。
进行俯卧撑，将胸部降低到地面，然后再向上推。
双脚向前跳，以蹲姿落地。
爆发性地跳起，将双臂举过头顶。
轻轻落地并立即回到蹲姿，开始下一次重复。

items.name: 开合跳波比 v. 2
items.description: A burpee that finishes with a jumping jack. It raises your heart rate and works the whole body.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down, place your hands on the floor and jump your feet back to a plank.
Lower your chest to the floor and push up, or skip the push-up if you prefer.
Jump your feet back toward your hands.
Jump up, spreading your arms and legs like a jumping jack, then repeat.

items.name: 开合跳波比跳加俯卧撑
items.description: A burpee that adds a jumping jack finish and a push-up on the floor. It spikes your heart rate while working the chest, arms and legs.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down, place your hands on the floor and jump your feet back into a plank.
Lower your chest to the floor in a push-up and press back up.
Jump your feet back toward your hands.
Explode up into a jumping jack, landing softly, then flow into the next rep.

items.name: 开合跳高抬腿
items.description: Jumping jack paired with a high knee for a lively cardio drill.
steps: Stand tall with arms at your sides.
Jump your feet out and raise your arms overhead.
Jump back in and bring one knee high.
Alternate knees each rep.
Stay light on your feet.

items.name: 弓步俯卧撑
items.description: A lunge flowing into a push-up. It combines leg and upper body work for a full-body challenge.
steps: Stand tall with feet together.
Step back into a lunge and lower your back knee toward the floor.
Place your hands on the floor and step into a plank.
Lower into a push-up and press back up.
Step back into the lunge and stand up.
Alternate the lunging leg each rep.

items.name: 弹力带开合跳
items.description: A jumping jack with a band that raises your heart rate and adds a challenge to the hips and shoulders.
steps: Stand with a loop band around your thighs or ankles.
Keep your knees soft and your core tight.
Jump your feet apart while raising your arms overhead.
Push against the band as you land.
Jump back to the start with your arms down.
Keep a steady rhythm.

items.name: 徒手全蹲加过头推举
items.nameEn: bodyweight full squat with overhead press
items.description: A deep squat followed by a press overhead. Warms up legs and shoulders together.
steps: Stand with feet shoulder width apart and hands at your shoulders.
Squat down until your thighs pass parallel.
Drive up through your heels as you stand.
Press both arms overhead as you reach the top.
Lower your hands back to your shoulders.
Repeat in a smooth rhythm.

items.name: 徒手全蹲加过头推举(版本2)
items.nameEn: bodyweight full squat with overhead press (version 2)
items.description: A deep squat paired with an overhead reach or press, working the legs and shoulders together.
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hands at your shoulders.
Squat deep, keeping chest up.
Drive up out of the squat.
Press your arms overhead as you stand.
Lower your hands and repeat.

items.name: 徒手正面平板支撑转下犬式
items.nameEn: bodyweight front plank to downward dog
items.description: Moves between a plank and downward dog. Builds core strength and opens up the hamstrings and shoulders.
steps: Start in a straight-arm plank with hands under shoulders.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Push your hips up and back into an inverted V.
Press your heels toward the floor and lengthen your spine.
Return to plank with control.
Keep moving smoothly for reps.

items.name: 徒手跳绳
items.description: Skipping without a rope, with light hops and big arm swings. It lifts your heart rate and warms up the legs.
steps: Stand tall with your feet together.
Step and hop on one foot while driving the opposite knee up.
Swing the opposite arm forward as you hop.
Switch sides in a rhythmic skip.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep going for 30-60 seconds.

items.name: 战绳交替波浪加跪姿起身
items.nameEn: battling ropes alternating waves with kneeling get up
items.description: Alternating rope waves mixed with standing up from kneeling for a full body conditioning move.
steps: Kneel holding the rope ends.
Make alternating waves with your arms.
Rise to a standing position while continuing.
Wave for a few more seconds.
Return to kneeling and repeat.

items.name: 战绳交替甩臂侧弓步
items.nameEn: battling ropes alternate arms side lunge
items.description: Side lunges while whipping the ropes alternately, working legs, shoulders and heart.
steps: Hold the rope ends and stand with feet together.
Step wide to one side and sit into a side lunge.
Whip the ropes alternately with your arms.
Push back to the middle.
Alternate sides and keep the waves going.

items.name: 战绳交替甩臂深蹲
items.description: Squatting while whipping the battle ropes with alternating arms. It raises your heart rate and works legs and shoulders.
steps: Hold one rope end in each hand and stand with feet shoulder width apart.
Sit into a squat position.
Whip the ropes up and down with alternating arms.
Keep your chest tall and your knees stable.
Continue for a set time at a steady pace.

items.name: 战绳后撤弓步
items.description: Alternating rear lunges while making waves with heavy ropes. It combines leg work with a hard cardio effort.
steps: Stand holding the ends of the battle ropes, feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot back into a lunge while making a wave with the ropes.
Push through your front heel to return to standing.
Alternate legs, keeping the rope waves going.
Work for a set time, then rest.

items.name: 战绳开合跳
items.description: A jumping jack with rope waves added, so arms and legs both work hard.
steps: Hold the rope ends with feet together.
Jump your feet apart while raising your arms and making waves.
Jump back to the start.
Keep your landings soft.
Keep a steady pace for the set time.

items.name: 拜日式A
items.description: A flowing sequence linking breath and movement. Warms up the whole body.
steps: Stand in mountain pose and sweep your arms overhead.
Fold forward and step back to plank.
Lower, then press into upward dog and downward dog.
Step forward, rise and return to mountain.
Repeat the flow at a steady pace.

items.name: 拜日式b
items.description: A more powerful flow that adds chair pose and warrior I. Builds heat and leg strength.
steps: Stand in mountain pose and sit into a chair pose with your arms overhead.
Fold forward, step back to plank and flow through chaturanga.
Press to downward dog.
Step forward into warrior I on each side, then flow again.
Link every move to your breath.

items.name: 拳击右勾拳
items.description: A right-handed hook punch thrown in a boxing stance. It trains rotation and power from the hips.
steps: Stand in a boxing stance with your hands up.
Bend your right elbow to about 90 degrees.
Pivot on your back foot and rotate your hips and torso.
Swing your fist in an arc to your target.
Snap back to guard position.
Keep your chin tucked and your left hand up.

items.name: 搭档滑步
items.description: A mirror drill where you shuffle sideways in response to a partner, training lateral quickness and reaction.
steps: Face a partner about 2 yards away in an athletic stance.
Have your partner move left or right.
Shuffle sideways to mirror them without crossing your feet.
Keep your hips low and chest up.
Work for 20-30 seconds, then swap roles.

items.name: 摊尸式
items.description: The classic resting pose at the end of practice. Lets the body relax fully.
steps: Lie flat on your back with your legs extended and slightly apart.
Let your arms rest by your sides with palms up.
Close your eyes and let your whole body soften.
Breathe slowly for 2-5 minutes.
Roll to your side and sit up gently.

items.name: 敏捷球训练
items.description: A footwork and reaction drill with a ball that sharpens agility, balance and quick direction changes.
steps: Set up with a ball in front of you in an athletic stance.
Move quickly around or over the ball with short, light steps.
Keep your hips low and eyes up.
Change direction without crossing your feet.
Work for 20-30 seconds, rest, then repeat.

items.name: 斜向出拳
items.description: A fast, rotating punch that travels across the body. It raises your heart rate and trains shoulders, core and rotation.
steps: Stand in an athletic stance with your fists up.
Rotate your hips and torso as you throw a punch across your body.
Extend your arm fully and pivot your back foot.
Pull the arm back quickly.
Alternate sides at a brisk, controlled pace.

items.name: 旋转开合跳
items.description: Jumping jacks with a twist added to the upper body. They raise your heart rate and engage the trunk.
steps: Stand tall with feet together and arms at your sides.
Jump your feet wide and twist your torso to one side.
Jump back together.
Repeat and twist to the other side.
Keep your knees soft.
Maintain a steady pace.

items.name: 无声波比
items.description: A low-impact burpee without the jump. It raises your heart rate while staying quiet and gentle on the joints.
steps: Stand with feet shoulder width apart.
Squat down and place your hands on the floor.
Step your feet back into a plank.
Step your feet forward to your hands.
Stand up tall.
Keep a steady pace for 30-60 seconds.

items.name: 星形跳(男)
items.description: A jump where arms and legs spread wide like a star at the top. It is a full-body cardio move that raises your pulse fast.
steps: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双臂放在身体两侧。
稍微弯曲膝盖并爆发性地跳起来。
跳跃时，张开双腿，将手臂向两侧伸展，与身体形成星形。
膝盖轻轻弯曲，脚掌轻轻着地。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 杰克推举
items.description: A jumping jack combined with an overhead press. It raises your heart rate and works the shoulders and legs together.
steps: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height.
Jump your feet out wide as you press the dumbbells overhead.
Lock out the arms without arching your back.
Jump your feet together as you lower the weights to your shoulders.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep a steady rhythm for the set.

items.name: 正念呼吸冥想
items.description: A seated practice of following your breath. Lowers tension and trains focus.
steps: Sit tall in a comfortable position and relax your shoulders.
Rest your hands on your lap.
Breathe in slowly through your nose.
Breathe out slowly and notice the pause.
Continue for 3-10 minutes.

items.name: 波比
items.description: A full-body move: squat, kick back to a plank, push-up, jump up. It builds endurance and strength.
steps: 从站立位置开始，双脚分开与肩同宽。
弯曲膝盖并将双手放在身前的地板上，将身体降低至蹲姿。
将脚踢回到俯卧撑位置。
进行俯卧撑，保持身体呈一条直线。
将双脚跳回蹲姿。
爆发性地跳起，将双臂举过头顶。
轻轻落地并立即回到蹲姿，开始下一次重复。

items.name: 波比俯卧撑登山者组合
items.nameEn: burpee push up mountain climber complex
items.description: A conditioning chain of a burpee, a push-up and mountain climbers. Raises your heart rate quickly.
steps: Stand tall, then drop your hands to the floor and jump your feet back.
Do one push-up.
Run your knees in and out for several mountain climbers.
Jump your feet in toward your hands.
Jump up with arms overhead.
Keep a steady pace and a tight core.

items.name: 波比深蹲
items.description: A burpee with a squat finish that raises your heart rate and works the whole body.
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Drop into a squat and place your hands on the floor.
Jump or step your feet back into a plank.
Lower your chest down, then press back up.
Jump your feet forward to your hands.
Stand and finish with a bodyweight squat before the next rep.

items.name: 波比立定跳远加俯卧撑
items.nameEn: burpee long jump with push up
items.description: A burpee with a push-up that finishes in a long forward jump. It is a tough full-body conditioning move.
steps: Stand tall, then squat and place your hands on the floor.
Jump your feet back and do one push-up.
Jump your feet back toward your hands.
Explode into a long jump forward.
Land softly with bent knees and go into the next rep.

items.name: 波比跳上箱
items.description: A burpee that finishes with a jump onto a box, great for full-body conditioning.
steps: Stand facing a box.
Drop into a squat, kick your feet back and lower into a push-up.
Jump your feet back in.
Explode up and jump onto the box.
Step down carefully and repeat.

items.name: 波比跳加俯卧撑
items.description: A burpee that includes a full push-up for conditioning.
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat and place your hands on the floor.
Jump your feet back to a plank.
Do a push-up.
Jump your feet in and leap up.
Repeat at a steady pace.

items.name: 波比跳转雪橇推
items.description: A conditioning move that pairs a burpee with a hard sled push for a tough full body effort.
steps: Stand behind a loaded sled and drop into a burpee, chest to the floor.
Jump up to your feet explosively.
Grab the sled handles with your arms extended and lean in.
Drive with short, powerful steps to push the sled for a set distance.
Return and repeat, keeping your back flat while pushing.

items.name: 波比转体
items.description: A burpee with a trunk rotation on the jump, raising your heart rate while challenging the whole body.
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down, place your hands on the floor and jump your feet back to a plank.
Perform a push-up if you like.
Jump your feet forward under your hips.
Explode up, rotating your trunk as you jump, and land softly.
Alternate twist directions each rep.

items.name: 流瑜伽
items.description: A short flow of plank, chaturanga, upward dog and downward dog. Used to link poses together.
steps: Start in plank pose.
Lower to chaturanga with your elbows by your ribs.
Roll forward into upward dog with an open chest.
Lift your hips to downward dog.
Hold for a breath or two and repeat.

items.name: 深蹲伸腿
items.description: A burpee without the push-up and jump. You drop to a plank and spring back to your feet for a steady conditioning move.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Squat down and place your hands on the floor.
Kick your feet back into a plank.
Jump your feet back toward your hands.
Stand up and repeat at a steady pace.

items.name: 深蹲姿势交叉出拳
items.nameEn: cross body punch in squat position
items.description: Punching across the body from a low squat. It builds leg endurance and trunk rotation.
steps: Stand in a wide stance and sink into a half squat.
Keep your fists up near your chin.
Punch one arm across your body, rotating your torso.
Pull it back and punch with the other arm.
Stay low and keep a quick, controlled rhythm.

items.name: 深蹲开合跳
items.description: A cardio move that mixes a squat with a jumping jack. It raises your heart rate and burns the legs.
steps: Start in a squat with hands together at your chest.
Jump your feet wide while staying low in the squat.
Jump your feet back together, still low.
Keep your chest lifted and knees over your toes.
Continue at a steady, quick pace.

items.name: 熊爬低髋
items.description: A low bear crawl with your hips kept down, which challenges your shoulders, legs and core.
steps: Start on hands and feet with your knees slightly off the floor.
Keep your hips low and your back flat.
Crawl forward with opposite hand and foot.
Stay controlled and quiet.
Crawl for 20-30 seconds.

items.name: 爬行转螃蟹步
items.description: Move from a crawl position into a crab position to work the whole body.
steps: Start on hands and knees.
Lift your knees slightly into a low crawl.
Rotate your body and sit back into a crab position, face up.
Lift your hips.
Rotate back into the crawl and repeat.

items.name: 登山者交叉踢
items.description: A mountain climber variation where you bring each knee across toward the opposite elbow. It raises your heart rate and works the obliques.
steps: Start in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders.
Brace your core.
Drive one knee across your body toward the opposite elbow.
Return the foot and switch legs quickly.
Keep your hips low and level.
Keep up a steady pace for a set time.

items.name: 登山者弓步
items.description: A mountain climber that steps the foot all the way outside the hand into a lunge. It raises the heart rate and opens the hips.
steps: Start in a plank with hands under your shoulders.
Step one foot forward outside your hand.
Lower your hips into a lunge stretch.
Return the foot back to the plank.
Switch legs.
Keep your core tight and move at a steady pace.

items.name: 站姿(姿势检查)侧面
items.description: A side-view form check showing a correct standing posture.
steps: Stand with feet hip width apart.
Keep your ears over your shoulders and hips.
Keep a natural curve in your lower back.
Relax your arms.
Compare yourself to the correct posture.

items.name: 站姿(姿势检查)正面
items.description: A front-view form check showing a correct standing posture.
steps: Stand with feet hip width apart.
Keep your knees soft and hips level.
Stack your shoulders over your hips.
Look straight ahead.
Compare yourself to the correct posture.

items.name: 站姿剪刀腿
items.description: A quick jumping drill where your legs swap front and back like scissors. Good for conditioning and coordination.
steps: Stand tall with one foot forward and one back, arms ready.
Hop lightly and switch your leg positions in the air.
Swing your arms opposite to your legs for balance.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep a quick, steady rhythm for the set.

items.name: 篮球投篮跳
items.description: A jump with a shooting arm motion that trains explosive legs and coordination.
steps: Stand in an athletic stance with hands at chest height.
Dip into a quarter squat.
Jump up and extend one arm like shooting a basketball.
Land softly with bent knees.
Reset and repeat.

items.name: 绳梯训练
items.description: A footwork drill through an agility ladder that builds quick feet, rhythm and coordination.
steps: Lay an agility ladder flat on the ground.
Stand at the start in an athletic stance.
Step quickly with both feet into each square, one after another.
Stay light on the balls of your feet.
Pump your arms and keep your eyes up.
Jog back and repeat for several rounds.

items.name: 脚跟接脚尖走
items.description: A slow line walk with each heel touching the toes of the other foot, which trains balance and steady stride control.
steps: Stand tall with your arms out to the sides.
Place your right heel directly in front of your left toes.
Shift your weight forward and step again with the other foot.
Keep your eyes forward and your core gently braced.
Walk 10-15 steps, then turn around and return.

items.name: 自由泳
items.description: A standing or floor drill that copies the front crawl arm stroke. It raises your heart rate and warms the shoulders.
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Swing one arm forward and over in a crawl stroke.
Alternate arms in a smooth, continuous rhythm.
Rotate your torso slightly with each stroke.
Keep going at a steady pace for 30-60 seconds.

items.name: 莲花坐呼吸
items.description: A seated cross-legged breathing practice that calms the mind and lengthens the spine while the hips stay open.
steps: Sit on the floor with your legs crossed and each foot resting on the opposite thigh if comfortable.
Rest your hands on your knees and lengthen your spine.
Inhale slowly through your nose and fill your belly and chest.
Exhale slowly and fully.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and breathe steadily for 1-2 minutes.

items.name: 螃蟹步
items.description: Walk on hands and feet with your belly facing up, a playful drill that fires up the glutes, triceps and core.
steps: Sit on the floor, place your hands behind you and lift your hips off the ground.
Keep your hips high and your core braced.
Step with opposite hand and foot to move forward.
Walk for several steps, then go backward.
Keep your head neutral and your arms steady.

items.name: 负重背包行走
items.description: Walking with a loaded backpack to add resistance. It builds leg endurance and trunk strength.
steps: Put on a backpack and tighten the straps snug.
Stand tall with your shoulders back.
Walk at a steady pace on flat ground.
Take natural strides and breathe evenly.
Keep your core lightly braced.
Walk for 10-30 minutes depending on your fitness.

items.name: 走钢丝
items.description: Walking along an imaginary or taped line to train balance and foot control.
steps: Place a line of tape on the floor or imagine one.
Stand at one end with your arms out for balance.
Walk heel to toe along the line.
Keep your gaze ahead and your core braced.
Turn at the end and walk back.

items.name: 超人式转俯卧撑
items.description: A combo move where you lift into a superman on the floor, then press into a push-up.
steps: Lie face down with arms extended in front.
Lift your arms, chest and legs off the floor and hold briefly.
Lower and place your hands under your shoulders.
Press up into a push-up.
Lower your chest back to the floor.
Repeat, keeping your body straight.

items.name: 跨步跳(男)
items.description: A jump from a squat that ends with the legs spread wide, like a jumping jack with a squat start. It raises the heart rate and trains the legs.
steps: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
弯曲膝盖并将身体降低至蹲姿。
爆发性向上跳跃，伸展双腿和手臂。
在空中时，将双腿分开，并将双臂向两侧伸出。
双脚分开与肩同宽，轻轻落地，弯曲膝盖以吸收冲击力。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 跪姿战绳
items.description: Making waves with heavy ropes while kneeling. It raises your heart rate and burns the shoulders and arms.
steps: Kneel in front of the anchored ropes and hold an end in each hand.
Brace your abs and keep your chest up.
Raise and lower your arms alternately to create waves.
Keep the waves quick and steady.
Work for a set time, then rest.

items.name: 跳步跳
items.description: A jumping combination with a step in the middle to raise your heart rate and train leg power.
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Jump up and land softly with bent knees.
Step to the side or forward.
Jump again and land softly.
Keep a steady rhythm.

items.name: 跳步跳绳
items.description: Jump rope with an alternating skip step for a lighter, rhythmic cardio workout.
steps: Hold the rope handles and swing the rope overhead.
Skip over the rope, alternating feet.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep your elbows near your sides.
Continue at a steady pace.

items.name: 跳绳
items.description: Skipping over a rope at a steady pace. Classic cardio that builds endurance and coordination.
steps: 双手握住跳绳的手柄，掌心向内。
站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，膝盖稍微弯曲。
将绳子甩过头顶，当绳子靠近你的脚时跳过它。
轻轻地用脚掌着地，当绳子再次绕回时重复跳跃。
继续跳跃所需的持续时间或重复次数。

items.name: 跳绳
items.description: Skipping rope with a jump on each turn. It builds stamina, coordination and calf strength.
steps: Hold the rope handles at hip height with elbows near your sides.
Swing the rope over your head using your wrists.
Jump just high enough to clear the rope.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep a steady rhythm for 30-60 seconds, rest, and repeat.

items.name: 跳起侧向跳
items.description: A vertical jump followed by a hop to the side, building leg power and agility.
steps: Stand with feet hip width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Jump straight up, swinging your arms for momentum.
Land softly and immediately hop sideways to one side.
Land on both feet with soft knees and reset your balance.
Alternate the side of each hop and keep a steady rhythm.

items.name: 跳跃弓步蹲转开合跳
items.description: A jumping lunge that finishes with a jumping jack. It is a high-intensity move for legs and conditioning.
steps: Start standing tall with feet together.
Step into a lunge and drop your back knee toward the floor.
Jump and switch legs in the air, landing in a lunge on the other side.
Jump up and land with feet wide as you swing your arms overhead, like a jumping jack.
Jump the feet back together and return to the start.
Land softly and keep your chest up.

items.name: 跳跃转体
items.description: A jump with a midair trunk rotation that trains explosive leg power and core control.
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart in a slight squat.
Jump up and rotate your hips and feet to one side.
Land softly with bent knees.
Jump again and twist to the other side.
Keep your chest up and land quietly.

items.name: 锥桶训练
items.description: A cone run that builds acceleration, cutting speed and agility.
steps: Place several cones in a pattern a few yards apart.
Start in an athletic stance.
Sprint or shuffle around the cones in order.
Plant and cut with your hips low.
Finish the course, rest, then go again.

items.name: 青蛙跳爬
items.description: A fast floor drill where you hop your feet out and in from a squat to a plank. It works your legs, core and heart at once.
steps: Start in a deep squat with your hands on the floor.
Jump or step your feet back into a plank.
Hop your feet to the outside of your hands.
Stand up or jump up from the squat.
Repeat at a steady quick pace.

items.name: 静态姿势站立
items.description: Hold a tall standing posture as a reference position.
steps: Stand with feet hip width apart.
Keep your knees soft.
Stack ribs over hips and shoulders back.
Let your arms hang.
Hold and breathe steadily.

items.name: 高抬腿跳绳
items.description: Jump rope while driving your knees high for a hard cardio effort.
steps: Hold the rope handles and swing the rope overhead.
Run over the rope.
Lift your knees to hip height.
Stay on the balls of your feet.
Keep your torso upright.

items.name: 高栏跳接冲刺和变向
items.nameEn: high hurdle jump to sprint and cut
items.description: Jump over a high hurdle, land and sprint into a sharp cut, training explosive power and reactive agility.
steps: Stand facing a high hurdle with feet shoulder-width apart.
Swing your arms and jump over it, tucking your knees.
Land softly with bent knees.
Sprint forward right away.
Plant and cut sharply to one side.
Walk back and repeat, alternating cut directions.

items.name: 高跳跳绳
items.description: Jump rope with higher jumps to add power and intensity.
steps: Hold the rope handles and stand tall.
Swing the rope overhead.
Jump higher than usual.
Land softly with bent knees.
Keep your rhythm.

items.name: 鹤禅式
items.description: An arm balance where your knees rest on the backs of your upper arms and your feet lift. It builds wrist, arm and core strength.
steps: Squat with feet together and place your hands flat on the floor shoulder-width apart.
Bend your elbows slightly and rest your shins against the backs of your upper arms.
Shift your weight forward onto your hands and lift one foot, then the other.
Round your upper back, draw your belly in and gaze slightly ahead.
Hold for a few breaths, then lower your feet gently.

items.name: 默认姿势
items.description: A relaxed, tall standing posture with arms by your sides. It is the neutral starting point for standing moves.
steps: Stand with feet about hip-width apart and weight even on both feet.
Let your arms hang naturally at your sides.
Lengthen your spine and gently draw your ribs down.
Relax your shoulders and look straight ahead.
Breathe calmly for a few breaths.

items.name: 伸拇指时手指屈曲
items.description: A small hand mobility drill where you curl your fingers while holding the thumb straight. It helps finger and thumb control.
steps: Hold one hand out with your palm open.
Extend your thumb out to the side and keep it straight.
Curl your four fingers slowly toward your palm.
Open the fingers again.
Repeat 10-15 times, then switch hands.
Keep the movement smooth and pain free.

items.name: 伸肘手内收拉伸
items.nameEn: adduction hand with elbow extended stretch
items.description: Tilts the hand sideways at the wrist with a straight elbow to stretch the forearm muscles along the outer edge of the arm.
steps: Stand tall and extend one arm in front of you with the elbow straight.
Turn the palm so the thumb points up.
Grab the hand with your other hand and tilt it gently toward the little finger side.
Keep the elbow locked and the shoulder down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release and repeat on the other arm.

items.name: 侧向拉腕拉伸
items.description: You pull your wrist gently with the other hand to stretch the forearm. Hold on each side.
steps: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双臂在身前伸展。
将右臂向侧面伸出，与地面平行，手掌朝下。
用左手抓住右手，轻轻地将其拉向身体，感觉右前臂有拉伸感。
保持拉伸 15-30 秒，然后放松。
在另一侧重复。

items.name: 前臂旋前
items.description: Rotating the forearm so the palm turns down. Helps forearm control and wrist mobility.
steps: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Hold your elbow close to your side bent at 90 degrees, palm facing up.
Rotate your forearm so your palm turns down to face the floor.
Keep the elbow still and pause briefly at the end.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

items.name: 前臂旋前肌拉伸
items.description: Rotating your forearm outward stretches the muscles that turn the palm down. Handy for anyone who types or lifts a lot.
steps: Extend one arm in front of you with your elbow straight and palm down.
Use your other hand to rotate the palm outward until you feel a stretch along your forearm.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

items.name: 前臂旋后
items.description: Rotating the forearm so the palm turns up. Helps forearm control and wrist mobility.
steps: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Hold your elbow close to your side bent at 90 degrees, palm facing down.
Rotate your forearm so your palm turns up to face the ceiling.
Keep the elbow still and pause briefly at the end.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

items.name: 单手悬垂
items.description: Hanging from a bar with just one hand. It builds grip strength and gives the shoulder a stretch.
