steps: Stand under a pull-up bar and grip it with one hand.
Lift your feet and hang with your arm straight.
Keep your shoulder active and your body still.
Hold for 10-20 seconds.
Lower yourself carefully and switch hands.

items.name: 单臂手指推球
items.nameEn: single arm fingers press with ball
items.description: A hand-strengthening drill pressing the fingers into a ball.
steps: Hold a small ball in one palm.
Press down on it with your fingers.
Spread and squeeze with control, keeping your wrist neutral.
Hold the press for 2-3 seconds.
Repeat for reps, then switch hands.

items.name: 单臂手指推球 v. 2
items.nameEn: single arm fingers press with ball v. 2
items.description: A second version of the fingers-on-ball drill for forearm and hand strength.
steps: Place a ball under one hand on a table or hold it in your palm.
Spread your fingers over the ball.
Press down and hold for 2-3 seconds.
Release with control.
Repeat for reps, then switch hands.

items.name: 坐姿前臂拉伸
items.description: A seated stretch for the muscles of the forearm. It eases tight wrists after typing or gripping.
steps: Sit tall and extend one arm in front of you, palm up.
With the other hand, gently pull the fingers back toward you.
Keep the elbow straight and shoulders relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Turn the palm down to stretch the other side, then switch arms.

items.name: 坐姿尺神经松动
items.description: A gentle seated nerve glide for the ulnar nerve on the inner side of the arm.
steps: Sit tall with one arm out to the side.
Bend your elbow and bring your hand toward your face like a mask.
Tilt your head slightly away.
Straighten the arm back out, keeping it gentle.
Repeat 8-10 times, then switch arms.

items.name: 坐姿正中神经松动
items.description: A gentle seated nerve glide for the median nerve running down the arm to the hand.
steps: Sit tall and lift one arm out to the side, palm up.
Extend your wrist and fingers backward.
Tilt your head slightly away from that arm.
Return slowly and repeat 8-10 times.
Stay within a mild stretch, then switch arms.

items.name: 坐姿腕尺偏肌和屈肌拉伸
items.nameEn: seated wrist ulnar deviator and flexor stretch
items.description: A seated wrist stretch for the inner forearm and the little finger side of the wrist.
steps: Sit tall and extend one arm forward with the palm facing up.
Use the other hand to bend the wrist back and tilt it toward the thumb side until the forearm stretches.
Keep the elbow straight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

items.name: 手指伸展拉伸
items.description: A stretch that bends the fingers back to lengthen the palm side of the forearm.
steps: Extend one arm in front with the palm facing up.
Use your other hand to hold the fingers.
Gently pull the fingers back toward you.
Keep your elbow straight and the wrist relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

items.name: 手指伸肌拉伸
items.description: Bending your fingers down stretches the muscles on the back of your forearm. Handy to loosen up after lots of gripping.
steps: Extend one arm forward with your palm facing down and your wrist relaxed.
Use your other hand to gently press your fingers and hand down toward you.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

items.name: 手指分开拉伸
items.description: Spreads the fingers wide apart to open up the hand and loosen the small muscles between the fingers.
steps: Hold one hand up in front of you with the palm facing you.
Spread your fingers as far apart as feels comfortable.
If you want more stretch, press between the fingers with your other hand.
Keep the wrist straight and the shoulder relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Relax the hand and switch sides.

items.name: 手指向下前臂拉伸
items.description: A stretch for the top of the forearm with the fingers pointing down.
steps: Extend one arm in front of you with the palm facing down.
Bend the wrist so the fingers point toward the floor.
Use your other hand to press the back of the hand gently toward you.
Keep your elbow straight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

items.name: 手指屈曲拉伸
items.description: Gently bends the fingers down to stretch the tight tissue on the top of the hand and fingers. Handy after typing or gripping work.
steps: Hold one arm out in front of you with the palm facing down.
Use your other hand to press the fingers of the extended hand gently downward.
Keep the elbow of the extended arm straight and the shoulders relaxed.
Stop at a mild pull, never at pain.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release and repeat on the other hand.

items.name: 手指屈肌拉伸
items.description: Pulling your fingers back stretches the muscles on the palm side of your forearm. Great after grip-heavy training or typing.
steps: Extend one arm forward with your palm facing up or out.
Use your other hand to gently pull your fingers and palm back toward you.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

items.name: 手指拉伸
items.description: A simple stretch that opens the fingers and forearm muscles, useful after typing or gripping.
steps: Hold one arm out in front of you with the elbow straight.
Use the other hand to gently pull the fingers back until you feel a stretch in the palm and forearm.
Keep the fingers straight and relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

items.name: 手指爆发
items.description: A quick open-and-close finger drill that warms up the hands and forearms.
steps: Hold your hands out in front of you.
Close both hands into tight fists.
Open them fast, spreading your fingers as wide as possible.
Repeat quickly for 20-30 reps.
Keep your wrists relaxed.

items.name: 手腕绕环
items.description: Hold your arms out and move your wrists in slow circles. It warms up the wrist joints and forearm muscles.
steps: 将双臂伸直在身前。
双手握拳。
以圆周运动旋转手腕，保持手臂静止。
继续手腕转圈达到所需的重复次数。

items.name: 拇指外展
items.description: A simple thumb movement where you lift the thumb away from the palm to improve hand mobility.
steps: Rest your hand on a table with the palm facing up.
Keep your fingers relaxed and straight.
Slowly move your thumb away from your palm.
Pause at the end of the range.
Return slowly to the start.
Do 10-15 reps, then switch hands.

items.name: 拇指拉伸
items.description: A gentle stretch for the thumb and the muscles at its base.
steps: Extend one arm with the palm facing up.
Use your other hand to hold the thumb.
Gently pull the thumb back and away from the palm.
Stop at a mild stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

items.name: 指力板半扣握
items.description: A hang from a hangboard in a half crimp grip. It builds finger strength for climbing.
steps: Place your fingers on the edge with the knuckles bent at about 90 degrees.
Step off and hang with straight arms.
Keep your shoulders engaged.
Hold for 5-10 seconds.
Rest fully between hangs.

items.name: 指力板开手握
items.description: A hang from a hangboard using an open hand grip. It builds finger strength with less strain on your joints.
steps: Grip the edge with fingers extended and a slight arch.
Step off and hang with straight arms.
Keep your shoulders engaged.
Hold for 5-10 seconds.
Lower down and rest before the next hang.

items.name: 指力板悬挂肘部135度
items.description: A hangboard hold with your elbows bent to about 135 degrees. It builds grip and pulling strength in a partly pulled position.
steps: Grip the hold and pull up slightly so your elbows bend to about 135 degrees.
Keep your shoulders back and your core tight.
Hold for 5-10 seconds.
Lower down under control.
Rest before the next hold.

items.name: 指力板悬挂肘部90度
items.description: A hangboard hold with your elbows bent to 90 degrees. It builds pulling strength and grip.
steps: Grip the hold and pull yourself up until your elbows are at 90 degrees.
Keep your shoulders back and your core tight.
Hold for 5-10 seconds.
Lower down under control.
Rest before the next hold.

items.name: 指力板斜面悬挂
items.description: A hang from a sloped hangboard hold. It builds finger and forearm strength for climbing.
steps: Grip the sloped hold with open hands.
Step off the ground and hang with straight arms.
Keep your shoulders active and your core tight.
Hold for 5-10 seconds.
Rest fully, then repeat.

items.name: 掌心向外前臂拉伸
items.description: Clasped hands pressed forward with the palms facing out to stretch the forearms.
steps: Stand or sit tall and interlace your fingers.
Turn your palms outward and straighten your arms in front of you.
Push your hands gently away until you feel the stretch in the forearms.
Keep your shoulders relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then release.

items.name: 改良式俯卧撑至前臂
items.nameEn: modified push up to lower arms
items.description: A modified push-up variation where you shift your weight toward your wrists. It strengthens the forearms, chest and shoulders.
steps: 从俯卧撑位置开始，双手直接放在肩膀下方，身体呈一条直线。
弯曲肘部，使肘部靠近身体两侧，将身体降低到地面。
一旦肘部成 90 度角，将前臂放低至地面，将肘部保持在肩膀正下方。
暂停片刻，然后用手掌推动前臂，使其回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 毛巾仰卧单腿反握二头弯举
items.nameEn: lying single leg reverse biceps curl with towel
items.description: Lying on your back, you curl a towel looped around one foot with an overhand grip. It targets your forearms and biceps.
steps: Lie on your back and loop a towel around one foot.
Hold the ends with an overhand grip.
Pull the towel toward you while the foot resists.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly, then switch legs.

items.name: 站姿手位(旋前旋后中立)
items.description: A forearm drill that rotates the hands through pronation, neutral and supination. It builds wrist and forearm control.
steps: Stand tall with your arms hanging by your sides.
Bend your elbows and hold your forearms in front of you.
Rotate your palms down, then to neutral, then up.
Move slowly and keep your elbows still.
Repeat for several smooth rounds.

items.name: 肘伸展及前臂旋后旋前拉伸
items.nameEn: elbow extension and supination pronation forearm stretch
items.description: Straightening your elbow and rotating your forearm stretches the muscles on both sides of the lower arm.
steps: Extend one arm in front of you with your elbow straight.
Slowly rotate your palm up and down and let your other hand add gentle pressure at each end.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

items.name: 肘伸肌肘肌拉伸
items.description: A forearm and elbow stretch for the small muscle at the back of the elbow along with the triceps. Useful after pressing or typing.
steps: Extend one arm forward and bend the elbow fully with your palm down.
Use your other hand to press your forearm toward your upper arm, then rotate it gently.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

items.name: 腕伸展
items.description: Lifting the back of the hand up, working the top of the forearm.
steps: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Rest your forearm on a table with your hand hanging off the edge, palm down.
Raise your hand upward by bending the wrist back.
Pause briefly, then lower slowly.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

items.name: 腕伸展等长收缩
items.description: A static hold where you press the back of your hand upward against resistance. It strengthens the wrist extensors without moving the joint.
steps: Sit with your forearm resting on a table, palm down and wrist at the edge.
Place your other hand on top of the working hand.
Try to lift the hand up while the top hand resists.
Hold for 5-10 seconds with no movement.
Relax slowly.
Repeat, then switch arms.

items.name: 腕伸肌拉伸
items.description: Stretches the muscles on top of the forearm that lift the wrist. Good after typing, climbing or heavy gripping.
steps: Extend one arm in front of you with the elbow straight and palm facing down.
Bend the wrist so your fingers point toward the floor.
With your other hand, gently pull the back of the hand toward you.
Keep the stretch mild and your shoulder relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch arms.

items.name: 腕内收
items.description: Tilting the wrist toward the little finger side, working the forearm muscles that guide the wrist.
steps: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Rest your forearm on a table with your hand hanging off the edge, thumb up.
Tilt your hand down toward the little finger side.
Pause briefly, then return to neutral under control.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

items.name: 腕外展
items.description: A gentle wrist movement that tilts the hand toward the thumb side. It improves wrist mobility.
steps: Rest your forearm on a table with your hand off the edge.
Keep your palm facing in.
Tilt your hand up toward the thumb side.
Return to neutral slowly.
Keep your forearm still.
Do equal reps on both wrists.

items.name: 腕尺偏肌和伸肌拉伸
items.nameEn: wrist ulnar deviator and extensor stretch
items.description: A forearm stretch that targets the wrist extensors with ulnar deviation, easing tightness after gripping or typing.
steps: Extend one arm in front of you with the palm down.
Bend the wrist so your fingers point down.
Gently tilt the hand toward the little finger side.
Use the other hand to apply light pressure.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch arms.

items.name: 腕尺偏肌和屈肌拉伸
items.nameEn: wrist ulnar deviator and flexor stretch
items.description: A forearm stretch that targets the wrist flexors with ulnar deviation.
steps: Extend one arm in front of you with the palm up.
Use your other hand to pull the fingers back toward you.
Gently tilt the hand toward the little finger side.
Keep the elbow straight and your shoulder relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch arms.

items.name: 腕屈曲
items.description: Curling the hand toward the forearm, working the underside of the forearm.
steps: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Rest your forearm on a table with your hand hanging off the edge, palm up.
Curl your hand upward by bending the wrist toward your forearm.
Pause briefly, then lower slowly.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

items.name: 腕屈肌拉伸
items.description: A simple forearm stretch for the wrist flexors, helpful after gripping or typing.
steps: Extend one arm in front of you with the palm up.
Use your other hand to pull the fingers back toward you.
Keep your elbow straight and your shoulder relaxed.
Feel the stretch along the inner forearm.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch arms.

items.name: 腕桡偏肌和伸肌拉伸
items.nameEn: wrist radial deviator and extensor stretch
items.description: A forearm stretch that targets the wrist extensors with radial deviation.
steps: Extend one arm in front of you with the palm down.
Bend the wrist so your fingers point down.
Gently tilt the hand toward the thumb side.
Use the other hand to apply light pressure.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch arms.

items.name: 腕桡偏肌和屈肌拉伸
items.nameEn: wrist radial deviator and flexor stretch
items.description: A forearm stretch that targets the wrist flexors with radial deviation.
steps: Extend one arm in front of you with the palm up.
Use your other hand to pull the fingers back toward you.
Gently tilt the hand toward the thumb side.
Keep the elbow straight and your shoulder relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch arms.

items.name: 跪姿腕屈肌拉伸
items.description: Kneeling on the floor, you press your palms down to stretch the underside of the forearms. Useful for lifters with tight wrists.
steps: Kneel on the floor and place your palms down with fingers pointing toward your knees.
Keep your palms flat and arms straight.
Slowly sit your hips back to increase the stretch.
Stop when you feel a pull along the inner forearms.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Ease off gently and shake out your hands.

items.name: 靠墙屈肌拉伸
items.description: Pressing the palm against a wall to stretch the forearm flexors.
steps: Stand facing a wall and place one palm on it with the fingers pointing down.
Keep your arm straight.
Slowly turn your body away until you feel the stretch in the forearm.
Keep your fingers flat on the wall.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

items.name: 仰卧小腿拉伸
items.description: A calf stretch done lying on your back. It stretches the lower leg with little effort from the rest of your body.
steps: Lie on your back and lift one leg toward the ceiling.
Hold behind the thigh or use a strap on your foot.
Pull your toes toward your shin.
Keep the knee as straight as you comfortably can.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs.

items.name: 仰卧屈膝胫骨前肌推
items.description: Lying on your back with knees bent, you press your foot toward your shin. It targets the front of the lower leg.
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Slide one foot under the other for light resistance.
Lift the toes of the lower foot toward your shin.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch feet.

items.name: 侧向快速步
items.description: Quick side-to-side steps that build foot speed and agility. It warms up the legs and trains coordination.
steps: Stand in a slight athletic stance with knees bent.
Step quickly to one side, pushing off the opposite foot.
Bring the trailing foot in and step back the other way.
Stay on the balls of your feet.
Keep your chest up and arms moving naturally.
Work at a fast but controlled pace for the set.

items.name: 倾身脚跟后踩跟腱拉伸
items.description: Targets the lower calf and Achilles tendon area by leaning into a wall with the back heel pressed down and the knee bent.
steps: Stand facing a wall and place your hands on it at chest height.
Step one foot back and keep that heel on the floor.
Bend both knees slightly and lean forward until you feel a pull low in the back calf.
Keep the back heel flat and the toes pointing forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs.

items.name: 分腿站姿单腿提踵
items.nameEn: split stance single leg calf raise
items.description: A calf raise in a split stance, with most work on the front leg. It trains the calf with balance support.
steps: Stand in a split stance, front foot flat and back toes lightly touching the floor.
Keep most weight on the front leg.
Rise onto the ball of the front foot.
Pause at the top.
Lower the heel slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

items.name: 前交叉胫骨拉伸
items.description: Crossing one foot in front and pressing the toes down to stretch the front of the shin.
steps: Stand tall and cross one leg in front of the other.
Point the toes of the back foot against the floor and gently bend the knee until the shin and ankle stretch.
Hold a wall or chair for balance.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

items.name: 前后跳
items.description: A light hop forward and back that builds ankle spring and coordination.
steps: Stand tall with your feet together.
Hop forward a short distance on the balls of your feet.
Hop back to the start.
Land softly with your knees slightly bent.
Keep a quick tempo.
Repeat for the planned time.

items.name: 半屈膝胫骨拉伸
items.nameEn: tibial stretch with semi flexed knee
items.description: A bent-knee stretch that targets the lower calf and the muscles around the shin.
steps: Stand facing a wall with one foot back and the toes pressed against the wall or floor.
Bend the knee of the stretching leg slightly.
Shift your weight forward until you feel a stretch low in the calf.
Keep the heel on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

items.name: 单脚脚跟下落小腿拉伸
items.description: Dropping one heel off a step to stretch the calf through a full range.
steps: Stand on the edge of a step with the ball of one foot on it and hold a rail for balance.
Slowly lower that heel below the step until you feel the calf stretch.
Keep the knee straight to hit the calf, then bend it slightly to reach deeper into the soleus.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

items.name: 单脚脚跟下落跟腱拉伸
items.description: Lets one heel drop off a step to stretch the Achilles and calf.
steps: Stand on a step with the ball of one foot on the edge.
Hold a rail for balance.
Lower your heel slowly below the step.
Keep the knee straight for the calf, then slightly bent for the soleus.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

items.name: 单腿地面提踵
items.description: A one-leg calf raise on the floor with a hand on a wall for balance. It builds calf strength and ankle stability.
steps: 双脚分开与臀部同宽站立，双手放在墙壁或坚固的物体上以保持平衡。
将一只脚抬离地面并用另一只脚保持平衡。
慢慢地将脚跟抬离地面，将身体抬起到脚掌上。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将脚跟放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换腿并重复。

items.name: 单腿小腿拉伸
items.description: A calf stretch done on one leg at a time. It lengthens the lower leg muscles.
steps: Stand facing a wall with one foot back and heel on the floor.
Place your hands on the wall.
Lean forward with a straight back leg.
Feel the stretch in the calf.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs.

items.name: 单腿小腿跳
items.description: Hopping on one leg using mostly the ankles. It builds calf power and springy ankles.
steps: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend and arms relaxed.
Push through the ball of your foot and jump up using mainly your ankles.
Keep the knee nearly straight in the air.
Land softly on the ball of the same foot.
Rebound right away into the next hop.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 单腿小腿跳(跳箱支撑)
items.nameEn: single leg calf jump step box supported
items.description: A single-leg calf hop with a step box nearby for balance. It trains ankle power with extra stability.
steps: Stand beside a step box and rest a hand lightly on it for balance.
Lift one foot off the floor.
Hop up using mostly your ankle and calf.
Land softly on the ball of your foot.
Keep the hops small and quick.
Switch legs after your set.

items.name: 单腿弹跳
items.description: Small, springy hops on one leg that build calf and ankle stiffness, elasticity and balance.
steps: Stand on one leg with a soft knee and your arms relaxed at your sides.
Hop straight up by pushing through the ball of your foot, keeping the knee almost straight.
Land softly on the ball of the same foot and rebound right away.
Keep your hops small and quick, with your hips level and your core tight.
Hop for the planned time or reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 单腿驴式提踵
items.description: A one-leg donkey calf raise where you bend forward and rise onto your toes. It trains the calf with a deep stretch at the bottom.
steps: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，脚趾指向前方。
将双手放在稳定的表面上以获得支撑，例如墙壁或酒吧。
将一条腿抬离地面，保持膝盖稍微弯曲。
使用小腿肌肉，尽可能高地抬高脚跟。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低脚跟。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换腿。

items.name: 双手撑墙小腿拉伸
items.nameEn: calf stretch with hands against wall
items.description: Stand facing a wall and place your hands on it, one foot back with heel down. It stretches the calf of the back leg.
steps: 面向墙壁站立，双脚分开与臀部同宽。
将双手靠在墙上，与肩同高。
右脚向后退一步，保持脚后跟着地，腿伸直。
弯曲左膝并向前倾斜，保持后腿伸直，脚后跟着地。
保持拉伸 20-30 秒。
换腿并重复拉伸。

items.name: 双手撑墙小腿推拉伸
items.nameEn: calf push stretch with hands against wall
items.description: Stand facing a wall with your hands on it and push your heel down on the back leg. It stretches the calf of the back leg.
steps: 面向墙壁站立，双脚分开与臀部同宽。
将双手靠在墙上，与肩同高。
一只脚向后退一步，脚跟保持在地面上，腿伸直。
稍微弯曲前膝盖并向前倾斜，感觉小腿有拉伸感。
保持拉伸 20-30 秒。
换腿并重复拉伸。

items.name: 双膝跪姿胫骨拉伸
items.description: Kneeling and sitting back onto your heels to stretch the front of the shins and ankles.
steps: Kneel on a mat with your feet pointing straight back and the tops of the feet on the floor.
Slowly sit back toward your heels until you feel the shins and ankles stretch.
Place your hands on the floor in front of you to control the pressure.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

items.name: 台阶边单腿提踵
items.nameEn: single leg calf raise off step
items.description: One-legged calf raise from the edge of a step. It builds calf strength with a deep stretch.
steps: Stand on one foot on the edge of a step, holding a rail for balance.
Let your heel lower below the step.
Rise as high as possible on your toes.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly, then switch legs.

items.name: 四向单腿跳
items.description: Hopping on one leg forward, back and side to side trains balance, ankle stability and power.
steps: Stand on one leg with a soft knee.
Hop forward and land softly.
Hop back to the start, then hop to each side.
Hold each landing for a moment.
Keep your chest up and your knee over your foot.
Repeat the pattern, then switch legs.

items.name: 坐姿单腿挤压脚趾
items.description: A one-foot toe curl while seated. It trains the muscles under the foot.
steps: Sit on a chair and place one foot flat on the floor.
Curl your toes down and squeeze.
Hold for a second or two.
Relax and spread the toes.
Finish your reps, then switch feet.

items.name: 坐姿单腿挤压脚趾 v. 2
items.nameEn: seated single leg squeezing toes v. 2
items.description: Another one-foot toe squeeze while seated. It strengthens the small muscles in the foot.
steps: Sit with one foot flat on the floor.
Curl your toes down and hold the squeeze.
Keep your heel planted.
Release and spread your toes.
Do all reps, then switch feet.

items.name: 坐姿单腿胫骨前肌推
items.description: Press the top of your foot upward against resistance while seated. It strengthens the shin muscle.
steps: Sit with one foot resting flat and the other leg crossed over it.
Hook the toes of the lower foot under your other foot for light resistance.
Lift the toes and forefoot up toward your shin.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch feet.

items.name: 坐姿单腿胫骨前肌推 v. 2
items.nameEn: seated single leg tibialis press v. 2
items.description: A gentle seated press that engages the shin muscle. Useful for ankle control.
steps: Sit on a chair with one foot flat and the other crossed over it.
Press the top foot up against the resistance of the bottom foot.
Feel the front of your shin work.
Hold for a second.
Relax and repeat, then switch feet.

items.name: 坐姿单腿脚趾下压
items.description: Pressing the toes into the floor while seated. It activates the foot and calf muscles.
steps: Sit on a chair with one foot on the floor.
Lift your heel slightly and press your toes into the floor.
Hold briefly.
Lower your heel again.
Finish your reps, then switch feet.

items.name: 坐姿单腿足部左右摆动
items.nameEn: seated single leg foot side to side
items.description: A seated ankle move that sweeps the foot from side to side. It improves ankle mobility.
steps: Sit tall and lift one foot slightly off the floor.
Keep your lower leg still.
Turn your foot inward, then outward, in a smooth motion.
Move through a comfortable range.
Repeat for your reps, then switch feet.

items.name: 坐姿单腿足部左右摆动 v. 2
items.nameEn: seated single leg foot side to side v. 2
items.description: A second version of the side-to-side seated foot move for ankle mobility.
steps: Sit tall and lift one foot a little off the floor.
Keep your leg still.
Sweep the foot to the inside, then to the outside.
Keep the motion smooth and pain free.
Repeat, then switch feet.

items.name: 坐姿单腿足部画圈
items.description: Seated ankle circles on one leg. They loosen the ankle and warm up the lower leg.
steps: Sit tall on a chair and lift one foot slightly off the floor.
Keep your lower leg still.
Draw slow circles with your toes, as wide as is comfortable.
Do half your reps clockwise, then switch to counterclockwise.
Repeat on the other foot.

items.name: 坐姿双足画圈
items.description: Circling both feet while seated. A simple way to mobilise the ankles.
steps: Sit tall on a chair with both feet lifted off the floor.
Keep your knees still.
Circle both feet in the same direction, as wide as feels comfortable.
Reverse the direction after several turns.
Keep your breathing relaxed.

items.name: 坐姿地面提胫骨
items.description: Sitting on the floor, you pull your toes toward your shins to work the muscles at the front of the lower leg.
steps: Sit on the floor with your legs straight and your hands behind you.
Keep your heels on the floor.
Pull your toes up toward your shins.
Hold for a moment.
Lower the toes slowly.
Repeat for the set.

items.name: 坐姿小腿拉伸 v. 2
items.description: A seated stretch for the calves, a second variation. It helps loosen tight lower legs.
steps: Sit with one leg straight in front of you.
Loop your hands or a strap around the ball of your foot.
Gently pull your toes toward you.
Feel the stretch in the calf.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs.

items.name: 坐姿小腿拉伸(男)
items.description: Sit on a chair and reach to pull your toes toward you. It stretches the calf and the back of the lower leg.
steps: 坐在椅子或长凳的边缘，双脚平放在地面上。
将一只腿伸直在身前，脚跟保持在地面上。
稍微向前倾，感受小腿肌肉的拉伸。
保持拉伸 20-30 秒。
换腿并重复拉伸。

items.name: 坐姿拉脚尖小腿拉伸
items.description: Pulls the toes back toward the shin while sitting, giving the calf and the back of the lower leg a gentle stretch.
steps: Sit on the floor with one leg straight out in front of you.
Reach forward and grab the toes or the ball of the foot of that leg.
Gently pull the toes toward your shin while keeping the knee straight.
Sit tall and avoid rounding your back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release and switch legs.

items.name: 坐姿拉脚尖跟腱拉伸
items.description: Seated stretch where you pull the toes toward you.
steps: Sit on the floor with one leg straight.
Loop a towel around the ball of your foot or grip your toes.
Pull your toes toward your shin.
Keep your knee straight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

items.name: 坐姿挤压脚趾
items.description: Curling and squeezing the toes while seated. It wakes up the small muscles of the feet.
steps: Sit on a chair with both feet flat on the floor.
Curl all your toes down as if gripping the floor.
Squeeze for a couple of seconds.
Relax and spread your toes wide.
Repeat smoothly.

items.name: 坐姿直腿小腿拉伸
items.description: Seated with a straight leg, you pull your toes toward you. It stretches the calf muscles.
steps: Sit on the floor with one leg straight.
Loop a towel around the ball of your foot, or hold your toes.
Pull your toes toward you.
Keep your knee straight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs.

items.name: 坐姿胫骨前肌推
items.description: A seated press with the front of the foot to train the shin muscle. It helps balance the lower leg.
steps: Sit tall with your heels on the floor.
Lift the toes of one foot as high as you can.
Press them up against light resistance such as the other foot.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.
Finish the reps, then switch feet.

items.name: 坐姿脚滑动
items.description: Gentle seated mobility drill sliding the foot along the floor to warm up the ankle and calf.
steps: Sit tall on a chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Keep your heel down and slide the foot forward along the floor.
Pull it back, letting the heel lift slightly toward the end.
Move smoothly through a comfortable range.
Repeat, then switch feet.

items.name: 坐姿脚趾伸肌和足内翻肌拉伸
items.nameEn: seated toe extensor and foot inverter stretch
items.description: Seated stretch combining pointing the toes down with a turn of the sole inward.
steps: Sit and cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Hold the top of the foot and toes with your hand.
Curl the toes down and turn the sole gently inward.
Feel the stretch along the top and inner edge of the foot.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

items.name: 坐姿脚趾伸肌和足外翻肌拉伸
items.nameEn: seated toe extensor and foot everter stretch
items.description: Seated stretch combining pointing the toes down with a turn of the sole outward.
steps: Sit and cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Hold the top of the foot and toes with your hand.
Curl the toes down and turn the sole gently outward.
Feel the stretch along the top and outer edge of the foot.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

items.name: 坐姿脚趾伸肌拉伸
items.description: A seated stretch for the muscles that lift the toes, using your hand to point the toes downward.
steps: Sit and cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Hold the top of the foot and toes with your hand.
Gently curl the toes and foot downward until you feel a stretch on the top.
Keep the motion gentle.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

items.name: 坐姿脚趾屈肌和足内翻肌拉伸
items.nameEn: seated toe flexor and foot inverter stretch
items.description: Seated stretch pulling the toes back while turning the sole inward.
steps: Sit and cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Hold the toes with your hand.
Pull the toes back toward your shin and turn the sole gently inward.
Feel the stretch along the sole and outer edge of the foot.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

items.name: 坐姿脚趾屈肌和足外翻肌拉伸
items.nameEn: seated toe flexor and foot everter stretch
items.description: Seated stretch pulling the toes back while turning the sole outward.
steps: Sit and cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Hold the toes with your hand.
Pull the toes back toward your shin and turn the sole gently outward.
Feel the stretch along the sole and inner edge of the foot.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

items.name: 坐姿脚趾屈肌拉伸
items.description: A seated stretch pulling the toes back to lengthen the bottom of the foot.
steps: Sit and cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Hold the toes with your hand.
Gently pull the toes back toward your shin.
Feel the stretch along the sole of the foot.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

items.name: 坐姿足旋前旋后
items.description: Seated, you roll the foot inward and outward. It mobilizes the ankle and foot.
steps: Sit on a chair with one foot lifted slightly off the floor.
Roll the sole of your foot inward.
Roll it outward as far as is comfortable.
Keep the lower leg still.
Finish your reps, then switch feet.

items.name: 坐姿踝部拉伸
items.description: A gentle seated stretch for the front of the ankle and shin that eases stiffness after sitting or training.
steps: Sit on a chair or the floor with one leg extended.
Point your toes away from you so the top of the foot lengthens.
Slowly circle or press the foot until you feel a comfortable stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without forcing it.
Release and switch legs.
Repeat 2-3 times on each side.

items.name: 垫高坐姿提踵
items.description: A seated calf raise with the balls of the feet on a raised surface for a deeper stretch. It targets the lower calf muscle.
steps: Sit on a bench with the balls of your feet on a raised step.
Rest weight or your hands on your thighs.
Lower your heels as far as you comfortably can.
Press up onto your toes as high as possible.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

items.name: 垫高站姿单腿提踵
items.nameEn: elevated standing single leg calf raise
items.description: A one-leg calf raise on a step with a full stretch at the bottom. It builds calf strength and balance.
steps: Stand on one foot with the ball of that foot on a step, other foot lifted.
Hold a wall or rail for balance.
Lower your heel below the step.
Press up onto your toes as high as you can.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 垫高站姿提踵
items.description: A standing calf raise from a raised platform so your heels drop below the toes. The extra range works the calves hard.
steps: Stand with the balls of your feet on a step or block, heels hanging off.
Hold something for balance.
Lower your heels below the step to stretch your calves.
Rise up as high as you can on your toes.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.

items.name: 垫高站姿提踵 v. 2
items.description: Standing calf raise from a raised platform for a full range of motion. It builds the calves.
steps: Stand with the balls of your feet on a step and your heels hanging off.
Hold something for balance.
Rise high onto your toes.
Pause and squeeze your calves.
Lower your heels below the step slowly.

items.name: 小腿向前跳
items.description: Small forward hops driven by the calves. They build ankle stiffness and reactive power.
steps: Stand tall with feet together and knees slightly soft.
Push off the balls of your feet and hop forward a short distance.
Keep your knees nearly straight.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Hop back or turn around and repeat.
Stay light and quick through the whole set.

items.name: 小腿左右跳
items.description: Quick lateral hops powered by the calves. They improve ankle strength and foot speed.
steps: Stand tall with feet together and knees slightly soft.
Spring off your toes and hop to one side.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Immediately hop to the other side.
Keep your chest up and hips level.
Continue alternating for the set.

items.name: 小腿拉伸
items.description: A standing wall stretch for the calf muscles. Helps with ankle mobility and tight lower legs.
steps: Stand facing a wall with your hands on it.
Step one foot back with the heel on the floor.
Bend your front knee and lean forward.
Feel the stretch in the back calf.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs and repeat.

items.name: 小腿拉伸 v. 2
items.description: A standing calf stretch variation that lengthens the lower leg muscles and helps ankle mobility.
steps: Stand facing a wall and place your hands on it at chest height.
Step one foot back with the heel flat on the floor and the toes pointing forward.
Bend the front knee and lean in until you feel the back calf stretch.
Keep the back leg straight and the heel down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

items.name: 小腿跳
items.description: Jump using only your calves. It builds explosive lower legs.
steps: Stand tall.
Keep knees nearly straight.
Jump using your ankles.
Land softly.
Repeat quickly.

items.name: 小腿静态拉伸
items.description: A static calf stretch that lengthens the lower leg muscles and the Achilles area.
steps: Stand facing a wall with one foot back and your heel on the floor.
Keep your back leg straight and lean toward the wall.
Press your back heel down until you feel a stretch in the calf.
Keep your hips square and your toes pointing forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

items.name: 屈膝小腿拉伸
items.description: A calf stretch with a bent back knee that targets the deeper soleus muscle near the Achilles tendon.
steps: Stand facing a wall with hands on it and one foot back.
Bend both knees, keeping the back heel flat on the floor.
Lean forward until you feel a stretch low in the back calf.
Keep your hips square and chest up.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

items.name: 左右跳
items.description: Hop laterally from one foot to the other. It builds ankle stability, leg power and agility.
steps: Stand on one foot with a slight knee bend.
Hop sideways to the other foot.
Land softly and balance for a second.
Hop back to the first foot.
Keep your hips level and repeat for 20-30 hops.

items.name: 平衡垫单腿平衡
items.description: A one-legged stand on a foam balance pad. It improves ankle stability and body control.
steps: Place the pad on a flat floor.
Step on with one foot and stand tall.
Lift the other foot off the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your eyes on a fixed point.
Switch legs.

items.name: 平衡板 v. 2
items.description: Standing on a balance board to train stability. It strengthens the ankles and the small stabilisers in the feet.
steps: Place the board on a flat, non-slip surface.
Step onto it with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Keep your knees soft and your core tight.
Tilt gently without letting the edges touch the floor.
Balance for 30-60 seconds.

items.name: 平衡板单腿平衡
items.description: A single-leg stand on a balance board. It trains ankle stability and control.
steps: Place a balance board on a flat floor next to a wall for safety.
Step on with one foot and find your centre.
Lift the other foot off the floor.
Hold steady for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your hips level.
Switch legs.

items.name: 弓步直腿小腿拉伸
items.description: Lunge forward with the back leg straight to stretch the calf. It improves ankle mobility.
steps: Step into a lunge with hands on a wall or knee.
Keep the back leg straight with heel down.
Lean forward until you feel a stretch.
Keep your foot pointing forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

items.name: 弹力床踮脚跳
items.description: Toe jumps on an elastic bed. It trains calves and ankle bounce.
steps: Stand on the elastic bed with feet together.
Rise onto your toes.
Jump using your ankles.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Stay quick and light.
Continue for the set.

items.name: 弹跳双脚
items.description: Small, quick hops off the balls of both feet. It builds calf and ankle stiffness and bounce.
steps: Stand tall with your knees nearly straight.
Hop off the balls of your feet.
Keep your heels off the ground.
Bounce quickly with minimal knee bend.
Stay light and quiet on landing.
Go for a set time or number of hops.

items.name: 徒手站姿提踵
items.description: A standing calf raise using just your body weight. It strengthens the calves and ankles and needs no equipment.
steps: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，脚趾指向前方。
将手放在墙壁或稳定的表面上以保持平衡。
慢慢地将脚后跟抬离地面，将身体重量转移到脚掌上。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 徒手行走提踵
items.description: Walk forward staying high on your toes with every step. It builds calf endurance and ankle control without any equipment.
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Rise onto the balls of your feet as high as you can.
Take a step forward, staying on your toes.
Keep alternating steps without dropping your heels.
Lower your heels when you reach the end of the set.

items.name: 徒手靠墙提胫骨
items.description: A wall-supported toe raise that strengthens the muscles at the front of the shins.
steps: Stand with your back against a wall and your feet a bit in front of you.
Keep your legs straight.
Lift your toes toward your shins as high as you can.
Lower slowly to the floor.
Keep the movement smooth and repeat.

items.name: 扶持站姿提踵
items.description: A calf raise holding on for balance, so you can focus on the calves.
steps: Stand holding a wall or rail for balance.
Place your feet hip-width apart.
Rise up on your toes as high as you can.
Pause and squeeze your calves.
Lower slowly.

items.name: 抬脚胫骨拉伸
items.description: A stretch with the foot raised on a support, easing the shin and top of the ankle.
steps: Stand next to a wall and lift one foot behind you onto a low support with the top of the foot down.
Keep your torso upright and your standing leg soft.
Press your hips forward gently until you feel the shin stretch.
Keep the movement slow and controlled.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

items.name: 指间分开拉伸
items.description: Spreads the toes apart to wake up and loosen the small muscles of the foot.
steps: Sit comfortably and bring one foot up to rest on the opposite knee.
Hold the foot with your hand.
Slide your fingers between the toes and gently spread them apart.
Keep the movement slow and easy.
Hold the spread for 15-20 seconds.
Release and switch feet.

items.name: 摇摆踝部拉伸
items.description: Rocking forward over a bent knee to open the ankle and calf. It helps ankle mobility for squats and walking.
steps: Kneel on one knee with the front foot flat on the floor.
Keep your front heel down.
Rock your front knee forward over your toes until you feel a stretch.
Rock back and forth slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs.

items.name: 椅上坐姿单腿提踵
items.nameEn: seated single leg calf raise on a chair
items.description: A seated one-leg calf raise that mainly hits the soleus using only your body weight.
steps: Sit on a chair with one foot flat on the floor, knee bent to 90 degrees.
Lift the other foot off the floor or tuck it behind.
Press through the ball of the working foot and raise your heel.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 椅子支撑下沉式提踵
items.nameEn: calf raise from deficit with chair supported
items.description: A calf raise from a raised step with a chair for balance, giving a deeper stretch and fuller range.
steps: Stand with the balls of your feet on a step edge, holding a chair for balance.
Let your heels drop below the step to stretch your calves.
Rise as high onto your toes as you can.
Pause for a second at the top.
Lower slowly into the deep stretch.
Keep your knees almost straight.

items.name: 椅子支撑站姿屈膝交替提踵
items.nameEn: standing bent knee alternating calf raise with a chair support
items.description: An alternating calf raise with the knees bent, using a chair for balance. It works the soleus one side at a time.
steps: Stand behind a chair and hold it with both hands.
Bend your knees slightly.
Raise one heel as high as possible.
Lower it slowly.
Raise the other heel.
Keep alternating without locking your knees.

items.name: 椅子支撑站姿屈膝提踵
items.nameEn: standing bent knee calf raise with a chair support
items.description: A calf raise with the knees slightly bent while holding a chair. It targets the deeper soleus muscle.
steps: Stand behind a chair and hold it for balance.
Bend your knees slightly.
Raise your heels as high as you can.
Pause at the top.
Lower your heels slowly.
Keep your knees bent throughout.

items.name: 深蹲停顿提踵
items.description: Hold a squat while lifting and lowering your heels. It combines quad endurance with calf work.
steps: Stand with feet shoulder width apart and lower into a half squat.
Hold that depth with your chest up.
Raise your heels as high as you can.
Lower your heels slowly.
Repeat while holding the squat position.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.

items.name: 深蹲跟腱拉伸
items.description: Deep squat hold that opens the ankles and calves.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Sink into a deep squat with your heels down.
Hold on to a support if needed.
Gently shift your weight forward over your toes.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Stand up slowly.

items.name: 点位训练
items.description: A fast foot drill over a pattern of dots that builds foot speed, ankle stability and coordination.
steps: Mark five dots on the floor like the five on a die.
Stand on the balls of your feet next to the pattern.
Hop quickly from dot to dot in your chosen order.
Keep your hops small and your knees soft.
Work for 20-30 seconds, then rest.

items.name: 站姿单腿小腿摇摆
items.description: Balance on one leg and rock between heel and toes. It warms up the calf and ankle.
steps: Stand on one leg next to a wall for balance.
Rock your weight back onto your heel, lifting the toes.
Roll forward onto the ball of your foot.
Keep the movement smooth and controlled.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 站姿单腿提踵(扶持)
items.nameEn: standing single leg calf raise with support
items.description: Raise your heel on one leg while holding a support for balance, building the calf.
steps: Stand on one foot and hold a wall or rail for balance.
Rise as high as you can onto the ball of your foot.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly below flat if you can do so comfortably.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 站姿单腿提踵(楼梯上)
items.nameEn: standing single leg calf raise (on a staircase)
items.description: One-legged calf raise from a stair step for a deep stretch. It builds calf strength and ankle stability.
steps: Stand on the edge of a stair on one foot, holding the rail for balance.
Let your heel drop below the step.
Rise up onto your toes as high as you can.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly, then switch legs after your set.

items.name: 站姿单腿提踵平衡
items.nameEn: standing single leg calf raise balance
items.description: A one-leg calf raise that also challenges balance. It builds calf strength and ankle stability.
steps: Stand tall on one foot with the other lifted.
Keep your hands on your hips or lightly on a wall.
Rise up onto your toes as high as you can.
Hold briefly at the top, steady.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 站姿单腿集中提踵
items.nameEn: standing single leg concentration calf raise
items.description: A one-legged calf raise performed slowly with full focus. It builds calf strength and ankle control.
steps: Stand on one leg and hold a wall or rail lightly.
Lower your heel slightly for a stretch.
Rise high onto your toes, squeezing the calf.
Pause for a second at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 站姿后侧跟腱拉伸
items.description: A standing stretch for the back of the lower leg and the Achilles area.
steps: Stand facing a wall and step one foot back.
Keep the back heel down and the knee slightly bent.
Lean forward until you feel the stretch low in the calf.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs.

items.name: 站姿地面胫骨前肌上抬(扶墙)
items.nameEn: standing floor tibialis raise wall supported
items.description: Standing with your back against a wall, you lift your toes off the floor. It strengthens the muscles on the front of the shin.
steps: Stand with your back and hips against a wall, feet a little way out in front.
Keep your legs straight and your heels planted on the floor.
Pull your toes up toward your shins as high as you can.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower your toes slowly and repeat.

items.name: 站姿小腿
items.description: A standing calf raise where you lift your heels as high as you can. It builds the calf muscles.
steps: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，脚趾指向前方。
将脚后跟抬离地面，尽可能高，用脚趾站立。
保持该姿势片刻，然后慢慢降低脚跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 站姿小腿拉伸
items.description: Stand facing a wall and step one foot back with the heel down. It stretches the calf of the back leg.
steps: 面朝墙壁或坚固物体站立，距离大约一臂远。
将手放在与肩同高的墙壁或物体上。
一只脚向后退一步，保持脚跟平放在地面上。
稍微弯曲前膝盖并向前倾斜，保持后腿伸直。
您应该感觉到小腿肌肉有拉伸感。
保持拉伸 20-30 秒。
在另一条腿上重复。

items.name: 站姿小腿胫骨拉伸
items.description: Standing with the top of the foot on the floor to stretch the muscles at the front of the shin.
steps: Stand tall and hold a wall for balance.
Place the top of one foot on the floor behind you with the toes curled under.
Gently press the foot down by bending the standing knee.
Feel the stretch along the front of the shin and ankle.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

items.name: 站姿提踵
items.description: A bodyweight calf raise that builds lower-leg strength and ankle stability.
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Rise up onto the balls of your feet as high as you can.
Pause at the top for a second.
Lower your heels slowly back to the floor.
Hold a wall for balance if needed.

items.name: 站姿提踵(台阶上)
items.description: A calf raise with your heels hanging off a stair step for extra range. It trains the calves through a deep stretch.
steps: 站在台阶或坚固平台的边缘，脚后跟悬垂，脚趾放在台阶上。
如果需要，抓住栏杆或墙壁以保持平衡。
慢慢地尽可能高地抬起脚后跟，将身体重量转移到脚掌上。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 站姿提踵绕圈
items.description: A calf raise that finishes with a small circle of the heels. It works the calves and the ankle control.
steps: Stand tall with feet hip width apart and hold a support if needed.
Rise onto the balls of your feet.
Trace a small circle with your heels while staying high.
Lower your heels slowly to the floor.
Reverse the circle direction on the next rep.
Keep your knees straight and your balance steady.

items.name: 站姿毛巾足部卷腹
items.description: A foot exercise where you scrunch a towel on the floor with your toes. It strengthens the muscles of the foot and arch.
steps: Stand with one foot flat on a towel laid on a smooth floor.
Keep your heel down.
Curl your toes to pull the towel toward you.
Release and repeat until the towel is bunched under your foot.
Hold on to a support if you need balance.
Do your reps, then switch feet.

items.name: 站姿等长保持提踵
items.description: A standing calf raise held at the top. It builds calf endurance.
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip width apart.
Rise onto the balls of your feet.
Hold the top position for 20 to 30 seconds.
Keep your ankles straight and stable.
Lower your heels slowly.
Rest briefly between holds.

items.name: 站姿胫骨前肌拉伸
items.description: A standing stretch for the muscle at the front of the shin. Useful after running or lots of walking.
steps: Stand near a wall for balance.
Place the top of one foot on the floor behind you with toes curled under.
Gently bend the standing knee to press forward.
Feel the stretch along the shin.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Switch feet.

items.name: 站姿脚尖上翘小腿拉伸
items.description: Standing with the toes lifted against a surface to stretch the calf.
steps: Stand facing a wall or step and place the ball of one foot against it with the heel on the floor.
Keep the leg straight.
Lean your hips gently toward the wall until you feel a stretch in the calf.
Keep your heel down and your back tall.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

items.name: 站姿脚尖上翘跟腱拉伸
items.description: Stretches the calf and Achilles by lifting the toes against a wall.
steps: Stand facing a wall with one foot forward.
Place the ball of the forward foot against the wall, heel on the floor.
Lean your hips toward the wall.
Feel the stretch in the calf and Achilles.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

items.name: 站姿脚趾伸肌拉伸
items.description: Pressing the tops of the toes against the floor to stretch the front of the foot and shin.
steps: Stand next to a support and place the top of one foot on the floor behind you with the toes curled under.
Gently bend your standing knee and press the toes down until you feel the stretch on top of the foot and shin.
Keep the pressure light and controlled.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

items.name: 站姿脚趾屈肌拉伸
items.description: Pulling the toes back against a wall to stretch the sole of the foot and the calf.
steps: Stand facing a wall and place the toes of one foot on it with the heel on the floor.
Lean forward gently until you feel the stretch along the bottom of the foot and into the calf.
Keep your heel firmly on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

items.name: 站姿脚跟后踩跟腱拉伸
items.description: Classic lunge-style calf stretch with the back heel kept down.
steps: Stand facing a wall and step one foot back.
Keep the back leg straight and the heel down.
Bend your front knee and lean forward.
Feel the stretch in the back calf.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

items.name: 站姿腓骨肌拉伸
items.description: A standing stretch for the muscles on the outside of the lower leg. It helps ankle mobility.
steps: Stand near a wall for balance.
Cross one foot behind and turn the sole so the outer edge presses into the floor.
Gently shift your weight onto that foot.
Feel the stretch along the outside of the lower leg.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Switch feet.

items.name: 站姿足部肌肉激活
items.description: A standing drill that wakes up the small muscles of the feet. It builds foot control and balance.
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Spread your toes wide and press all of them into the floor.
Lift your toes while keeping the ball of the foot down.
Lower them one by one.
Keep your arch lifted.
Repeat for 10-15 slow reps.

items.name: 站姿跟腱拉伸
items.description: Simple standing stretch for the Achilles tendon and calf.
steps: Stand near a wall or support.
Step one foot back with the heel down.
Slightly bend the back knee to target the lower Achilles.
Keep your back foot pointing forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

items.name: 站姿踝关节画圈 v. 2
items.description: A standing mobility drill that rotates the ankle through its full range. It warms up the ankle joints.
steps: Stand tall and hold a wall or chair for balance.
Lift one foot slightly off the floor.
Draw slow circles with your toes.
Do about 10 circles in one direction.
Switch to the other direction.
Change feet and repeat.

items.name: 站姿踝髋练习
items.description: A standing drill that loosens the ankles and hips. It is a good warm-up for squats and lunges.
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip width.
Shift your weight onto one foot.
Rotate your ankle and hip through a smooth circle.
Keep your upper body steady.
Do 8-10 slow reps, then switch sides.

items.name: 站姿靠墙提胫骨
items.description: Leaning against a wall, you lift your toes toward your shins to train the muscle at the front of your lower leg.
steps: Stand with your back against a wall and feet a little forward.
Keep your legs straight.
Lift your toes as high as you can, keeping your heels down.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

items.name: 绕膝拉伸
items.description: A standing knee circle drill with the heels lifted. It warms up the knees and calves and can ease tight lower legs.
steps: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手放在臀部。
稍微弯曲膝盖，将脚跟抬离地面，用脚掌保持平衡。
保持膝盖弯曲，先顺时针旋转膝盖，然后逆时针旋转膝盖。
执行所需的重复运动次数。

items.name: 绕膝拉伸 v. 2
items.description: Gentle knee circles with the leg slightly bent that loosen up the knee area and calves. Handy as a warm-up or a loosening drill.
steps: Stand with your feet together and bend your knees slightly.
Place your hands on your knees for support.
Slowly rotate your knees in a circle in one direction.
Keep the movement smooth and controlled.
Switch to the other direction after 8 to 10 circles.

items.name: 肋木胫骨屈曲拉伸
items.nameEn: tibial flexion stretch on wall bar
items.description: A stretch using a wall bar to flex the ankle and lengthen the muscles of the lower leg.
steps: Stand facing the wall bars and place the front of one foot against a low bar.
Lean your body forward and press your heel toward the floor until the lower leg stretches.
Hold the bars with your hands to stay balanced.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

items.name: 脚和踝部左右拉伸
items.nameEn: feet and ankles side to side stretch
items.description: A seated stretch moving the feet side to side to loosen the ankles.
steps: Sit with your legs extended.
Keep your heels on the floor.
Roll your feet slowly to the outside.
Then roll them inward.
Continue for 20-30 seconds.

items.name: 脚尖跳
items.description: Quick small hops on the balls of your feet. It trains the calves and ankles and builds a springy stride.
steps: Stand tall with feet close together and knees slightly bent.
Rise onto the balls of your feet.
Hop up quickly using mainly your ankles.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep your hops small and rhythmic.
Continue for 20-30 seconds.

items.name: 脚趾深蹲拉伸
items.description: Kneeling on the toes to stretch the feet and front of the ankles.
steps: Kneel on a mat with your toes tucked under.
Sit back onto your heels slowly.
Rest your hands on your thighs.
Ease off if the stretch is too sharp.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Release and shake out your feet.

items.name: 脚跟下压
items.description: Pressing the heel down toward the floor to lengthen the calf. It helps ankle flexibility.
steps: Stand with the ball of one foot on a low step or wall, heel on the floor.
Hold something for balance.
Press your heel gently down and back.
Keep your knee straight for the calf.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

items.name: 脚跟下沉
items.description: A controlled drop of the heels off a step that stretches and strengthens the calves and ankles.
steps: Stand on the edge of a step with the balls of your feet on it.
Hold a rail for balance.
Rise onto your toes.
Slowly lower your heels below the step level.
Pause and feel the stretch in your calves.
Raise up and repeat.

items.name: 脚跟行走
items.description: Walking on your heels with the toes lifted, strengthening the shins and loosening the ankles.
steps: Stand tall with arms relaxed at your sides.
Lift your toes and forefoot off the floor so you balance on your heels.
Walk forward with small, controlled steps.
Keep your toes pulled up the whole time.
Walk for 20-30 seconds, then rest.

items.name: 膝碰箱小腿拉伸
items.description: Press one knee forward toward a box with your foot flat to stretch the calf. It improves ankle flexibility.
steps: Place a foot flat a short distance from a box or step.
Keep your heel down.
Push your knee forward to touch the box.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a calf stretch.
Switch legs and repeat.

items.name: 自重站姿脉冲提踵
items.description: A standing calf raise with small pulses at the top. It builds calf endurance.
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding a support for balance.
Rise up onto the balls of your feet.
Pulse up and down in small movements.
Keep your knees straight.
Lower fully when you finish.
Keep the movement controlled.

items.name: 足部和脚踝拉伸
items.description: A gentle stretch for the feet and ankles. It helps loosen stiff joints and the muscles around them.
steps: Sit on a chair or the floor with one leg extended.
Point your toes away from you.
Hold for 15 seconds.
Pull your toes back toward your shin.
Hold for another 15 seconds.
Switch legs and repeat.

items.name: 足部和脚踝旋转拉伸
items.description: Rotating the foot in slow circles to mobilise the ankle. It warms up the joint and relieves stiffness.
steps: Sit with one leg extended or crossed over your knee.
Hold your lower leg steady.
Draw slow circles with your foot.
Do 10 circles in one direction.
Switch to the other direction.
Repeat on the other foot.

items.name: 跖屈拉伸
items.description: Pointing the foot downward to stretch the front of the ankle and shin.
steps: Sit on a chair or the floor with one leg extended.
Point your toes away from you as far as is comfortable.
Gently press the top of the foot with your hand for a little extra stretch.
Keep the movement slow and avoid forcing the ankle.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

items.name: 跖屈肌和足内翻肌拉伸
items.nameEn: plantar flexor and foot inverter stretch
items.description: A seated ankle stretch that lengthens the front of the lower leg and the inner side of the ankle.
steps: Sit with one leg extended and hold the foot with your hand.
Point the foot down and turn the sole slightly inward.
Gently press the foot until you feel a stretch along the front and inner ankle.
Move slowly and stop at a mild stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

items.name: 跖屈肌和足外翻肌拉伸
items.nameEn: plantar flexor and foot everter stretch
items.description: A seated ankle stretch that lengthens the calf and the outer side of the lower leg.
steps: Sit with one leg extended and hold the foot with your hand.
Point the foot down and turn the sole slightly outward.
Gently press the foot until you feel a stretch along the front and outer ankle.
Move slowly and stop at a mild stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

items.name: 跪姿脚跟下压跟腱拉伸
items.description: Kneeling stretch with the heel pressed down to lengthen the Achilles.
steps: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward.
Lean forward, keeping your front heel on the floor.
Press your front knee over your toes.
Feel the stretch behind the ankle.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

items.name: 跳下箱并单腿稳定
items.nameEn: box jump down with one leg stabilization
items.description: Step off a box and land on both feet, then hold the landing on one leg. It builds landing control and strengthens the calves and ankle.
steps: 站在盒子或平台前，双脚分开与肩同宽。
弯曲膝盖，跳到盒子上，一只脚轻轻落地，另一只脚悬在盒子边缘。
将脚踩在盒子上，将自己稳定在盒子上，同时保持另一只脚离开地面。
保持这个姿势几秒钟，锻炼小腿肌肉以保持平衡。
将放在盒子上的脚慢慢放下，回到起始位置。
用另一条腿重复该练习。

items.name: 踝关节活动拉伸
items.description: A gentle rocking stretch that improves ankle movement and loosens the calf.
steps: Stand facing a wall with one foot forward, toes a few inches from it.
Keep your front heel on the floor.
Bend the front knee and glide it toward the wall.
Return and repeat slowly for 10-15 reps, then switch feet.

items.name: 踝关节绕环
items.description: Sit and move your foot in slow circles from the ankle. It warms up the ankle joint and the muscles around the calf.
steps: 坐在地上，双腿在身前伸展。
将一条腿抬离地面，并以圆周运动旋转脚踝。
在一个方向上转所需的圈数，然后切换到另一个方向。
换另一条腿重复上述步骤。

items.name: 踝背屈
items.description: Pulling the toes up toward the shin, working the front of the lower leg. A simple way to keep the ankle moving well.
steps: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Sit with one leg out and your heel resting on the floor.
Pull your toes and the top of your foot toward your shin as far as is comfortable.
Pause briefly, then lower the foot back down slowly.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

items.name: 踝跖屈
items.description: Pointing the foot away from the shin, engaging the calf. Good for warming up and mobilising the ankle.
steps: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Sit with one leg out and your foot relaxed.
Point your toes down and away from you, as if pressing a gas pedal.
Pause briefly at the end, then return to the neutral position.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

items.name: 踮脚侧向行走
items.description: A sideways walk on tiptoe. It builds calf strength and ankle stability.
steps: Stand tall and rise onto your toes.
Bend your knees slightly.
Step sideways with small controlled steps.
Stay high on your toes.
Keep your hips level.
Walk one way, then return.

items.name: 踮脚走
items.description: Walking on the balls of your feet with heels lifted. It works the calves and the small stabilisers of the feet and ankles.
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and rise onto the balls of your feet.
Keep your heels lifted as high as you comfortably can.
Walk forward with small, controlled steps.
Keep your core tight and your gaze forward.
Walk for 20-30 steps, rest, and repeat.

items.name: 蹲姿脚趾拉伸
items.description: A deep squat on the balls of the feet that stretches the toes and the bottom of the feet.
steps: Crouch down with your heels lifted and toes tucked under.
Place your hands on the floor in front of you for support.
Slowly sit back toward your heels until you feel the toes and soles stretch.
Ease off if the stretch is too sharp.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then release.

items.name: 蹲姿脚跟后踩小腿拉伸
items.description: A deep crouch with the heels pressed back to stretch the calves and Achilles area.
steps: Crouch down with your feet flat and hands on the floor for balance.
Shift one heel backward and press it toward the floor.
Keep the other leg bent and supporting your weight.
Feel the stretch in the calf of the pressing leg.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

items.name: 蹲姿脚跟后踩跟腱拉伸
items.description: Low crouch stretch with one heel pushed back to lengthen the Achilles.
steps: Crouch down with your hands on the floor for balance.
Extend one leg back with the heel down.
Press the heel toward the floor.
Keep your chest lifted.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

items.name: 驴式提踵
items.description: A donkey calf raise with the toes on a raised surface. You lift and lower the heels through a full range to work the calves.
steps: 将脚趾站立在升高的表面上，例如台阶或木块。
将双手放在稳定的支撑物上，例如墙壁或栏杆，以保持平衡。
尽可能高地抬高脚后跟，将身体重量转移到脚掌上。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 下巴贴胸拉伸
items.description: A gentle neck stretch that lengthens the muscles at the back of the neck. Useful after long periods of sitting.
steps: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Slowly lower your chin toward your chest.
Place your hands lightly on the back of your head if you want a deeper stretch.
Keep your shoulders down away from your ears.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return slowly to neutral.

items.name: 仰卧收下巴
items.description: A small nodding motion lying on your back. It trains the deep neck muscles and improves head posture.
steps: Lie on your back with your head resting on the floor and knees bent.
Gently draw your chin toward your throat.
Press the back of your head lightly into the floor.
Hold for 3-5 seconds.
Release and repeat.

items.name: 仰卧斜角肌激活
items.description: A gentle lying exercise that wakes up the scalene muscles at the side of the neck. It supports neck control.
steps: Lie on your back with your head resting on the floor.
Relax your shoulders away from your ears.
Gently tilt your head to one side without lifting your shoulder.
Feel a light engagement along the side of your neck.
Return to the middle slowly.
Alternate sides for several reps.

items.name: 仰卧颈伸展
items.description: Lying face down, you lift the head slightly to train the back of the neck.
steps: Lie face down with your forehead hanging near the edge of a bench or resting just off the floor.
Keep your shoulders relaxed.
Lift your head a few centimeters, keeping your chin slightly tucked.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly.
Use small, controlled reps.

items.name: 仰卧颈伸肌拉伸
items.description: Lets gravity help stretch the back of the neck while you lie on your back.
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent.
Clasp your hands behind your head.
Gently lift your head and ease your chin toward your chest.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Lower your head back down slowly.

items.name: 仰卧颈屈曲
items.description: Gentle chin tuck while lying on your back. It strengthens the front neck muscles.
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent.
Relax your shoulders.
Tuck your chin and lift your head slightly off the floor.
Hold for a second.
Lower slowly.
Keep the motion small and smooth.

items.name: 仰卧颈部伸展拉伸
items.description: Stretches the front of the neck by letting the head drop back from the edge of a bench or bed.
steps: Lie on your back with your head near the edge of a bench or bed, shoulders supported.
Slowly let your head relax backward past the edge.
Support it with your hands if it feels heavy.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Use your hands to lift your head back up carefully.

items.name: 仰望天花板拉伸
items.description: A gentle neck stretch where you tilt the head back to look at the ceiling. It opens the front of the neck.
steps: Sit or stand tall with relaxed shoulders.
Slowly tilt your head back to look at the ceiling.
Open your mouth slightly to relax the jaw.
Feel the stretch along the front of your neck.
Hold for 15-20 seconds.
Return to neutral slowly.

items.name: 俯卧颈桥
items.description: A face-down neck bridge that strengthens the muscles at the back of the neck. Start gently and keep the load light.
steps: Kneel on a mat and lean forward so the top of your head rests lightly on the floor.
Place your hands on the floor for support.
Take some weight through your neck by rocking forward and back slowly.
Keep your movements small and controlled.
Return to the start and rest between sets.
Never bounce and keep most weight on your hands at first.

items.name: 俯卧颈部伸展
items.description: Lying face down, you gently lift your head. It trains the muscles at the back of the neck.
steps: Lie face down with your forehead on the floor or a towel.
Keep your arms by your sides.
Slowly lift your head a few inches, keeping your chin tucked.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly and repeat.

items.name: 俯卧颈部伸展等长保持
items.description: Hold your head lifted while lying face down. It builds endurance in the neck extensors.
steps: Lie face down with your arms by your sides.
Tuck your chin slightly.
Lift your head a few inches off the floor.
Hold steady while breathing normally.
Hold for 10-20 seconds, then lower slowly.

items.name: 坐姿仰望天空
items.description: Sit upright and slowly tip your head back to look up. It stretches the front of the neck.
steps: Sit tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Slowly tip your head back to look up at the ceiling.
Keep your mouth closed and move only as far as feels comfortable.
Hold for 15-20 seconds.
Return your head to neutral slowly.

items.name: 坐姿收下巴
items.description: Gently glide your chin straight back while seated to wake up the deep neck flexors and ease a forward head posture.
steps: Sit tall on a chair with your shoulders relaxed and eyes forward.
Keep your chin level, not tilted up or down.
Slide your head straight back as if making a double chin.
Hold for 2-3 seconds without tensing your jaw.
Return slowly to the start and repeat for 10-12 reps.

items.name: 坐姿点颈
items.description: A seated move tapping toward your neck area. It gently mobilises the neck and shoulders.
steps: Sit tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Bring one hand up toward the side of your neck.
Tap lightly.
Switch to the other hand.
Keep your head level.
Continue at a gentle pace.

items.name: 坐姿颈部侧向拉伸
items.description: A seated lateral neck stretch. It loosens the side of the neck and upper traps.
steps: Sit tall and relax your shoulders.
Tilt your ear toward one shoulder.
Rest your hand lightly on your head for a gentle added stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return to centre and switch sides.

items.name: 坐姿颈部屈伸
items.description: A seated neck mobility drill moving the head forward and back.
steps: Sit tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Lower your chin gently toward your chest.
Hold for a moment.
Slowly lift your head and look up slightly.
Move through a comfortable range only.
Repeat 8-10 times smoothly.

items.name: 坐姿颈部屈曲拉伸
items.description: Seated chin-to-chest stretch for the muscles along the back of the neck.
steps: Sit tall on a chair with your hands resting in your lap.
Slowly lower your chin toward your chest.
Let the weight of your head do the work, without forcing it.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Lift your head back to neutral slowly.

items.name: 坐姿颈部拉伸
items.description: A gentle seated stretch for the back of the neck. It helps ease tension from desk time.
steps: Sit tall on a chair with your shoulders relaxed.
Place one hand on the back of your head.
Gently guide your chin toward your chest until you feel a stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.
Release slowly and repeat.

items.name: 手辅助颈部拉伸
items.description: A neck stretch where your hand adds gentle pressure. It eases the side and back of the neck.
steps: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Place one hand on the side of your head.
Gently tilt your head toward the shoulder, using light pressure.
Keep the opposite shoulder down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Release slowly and switch sides.

items.name: 推头侧向颈部拉伸
items.description: Tilting your head to one side, you add gentle pressure with your hand. Stretches the side of the neck.
steps: 站直或坐直，肩膀放松。
将头向右倾斜，将右耳靠近右肩。
将右手放在头部左侧，轻轻施加压力以增加拉伸。
保持拉伸 15-30 秒。
在另一侧重复，将头向左倾斜并用左手施加压力。
每侧重复拉伸 2-3 次。

items.name: 收下巴
items.description: Drawing your chin straight back to line up your head over your shoulders. It's a simple neck posture exercise.
steps: Sit or stand tall with your eyes level.
Place a finger on your chin if it helps.
Draw your chin straight back as if making a double chin.
Keep your head level without tilting.
Hold for 3-5 seconds.
Release and repeat 8-10 times.

items.name: 斜方肌与颈部拉伸
items.description: Tilting your head to the side while anchoring the opposite shoulder stretches the upper traps and the side of the neck.
steps: Sit or stand tall and hold the edge of the seat or a hand behind your back to anchor one shoulder down.
Tilt your head toward the opposite shoulder until you feel a stretch along your neck.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

items.name: 椅上坐姿颈屈曲到伸展
items.nameEn: seated neck flexion to extension on chair
items.description: Seated, you slowly nod your head forward and back. It loosens the neck.
steps: Sit tall on a chair with your shoulders relaxed.
Slowly lower your chin toward your chest.
Gently lift your head and look slightly upward.
Keep the motion smooth and pain free.
Repeat for several slow reps.

items.name: 椅上坐姿颈左右侧屈
items.nameEn: seated side to side neck bend on chair
items.description: Seated, you tilt your ear toward each shoulder. It eases side neck tightness.
steps: Sit tall on a chair with your shoulders relaxed.
Slowly tilt your head so your ear moves toward one shoulder.
Return to the centre.
Tilt toward the other shoulder.
Repeat for several slow reps.

items.name: 椅上坐姿颈左右扭转
items.nameEn: seated side to side neck twist on chair
items.description: Seated, you turn your head from side to side. It restores easy neck rotation.
steps: Sit tall on a chair with your shoulders relaxed.
Slowly turn your head to look over one shoulder.
Return to the centre.
Turn to the other side.
Repeat for several slow reps.

items.name: 站姿颈侧拉伸
items.description: A gentle side stretch for the neck and upper traps, useful after desk work.
steps: Stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Tilt your head toward one shoulder.
Rest a hand lightly on your head for slight pressure.
Keep the opposite shoulder low.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Switch sides.

items.name: 跪姿颈部拉伸
items.description: Kneeling side neck stretch. It releases tension in the sides and back of the neck.
steps: Kneel tall with your back straight.
Tilt your head to one side, ear toward shoulder.
Place a hand lightly on your head for a gentle pull.
Keep the opposite shoulder low.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

items.name: 辅助颈部旋转拉伸
items.description: A hand-assisted head turn that stretches the muscles at the side of the neck.
steps: Sit tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Turn your head to one side as far as is comfortable.
Place one hand on your chin and the other on the back of your head.
Add light pressure to deepen the turn.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

items.name: 颈伸肌及旋转拉伸
items.description: Combines forward bending with a turn of the head to stretch the back and side of the neck.
steps: Sit tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Turn your head about 45 degrees to one side.
Rest a hand on the back of your head and ease your nose toward your armpit.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

items.name: 颈伸肌拉伸
items.description: Lengthens the extensor muscles at the back of the neck by tucking the chin down.
steps: Sit tall with your back straight.
Tuck your chin toward your chest.
Rest one hand on the back of your head and add very light pressure down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Remove your hand and lift your head slowly.

items.name: 颈后侧等长收缩
items.description: Press the back of your head into your hands without moving. It strengthens the muscles at the back of the neck.
steps: Sit or stand tall with your hands clasped behind your head.
Keep your chin level.
Press your head back into your hands without letting it move.
Hold for 5-10 seconds.
Relax and repeat a few times.

items.name: 颈屈肌及旋转拉伸
items.description: Stretches the front and side of the neck by combining a head tilt back with a turn.
steps: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders down.
Turn your head slightly to one side.
Tilt your chin up and back until you feel a stretch along the front of your neck.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

items.name: 颈屈肌拉伸
items.description: Tilts the head back to stretch the muscles at the front of the neck.
steps: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Lift your chin and slowly tilt your head back.
Keep the movement small and comfortable.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Return your head to neutral.

items.name: 颈部伸展及侧倾拉伸
items.description: Tilts the head back and to the side to stretch the front and side of the neck.
steps: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders down.
Tilt your head back slightly.
Lower one ear toward the same shoulder.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

items.name: 颈部伸展拉伸
items.description: Tilting your head back stretches the front of the neck. Go slowly and stay within a comfortable range.
steps: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Slowly tilt your head back to look up at the ceiling, keeping your jaw relaxed.
