Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

items.name: 颈部侧向拉伸
items.description: A simple side-bend stretch for the muscles along the side of your neck and top of the shoulders.
steps: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Tilt your head so your ear moves toward one shoulder.
Keep the opposite shoulder pressed down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return to centre and repeat on the other side.
Don't pull hard on your head, a light weight of the hand is enough.

items.name: 颈部侧向拉伸
items.description: Gently tilt your head sideways to stretch the side of your neck. It eases tension in the neck and upper shoulder.
steps: 站直或坐直，肩膀放松。
将头向一侧倾斜，将耳朵靠近肩膀。
保持拉伸 15-30 秒。
在另一侧重复。
每侧进行 2-4 组。

items.name: 颈部前伸拉伸
items.description: A gentle stretch that glides the head forward to open the back of the neck and the base of the skull.
steps: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Keep your eyes level and slide your chin and head straight forward.
Stop when you feel a stretch at the back of the neck.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Draw your head back to neutral and relax.

items.name: 颈部前后拉伸
items.description: A gentle neck stretch where you tip your head forward and then back to loosen the front and back of the neck.
steps: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Slowly lower your chin toward your chest until you feel a stretch at the back of the neck.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Raise your head and slowly tip it back to look up.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, staying comfortable.
Move slowly and keep your breathing relaxed.

items.name: 颈部前屈拉伸
items.description: Bends the neck forward to lengthen the muscles at the back of the neck and upper shoulders.
steps: Stand or sit tall with your shoulders down.
Place both hands lightly behind your head.
Let your elbows drop forward and ease your head toward your chest.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Release your hands and return to neutral.

items.name: 颈部斜向屈曲拉伸
items.description: Tilting your head diagonally forward stretches the back and side of the neck. It targets the muscle running from the neck to the shoulder blade.
steps: Sit tall and gently turn your head about 45 degrees to one side.
Drop your chin diagonally toward your chest, using your hand for light added pressure.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

items.name: 颈部旋转拉伸
items.description: Turning your head slowly from side to side stretches the muscles around the neck. It is a gentle way to ease stiffness.
steps: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Slowly turn your head to one side, then to the other, as far as is comfortable.
Keep your chin level and avoid pushing into any pain.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

items.name: 颈部绕圈拉伸
items.description: Gentle circles of the head to loosen the neck. It eases stiffness in the neck muscles.
steps: Stand or sit tall with relaxed shoulders.
Drop your chin toward your chest.
Slowly roll your head to one side.
Continue in a smooth circle.
Do 5 circles, then reverse.

items.name: pvc管外旋
items.description: Using a light pipe to practice rotating the shoulders outward, building control and range for overhead lifts.
steps: Hold a PVC pipe in both hands with your elbows tucked at your sides and bent to 90 degrees.
Keep your elbows pinned and rotate the pipe so one hand moves outward.
Return to the start and rotate the other way.
Move slowly and keep your ribs down and your wrists straight.
Continue alternating for the planned reps.

items.name: pvc管绕肩
items.description: Swinging a pipe from the front of your thighs to behind your back to open the shoulders and chest.
steps: Stand holding a PVC pipe in front of your thighs with a wide overhand grip.
Keep your arms straight and raise the pipe overhead.
Continue moving it down behind your back as far as comfortable.
Reverse the path back to the front with control.
Widen your grip if the shoulders feel pinched.

items.name: 上举肩部拉伸
items.description: Reaching overhead to stretch the shoulders and the sides of the upper body.
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip width apart.
Reach one or both arms overhead and up as high as you can, then press them slightly backward.
Do not arch your lower back as you reach.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

items.name: 下斜屈体推举(凳间)
items.description: A harder pike push-up with the feet raised, hands on benches, loading the shoulders strongly.
steps: Place your hands on two benches and your feet on a higher surface behind you.
Lift your hips into a pike.
Bend your elbows and lower your head between the benches.
Press up to straight arms.
Keep your core tight.
Control the descent.

items.name: 交叉肩部拉伸
items.description: Pulling one arm across your chest stretches the rear shoulder. It is a staple warm-up and cooldown stretch.
steps: Stand tall and bring one straight arm across your chest.
Use your other hand to hold it just above the elbow and draw it closer to you.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

items.name: 仰卧环绕世界
items.description: Lying on your back, you sweep your arms in a big arc overhead. It opens up your shoulders and chest.
steps: Lie on your back with your arms by your sides.
Raise your arms to the ceiling.
Sweep them in a wide arc overhead toward the floor.
Continue the arc back down to your sides.
Move slowly and keep your ribs down.

items.name: 仰卧肩部划扫
items.description: Slide your arms along the floor in a wide arc to mobilise the shoulders.
steps: Lie on your back with arms straight out to the sides.
Sweep both arms up in an arc toward overhead.
Keep your arms as close to the floor as you comfortably can.
Return along the same path.
Move slowly for 10-12 reps.

items.name: 侧卧内旋
items.description: A light rotation exercise lying on your side that turns the arm inward. It strengthens the rotator cuff gently.
steps: Lie on your side with your elbow bent to 90 degrees and tucked to your ribs.
Rest the forearm on the floor in front of you.
Rotate your forearm up toward your belly.
Lower it slowly back to the floor.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

items.name: 侧卧外旋
items.description: A light side-lying rotation for the back of the shoulder. Often used for shoulder stability.
steps: Lie on your side with your top elbow bent to 90 degrees against your ribs.
Hold your forearm across your stomach.
Rotate your forearm upward without moving your elbow.
Lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

items.name: 侧步后三角肌划船
items.description: A side step paired with a rowing motion that works the rear shoulders and upper back while elevating your pulse.
steps: Stand in a slight squat with your arms out in front.
Step to the side.
Pull your elbows back and squeeze your shoulder blades.
Return your arms forward as you step back.
Alternate sides at a steady pace.

items.name: 俯身后侧前举臂
items.nameEn: bent over back to side to front arms raise
items.description: A flowing bent-over arm sweep from back to side to front that warms up and strengthens the rear and side shoulders.
steps: Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back and let your arms hang down.
Sweep both arms back behind your hips.
Swing them out wide to the sides up to shoulder height.
Continue the arc forward until your arms point ahead of you, then reverse the path.
Keep your neck neutral and move smoothly for the planned reps.

items.name: 俯身肩部钟摆
items.description: A gentle pendulum swing for the shoulder joint. It loosens the shoulder and warms it up without any load.
steps: Stand beside a bench and rest one hand on it, hinging forward at the hips.
Let the other arm hang straight down, relaxed.
Swing the arm gently forward and back in a small arc using your body's motion.
Then swing it side to side and in small circles.
Keep the shoulder loose and the movement easy.
Do equal time on both sides.

items.name: 倒立行走
items.description: An advanced bodyweight skill where you walk on your hands while inverted. It builds shoulder strength, balance and body control.
steps: Kick up into a handstand against a wall or with a spotter, hands shoulder-width apart.
Squeeze your glutes and legs together and push tall through your shoulders.
Shift your weight onto one hand and move the other forward a small step.
Alternate hands in short, controlled steps, keeping your core tight.
Come down safely with control, and practise on soft ground.

items.name: 凳上坐姿肩部拉伸
items.description: A seated stretch that opens the front of the shoulders using a bench.
steps: Sit on the edge of a bench and place your hands behind you on it, fingers pointing back.
Walk your hips slightly forward off the bench.
Lower your hips gently until you feel a stretch at the front of the shoulders.
Keep your back close to the bench and shoulders down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then rise up.

items.name: 凳上派克俯卧撑
items.description: A pike push up with your feet raised on a bench, shifting more load to the shoulders. A bodyweight alternative to the overhead press.
steps: Place your feet on a bench and your hands on the floor, hips raised in an inverted V.
Keep your legs straight and your core braced.
Bend your elbows and lower your head toward the floor.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your elbows at about 45 degrees to your body.

items.name: 前臂倒立瑜伽体式
items.nameEn: forearms stand yoga pose pincha mayurasana
items.description: A forearm balance that builds strong shoulders and core, also known as feathered peacock pose.
steps: Start on your forearms and knees with your elbows under your shoulders.
Press your forearms into the floor and tuck your toes.
Lift your hips high and walk your feet toward your elbows.
Swing or float one leg up, then bring the other to meet it.
Keep your ribs in and your gaze between your hands.
Hold briefly, then lower with control.

items.name: 前臂靠墙滑动
items.description: Sliding your forearms up a wall to wake up the shoulder blade muscles. It improves overhead movement.
steps: Stand facing a wall with your forearms on it, elbows at shoulder height.
Lean in slightly and keep your abs braced.
Slide your forearms up the wall as you reach upward.
Pause at the top without arching your back.
Slide back down and repeat.

items.name: 单臂肩屈肌拉伸
items.description: Stretching one arm back and down to lengthen the front of the shoulder.
steps: Stand next to a wall or post and place one hand on it behind you with the arm straight.
Slowly turn your body away until you feel the front of the shoulder stretch.
Keep the arm straight and the shoulder relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

items.name: 原地快速摆臂
items.description: Swing your arms quickly while standing to warm up the shoulders and raise your heart rate.
steps: Stand with feet hip width apart and knees soft.
Swing both arms across your chest and open wide.
Keep your torso upright and relaxed.
Increase speed gradually.
Continue for 30-60 seconds.

items.name: 反向肩部拉伸
items.description: Clasping your hands behind your back and lifting them to open the front of the shoulders.
steps: Stand tall and clasp your hands behind your back.
Straighten your arms and lift your hands up and away from your body until the shoulders and chest stretch.
Keep your chest open and avoid leaning forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

items.name: 反手举
items.description: Lifting your arms behind you from a face-down position. It strengthens the rear shoulders and upper back.
steps: Lie face down with your arms by your sides, palms up.
Lift your chest and arms slightly off the floor.
Raise your hands up and back by squeezing your shoulder blades.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

items.name: 后三角肌拉伸
items.description: You pull one arm across your chest to stretch the back of the shoulder. Hold it gently on each side.
steps: 站直，双脚分开与肩同宽。
将右臂伸过胸部，将左手放在右肘上。
轻轻地将右臂拉向左肩，感受右肩的拉伸。
保持拉伸 15-30 秒，然后放松。
在另一侧重复。

items.name: 坐姿肩屈肌下压肌回缩肌拉伸
items.nameEn: seated shoulder flexor depressor retractor stretch
items.description: A seated stretch that lengthens the shoulder and chest by pressing the arms back and down.
steps: Sit tall on a chair or bench.
Place your hands behind you on the seat, fingers pointing back.
Press your shoulders down and back, opening your chest.
Lean slightly forward until you feel the stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then relax.

items.name: 坐姿肩部屈伸收缩拉伸(屈膝)
items.nameEn: seated shoulder flexor depressor retractor stretch (bent knee)
items.description: A seated stretch that opens the front of the shoulder and lengthens the muscles that lift and pull the arm.
steps: Sit on the floor with one knee bent and the other leg comfortable.
Place your hands behind you on the floor, fingers pointing away.
Slowly slide your hips forward while keeping your chest tall.
Feel the stretch in the front of your shoulders.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
Release slowly and repeat on the other side if needed.

items.name: 坐姿芭蕾
items.description: A seated arm movement like a ballet arm sweep. It loosens the shoulders and warms up the upper body.
steps: Sit tall with arms by your sides.
Sweep your arms out and up in a wide arc.
Bring your hands overhead.
Lower them back with control.
Keep the movement graceful.
Repeat at an easy pace.

items.name: 屈体俯卧撑(凳上) v. 2
items.description: A pike push-up with your feet on a bench, loading the shoulders more than a flat push-up does.
steps: Place your feet on a bench and your hands on the floor, hips piked high.
Walk your hands back until your body forms an inverted V.
Bend your elbows and lower your head toward the floor.
Keep your elbows at about 45 degrees from your body.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your core tight throughout.

items.name: 屈体俯卧撑(凳间)
items.description: A pike push-up with your feet on one bench and your hands between benches for extra depth.
steps: Put your feet on one bench and your hands on the floor or a second bench.
Raise your hips into a pike.
Lower your head between your hands.
Keep elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press back up to straight arms.
Keep your core tight.

items.name: 屈体俯卧撑(椅间)
items.description: A pike push-up with your hands on two chairs so your head can drop lower.
steps: Set two sturdy chairs shoulder-width apart and grip them.
Walk your feet back and lift your hips into a pike.
Bend your elbows to lower your head between the chairs.
Keep your back flat and elbows slightly in.
Press back up.
Make sure the chairs are stable.

items.name: 屈体推举(凳间)
items.description: A pike push-up with the hands on two benches so you can lower deeper, building the shoulders.
steps: Place your hands on two benches shoulder-width apart and your feet on the floor.
Lift your hips into a pike shape.
Bend your elbows and lower your head between the benches.
Press back up to straight arms.
Keep your core tight.
Keep your hips high throughout.

items.name: 屈体站立
items.description: A folded stance with hips high and head down, shifting weight over your hands. It opens the hamstrings and loads the shoulders.
steps: Start on all fours and walk your feet in while lifting your hips high.
Form an upside-down V with straight arms and legs.
Press the floor away and let your head hang between your arms.
Keep your heels reaching toward the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.

items.name: 屈臂肩部拉伸
items.description: A cross-body shoulder stretch with the elbow bent, easing the back of the shoulder.
steps: Stand tall and bring one arm across your chest with the elbow bent.
Hold the elbow with your other hand.
Gently pull the elbow toward the opposite shoulder.
Keep your shoulders level and your neck relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

items.name: 山式转眼镜蛇式
items.description: A flowing bodyweight move that goes from a pike with hips high to a cobra with chest lifted. It warms up the shoulders, spine and hamstrings.
steps: Start on hands and toes with your hips high in an inverted V.
Bend your elbows and glide your chest forward and down between your hands.
Sweep forward and up, straightening your arms and lifting your chest into a cobra.
Keep your legs active and look slightly forward.
Reverse the path, pushing your hips back up into the pike, and repeat smoothly.

items.name: 左勾拳 拳击
items.description: A boxing left hook thrown with a hip and torso rotation. Builds rotational power and conditioning.
steps: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，膝盖稍微弯曲。
左手举起以保护脸部，右手握住下巴。
旋转臀部并以左脚为轴心，同时以出拳动作向前伸展左臂。
扭转你的躯干并调动你的核心肌肉以产生出拳的力量。
将手臂拉回到起始位置，然后重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 平板撑推举
items.description: An advanced gymnastics skill where you press from a lean into a planche shape. It builds shoulder strength and a strong core.
steps: Start in a deep planche lean with hands under your shoulders.
Protract your shoulders and squeeze your glutes.
Lean forward and lift your feet from the floor.
Press into the ground and hold the position.
Lower under control.
Warm up your wrists first.

items.name: 平行杠下沉拉伸
items.description: A hanging stretch between parallel bars that opens the shoulders and lengthens the lats.
steps: Stand between parallel bars and grip them at hip height.
Walk back slightly, letting your arms straighten.
Lower your chest toward the floor and press your head between your arms.
Feel the stretch in the lats and shoulders.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then walk forward to release.

items.name: 床单后三角肌飞鸟
items.nameEn: rear delt fly with bed sheet
items.description: A no-equipment fly that uses a bed sheet pulled apart to work the rear shoulders.
steps: Hold a bed sheet taut in both hands in front of you.
Keep your arms nearly straight.
Pull your hands apart, opening your arms out to the sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly and keep tension on the sheet.

items.name: 徒手侧卧肩外旋
items.description: A side-lying rotation that turns the forearm upward. It strengthens the rotator cuff without weights.
steps: Lie on your side with your elbow bent 90 degrees and tucked at your waist.
Rest your forearm across your stomach.
Rotate your forearm upward, keeping the elbow in.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.

items.name: 徒手俯身后三角肌飞鸟
items.nameEn: bodyweight bent over rear delt fly
items.description: A bent over fly using only your arms as resistance. It trains the rear shoulders and upper back.
steps: Hinge forward with a flat back and arms hanging down.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly.
Keep your neck neutral.

items.name: 徒手站姿军事推举
items.description: A standing overhead press without weight, good for learning the pressing path or warming up.
steps: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart and fists at your shoulders.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Press your arms straight overhead.
Lower back to your shoulders with control.
Avoid leaning back.

items.name: 徒手站姿军事推举(靠墙支撑)
items.description: An unloaded overhead press against a wall to groove a clean path and open the shoulders.
steps: Stand with your back, head and hips against a wall, hands at shoulder height with elbows bent.
Brace your abs so your lower back stays on the wall.
Press your hands straight overhead until your arms are locked out.
Lower back to shoulder height with control.
Keep your wrists stacked over your elbows.

items.name: 徒手站姿环绕(靠墙支撑)
items.nameEn: bodyweight standing around the world (wall supported)
items.description: A standing arm circle against a wall that mobilises the shoulders while keeping your back from compensating.
steps: Stand with your back flat against a wall, feet slightly forward.
Start with arms straight down at your sides, palms forward.
Sweep your arms out to the sides and overhead in a wide arc, staying close to the wall.
Lower them back down the same way.
Keep your ribs and head against the wall.

items.name: 徒手站姿肩胛外旋
items.description: A standing drill that rotates the arms outward while drawing the shoulder blades back. It wakes up the rotator cuff and upper back.
steps: Stand tall with your elbows bent at your sides.
Keep your palms facing forward.
Rotate your forearms outward and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Hold for a second.
Return slowly to the start.
Keep your ribs down and your shoulders away from your ears.

items.name: 战绳
items.description: Wave the heavy ropes rhythmically to raise heart rate and challenge the shoulders and arms.
steps: 站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，膝盖稍微弯曲。
双手握住绳子的一端，手掌相对。
将手臂举至肩膀高度，保持肘部稍微弯曲。
快速抬起和放下每只手臂，开始用绳索产生交替的波浪。
继续所需的持续时间或重复次数。

items.name: 战绳侧举
items.description: Raising battling ropes out to the side with a fast, wave-making motion. Boosts shoulder endurance and heart rate.
steps: Stand in a slight squat holding a rope end in each hand.
Keep your core braced and elbows soft.
Raise both arms out to the sides to about shoulder height in a quick, controlled motion.
Lower and repeat at a steady fast pace.
Work in intervals of 20-30 seconds.

items.name: 战绳向内绕圈
items.description: Drawing circles with the ropes toward each other. It builds shoulder endurance.
steps: Stand with knees bent and a rope end in each hand.
Move your arms in circles that turn inward.
Keep the circles even and large.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Continue for a set time then rest.

items.name: 战绳向外绕圈
items.description: Drawing outward circles with the ropes, training shoulders and conditioning.
steps: Stand with knees bent and a rope end in each hand.
Move your arms in circles that turn outward.
Keep the movement smooth and even.
Keep your core tight.
Continue for a set time.

items.name: 战绳左右甩臂
items.nameEn: battling ropes side to side arms
items.description: Swinging the ropes from side to side to condition your shoulders and trunk.
steps: Hold the rope ends in an athletic stance with knees bent.
Swing both ropes to one side.
Swing them across to the other side in a flowing motion.
Rotate through your torso a little.
Keep a steady rhythm for the set time.

items.name: 战绳飞鸟
items.description: Sweeping the ropes out and in like a fly, hitting the shoulders and upper body.
steps: Stand with knees bent, a rope end in each hand and arms in front.
Sweep your arms out wide and slightly up.
Bring them back together in front of you.
Keep a steady rhythm.
Continue for a set time.

items.name: 战绳高波浪
items.description: Big overhead wave style rope slams that fire up the shoulders and heart.
steps: Stand with feet shoulder width apart and a rope end in each hand.
Bend your knees slightly.
Raise both arms overhead and slam the ropes down.
Repeat quickly to make big waves.
Keep your core braced for the set time.

items.name: 手臂上举旋转肌拉伸
items.description: An overhead stretch for the rotator cuff and back of the arm.
steps: Raise one arm overhead and bend the elbow, palm resting on your upper back.
Use your other hand to hold the elbow.
Gently press the elbow back and down.
Keep your ribs down and chest open.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

items.name: 手臂下垂旋转肌拉伸
items.description: A stretch for the rotator cuff with the arm held low behind the body.
steps: Stand tall and place one arm behind your back, bent at the elbow.
Hold the wrist with the other hand.
Gently draw the hand away from your body and slightly up.
Keep your shoulders relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

items.name: 手臂绕圈
items.description: Draw circles with straight arms to warm up the shoulders. It loosens the shoulder joints.
steps: Stand tall with arms out to the sides.
Make small circles forward.
Increase to larger circles.
Reverse the direction.
Keep your shoulders relaxed.

items.name: 手臂绕环
items.description: A simple warm-up that loosens the shoulder joints by moving the arms in circles.
steps: Stand tall with your arms out to the sides at shoulder height.
Make small circles forward.
Gradually make the circles larger.
Do 10 to 15 circles, then reverse direction.
Keep your shoulders relaxed.
Breathe normally.

items.name: 拳击刺拳
items.description: A quick straight punch with the lead hand, used to build speed, shoulder endurance and timing.
steps: Stand in a boxing stance with your lead foot forward and hands up by your chin.
Extend your lead hand straight toward the target.
Rotate your fist so the palm faces down as it lands.
Keep your chin tucked and your rear hand guarding.
Snap the hand back to the guard quickly.
Repeat, then switch stance if you want.

items.name: 拳击刺拳(打沙袋)
items.description: A quick straight punch with your lead hand thrown at a heavy bag.
steps: Stand in a boxing stance facing the bag with your hands up.
Extend your lead hand straight toward the bag.
Rotate your fist so the palm faces down on impact.
Keep your rear hand guarding your chin.
Snap the punch back to your guard right away.
Stay light on your feet and repeat.

items.name: 拳击刺拳(搭档)
items.description: A straight lead-hand punch thrown at a partner holding pads, working speed and accuracy.
steps: Face your partner, who holds a pad at head height.
Stand in a boxing stance with hands up.
Throw your lead hand straight to the pad.
Rotate your fist so the palm faces down.
Retract your hand quickly to your guard.
Keep your feet light and repeat.

items.name: 拳击右上勾拳
items.description: A rising punch with the right hand aimed upward, using leg drive and a hip turn.
steps: Stand in a boxing stance with hands up.
Bend your knees slightly and dip your right side.
Drive up through your legs as you rotate your hips.
Throw your right fist upward with the palm facing you.
Keep your left hand guarding your chin.
Return to stance and repeat.

items.name: 拳击右上勾拳(搭档)
items.description: A rising rear-hand punch thrown to a partner's pad, driven by the legs and hips.
steps: Face your partner, who holds a pad low in front of them.
Stand in a boxing stance and bend your knees slightly.
Drive up through your legs and rotate your hips.
Bring your right fist up in a tight arc to the pad.
Keep your left hand guarding.
Reset your stance.

items.name: 拳击右勾拳(打沙袋)
items.description: A curved punch thrown from the rear hand, rotating the torso to hit the side of the bag.
steps: Stand in a boxing stance facing the bag.
Bend your right elbow to about 90 degrees.
Rotate your hips and torso to swing the fist in an arc.
Pivot your rear foot as you turn.
Hit the bag and keep your left hand guarding.
Return to your guard and repeat.

items.name: 拳击右勾拳(搭档)
items.description: A curved rear-hand punch thrown to a partner's pad, using torso rotation for power.
steps: Face your partner, who holds a pad out to the side.
Stand in a boxing stance with hands up.
Bend your right elbow and rotate your hips and torso.
Swing the fist in an arc into the pad.
Pivot your rear foot as you turn.
Return to your guard.

items.name: 拳击右直拳
items.description: A powerful straight punch with the rear hand, driven by a turn of the hips and back foot.
steps: Stand in a boxing stance with hands up.
Push off the back foot and rotate your hips and shoulders.
Throw your rear hand straight toward the target.
Keep your lead hand up to protect your chin.
Pull the hand back along the same line.
Return to your stance and repeat.

items.name: 拳击右直拳(打沙袋)
items.description: A powerful straight punch from the rear hand, driven by the hips and thrown at a bag.
steps: Stand in a boxing stance facing the bag.
Rotate your rear foot and hips as you throw the right hand.
Drive your fist straight to the bag.
Rotate your shoulder and keep your chin tucked.
Keep your lead hand up to guard.
Snap back to your stance and repeat.

items.name: 拳击右直拳(搭档)
items.description: A straight rear-hand punch with hip rotation, thrown to a partner's pad.
steps: Face your partner, who holds a pad at head height.
Stand in a boxing stance with hands up.
Rotate your rear foot and hips as you throw the right hand.
Drive your fist straight to the pad.
Keep your chin tucked and left hand up.
Snap back to your stance.

items.name: 拳击左上勾拳
items.description: A rising punch with the left hand, thrown upward from the hips and legs.
steps: Stand in a boxing stance with hands up.
Bend your knees slightly and dip your left side.
Drive up through your legs as you rotate your hips.
Throw your left fist upward with the palm facing you.
Keep your right hand guarding your chin.
Return to stance and repeat.

items.name: 拳击左上勾拳(搭档)
items.description: A rising punch with the left hand thrown to a partner's pad, using leg and hip drive.
steps: Face your partner, who holds a pad low in front of them.
Stand in a boxing stance and bend your knees slightly.
Dip slightly and drive up through your legs.
Rotate your hips as you bring your left fist up in a tight arc.
Hit the pad with the palm facing you.
Reset your guard.

items.name: 拳击格挡
items.description: A defensive boxing guard that covers your head and body from incoming punches.
steps: Stand in a boxing stance with feet staggered and knees slightly bent.
Bring your fists up to your cheeks with elbows tucked in.
Keep your chin down.
Raise your forearms to cover your face as if blocking a punch.
Bring your elbows together to cover your ribs.
Reset to your guard and repeat.

items.name: 掌心向上掌心向下旋转
items.description: Hold your arms out and rotate your palms up and down. A simple warm-up for the shoulders and forearms.
steps: Stand tall and raise your arms out to your sides at shoulder height.
Turn your palms up so your thumbs point back.
Rotate them down so your thumbs point forward.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your arms level.
Repeat smoothly for 10-15 rotations.

items.name: 摆动式倒立俯卧撑
items.description: Use a leg kick to help drive yourself up from a handstand push-up. It lets you handle more reps and volume overhead.
steps: Kick up into a handstand against a wall.
Lower your head toward the floor under control.
Bend your hips and knees slightly, then drive them back out as you press.
Press up to lockout.
Keep your core tight and move carefully.

items.name: 支撑头倒立瑜伽体式
items.description: An inversion where your forearms and head share the load, building shoulder strength and balance.
steps: Kneel and place your forearms on the mat with your fingers interlaced.
Set the crown of your head lightly on the floor against your hands.
Lift your knees and walk your feet toward your face.
Lift your legs slowly, using your core, until they point to the ceiling.
Keep most of the weight in your forearms and shoulders.
Hold briefly, then lower with control and rest in child's pose.

items.name: 旋转肩部拉伸
items.description: A gentle rotation stretch for the shoulder joint.
steps: Stand tall and bend one elbow to 90 degrees at your side.
Slowly rotate your forearm outward or inward, using the other hand to assist, until you feel the shoulder stretch.
Keep your elbow tucked in close to your body.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

items.name: 木棍仰卧前平举
items.description: Lying on your back, raise a light stick from your hips to overhead. It helps shoulder mobility.
steps: Lie on your back holding a stick with an overhand grip.
Keep your arms straight.
Raise the stick overhead as far as is comfortable.
Return to your thighs slowly.
Keep your ribs down throughout.

items.name: 木棍背后外展肩部灵活性练习
items.nameEn: stick shoulder mobilization in abduction behind back
items.description: Using a stick to guide the arm out and back behind you. It improves shoulder range.
steps: Stand tall holding a stick behind your back.
Hold it with one hand low and the other high.
Use the low hand to guide the top arm out and up.
Move only in a comfortable range.
Return slowly and switch sides.

items.name: 木棍过头肩旋转
items.description: Passing a stick overhead and around the body. It opens up the shoulders.
steps: Hold a stick with a wide grip in front of your thighs.
Raise it overhead with straight arms.
Continue the arc behind your back as far as comfortable.
Return along the same path.
Narrow your grip over time.

items.name: 木棒站姿前平举
items.description: Raising a stick in front of you with straight arms warms up the shoulders. It is a light, controlled drill.
steps: Stand tall holding a stick at your thighs with an overhand grip.
Keep your arms straight.
Raise the stick in front of you to shoulder height or above.
Keep your ribs down and your core tight.
Lower slowly to the start.
Repeat for smooth reps.

items.name: 木棒站姿肩部后伸活动度练习
items.nameEn: stick standing shoulder mobilization in extension
items.description: Holding a stick behind your back, you lift it away to open the front of the shoulders. It improves shoulder extension.
steps: Stand tall holding a stick behind your back with an overhand grip.
Keep your arms straight.
Lift the stick back and away from your body.
Stay tall and avoid leaning forward.
Hold for a moment.
Lower slowly and repeat.

items.name: 木棒站姿肩部外旋活动度练习
items.nameEn: stick standing shoulder mobilization in external rotation
items.description: Using a stick to guide the arm, you rotate the shoulder outward. It improves external rotation range.
steps: Stand holding a stick with both hands, elbows tucked at your sides and bent.
Push the stick with the stronger hand to rotate the other arm outward.
Keep your elbow glued to your side.
Move only as far as is comfortable.
Return to the start slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

items.name: 木棒肩部外展活动度练习
items.description: Using a stick, you guide one arm out and up to the side. It opens up shoulder range overhead.
steps: Hold a stick with both hands in front of you.
Keep one arm relaxed and guide it with the other.
Raise the stick sideways and up.
Keep your torso upright.
Pause at the top.
Lower and switch sides.

items.name: 棍棒环绕传递拉伸
items.description: Swinging a stick from front to back in a wide arc to open up the shoulders. A classic warm-up for shoulder mobility.
steps: Stand tall and hold the stick in front of you with a wide overhand grip.
Keep your arms straight and raise the stick overhead.
Carry it back behind your body in a smooth arc.
Return the same way to the start.
Repeat for 8-10 slow passes and narrow your grip as you get more flexible.

items.name: 棍棒肩部拉伸
items.description: Stretches the front of your shoulders and chest using a stick for leverage. Helps with posture and overhead reach.
steps: Stand tall and hold the stick behind your back with both hands.
Keep your arms straight and lift the stick slightly away from your body.
Stay tall and avoid arching your lower back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release slowly and repeat.

items.name: 椅上坐姿反握手臂画圈
items.nameEn: seated underhand arm circle on a chair
items.description: A seated arm circle with palms up to warm up the shoulder joints.
steps: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Extend your arms out to the sides with palms facing up.
Draw small circles, then gradually bigger.
Reverse the direction after a set.

items.name: 椅上坐姿外旋
items.nameEn: seated external rotation on a chair
items.description: A seated rotation drill for the back of the shoulders and rotator cuff.
steps: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Tuck your elbows at your sides bent to 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearms outward, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Return slowly and repeat.

items.name: 椅上坐姿旋转拳击滚动
items.nameEn: seated rotating boxing rolls on a chair
items.description: A seated drill of circular arm rolls and trunk rotation that lifts your heart rate.
steps: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Raise your fists in a boxing guard.
Roll your arms in circles while rotating your trunk side to side.
Keep a quick, rhythmic pace.

items.name: 椅上坐姿游泳式
items.description: A seated move where your arms alternate in a swimming motion. A gentle shoulder warm-up for any time.
steps: Sit upright near the edge of a chair.
Lean forward slightly with a flat back.
Reach one arm forward and the other back, then alternate.
Move in a steady rhythm.
Keep your core braced.

items.name: 椅上坐姿点肩
items.nameEn: seated shoulder tap on a chair
items.description: A seated drill where you tap each shoulder with the opposite hand, adding light coordination and shoulder work.
steps: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Reach one hand across to tap the opposite shoulder.
Return and tap with the other hand.
Keep the pace steady.

items.name: 椅上坐姿肩部推举
items.nameEn: seated shoulder press on a chair
items.description: A seated overhead press without equipment that trains the shoulders and triceps.
steps: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Raise your hands to shoulder height with elbows bent.
Press them overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower back to your shoulders under control.

items.name: 毛巾侧平举
items.description: A no-equipment side raise using a towel for resistance, so you can train the delts at home.
steps: Hold a towel with both hands and stand on its middle with one foot, or pull its ends apart.
Keep your elbows slightly bent.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Lower slowly.
Keep tension on the towel throughout.

items.name: 派克俯卧撑
items.description: A push-up with hips lifted high so you press more overhead. It builds shoulder strength using only your body weight.
steps: Start in a push-up position, then walk your feet in and lift your hips into an inverted V.
Keep your arms and back straight.
Bend your elbows and lower the top of your head toward the floor.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your core tight throughout.

items.name: 海豚式
items.description: A yoga inverted V on your forearms. It stretches the shoulders and hamstrings and builds shoulder strength.
steps: Start on hands and knees, then lower to your forearms.
Tuck your toes and lift your hips up high.
Press your forearms into the floor.
Let your head hang between your arms.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.

items.name: 牛面式瑜伽体式
items.description: A seated pose that stretches the shoulders, triceps and hips together.
steps: Sit with one knee stacked over the other and your feet beside your hips.
Reach one arm up and bend the elbow, hand down your back.
Sweep the other arm behind you and try to clasp your fingers.
Keep your spine tall and your chest open.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Switch sides and repeat.

items.name: 环绕肩部拉伸
items.description: Wrapping one arm across your body and hooking it with the other stretches the back of the shoulder and upper back.
steps: Stand tall and bring one arm across your chest at shoulder height.
Hook it with your other forearm and pull it gently closer to your chest.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

items.name: 睡姿肩部拉伸
items.description: A side-lying stretch that opens up the back of the shoulder. Handy for keeping internal rotation smooth.
steps: Lie on your side with the bottom arm in front of you, elbow bent to 90 degrees.
Keep your shoulder stacked and the upper arm at chest height.
Use your top hand to gently press the bottom forearm toward the floor.
Stop where you feel a mild stretch at the back of the shoulder.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

items.name: 祈祷式推
items.description: Pressing your palms together in front of your chest. It activates the chest and shoulders without any equipment.
steps: Stand or sit tall and press your palms together at chest height.
Point your fingers up and keep your elbows out.
Push your palms firmly into each other.
Hold the squeeze for 5-10 seconds.
Relax and shake out your arms.
Repeat for several rounds.

items.name: 站姿T字上举
items.description: Lift your arms out to the sides into a T shape to train the upper back and rear shoulders.
steps: Stand tall with arms in front of you at chest height.
Open your arms out to the sides into a T.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Pause, then return slowly.
Keep your ribs down and avoid leaning back.

items.name: 站姿W字上举
items.description: Pull your elbows back into a W shape to strengthen the mid-back and rotator cuff.
steps: Stand tall with elbows bent and hands in front of your chest.
Pull your elbows back and down, forming a W.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together and rotate your hands outward.
Pause briefly.
Return slowly and repeat.

items.name: 站姿Y字上举
items.description: Raise your arms into a Y shape to strengthen the lower traps and shoulder stabilisers.
steps: Stand tall with arms by your sides, thumbs pointing up.
Raise both arms diagonally overhead to form a Y.
Squeeze your shoulder blades down and back.
Pause briefly, then lower slowly.
Keep your neck long and avoid shrugging.

items.name: 站姿交替单臂绕环
items.description: Big alternating arm circles that warm up the shoulder joints and loosen the upper back before pressing or pulling work.
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and arms hanging at your sides.
Swing one arm forward, up and back in a large smooth circle.
As that arm finishes, start the same circle with the other arm.
Keep your ribs down and your neck relaxed.
Continue alternating for 20-30 seconds, then reverse the direction.

items.name: 站姿单臂绕环
items.description: One-arm circles to warm up the shoulder joint.
steps: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart.
Extend one arm out to the side.
Make slow circles, gradually larger.
Reverse the direction.
Switch arms.

items.name: 站姿双臂绕环
items.description: Big arm circles with both arms to warm up the shoulders.
steps: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart.
Extend both arms out to the sides.
Make slow circles forward.
Then reverse direction.
Keep your shoulders relaxed.

items.name: 站姿反向肩部拉伸
items.description: Standing with your hands clasped behind you to open the front of the shoulders.
steps: Stand tall and clasp your hands behind your back.
Straighten your arms and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lift your hands slightly away from your body.
Keep your chest up and avoid arching your lower back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then release.

items.name: 站姿旋后面拉(毛巾)
items.description: A face pull using a towel looped around a fixed anchor and an underhand grip. A simple way to train the rear delts without a cable.
steps: Loop a towel around a sturdy anchor and hold both ends, palms up.
Lean back with your arms extended.
Pull your hands toward your face, elbows wide.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower yourself slowly. Walk your feet in to make it harder.

items.name: 站姿甩臂
items.description: Open and close your arms in a relaxed fling to loosen the chest and shoulders. Handy as a quick warm-up.
steps: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart and arms out in front at chest height.
Fling both arms wide open to the sides, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Swing them back across your body, letting one arm cross over the other.
Keep the motion loose and controlled, without arching your back.
Repeat for 15-20 swings.

items.name: 站姿等长肩外旋(用毛巾)
items.nameEn: standing isometric shoulder external rotation with towel
items.description: Press the back of your hand into a towel on a wall while standing. It trains the rotator cuff without moving the joint.
steps: Stand next to a wall with a towel between the back of your hand and the wall.
Bend your elbow to 90 degrees, tucked at your side.
Press your hand outward into the towel.
Hold the effort for 10 to 20 seconds.
Relax, then switch sides.

items.name: 站姿肩部绕环
items.description: Circle your shoulders to loosen the joint and ease tension in the upper back.
steps: Stand tall with arms relaxed at your sides.
Lift your shoulders up and roll them back in a large circle.
Keep your neck relaxed.
Do 10 circles, then reverse the direction.

items.name: 站姿菲尔普斯
items.description: Swim-style arm swings that loosen the shoulders and chest as a warm-up.
steps: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart.
Swing both arms forward and up in big arcs.
Swing them back down past your hips behind you.
Keep the movement loose and rhythmic.
Continue for 20-30 seconds.

items.name: 站姿靠墙肩内旋等长收缩
items.nameEn: standing isometric shoulder internal rotation against wall
items.description: An isometric hold pressing the inner forearm into a wall to work the shoulder rotators. There is no movement, only steady tension.
steps: Stand sideways to a wall with your elbow bent to 90 degrees and tucked at your side.
Place the inside of your fist or forearm against the wall.
Press into the wall as if rotating your arm inward.
Hold the contraction for 5-10 seconds.
Relax and rest briefly.
Keep your elbow at your side, then switch arms.

items.name: 站姿靠墙肩旋转
items.description: Rotating the shoulder against a wall. It gives gentle mobility and awareness.
steps: Stand facing a wall and place your forearm against it.
Bend your elbow to 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm up and down against the wall.
Keep your shoulder relaxed.
Switch arms after your reps.

items.name: 站直肩部拉伸
items.description: A tall standing stretch that opens the shoulders and chest.
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Clasp your hands behind your back.
Straighten your arms and lift them gently away from your body.
Keep your chest open and your neck relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.

items.name: 肘外展旋转肌拉伸
items.description: A stretch for the rotator cuff with the elbow lifted out to the side.
steps: Stand tall and lift one elbow out to the side, hand behind your head.
Hold the elbow with your other hand.
Gently press the elbow back and slightly down.
Feel the stretch in the shoulder.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

items.name: 肘支撑planche
items.description: A planche hold with your elbows tucked into your waist. It is an early step toward a full planche.
steps: Place your hands on the floor and tuck your elbows into your waist.
Lean forward over your hands.
Lift your feet off the floor one at a time.
Hold your body level with a tight core.
Keep your shoulders pressed forward.
Lower down after the hold.

items.name: 肘臂绕圈
items.description: A shoulder warm-up where you draw circles with your elbows. It loosens the joint and prepares it for training.
steps: Stand tall with your fingertips on your shoulders.
Raise your elbows out to the sides.
Draw big circles with your elbows.
Do several circles forward.
Reverse and circle backward.
Keep your neck relaxed and your breathing steady.

items.name: 肩伸展
items.description: Moving the arm back behind the body, working the lats and rear shoulder.
steps: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall with your arm straight down at your side.
Swing the arm back behind you, keeping it straight.
Avoid leaning forward, pause, then return to the start.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

items.name: 肩伸肌内收肌和回缩肌拉伸
items.nameEn: shoulder extensor adductor and retractor stretch
items.description: A stretch for the back of the shoulder and the muscles between the shoulder blades.
steps: Stand tall and extend one arm behind you.
Reach across to grab it with the other hand.
Draw the arm gently back and across the body.
Keep your chest open and your shoulders down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

items.name: 肩内收
items.description: Bringing the arm down toward the body from the side, working the lats and chest.
steps: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall with one arm raised out to the side at shoulder height.
Pull the arm down toward your side with control.
Keep your torso still and finish with the arm next to your body.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

items.name: 肩内收肌上提肌和前伸肌拉伸
items.nameEn: shoulder adductor elevator and protractor stretch
items.description: A cross body stretch that loosens the back of the shoulder and the muscles between the shoulder blades.
steps: Stand or sit tall and bring one arm across your chest.
Use the opposite hand to press the arm toward you until the shoulder and upper back stretch.
Keep your shoulders down away from your ears.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

items.name: 肩内收肌前伸肌和上提肌拉伸
items.nameEn: shoulder adductor protractor and elevator stretch
items.description: A stretch for the back of the shoulder and the muscles along the upper back.
steps: Stand tall and bring one arm across your chest.
Hold it with the other arm just above the elbow.
Gently pull while rounding the upper back slightly forward.
Keep your neck relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

items.name: 肩内旋
items.description: Rotating the upper arm inward, working the muscles that turn the shoulder in.
steps: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand with your elbow at your side bent at 90 degrees, forearm pointing forward.
Rotate your forearm inward across your stomach, keeping the elbow tucked in.
Pause briefly, then return slowly.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

items.name: 肩内旋拉伸
items.description: A stretch that eases the shoulder into inward rotation.
steps: Stand tall and place one hand behind your lower back with the elbow bent.
Use the other hand or a towel to gently draw the hand up your back until the back of the shoulder stretches.
Keep your shoulders level and do not twist.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

items.name: 肩内旋测试
items.description: A simple check of how far your shoulder turns inward, handy for spotting tightness before you train.
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Reach one arm behind your back with the palm facing out.
Slide your hand slowly up your spine as far as is comfortable.
Note how high your thumb reaches, keeping your chest open.
Lower the arm, then repeat with the other side to compare.

items.name: 肩外展
items.description: Raising the arm out to the side, working the side of the shoulder.
steps: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall with your arms at your sides.
Raise one arm out to the side up to about shoulder height.
Lower slowly without shrugging.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

items.name: 肩外旋
items.description: Rotating the upper arm outward, which works the rotator cuff muscles at the back of the shoulder.
steps: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand with your elbow at your side bent at 90 degrees, forearm pointing forward.
Rotate your forearm outward, keeping the elbow tucked against your side.
Pause briefly, then return slowly.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

items.name: 肩外旋拉伸
items.description: A stretch that eases the shoulder into outward rotation.
steps: Stand next to a doorframe and bend your elbow to 90 degrees with your forearm on the frame.
Slowly turn your body away from the arm until you feel the front of the shoulder stretch.
Keep your elbow level with your shoulder.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

items.name: 肩外旋测试
items.description: A simple check of how far the shoulder turns outward. Move slowly and stay in a pain-free range.
steps: Stand or lie with your elbow bent 90 degrees and tucked at your side.
Keep your elbow against your body.
Rotate your forearm outward slowly.
Stop where you feel a stretch or end of range.
Note how far each side goes.
Repeat on the other arm.

items.name: 肩屈曲
items.description: Raising the arm forward and up in front of the body, working the front of the shoulder.
steps: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall with your arms at your sides, palms facing in.
Raise one arm forward and up to about shoulder height or higher.
Keep your ribs down, then lower slowly.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

items.name: 肩水平伸展
items.description: Drawing the arm back in a horizontal plane, working the rear shoulder and upper back.
steps: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall with your arm held in front at shoulder height.
Pull the arm back and out to the side, keeping it level.
Squeeze your shoulder blade lightly, then return slowly.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

items.name: 肩水平内收
items.description: Moving the arm forward and across the body in a horizontal arc, working the chest.
steps: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall with one arm held out to the side at shoulder height.
Sweep the arm forward and across your body in a horizontal arc.
Keep the arm at shoulder height, pause, then return.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

items.name: 肩水平外展
items.description: Moving the arm backward in a horizontal arc, working the rear delts and upper back.
steps: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall with one arm held out in front at shoulder height.
Sweep the arm out and back in a horizontal arc as far as is comfortable.
Keep the arm at shoulder height, pause, then return.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

items.name: 肩水平屈曲
items.description: Bringing the arm forward in a horizontal plane, working the chest and front shoulder.
steps: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall with your arm held out to the side at shoulder height.
Bring the arm forward in front of your chest, keeping it level.
Pause briefly, then return slowly to the side.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

items.name: 肩水平测试
items.description: A quick posture check to see whether one shoulder sits higher than the other.
steps: Stand relaxed with your feet hip-width apart and arms hanging loose.
Look straight ahead and let your shoulders settle naturally.
Check in a mirror, or ask a friend, whether both shoulders are at the same height.
Roll the shoulders once and re-check without shrugging.
Note any difference and repeat now and then to track it.

items.name: 肩袖拉伸
items.description: A stretch aimed at the small stabilizing muscles around the shoulder joint.
steps: Stand tall and bring one arm across your body at chest height.
Hold the arm just above the elbow with the other hand and draw it in until the back of the shoulder stretches.
Keep the shoulder blade down and relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

items.name: 肩部内旋松动
items.description: A gentle shoulder mobility drill that trains internal rotation.
steps: Stand or sit tall with one elbow bent to 90 degrees at your side.
Rotate your forearm across your belly.
Move slowly through a comfortable range.
Return to the start and repeat 8-12 times.
Switch arms.

items.name: 肩部前推松动
items.description: A shoulder mobility drill pressing the arm forward to warm up the joint.
steps: Stand tall with your elbows bent in front of you.
Press your arm forward until it is straight.
Keep your shoulder relaxed.
Return slowly and repeat 8-12 times.
Switch arms.

items.name: 肩部后弯拉伸
items.description: A gentle backbend stretch that opens the shoulders and chest.
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Clasp your hands behind your back.
Lift your arms up behind you and open your chest.
Tilt back slightly if comfortable.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release slowly.

items.name: 肩部后推松动
items.description: A shoulder mobility drill moving the arm backward to open the front of the shoulder.
steps: Stand tall with your arms at your sides.
Press one arm backward, keeping the elbow straight.
Move through a comfortable range.
Return slowly and repeat 8-12 times.
Switch arms.

items.name: 肩部外推松动
items.description: A gentle shoulder mobility drill pressing outward to warm up the joint.
steps: Stand tall with your elbow bent at your side.
Press your forearm outward away from your body.
Hold for a moment at the end of your comfortable range.
Return slowly and repeat 8-12 times.
Switch arms.

items.name: 肩部外旋松动
items.description: A gentle shoulder mobility drill for external rotation.
steps: Stand tall with your elbow bent to 90 degrees at your side.
Rotate your forearm outward away from your belly.
Keep your elbow tucked in.
Return slowly and repeat 8-12 times.
Switch arms.

items.name: 背后手臂内收拉伸
items.nameEn: adduction of arm in back stretch
items.description: Reaching one arm behind your back and pulling it across to stretch the shoulder.
steps: Stand or sit tall.
Reach one arm behind your back.
Grab that wrist with the other hand and gently pull it across your body.
Keep your shoulders level.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

items.name: 背后毛巾肩部拉伸
items.nameEn: shoulder stretch behind the back with towel
items.description: A towel stretch behind the back that opens the shoulder.
steps: Hold a towel with one hand over your shoulder and the other behind your lower back.
Gently pull the towel upward with the lower hand.
Keep your chest open and neck relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.

items.name: 背后毛巾肩部拉伸
items.nameEn: shoulder stretch with towel behind the back
items.description: Using a towel behind the back to ease the shoulders into a deeper stretch.
steps: Hold a towel in one hand and raise that arm overhead, bending the elbow.
Reach the other hand up from behind your back and grab the towel.
Gently pull the towel down with the lower hand.
Keep your head upright.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

items.name: 背后肩部拉伸
items.description: A simple stretch that opens the front of the shoulders and chest by clasping the hands behind you.
steps: Stand tall and clasp your hands behind your back.
Straighten your arms and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lift your hands gently away from your body until you feel a stretch.
Keep your chest open and avoid arching your lower back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing steadily, then release slowly.

items.name: 背靠墙肩屈曲
items.description: Raising your arms overhead while your back stays against a wall. It improves shoulder mobility and posture.
steps: Stand with your back, head and hips against a wall.
Keep your arms at your sides with elbows straight.
Raise your arms forward and up overhead as far as you can without arching your back.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

items.name: 胸前交叉肩部拉伸
items.description: A classic cross-body stretch for the back of the shoulder.
steps: Stand tall and bring one arm straight across your chest.
Use your other forearm to press the arm gently toward your body.
Keep the shoulder relaxed and down.
Feel the stretch in the back of the shoulder.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

items.name: 螃蟹式
items.description: Seated backbend with hips lifted, like an upside down table. It opens the chest, shoulders and front of the hips.
steps: Sit with knees bent and hands behind you, fingers pointing toward your feet.
Press into your hands and feet.
Lift your hips until your torso is flat.
Let your head relax back gently.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.

items.name: 跪姿单臂体前交叉拉伸
items.nameEn: kneeling one arm cross body stretch
items.description: A kneeling stretch where you reach one arm across the body to open the back of the shoulder.
steps: Kneel on a mat and slide one arm across the floor in front of you, palm down.
Sink your chest toward the floor and keep reaching until the shoulder and upper back stretch.
Keep your hips over your knees.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

items.name: 过头击掌
items.description: Reaching your arms overhead and clapping to warm up the shoulders. It improves shoulder mobility and activation.
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and arms at your sides.
Raise both arms out to the sides and overhead.
Clap your hands above your head.
Lower your arms back to your sides with control.
Keep your ribs down and move smoothly through your reps.

items.name: 靠墙下犬式俯卧撑
items.nameEn: downward dog push up against wall
items.description: A wall-assisted version of a downward dog push-up with a push off at the top. It trains the shoulders in a bent-hip position.
steps: Stand facing a wall and place your hands on it with hips back.
Lower your head toward the wall, bending the elbows.
Push explosively away from the wall.
Land softly back into the start position.
Keep your core braced and back flat.

items.name: 靠墙交替肩屈曲
items.nameEn: alternate shoulder flexion back to wall
items.description: A wall-supported drill to improve overhead reach, one arm at a time, while keeping the back flat against the wall.
steps: Stand with your back, head and hips against a wall.
Keep your ribs down and your lower back near the wall.
Raise one arm forward and overhead as far as you can without arching.
Lower it with control.
Alternate arms for the set.

items.name: 靠墙倒立保持
items.description: A wall-supported handstand held in place, building shoulder strength, balance and body control.
steps: Place your hands on the floor a short distance from a wall.
Kick up carefully until your heels rest on the wall.
Push the floor away and keep your arms straight.
Tighten your core and glutes.
Hold for 15-30 seconds, then come down with control.

items.name: 靠墙倒立肩推(凳间)
items.nameEn: handstand shoulder press with wall (between benches)
items.description: A wall-supported handstand press between two benches for strong shoulders and triceps.
steps: Place your hands on two benches and kick up into a handstand with your heels against the wall.
Brace your core and keep your body straight.
Lower your head between the benches by bending your elbows.
Press back up to straight arms.
Keep the movement controlled.
Come down carefully when done.

items.name: 靠墙倒立转屈体planche离心
items.nameEn: wall assisted handstand to tuck planche negative
items.description: Lowering from a wall handstand into a tuck planche. It builds advanced shoulder strength.
steps: Kick up into a handstand with your heels on the wall.
Brace your core and keep your arms straight.
Slowly lower your body forward.
Tuck your knees as you reach the planche position.
Control the descent and then reset.

items.name: 靠墙爬行
items.description: Walk your feet up a wall into a handstand-like position, then walk back down. It builds shoulder strength and trunk control.
steps: Lie face down with your feet against a wall.
Place your hands beside your chest and push up into a plank.
Walk your feet up the wall as your hands walk toward it.
Stop where you can keep your body straight and braced.
Walk back down slowly with control.

items.name: 面墙单腿分腿倒立保持
items.nameEn: wall facing single leg split handstand hold
items.description: A wall-facing handstand with one leg split off the wall. It trains balance and shoulder endurance.
steps: Kick up into a handstand facing the wall.
Keep your arms straight and push the floor away.
Lift one leg off the wall.
Hold for 10-20 seconds with control.
Return the leg and come down safely.

items.name: 三凳臂屈伸
items.description: A bench dip with hands on the bench edge and body hanging off the front. A classic bodyweight move for the triceps.
steps: 坐在长凳上，双手抓住边缘，手指指向前方。
将臀部滑离长凳，用手支撑体重。
弯曲肘部并降低身体，直到上臂与地面平行。
将自己推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 三头肌拉伸
items.description: An overhead stretch for the back of the upper arm, pulling the elbow toward the head. It loosens the triceps and shoulders.
steps: 站立或坐直，背部挺直。
将一只手臂伸过头顶，肘部弯曲。
将另一只手放在弯曲的肘部上，然后轻轻地将其拉向头部。
保持拉伸 15-30 秒，感受三头肌的轻微拉伸。
松开拉伸并在另一只手臂上重复。

items.name: 三头肌推举
items.description: A bodyweight triceps press that lowers the body by bending the elbows, then presses back up. It works the triceps.
steps: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，膝盖稍微弯曲。
将双臂伸直在身前，与地面平行。
弯曲肘部，将身体放低至地面，保持上臂靠近身体两侧。
在底部暂停片刻，然后将自己推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 三头肌臂屈伸
items.description: A triceps dip using the edge of a bench or chair, lowering the body and pressing back up. It builds the triceps.
steps: 坐在长凳或椅子的边缘，双手抓住边缘，手指指向前方。
将臀部滑离长凳，用手支撑体重。
弯曲肘部，将身体放低至地面，保持背部靠近长凳。
在底部暂停片刻，然后将自己推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 三头肌臂屈伸(双凳之间)
items.description: A triceps dip with the hands on one bench and the feet on another. It trains the triceps and shoulders.
steps: 坐在长凳上，双手抓住长凳边缘，手指指向前方。
将臀部滑离长凳，用手支撑体重。
弯曲肘部，将身体放低至地面，保持背部靠近长凳。
在底部暂停片刻，然后将自己推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 三头肌臂屈伸(腿放凳上)
items.description: A bench dip with the legs extended on the floor or a bench, lowering and pressing the body up. It trains the triceps.
steps: 坐在长凳边缘，双手抓住边缘，手指指向前方。
双脚向前走，将臀部滑离长凳，然后伸直手臂。
弯曲肘部，将身体放低至地面，保持背部靠近长凳。
推动手掌以伸直手臂并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 三头肌臂屈伸拉伸
items.description: A stretch for the back of the upper arm, taken with the elbow bent overhead.
steps: Stand or sit tall and raise one arm overhead.
Bend the elbow so your hand drops behind your head.
Use your other hand to gently press the elbow back and down.
Keep your ribs down and avoid arching your back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch arms.

items.name: 三腿鳄鱼式
items.description: A low plank with one leg lifted. Adds a balance challenge to the arms and core.
steps: Start in a high plank and lift one leg behind you.
Keep your hips level.
Bend your elbows back and lower.
Hold briefly with your body in line.
Press up, lower the leg and switch.

items.name: 上斜窄距俯卧撑
items.description: An incline push-up with a narrow hand position. It targets the triceps and chest.
steps: 将双手放在较高的表面上，例如长凳或台阶上，双手之间的距离略宽于肩宽。
将双腿伸到身后，放在脚掌上，身体从头到脚跟形成一条直线。
弯曲肘部，使肘部靠近身体两侧，将胸部降低到升高的表面。
在底部暂停片刻，然后伸直手臂将自己推回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 上斜窄距俯卧撑
items.description: A push-up with hands close together on a raised surface. The easier angle keeps the focus on your triceps.
steps: Place your hands close together on a bench or sturdy box, just under your chest.
Step back until your body is straight from head to heels.
Lower your chest toward the edge, elbows tucked close to your ribs.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your hips from sagging throughout.

items.name: 不可能臂屈伸
items.description: An advanced dip on parallel bars with the legs crossed or lifted. It trains the triceps and chest through a tough range.
steps: 将自己定位在两个双杠之间，双臂完全伸展，身体悬浮在空中。
弯曲膝盖并交叉脚踝。
弯曲肘部降低身体，直到上臂与地面平行。
暂停片刻，然后伸直手臂，将自己推回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 二头弯举前踏步
items.description: A rhythm drill pairing an arm curl with a quick step forward. Raises the heart rate while working the arms and legs.
steps: Stand tall with your elbows at your sides and palms up.
Step one foot forward while curling your hands up to your shoulders.
Step back as you lower your arms.
Alternate legs at a brisk, steady pace.
Keep your elbows pinned and your core tight.

items.name: 二头肌引体向上
items.description: A pull-up with an underhand grip. Targets the biceps.
steps: 悬挂在引体向上杆上，手掌背向自己，双手与肩同宽。
启动核心肌群，弯曲肘部将自己拉起，使胸部靠近杠铃。
在动作的最高点暂停，然后慢慢降低回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 二头肌窄握引体向上
items.description: A pull-up with a narrow grip. Emphasises the biceps and lats.
steps: 悬挂在引体向上杆上，手掌朝向自己，双手与肩同宽。
启动你的核心并将自己拉向杠铃，专注于使用二头肌来抬起你的身体。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢降低回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 二头肌腿部集中弯举(离心)
items.description: A seated concentration curl braced against the thigh with a slow lowering phase. It emphasises the biceps through the negative.
steps: Sit with your legs apart and hold a weight in one hand.
Rest the back of your upper arm against your inner thigh.
Curl the weight up with help from your other hand if needed.
Lower it very slowly over about 3 to 4 seconds.
Keep your upper arm still against your leg.
Do your reps, then switch arms.

items.name: 交叉手俯卧撑
items.description: A push-up with your hands crossed under your chest. It puts extra load on the triceps.
steps: Start in a high plank with your hands crossed under your chest.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your chest toward the floor with your elbows close.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Switch which hand is on top each set.

items.name: 仰卧单臂三头肌拉伸
items.description: A floor stretch for the back of your upper arm. Lying down lets you relax into it.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent.
Raise one arm and bend the elbow, hand reaching behind your head.
Use your other hand to press the elbow gently toward the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your ribs down.
Switch arms.

items.name: 侧向俯卧撑
items.description: Lying on your side, you push your body away from the floor with one arm. Works the chest, shoulder and triceps.
steps: 首先侧躺，双腿伸展并叠放在一起。
将下面的手放在肩膀正下方的地面上，手指指向前方。
用下面的手将身体抬离地面，保持双腿伸直，核心肌群参与。
将上臂伸向天花板，形成从头部到脚后跟的直线。
有控制地降低身体回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。

items.name: 倒立
items.description: A balance hold on the hands with the body upside down, usually against a wall to start. It trains the shoulders, triceps and core.
steps: 找到一个有足够空间的空地来进行倒立。
将双手放在地上，与肩同宽，手指指向前方。
将双腿向上踢向墙壁，用核心和肩膀保持平衡。
处于倒立位置后，用三头肌来支撑体重。
只要能保持平衡，就保持倒立。
下降时，慢慢将双腿放回地面。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 倒立俯卧撑
items.description: You press your body upward while inverted against a wall. It builds the shoulders and triceps.
steps: 找到一堵墙，背对墙，站在几英尺远的地方。
将双手放在地面上，与肩同宽，然后将脚踢到墙上，形成倒立姿势。
弯曲肘部，将头低向地面，保持身体呈一条直线。
用手推动并伸展双臂以返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 凳上臂屈伸(屈膝)
items.description: A bench dip with knees bent. A manageable way to train the triceps.
steps: 坐在长凳或椅子的边缘，双手抓住臀部旁边的边缘。
将臀部从长凳上滑下来，在身前伸直双腿，脚后跟保持在地面上。
弯曲肘部，将身体放低至地面，保持背部靠近长凳。
在底部暂停片刻，然后将自己推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 凳上臂屈伸背部手臂(动作检查)
items.description: A side-by-side form check for back and arm position in bench dips, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
steps: Sit on the edge of a bench, grip it beside your hips and slide your butt off.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your back stays close to the bench and your elbows point straight behind you.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

items.name: 前臂俯卧撑
items.description: A push-up with your forearms on the floor instead of your hands. It is tough on the triceps and the core.
steps: 从平板支撑位置开始，前臂放在地面上，肘部位于肩膀正下方。
调动你的核心力量，让你的身体从头到脚保持在一条直线上。
弯曲肘部，使胸部靠近地面，使胸部靠近地面。
在底部暂停片刻，然后将自己推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 单臂臂屈伸
items.description: A dip using one arm on a bench or chair behind you. Works the triceps and shoulders on one side at a time.
steps: 背对长凳或椅子站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
将一只手放在身后的长凳或椅子上，手指指向您的身体。
将双腿向前方伸展，脚跟保持在地面上。
弯曲肘部，将身体放低至地面，使背部靠近长凳或椅子。
在底部停顿片刻，然后用手掌推直手臂，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边并用另一只手臂重复。

items.name: 双杠平板撑臂屈伸
items.description: Dip with a leaning body angle that loads the shoulders and triceps hard.
steps: Support yourself on parallel bars with straight arms.
Lean forward and shift your weight over your hands.
Bend your elbows to lower your body under control.
Keep your core tight and elbows close.
Press back up to straight arms.

items.name: 双杠支撑保持
items.description: Holding the top of a dip on parallel bars. It builds the triceps and shoulder stability.
steps: Grip the parallel bars and press yourself up with straight arms.
Lean slightly forward and lock your shoulders down.
Hold the position with your body still.
Keep your elbows near your sides.
Hold for 15-30 seconds and step down.

items.name: 双腿放凳上凳上臂屈伸
items.nameEn: bench dip with legs on bench
items.description: A harder bench dip with your feet on a second bench. It places greater load on the triceps.
steps: Place your hands on one bench behind you and your heels on another in front.
Straighten your legs and lift your hips.
Bend your elbows to lower your body.
Press back up.
Keep your back close to the bench.

items.name: 反向俯卧撑
items.description: A pushup where your hands are behind you, working the triceps hard.
steps: Sit on the floor and place your hands behind you, fingers pointing toward your hips.
Lift your hips off the floor.
Bend your elbows and lower your hips.
Press back up to straight arms.
Keep your elbows pointing back.

items.name: 反向臂屈伸
items.description: You lower and press your body between parallel bars with your hands behind you. Works the triceps and shoulders.
steps: 将自己定位在两个双杠之间，双臂完全伸展，身体伸直。
弯曲肘部降低身体，直到上臂与地面平行。
暂停片刻，然后伸直手臂，将自己推回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 吊环臂屈伸
items.description: A dip performed on gymnastic rings. The unstable rings train the chest, triceps and shoulder stability.
steps: 首先，将手臂完全伸展，身体伸直，挂在吊环上。
弯曲肘部，降低身体，直到肩膀低于肘部。
伸直手臂，将自己推回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 向下够取三头肌拉伸
items.description: Reaching your hand down your upper back stretches the triceps and the back of the shoulder. A common warm-up and cooldown stretch.
steps: Raise one arm overhead, bend the elbow and drop your hand behind your head.
Use your other hand to press your elbow gently back and down.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

items.name: 四肢支撑式
items.description: A low plank with elbows hugged by your sides. Builds strength in the arms and core.
steps: Start in a high plank.
Shift slightly forward on your toes.
Bend your elbows straight back and lower.
Keep your body straight like a plank.
Hold briefly, then press back up.

items.name: 地面三头肌臂屈伸
items.description: A triceps dip with the hands on a chair behind you and the body lowered toward the floor. It builds the triceps and shoulders.
steps: 坐在椅子或长凳的边缘，双手放在臀部旁边，手指指向前方。
将你的屁股从椅子前面滑下来，双腿伸到你面前。
伸直手臂，保持肘部稍微弯曲，以保持三头肌和肘关节的张力。
慢慢弯曲你的肘部，将你的身体向地板降低，直到你的肘部成大约 90 度角。
一旦到达动作的底部，向下压入椅子以伸直肘部，返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 地面三头肌臂屈伸
items.description: A floor dip with hands behind you and hips lifted. It trains the triceps with just your bodyweight.
steps: Sit on the floor with knees bent and hands behind you.
Lift your hips off the floor.
Bend your elbows to lower your hips.
Push through your palms to straighten your arms.
Keep your elbows pointing back.
Keep your shoulders away from your ears.

items.name: 地面三头肌臂屈伸 v. 2
items.description: A floor dip with hands behind you and hips lifted. It trains the triceps with just your bodyweight.
steps: Sit on the floor with knees bent and hands behind you.
Lift your hips off the floor.
Bend your elbows to lower your hips.
Push through your palms to straighten your arms.
Keep your elbows pointing back.
Keep your shoulders away from your ears.

items.name: 地面凳上臂屈伸
items.description: With your hands on a bench behind you and your feet on the floor, you bend and straighten your elbows. It builds the triceps, chest and shoulders.
steps: 坐在长凳或椅子的边缘，双手抓住边缘，手指指向前方。
将臀部滑离长凳，用手支撑体重。
弯曲肘部降低身体，直到上臂与地板平行。
伸直手臂，将自己推回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 地面凳上臂屈伸 v. 2
items.description: A dip where your hands rest on a bench behind you and your feet stay on the floor. It builds the back of the upper arms.
steps: Sit on the floor with your back to a bench and place your hands on its edge.
Lift your hips and extend your legs slightly in front.
Bend your elbows and lower your body.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your shoulders away from your ears.

items.name: 地面单腿臂屈伸
items.description: A floor dip with one leg raised for extra challenge. It targets the triceps and core balance.
steps: Sit on the floor with hands behind you and knees bent.
Lift your hips and extend one leg out.
Bend your elbows to lower.
Press back up.
Switch legs after your reps.

items.name: 地面椅子臂屈伸
items.description: A seated dip with your hands on a chair behind you.
steps: Sit on the floor with hands on a chair behind you.
Lift your hips off the floor.
Bend your elbows to lower your body.
Keep elbows pointing back.
Press up.
Brace the chair against a wall.

items.name: 坐姿桡神经松动
items.description: A gentle seated nerve glide that moves the radial nerve along the arm.
steps: Sit tall with one arm down at your side, palm facing back.
Lower your shoulder slightly and rotate your arm inward.
Bend your wrist gently and tilt your head away.
Move slowly and stop at a mild pull, never pain.
Repeat 8-10 times, then switch arms.

items.name: 平行杠屈体planche
items.description: A hold on parallettes with knees tucked and hips lifted. It builds shoulder and core strength.
steps: Place your hands on parallettes and squat down.
Lean forward over your hands, arms straight.
Lift your feet with knees tucked toward the chest.
Hold for a few seconds, rounding your upper back slightly.
Lower your feet gently.

items.name: 床单二头弯举
items.description: A bicep curl using a bed sheet and your own opposing arm for resistance.
steps: Hold a bed sheet with both hands, one arm pulling down, the other curling up.
Keep your elbow at your side.
Curl the working hand toward your shoulder against the resistance.
Lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

items.name: 床单头上三头肌伸展
items.nameEn: overhead triceps extension with bed sheet
items.description: A home triceps exercise that uses a bed sheet as resistance.
steps: Hold a bed sheet with both hands behind your head, one hand pulling up, one down.
Keep your elbows pointing forward.
Press your top hand overhead against the resistance.
Return slowly to the start.
Finish your reps, then swap hand positions.

items.name: 徒手侧卧二头弯举
items.description: A bodyweight curl performed while lying on your side. A gentle way to train the biceps without equipment.
steps: 侧躺，双腿伸直，用手臂支撑头部。
将上臂靠在身体两侧，弯曲肘部，将前臂卷向肩膀。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将前臂放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 徒手平板支撑位三头肌伸展
items.nameEn: bodyweight triceps extension from plank position
items.description: From a plank, you bend and straighten your elbows to hinge forward and press back, a tough bodyweight move for the triceps.
steps: Start in a forearm-height plank with your hands under your shoulders.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Lean forward and bend your elbows to lower your head toward your hands.
Press back up by straightening your arms.
Keep your core tight and repeat.

items.name: 徒手站姿二头弯举 v. 2
items.description: A light, no-equipment biceps curl using self-resistance, useful for warming up.
steps: Stand tall with arms at your sides.
Make fists and curl your hands to your shoulders.
Tense your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your elbows pinned.

items.name: 徒手站姿二头肌弯举
items.description: A curl done with your own body resistance, such as pushing one hand against the other. It is a simple way to train the biceps without equipment.
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Place one hand under the wrist of your other hand to give resistance.
