Curl the working hand toward your shoulder while the other hand pushes down.
Squeeze the biceps at the top.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch arms.

items.name: 徒手跪姿三头肌伸展
items.description: A kneeling bodyweight triceps press with elbows kept tight to your sides. Builds triceps strength without equipment.
steps: 跪在地上，膝盖分开与臀部同宽。
将双手放在身前的地面上，与肩同宽，手指指向前方。
将双腿伸直在身后，用脚趾和双手保持平衡，从头到脚跟形成一条直线。
弯曲肘部，将上半身向地面降低，保持肘部靠近身体两侧。
在底部停顿片刻，然后双手用力伸直手臂，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 徒手过头三头肌伸展
items.description: A triceps extension using your own bodyweight against a stable surface. It targets the back of the arms.
steps: Place your hands on a bar or sturdy surface at about waist height, shoulder-width apart.
Walk your feet back and lean forward in a plank.
Bend your elbows and lower your head between your arms.
Keep your elbows pointing forward and your body straight.
Press back up by extending your arms and repeat.

items.name: 手臂垂直伸展拉伸
items.nameEn: extension of arms in vertical stretch
items.description: Arms stretched out vertically open up the front of the arm and shoulder. It lengthens the biceps and chest.
steps: Stand tall with your arms raised straight overhead.
Press your arms back slightly and reach long through your fingertips.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

items.name: 攀爬猴架
items.description: Swing from bar to bar along a horizontal ladder. It builds grip, shoulders and back with a playful challenge.
steps: Grab the first bar with both hands and hang.
Swing your body slightly and reach for the next bar with one hand.
Release the back hand and reach for the following bar.
Keep a steady rhythm using your hips for momentum.
Continue to the end of the ladder.
Drop down softly and rest before the next pass.

items.name: 支撑物上手臂拉伸
items.description: Resting your arms on a support and sinking down stretches the biceps and front of the shoulders. The support does part of the work for you.
steps: Place your hands or forearms on a bench or other stable support behind you.
Lower your body slightly and lean away until you feel a stretch in the front of your arms.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

items.name: 斯塔尔德推举
items.description: A gymnastics press where you shift your weight over the hands and lift the body up with straight arms. It trains the triceps and shoulders.
steps: 首先站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，双臂伸过头顶。
稍微弯曲膝盖并启动核心。
将身体降低至蹲姿，同时保持手臂伸过头顶。
当你蹲下时，将手臂向下压向地面，锻炼三头肌。
在深蹲底部停顿片刻，然后用脚后跟站起来，同时将手臂举过头顶。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 旋后握杆悬吊拉伸
items.description: Hanging from a bar with palms facing you stretches the biceps and forearms. Let your body weight do the lengthening.
steps: Grip a pull-up bar with an underhand, shoulder-width grip.
Let your body hang with your arms straight, relaxing your shoulders downward.
Take as much weight through your legs as you need to stay comfortable.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

items.name: 木棍仰卧单臂三头肌拉伸
items.nameEn: stick lying single arm triceps stretch
items.description: A triceps stretch on the floor using a stick to deepen the stretch. It opens the back of your upper arm and shoulder.
steps: Lie on your back holding a stick in both hands.
Bend one arm and take that hand behind your head.
Use the other hand to push the stick and press that elbow down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your neck relaxed.
Switch arms.

items.name: 木棒肩胛下肌放松
items.description: A gentle release for the muscle under the shoulder blade using a stick for leverage. It helps the shoulder feel looser.
steps: Hold a stick in one hand and bend your elbow to 90 degrees.
Place the other hand on the stick and rotate the arm outward.
Gently push into a comfortable stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release and repeat on the other arm.

items.name: 桌下二头弯举
items.description: Lie under a sturdy table and curl your body up by gripping the edge. A bodyweight biceps exercise.
steps: Lie under a strong table and grip its edge with an underhand grip.
Keep your body straight with heels on the floor.
Pull your chest toward the table by bending the elbows.
Squeeze your biceps.
Lower slowly.

items.name: 椅上坐姿过头三头肌伸展
items.nameEn: seated overhead triceps extension on a chair
items.description: A seated overhead extension that works the triceps using your own arm resistance.
steps: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Raise your arms overhead and bend your elbows so your hands drop behind your head.
Extend your arms back up until straight.
Lower slowly and keep your elbows pointing forward.

items.name: 椅子靠墙上斜窄距俯卧撑
items.nameEn: incline close grip push up with chair against wall
items.description: A close grip incline push-up with your hands on a chair. It is a good way to build triceps strength.
steps: Brace a chair against a wall and place your hands close together on the seat.
Walk your feet back until your body is in a straight line.
Lower your chest toward the chair, elbows close to your body.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your hips in line.

items.name: 椅间屈膝反向下巴弯举
items.nameEn: inverted chin curl with bent knee between chairs
items.description: An underhand-grip hang under a bar between two chairs, curling your body up with the biceps. Bent knees keep it manageable.
steps: Place a sturdy bar across two stable chairs and lie underneath it.
Grip the bar underhand, arms straight, knees bent.
Keep your hips up and body in a line.
Curl yourself up by bending the elbows, keeping them close.
Lower with control until the arms are straight.
Check the chairs are stable before each set.

items.name: 椅间臂屈伸
items.description: Bodyweight dips using two sturdy chairs, working the triceps and chest.
steps: Place two sturdy chairs facing each other and brace them against a wall.
Grip the seats, lift your body and straighten your arms.
Lower yourself by bending your elbows until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor.
Keep your elbows pointing back and your chest up.
Press up to straight arms.
Make sure the chairs cannot slide.

items.name: 毛巾仰卧二头弯举
items.description: Lie on your back and curl a towel held in both hands toward your chest, using your own resistance to work the biceps.
steps: Lie on your back and hold a towel in both hands, arms extended.
Pull the towel taut and curl your hands toward your shoulders.
Keep your upper arms still and your elbows close to your sides.
Squeeze at the top, then lower slowly to the start.
Repeat for the planned reps.

items.name: 毛巾仰卧双腿二头弯举
items.nameEn: lying double legs biceps curl with towel
items.description: A lying curl where you pull a towel wrapped around your feet with your hands, so your legs provide resistance.
steps: Lie on your back and wrap a towel around both feet, holding the ends.
Lift your legs slightly and press them against the towel.
Curl the towel toward your chest while your legs resist.
Lower slowly.
Keep your elbows at your sides.

items.name: 毛巾仰卧双腿锤式弯举
items.nameEn: lying double legs hammer curl with towel
items.description: Lying on your back, you loop a towel around your feet and curl it with a hammer grip. It trains your biceps.
steps: Lie on your back and loop a towel around both feet.
Hold the ends with palms facing each other.
Pull the towel toward your chest while pushing your feet against it.
Pause, then slowly extend your arms.
Keep your elbows near your sides.

items.name: 毛巾双腿反握二头弯举 v. 2
items.nameEn: two legs reverse biceps curl with towel v. 2
items.description: A reverse curl using a towel looped around both feet. It trains your biceps and forearms.
steps: Lie on your back and loop a towel around both feet.
Hold the ends with an overhand grip.
Pull the towel toward your chest while your legs resist.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly.

items.name: 毛巾双腿锤式弯举 v. 2
items.nameEn: two legs hammer curl with towel v. 2
items.description: A hammer curl using a towel looped around both feet. It trains your biceps and brachialis.
steps: Lie on your back and loop a towel around both feet.
Hold the ends with palms facing each other.
Pull the towel toward your chest while your legs resist.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly.

items.name: 滑雪测功仪
items.description: Pulling the handles of a ski ergometer down in a rhythmic stroke. Works the arms, back and core while raising your heart rate.
steps: 将座椅高度和脚踏板调整到舒适的位置。
正手握住手柄，手掌朝下。
坐直，双脚平放在脚踏板上。
将手臂伸直在身前，保持肘部稍微弯曲。
收紧三头肌并将手柄向下推向大腿。
在底部停顿片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 窄距俯卧撑
items.description: A push-up with the hands placed close together under the chest. It shifts more of the load onto the triceps.
steps: 从高位平板支撑开始，双手并拢，位于肩膀正下方。
收紧核心，将身体降低到地面，保持肘部靠近身体两侧。
推动手掌以伸展手臂并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 窄距俯卧撑(跪姿)
items.description: A close-grip push-up done on your knees. An easier way to train the triceps and chest.
steps: 首先双手和膝盖着地，双手与肩同宽，膝盖与臀部同宽。
弯曲肘部，将上身压向地面，使其靠近身体两侧。
当你的胸部刚好高于地面时，暂停片刻。
推动手掌以伸直手臂并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 站姿等长二头肌保持
items.description: A static curl hold where you keep the elbows bent and the biceps working without moving.
steps: Stand tall with feet hip width apart and your elbows at your sides.
Bend your elbows to about 90 degrees with palms facing up.
Squeeze your fists and flex your biceps hard.
Hold the position for 20-30 seconds, breathing steadily.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and elbows pinned, then rest and repeat.

items.name: 肘伸展
items.description: Straightening the elbow from a bent position, which works the back of the upper arm and keeps the joint moving.
steps: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Hold your upper arm still with the elbow bent.
Straighten the arm slowly until it is almost fully extended.
Pause briefly, keeping the shoulder relaxed and the upper arm fixed.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

items.name: 肘屈曲
items.description: Bending the elbow to bring the hand toward the shoulder, working the front of the upper arm.
steps: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Start with your arm straight down at your side, palm forward.
Bend the elbow to bring your hand up toward your shoulder.
Pause briefly, then lower back down slowly without swinging.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

items.name: 肘屈肌拉伸
items.description: Extending your arm and turning the palm outward stretches the muscles that bend your elbow. It targets the biceps and brachialis.
steps: Extend one arm in front of you with your palm facing up.
Use your other hand to gently press the fingers down and back until you feel the stretch.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

items.name: 肘撑臂屈伸
items.description: A bench dip variation that bends the elbows to lower the hips. It trains the triceps and the front of the shoulders.
steps: 坐在长凳或椅子的边缘，双手抓住臀部旁边的边缘。
将臀部向前滑离长凳，伸直双腿，保持脚后跟着地。
弯曲肘部，将身体放低至地面，保持背部靠近长凳。
在底部停顿片刻，然后双手用力伸直手臂，将身体抬回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 背后二头肌拉伸
items.description: A stretch that opens the front of the arm and chest by reaching the arms behind you.
steps: Stand tall and reach both arms behind your back.
Straighten your elbows and turn your palms down or clasp your hands.
Lift your hands slightly away from your body until you feel a stretch in the biceps.
Keep your chest open and your neck relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing steadily, then release slowly.

items.name: 腿上集中弯举
items.description: A seated curl with your elbow braced on your inner thigh. Isolates the biceps and cuts out swinging.
steps: 坐在长凳上，双腿分开，双脚平放在地上。
一只手握住哑铃，将肘部放在大腿内侧，膝盖上方。
手掌朝上，将哑铃向肩膀弯曲，同时保持上臂静止。
在动作的最高点挤压二头肌，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

items.name: 虎尾滚棒三头肌
items.description: A triceps exercise using a bodyweight or stick-style handle, focused on straightening the elbows against resistance.
steps: Set up facing your anchor or support, with your upper arms close to your body.
Brace your core and keep your elbows still.
Straighten your arms fully to engage the triceps.
Squeeze at the bottom for a moment.
Return slowly to the start.

items.name: 跪姿等长二头肌保持
items.description: A static curl hold that builds biceps endurance.
steps: Kneel upright with your elbows bent at about 90 degrees.
Hold your hands in front of you with palms up.
Keep your elbows pinned to your sides.
Squeeze your biceps and hold the position.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then rest.

items.name: 身体上推
items.description: A bodyweight press-up that pushes the body back toward the hands. Trains the triceps.
steps: 首先将双手放在凸起的表面上，例如长凳或双杠上，手掌朝下，手指向前。
将双腿向前方伸展，脚跟保持在地面上，身体伸直。
弯曲肘部降低身体，使其靠近身体两侧，直到上臂与地面平行。
暂停片刻，然后用手掌伸直手臂，将身体抬回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 过头三头肌拉伸
items.description: Reaching one arm overhead and bending the elbow, you pull gently on it with the other hand. Stretches the triceps and shoulder.
steps: 站立或坐直，双脚分开与肩同宽。
将一只手臂伸过头顶，弯曲肘部，使手伸向对面的肩胛骨。
用另一只手轻轻地将伸出的手臂的肘部拉向头部的另一侧，感受三头肌的拉伸。
保持拉伸 15-30 秒，然后放松。
在另一侧重复。

items.name: 钻石俯卧撑
items.description: A push-up with the hands forming a diamond under the chest. It puts heavy focus on the triceps.
steps: 从高位平板支撑开始，双手并拢，拇指和食指形成菱形。
让你的身体从头到脚保持一条直线，锻炼你的核心和臀部。
将胸部降低至双手形成的菱形，保持肘部靠近身体。
在底部暂停片刻，然后将自己推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 钻石俯卧撑(跪姿)
items.description: An easier knee version of the diamond push-up that targets the triceps with hands close together.
steps: Kneel on the floor and place your hands under your chest, thumbs and fingers forming a diamond.
Keep your body straight from knees to head.
Lower your chest toward your hands, elbows close.
Press up until your arms are straight.
Keep your core tight throughout.

items.name: 靠墙三头肌拉伸
items.description: Leaning into a wall with your elbow bent overhead stretches the triceps. The wall gives a steady anchor.
steps: Stand next to a wall and place your bent elbow on it above head height.
Lean your body forward and down until you feel the stretch along the back of your upper arm.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

items.name: 靠墙脉冲
items.description: Small pulses in a wall push-up position. It keeps constant tension on your triceps.
steps: Stand facing a wall and place your hands on it, close together at chest height.
Step your feet back so your body leans in a straight line.
Bend your elbows slightly to bring your chest toward the wall.
Pulse in short, controlled movements.
Keep your elbows tucked and your core tight.

items.name: 高双杠三头肌臂屈伸
items.nameEn: triceps dip on high parallel bars
items.description: A dip on high parallel bars with an upright torso. It builds the triceps and chest.
steps: Grip the bars and lift yourself with straight arms.
Keep your body upright and elbows close.
Lower until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor.
Press back up to straight arms.
Avoid shrugging your shoulders.

items.name: 鳄鱼式
items.description: A low plank where the elbows are bent back by your ribs. Builds strength in the arms, chest and core.
steps: Start in a high plank with your wrists under your shoulders.
Shift slightly forward on your toes.
Bend your elbows straight back and lower to elbow height.
Keep your body in one line and your elbows near your ribs.
Hold briefly, then press back up.

items.name: 1对2跳箱
items.description: Push off with one leg to land on a box with both feet. It trains explosive single-leg power and a stable landing.
steps: Stand facing a sturdy box on one leg.
Drive your arms up and push off explosively from that leg.
Land softly on the box with both feet at once.
Stand fully upright before stepping down.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.

items.name: 2对1跳箱
items.description: Jump up onto a box with both feet and step or drop down with one. It builds explosive leg power and single-leg control.
steps: Stand facing a sturdy box with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Swing your arms and jump up, landing softly on the box with both feet.
Stand tall on top of the box.
Step down with one leg first, then the other.
Reset and repeat, alternating the leading leg.
Land quietly with bent knees.

items.name: 45度单腿山羊挺身(手臂置于胸前)
items.nameEn: 45 degree one leg hyperextension (arms in front of chest)
items.description: A single-leg back extension on a 45 degree bench that trains the glutes, hamstrings and lower back one side at a time.
steps: Set the pad under your hips and hook one foot under the roller, with the other leg lifted off.
Cross your arms over your chest and keep your body in a straight line.
Lower your torso toward the floor with a flat back.
Raise back up by squeezing your glute until your body is level, without overarching.
Complete all reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 45度髋伸展(臀部专注) v. 2
items.nameEn: 45 degree hip extension glute focused v. 2
items.description: A hip extension on a 45 degree bench that emphasises the glutes. It strengthens the posterior chain.
steps: Set the pad at hip height and lock your heels in.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Hinge forward at the hips with a straight back.
Drive your hips forward and squeeze your glutes.
Stop when your body is in a straight line.
Lower slowly each rep.

items.name: 45度髋伸展(重点臀部)
items.description: A hip extension on a 45 degree bench with a rounded upper back. This shifts the focus onto the glutes.
steps: Set up on a 45 degree bench with your ankles locked.
Cross your arms over your chest and round your upper back slightly.
Lower your torso by hinging at the hips.
Squeeze the glutes to raise back up.
Stop when your body is in a straight line.
Avoid overarching your lower back.

items.name: 90度到90度拉伸
items.description: A seated hip stretch with both legs bent at right angles. It loosens the hip rotators and the glutes.
steps: Sit on the floor with one leg bent in front and the other bent out to the side, both at about 90 degrees.
Sit tall with your hands on the floor.
Hinge forward over the front shin until you feel a stretch in the hip.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Come back up slowly.
Switch sides.

items.name: 90度对90度推举拉伸
items.description: Sit in a 90-degree hip position and press forward to stretch the glutes and hips. It improves hip rotation.
steps: Sit on the floor with both knees bent at 90 degrees, one leg in front, one to the side.
Sit tall.
Hinge forward over the front shin with a flat back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides and repeat.

items.name: faber测试
items.description: A gentle hip check where the ankle rests on the opposite knee and the knee drops out. It shows how mobile the hip is.
steps: Lie on your back with legs straight.
Place one foot on the opposite knee.
Let the bent knee drop out to the side.
Relax and notice how far it goes.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without forcing it.
Switch legs.

items.name: pvc管早安式体前屈
items.description: A hip hinge drill with a light pipe on your back, teaching you to bend at the hips with a flat spine.
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and a PVC pipe across your upper back.
Soften your knees slightly and push your hips straight back.
Lower your torso until you feel a stretch in the hamstrings, keeping your back flat.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall again.
Keep the pipe in contact with your head, upper back and tailbone if you can.

items.name: pvc管过头深蹲
items.description: A squat with a light pipe held overhead that checks your mobility and trains posture through the whole body.
steps: Hold a PVC pipe overhead with a wide grip and arms locked out.
Stand with feet slightly wider than shoulders.
Squat down by sitting between your hips, keeping the pipe over your mid-foot.
Go as deep as you can with your chest up and heels down.
Drive through your feet to stand back up.

items.name: pvc管髋铰链
items.description: A simple hinge pattern drill using a pipe along your spine to check posture while you bend at the hips.
steps: Hold a PVC pipe vertically along your spine, one hand at the neck and one at the lower back.
Keep the pipe touching head, upper back and tailbone.
Push your hips back with soft knees and tip forward.
Stop when you feel the hamstrings stretch, then squeeze your glutes to stand.
Keep the pipe contact the whole time.

items.name: 三角式
items.description: From a wide stance, reach sideways over the front leg with arms in a line. It stretches the hamstrings, hips and sides.
steps: Stand with feet wide apart and turn one foot out 90 degrees.
Raise your arms to shoulder height.
Reach toward the front foot, then lower that hand to your shin or the floor.
Extend the other arm up and look toward it.
Hold for 3 to 5 breaths, then switch sides.

items.name: 上台阶(第一级和第二级台阶)
items.description: A simple stair step-up done on the first and second steps. It builds leg strength and balance using everyday stairs.
steps: Stand facing the stairs with your feet hip-width apart.
Place one foot on the first step and push through the heel to climb up.
Continue onto the second step, then step back down in control.
Keep your torso tall and your knee tracking over your toes.
Alternate the leading leg each rep or finish all reps on one side first.

items.name: 上斜反向背伸
items.description: A reverse hyperextension on an incline bench that trains the glutes and lower back.
steps: Lie face down on an incline bench with hips at the edge.
Hold the sides of the bench.
Raise both legs until they are in line with your torso.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

items.name: 上楼梯
items.description: Stepping up stairs at a steady pace to train the legs and raise your heart rate.
steps: Stand at the bottom of a staircase, standing tall.
Step up with one foot, placing your whole foot on the step.
Press through your heel and bring the other foot up.
Keep your torso upright and swing your arms naturally.
Continue at a steady pace and alternate the leading leg.

items.name: 下台阶深蹲
items.description: A single-leg squat that lowers you off a step. It builds quad strength and knee control.
steps: Stand on a step with one foot hanging off the edge.
Hold your arms in front for balance.
Squat down on the standing leg and lower the free heel to the floor.
Keep your knee tracking over your toes.
Press back up to the start.
Finish your reps and switch legs.

items.name: 下沉式窄距深蹲
items.description: A close-stance squat with your heels raised on a small step to emphasize the quads.
steps: Stand with your heels on a low platform and your feet close together.
Hold your arms in front for balance.
Squat down, keeping your knees over your toes.
Go as deep as comfortable with your chest up.
Drive up through your feet.
Stand tall without locking out hard.

items.name: 世界上最伟大的拉伸
items.description: A flowing lunge with a twist and reach that opens the hips, hamstrings and upper back. A favorite warm-up move.
steps: 从弓步位置开始，右脚向前，左脚向后。
将双手放在右脚两侧的地面上。
将左膝降低到地面并伸展右腿，保持右脚平放在地面上。
向右旋转你的躯干，将你的右臂伸向天花板。
保持这个姿势几秒钟，然后回到起始位置。
换边并重复拉伸，左脚向前。

items.name: 交叉反向弓步蹲
items.description: A reverse lunge where the back leg steps behind and across the line of the front leg. It trains glutes, thighs and balance.
steps: Stand tall with your hands on your hips.
Step one foot back and across behind your other leg.
Lower until both knees are bent about 90 degrees.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee stable.
Push through the front foot to stand, then repeat or switch sides.

items.name: 交叉后撤跳
items.description: A quick hopping drill that crosses the feet and steps back, building agility and leg power.
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your knees soft.
Hop and cross one foot in front of the other.
Hop back out, then step one foot back behind you.
Land softly on the balls of your feet each time.
Keep a quick, rhythmic pace.
Alternate sides for the planned time.

items.name: 交叉跪姿髋屈肌拉伸
items.description: A kneeling lunge stretch with a cross-body reach to deepen the stretch along the front of the hip.
steps: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward in a lunge, on a mat.
Tuck your pelvis slightly and keep your torso upright.
Reach the arm on the kneeling side up and across toward the opposite side.
Shift your hips gently forward until you feel the stretch at the front of the hip.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

items.name: 交叉踏阶
items.description: A step up where you cross a knee or foot over your body. It raises your heart rate and works the legs and trunk.
steps: Stand facing a sturdy step or box.
Step up with one foot and bring the other knee across your body.
Step back down with control.
Keep your chest tall and core tight.
Alternate sides at a steady pace.

items.name: 交替打水腿
items.description: You lie on your back and kick your legs up and down in small alternating motions. It works the lower abs and hip flexors.
steps: 平躺，双腿伸展，双手放在身体两侧。
收紧核心肌群并将双腿抬离地面约 6 英寸。
保持双腿伸直，交替将一条腿抬得比另一条腿稍高。
继续这个颤动动作达到所需的重复次数。

items.name: 交替短跑式弓步
items.description: A lunge with a sprint-style arm drive and alternating legs.
steps: Stand tall.
Step back into a deep lunge.
Drive your arms like a sprinter.
Push back to standing.
Alternate legs.
Keep your torso upright.

items.name: 交替触脚跟侧踢深蹲
items.nameEn: alternate heel touch side kick squat
items.description: A squat that adds a side kick and a heel touch for legs and coordination.
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Squat down.
Stand and kick one leg to the side.
Touch the heel with your hand.
Squat again.
Alternate sides.

items.name: 交替跪姿到半跪姿
items.description: A floor-to-stand drill moving from kneeling to half kneeling, alternating sides. It builds hip mobility and control.
steps: Kneel upright with both knees on the floor.
Step one foot forward into a half-kneeling position.
Pause and keep your torso tall.
Step back to full kneeling.
Repeat with the other foot.
Move slowly and use your arms for balance if needed.

items.name: 仰卧交叉拉伸
items.description: Lying on your back, you cross one leg over the other. It stretches the outer hip and lower back.
steps: Lie on your back with arms out to the sides.
Bend one knee and bring it across your body.
Let it lower toward the floor on the opposite side.
Keep both shoulders flat on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.

items.name: 仰卧交叉膝上拉拉伸
items.nameEn: lying cross over knee pull up stretch
items.description: Lying on your back and drawing a crossed knee up toward the opposite shoulder to stretch the glutes and hips.
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Hold the knee of the lower leg or behind the thigh and pull it up toward your chest.
Keep your head and shoulders relaxed on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

items.name: 仰卧交叉膝下拉拉伸
items.nameEn: lying cross over knee pull down stretch
items.description: Lying on your back and guiding a crossed knee down across the body to stretch the outer hip and glutes.
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Use your hand to guide the crossed knee gently down and across your body.
Keep your shoulders on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

items.name: 仰卧交替蛙腿
items.description: A prone move where you alternate kicking each bent leg up, to work the glutes.
steps: Lie face down with your arms under your forehead.
Bend one knee to 90 degrees with the sole toward the ceiling.
Lift that thigh off the floor by squeezing the glute.
Lower and switch legs.
Keep your hips on the floor.

items.name: 仰卧交替髋伸展
items.description: Lying face down, you lift one leg at a time. It strengthens the glutes and the muscles along your lower back.
steps: Lie face down with arms by your sides or under your forehead.
Keep your legs straight and your hips pressed down.
Lift one leg off the floor while squeezing your glute.
Lower it with control.
Lift the other leg and alternate.
Avoid arching your lower back.

items.name: 仰卧剪刀交叉
items.description: A lying scissor kick where the legs cross over each other. It trains the inner thighs and lower abs.
steps: Lie on your back with your legs lifted.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Open your legs wide.
Cross one leg over the other.
Open and cross the other leg on top.
Keep a steady rhythm.

items.name: 仰卧单直腿伸髋
items.nameEn: lying single straight leg hip extension
items.description: Lying face down, you lift one straight leg off the floor. It strengthens your glutes and hamstrings with a gentle load on the lower back.
steps: Lie face down with your legs straight and your forehead on your hands.
Tighten your abs and glutes.
Raise one straight leg a few inches off the floor.
Pause briefly at the top without arching your lower back.
Lower under control and repeat, then switch legs.

items.name: 仰卧单腿抬高
items.description: A lying leg raise on one leg. It strengthens the thigh and hip flexors.
steps: Lie on your back with one knee bent and that foot flat.
Straighten the other leg and tighten the thigh.
Raise it to the height of your bent knee.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly. Finish your reps and switch legs.

items.name: 仰卧单腿画圈
items.description: A hip mobility move where one leg draws circles in the air.
steps: Lie on your back with one leg extended up.
Keep your pelvis still.
Draw small circles with that leg.
Reverse direction.
Switch legs.

items.name: 仰卧单腿股四头肌松动
items.description: A lying quad mobilization that gently bends the knee to loosen the front of the thigh.
steps: Lie on your side or stomach with your legs extended.
Bend one knee and bring your heel toward your glute, holding the ankle if needed.
Move the knee in and out of the bend in a slow, controlled rhythm.
Keep your hips level and stay within a comfortable range.
Repeat for 10-15 reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 仰卧外展
items.description: A side-lying leg raise that targets the outer hip. It is a simple way to strengthen the muscles that keep your pelvis steady.
steps: Lie on your side with your legs straight and stacked.
Rest your head on your lower arm and keep your hips stacked.
Lift your top leg up and slightly back without rolling your torso.
Pause at the top, then lower with control.
Finish your reps, then roll over and do the other side.

items.name: 仰卧外展肌拉伸
items.description: Floor stretch that pulls one leg across the body to open the outer hip.
steps: Lie on your back with your legs straight.
Bring one knee up and across your body.
Use the opposite hand to ease it toward the floor.
Keep your shoulders flat on the ground.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

items.name: 仰卧夹臀
items.description: Squeeze your glutes while lying down to activate them before heavier lower body work.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Squeeze your glutes and lift your hips slightly.
Hold the squeeze for 2 seconds.
Lower your hips without relaxing completely.
Repeat for 12-15 reps.

items.name: 仰卧屈腿髋背部向右拉伸
items.nameEn: lying leg tuck hip back to right stretch
items.description: A lying tuck stretch with the knees guided to the right.
steps: Lie on your back and tuck your knees.
Lower your knees to the right.
Keep both shoulders down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Breathe slowly.
Return to center.

items.name: 仰卧屈腿髋背部拉伸
items.nameEn: lying leg tuck hip back stretch
items.description: A lying tuck stretch easing the hips and lower back.
steps: Lie on your back.
Hug both knees toward your chest.
Rock gently if comfortable.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Relax your shoulders.
Release slowly.

items.name: 仰卧屈腿髋部向左扭转拉伸
items.nameEn: lying leg tuck hip twist to left stretch
items.description: A lying tuck stretch with the knees guided to the left.
steps: Lie on your back and tuck your knees.
Lower your knees to the left.
Keep both shoulders down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Breathe slowly.
Return to center.

items.name: 仰卧屈腿髋部扭转拉伸
items.nameEn: lying leg tuck hip twist stretch
items.description: A lying stretch with a spinal twist to open the hips and back.
steps: Lie on your back and pull your knees in.
Drop both knees to one side.
Keep your shoulders on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return to the center.
Switch sides.

items.name: 仰卧屈腿髋部拉伸
items.description: A lying hip stretch pulling the knee in toward the chest.
steps: Lie on your back.
Pull one knee toward your chest.
Keep your other leg relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release slowly.
Switch legs.

items.name: 仰卧屈腿髋部拉伸(双手过头)
items.nameEn: lying leg tuck hip stretch with overhead hands
items.description: A lying knee-tuck stretch with arms extended overhead for a longer line.
steps: Lie on your back with your arms overhead.
Pull one knee toward your chest.
Keep your arms reaching.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release slowly.
Switch legs.

items.name: 仰卧屈膝8字
items.description: A lying hip mobility move where you draw a figure eight with the bent knee. It loosens the hips.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent.
Lift one knee above the hip.
Trace a slow figure eight in the air with your knee.
Keep the movement smooth and controlled.
Keep your pelvis steady on the floor.
Switch legs after a set.

items.name: 仰卧悬腿外展肌拉伸
items.description: Lie on a bench and let one leg hang across for a gravity-assisted hip stretch.
steps: Lie on your back on a bench.
Cross one leg over your body and let it hang off the side.
Keep your shoulders flat.
Let gravity lower the leg slowly.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

items.name: 仰卧椒盐卷饼拉伸
items.description: A lying twist that pulls one leg across and bends the other back, stretching the glutes, hips and thighs.
steps: Lie on your side with your hips stacked and your bottom leg bent in front.
Bend the top knee and bring that foot back toward your glutes, holding it with your hand.
Gently roll your top knee back and open your chest toward the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

items.name: 仰卧直膝抬腿
items.description: A lying straight-leg raise that lifts the leg with the knee locked. It wakes up the quads and hip flexors in a gentle way.
steps: Lie on your back with one knee bent and the other leg straight.
Tighten the thigh of the straight leg so the knee is locked.
Lift the leg to the height of your bent knee.
Hold for a moment.
Lower slowly to the floor.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 仰卧股四头肌拉伸
items.description: A stretch for the front of the thigh done lying on your side or front. It loosens tight quads after leg work.
steps: Lie on your side with your legs stacked and your head resting on one arm.
Bend the top knee and grab that ankle with your top hand.
Pull your heel toward your glutes while keeping your knees close together.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

items.name: 仰卧腘绳肌拉伸
items.description: A simple lying hamstring stretch that eases tightness at the back of the thigh.
steps: Lie on your back with both legs extended.
Raise one leg and hold behind the thigh or calf.
Gently straighten the knee while pulling the leg toward you.
Keep your other leg flat and your back relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

items.name: 仰卧膝盖左右摆动
items.description: A gentle lying rotation that sways your bent knees side to side to loosen the lower back and hips.
steps: Lie on your back with arms out to the sides and knees bent, feet flat.
Keep your shoulders on the floor.
Slowly drop both knees to one side as far as is comfortable.
Bring them back to the middle and drop them to the other side.
Move at an easy pace and breathe through each rep.

items.name: 仰卧膝碰胸拉伸
items.description: Pulling one knee toward your chest while lying down stretches your glutes and lower back. A classic, easy hip release.
steps: Lie on your back with both legs extended.
Pull one knee toward your chest with both hands while the other leg stays flat.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

items.name: 仰卧臀部拉伸
items.description: Pull a knee toward your chest while lying down. It releases the glutes.
steps: Lie on your back.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Pull the bottom leg toward your chest.
Keep your head and shoulders relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

items.name: 仰卧蛙腿
items.description: A prone move where both knees bend outward like a frog and kick up, to work the glutes.
steps: Lie face down, knees bent and heels together.
Let your knees fall slightly out.
Lift both thighs off the floor by squeezing your glutes.
Pause at the top.
Lower with control and repeat.

items.name: 仰卧足跟滑动
items.description: A gentle floor move where you slide your heel toward your hips and back. It restores knee and hip bend with low strain.
steps: Lie on your back with both legs straight.
Slowly slide one heel along the floor toward your buttocks.
Bend the knee as far as feels comfortable.
Pause for a second.
Slide the heel back out until the leg is straight.
Repeat for your reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 仰卧靠墙拉伸
items.nameEn: lying leaning against the wall stretch
items.description: Lie with your legs resting on a wall and let them fall open to stretch the inner thighs.
steps: Lie on your back with your hips close to a wall.
Rest your legs straight up the wall.
Let your legs fall slowly out to the sides.
Relax and let gravity do the work.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Bring your legs together to finish.

items.name: 仰卧髋屈肌
items.description: A lying stretch that opens the front of the hip. Handy after long periods of sitting.
steps: Lie on your back near the edge of a bench or bed.
Hug one knee to your chest.
Let the other leg hang off the edge with the knee relaxed.
Keep your lower back pressed down and breathe slowly.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

items.name: 仰卧髋屈肌拉伸
items.description: Lying near the edge of a surface, you let one leg hang to stretch the front of the hip. It eases tightness from sitting.
steps: Lie on your back near the edge of a bench or bed.
Pull one knee toward your chest and hold it.
Let the other leg hang down relaxed over the edge.
Keep your lower back flat.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs.

items.name: 仰卧髋部抬腿(地面)
items.description: A side-lying leg lift done on the floor. It works the outer hip and glutes.
steps: Lie on your side with your legs straight and stacked.
Rest your head on your arm and keep your core tight.
Raise your top leg toward the ceiling.
Keep your toes pointing forward.
Lower slowly without touching the other leg.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

items.name: 仰卧髋部直腿抬腿
items.description: Lying on your back, you raise a straight leg toward the ceiling. It trains the hip muscles and leg control.
steps: Lie on your back with both legs straight.
Brace your abs and press your lower back down.
Lift one straight leg to about hip height.
Lower it slowly toward the floor.
Keep the other leg flat.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 仰望天花板拉伸 v. 2
items.description: A standing stretch where you reach up and look toward the ceiling to open the front of the body. It opens the hips and thighs.
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Reach both arms overhead and slightly back.
Tilt your head back to look at the ceiling while pressing your hips forward.
Keep your core engaged so your lower back is not over-arched.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing steadily, then relax.

items.name: 低位弓步瑜伽体式(安嘉内亚一式)
items.nameEn: low lunge yoga pose anjaneyasana i
items.description: A yoga low lunge with the back knee down and arms overhead. It opens the hips and stretches the front of the thigh.
steps: Start in a lunge with the front knee over the ankle.
Lower the back knee to the floor and untuck the toes.
Sink your hips forward and down.
Raise both arms overhead and lift your chest.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Step back and switch legs.

items.name: 低弓步
items.description: A deep lunge stretch that opens the hip flexors and quads.
steps: Step one foot forward into a lunge and lower your back knee.
Keep your front knee over your ankle.
Push your hips forward and lift your chest.
Reach your arms overhead if you like.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

items.name: 低弓步(左)
items.description: A deep lunge stretch on the left side that opens the hip flexors and quads.
steps: Step your right foot forward and lower your left knee to the floor.
Keep your front knee over your ankle.
Push your hips forward and lift your chest.
Reach your arms overhead if you like.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

items.name: 侧劈叉
items.description: A wide-leg stretch for the inner thighs and groin.
steps: Sit or stand with your legs as wide as comfortable.
Keep your toes pointing up or forward.
Lower slowly into the split.
Keep your back long.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Come out gently.

items.name: 侧卧剪刀腿
items.description: Lying on your side, you open and close the legs like scissors. Good for the outer hips and the glutes.
steps: Lie on your side with your body in a straight line and head supported.
Stack your legs and lift the top leg slightly.
Raise the top leg up while the bottom leg lifts toward it.
Bring them back together in a smooth scissor motion.
Keep your hips stacked and still.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

items.name: 侧卧对角后抬腿
items.nameEn: side lying diagonal backward leg raise
items.description: A side-lying leg lift that goes back on a diagonal. It focuses on the glutes and outer hip.
steps: Lie on your side with legs stacked and your bottom arm supporting your head.
Brace your core and keep your hips stacked.
Lift the top leg up and slightly back on a diagonal.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower slowly.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.

items.name: 侧卧抬脚
items.description: A side-lying lift of both feet at once. It works the inner thighs and the sides of the waist.
steps: Lie on your side with legs straight.
Support your head with your arm.
Lift both feet off the floor together.
Hold briefly.
Lower slowly.
Finish reps, then switch sides.

items.name: 侧卧抬腿
items.description: A side-lying leg lift that works the outer hip.
steps: Lie on your side with legs stacked.
Support your head with your arm.
Lift your top leg.
Lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

items.name: 侧卧抬腿
items.description: Lying on your side, you lift the top leg. It works the outer hip and glutes.
steps: Lie on your side with your legs stacked and your head supported.
Keep your hips stacked and core braced.
Lift the top leg up with the toes pointing forward.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch sides.

items.name: 侧卧股四头肌拉伸
items.description: Lying on your side, you pull your top foot toward your glutes to stretch the front of the thigh. A gentle quad stretch.
steps: 侧躺，双腿伸直。
弯曲上面的那条腿，用手抓住脚踝或脚。
轻轻地将脚踝或脚拉向臀部，直到感觉到股四头肌有拉伸感。
保持拉伸 20-30 秒。
松开拉伸并在另一侧重复。

items.name: 侧卧腿部画圈
items.description: A slow side-lying leg circle that works the outer hip and mobilizes the hip joint.
steps: Lie on your side with your legs stacked.
Lift the top leg slightly.
Draw small circles in the air.
Do 10 circles, then reverse direction.
Keep your pelvis still.
Switch sides.

items.name: 侧卧膝盖向外踢
items.description: From a side lying position you swing the top knee out and kick the leg outward. It works the outer hips and glutes.
steps: Lie on your side with your hips stacked and bottom leg bent.
Bend the top knee and bring it toward your chest.
Kick the top leg straight out to the side.
Pull the knee back in under control.
Keep your torso still the whole time.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

items.name: 侧卧蚌式开合
items.description: Lying on your side with knees bent, you open the top knee like a clam to strengthen the outer hip and glutes.
steps: Lie on your side with knees bent and feet stacked, head on your arm.
Keep your hips stacked and your core lightly braced.
Lift the top knee while keeping your feet together.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
Do all reps, then switch sides.

items.name: 侧卧髋内收(左)
items.description: A lying leg lift that trains the inner thigh of the left leg.
steps: Lie on your left side with your legs straight.
Bend your right knee and place that foot in front of you.
Raise your left leg a few inches off the floor.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat, then switch sides.

items.name: 侧卧髋内收(男)
items.description: A side-lying leg exercise that targets the inner thighs. It trains the adductors and hip stability.
steps: 侧躺，双腿伸直并叠放在一起。
将下臂放在头下方以获得支撑。
启动内收肌并尽可能高地抬起上面的腿，但不要旋转臀部或向后倾斜。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。

items.name: 侧向凳上深蹲
items.description: A side squat toward a bench with body weight only. It works the thighs and glutes one side at a time.
steps: Stand sideways to a bench with feet wide.
Shift your weight to the leg nearest the bench.
Sit back and down until you lightly touch the bench.
Keep the other leg straight.
Drive up through your heel and repeat, then switch sides.

items.name: 侧向分腿蹲
items.description: A wide side-to-side squat on one leg at a time. It builds the thighs and mobilises the hips.
steps: Stand with feet wide and toes slightly out.
Shift your weight to one side and bend that knee.
Keep the other leg straight with the foot flat or toes up.
Lower until your thigh is parallel.
Push back to the middle and alternate sides.

items.name: 侧向扭转跳箱
items.description: A box jump with a twist in the air that adds rotation. It builds explosive leg power and trunk control.
steps: Stand facing a sturdy box with feet shoulder-width apart.
Dip into a quarter squat and swing your arms back.
Jump up and rotate your hips to land sideways on the box.
Land softly with bent knees.
Step down and reset.
Alternate the twist direction each rep.

items.name: 侧向腿桥
items.description: A bridge with a sideways leg shift. It trains the glutes and hips.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Step or shift your legs to one side.
Return to the center.
Alternate sides.
Keep your hips lifted.

items.name: 侧向跨栏跳
items.description: A side-to-side jump over a low hurdle. It builds explosive power and quick landings.
steps: Stand beside a low hurdle with feet together.
Swing your arms and jump sideways over it.
Land softly on both feet with knees bent.
Jump straight back over the other way.
Keep your ground contact quick and controlled.

items.name: 侧向跳
items.description: A side-to-side jump that develops lateral power, balance and leg stability.
steps: Stand on both feet with your knees slightly bent and your arms ready.
Push off and jump sideways, covering a comfortable distance.
Land softly on both feet with your knees tracking over your toes.
Immediately jump back to the starting side.
Keep your chest up and repeat for the planned reps or time.

items.name: 侧向跳上凳
items.description: A side-on jump onto a bench that builds explosive leg power.
steps: Stand beside a sturdy bench.
Bend your knees and swing your arms back.
Jump up and sideways onto the bench.
Land softly with your knees bent.
Step down carefully.
Repeat, alternating sides.

items.name: 侧向跳步上台阶
items.description: A side-on step with a jump that trains power in the legs.
steps: Stand beside a low step.
Place your near foot on the step.
Drive up with a small jump.
Land softly on the step.
Step down with control.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

items.name: 侧向跳箱
items.description: A sideways jump onto a box that builds explosive power in the legs. It also trains landing control.
steps: Stand beside a sturdy box or step.
Bend your knees and swing your arms back.
Jump up and sideways, landing with both feet on the box.
Land softly with bent knees and stand tall.
Step down carefully.
Repeat, then switch the side you start from.

items.name: 侧向跳跃
items.description: A sideways leap from one leg to the other. It builds lateral power and balance.
steps: Stand on one leg with a slight bend in the knee.
Push off hard to leap sideways.
Land on the opposite foot and bend to absorb the impact.
Hold the landing for a second to stay balanced.
Bound back the other way.
Keep your chest up and your knee over your toes.

items.name: 侧向踏阶
items.description: Step sideways onto a box or step. It works the quads and glutes and builds single-leg strength.
steps: Stand sideways next to a box.
Place your near foot on the box.
Press through that foot to step up.
Lower back down slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

items.name: 侧向踏阶加提膝
items.nameEn: lateral step up with knee drive
items.description: Step sideways onto a box and drive the other knee up. It adds balance and hip flexion to the lateral step up.
steps: Stand sideways next to a box with one foot on top.
Press through that foot to step up.
Drive your other knee up toward your chest.
Lower back down with control.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

items.name: 侧向髋外展
items.description: Standing on one leg, you lift the other leg out to the side. Works the outer hips and glutes.
steps: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手放在臀部。
将重心转移到一条腿上，并将另一条腿向一侧抬起，保持伸直。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将腿放回起始位置。
在另一侧重复。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

items.name: 侧平板支撑抬腿
items.description: Hold a side plank and lift the top leg to work the outer hips and the side of your trunk.
steps: Lie on your side and prop yourself up on one forearm with elbow under the shoulder.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.
Raise your top leg to about hip height, toes pointing forward.
Lower it a little without dropping your hips.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

items.name: 侧平板支撑髋内收
items.description: A side plank with a top leg raise. Challenges the inner and outer thighs while keeping the core braced.
steps: 首先侧躺，双腿伸展并叠放在一起。
用前臂支撑自己，将肘部保持在肩膀正下方。
启动你的核心并将臀部抬离地面，从头到脚形成一条直线。
在保持侧平板支撑位置的同时，将上面的腿抬向天花板，保持笔直。
慢慢地将腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。

items.name: 侧平板支撑髋内收(屈膝)
items.description: A side plank with the top leg lifting inward, working the inner thighs and obliques.
steps: Set up in a side plank with the bottom knee bent.
Keep your body straight.
Lift your hips.
Raise the bottom leg toward the top leg.
Lower with control.
Switch sides.

items.name: 侧平板蚌式开合
items.description: A side plank where you open and close your top knee. It works the outer hips and the obliques.
steps: Lie on your side in a side plank, supported on your forearm with knees bent.
Lift your hips so your body is in a line.
Keep your feet together and open your top knee upward.
Close it under control.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

items.name: 侧弓步
items.description: Stepping out to the side into a deep lunge. It works the quads and glutes while opening the inner thighs.
steps: Stand tall with your feet together and hands in front of your chest.
Step wide to one side.
Bend that knee and sit your hips back, keeping the other leg straight.
Push off the bent leg to return.
Alternate sides.

items.name: 侧弓步内收肌拉伸
items.description: A wide side lunge that stretches the inner thigh of the straight leg.
steps: Stand with your feet wide apart.
Shift your weight to one side and bend that knee.
Keep the other leg straight with the foot flat.
Keep your chest tall.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

items.name: 侧弓步拉伸
items.description: A wide lunge to the side that stretches the inner thigh. It improves hip mobility.
steps: Stand with your feet wide apart.
Shift your weight to one side and bend that knee.
Keep the other leg straight.
Keep your chest up.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.

items.name: 侧弓步拉伸 v. 2
items.description: Sinking into a wide side lunge stretches the inner thigh and groin. A good opener before lower body work.
steps: Stand with your feet wide apart and toes pointing forward.
Shift your weight to one side and bend that knee.
Keep the other leg straight with the foot flat or toes up.
Sit your hips back and feel the stretch on the inner thigh.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides and repeat.

items.name: 侧桥髋外展
items.description: A side bridge with a top leg lift. Works the outer hips and glutes plus the core.
steps: 侧躺，双腿伸展并叠放在一起。
用前臂支撑自己，将肘部保持在肩膀正下方。
启动你的核心并将臀部抬离地面，从头到脚形成一条直线。
在保持核心肌群参与的同时，尽可能高地抬起上面的那条腿，但不要旋转臀部。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后将腿放下。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。

items.name: 侧桥髋外展(星式)
items.description: A side plank with the top leg raised in a star shape. It works the outer hip and obliques.
steps: Start in a side plank on your forearm.
Keep your body straight.
Lift your top leg toward the ceiling.
Hold briefly.
Lower the leg with control.
Switch sides after your reps.

items.name: 侧步转宽距深蹲
items.description: A squat that starts with feet together and steps out to a wide stance. It trains the glutes and legs.
steps: Stand with your feet together and arms in front.
Step one foot out to the side into a wide stance.
Sit down into a squat with your chest up.
Stand up and bring your feet back together.
Alternate the stepping side.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.

items.name: 侧踢
items.description: A kick that thrusts the heel out to the side, using hip strength and balance.
steps: Stand sideways in a fighting stance with your hands up.
Lift your knee toward your chest.
Extend the leg sideways and push the heel to the target.
Keep your supporting foot turned slightly away.
Pull the leg back and set it down.
Repeat, then switch legs.

items.name: 侧蹲
items.description: A side squat in a wide stance, bending one leg while the other stays straight. It works the thighs, glutes and inner legs.
steps: Stand with feet wide and your arms in front for balance.
Shift your weight to one leg and sit back and down.
Keep the other leg straight.
Keep your chest up and your heel down.
Push back to the middle and switch sides.

items.name: 保加利亚跳跃深蹲
items.description: A single-leg squat jump with the rear foot elevated, building explosive power and balance in each leg.
steps: Stand facing away from a bench and rest the top of one foot on it.
Lower into a split squat until your front thigh is about parallel.
Drive up explosively through your front foot so it leaves the floor.
Land softly and sink straight back into the next rep.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee stable.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 保持深蹲
items.description: A static squat hold that builds endurance in your thighs and glutes and teaches a solid bottom position.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit down into a squat until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Keep your chest up and your knees tracking over your toes.
Hold the position while breathing steadily.
Hold for 20-40 seconds, then stand up.

items.name: 俯卧撑内侧踢腿
items.description: A push-up where you kick one leg inward at the top. Adds core and hip work to the chest effort.
steps: 从俯卧撑位置开始，双手分开略宽于肩宽，双脚并拢。
弯曲肘部，将身体降低到地面，保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
当你向后推时，将一条腿抬离地面并将其踢向一侧，保持伸直。
将腿放下并重复俯卧撑，然后换另一条腿。
每次重复俯卧撑时继续交替踢腿。

items.name: 俯卧腿弯举 v. 2
items.description: A posterior chain exercise on a glute ham bench. Works the hamstrings and glutes through a long range of motion.
steps: Set your feet on the platform with your thighs against the pad and knees just behind it.
Start with your torso hanging down and your body straight.
Curl your body up by bending your knees and squeezing your hamstrings.
Finish with hips extended and torso upright.
Lower slowly with control, keeping your hips locked.
Repeat for reps.

items.name: 倾身外展肌拉伸
items.description: Leaning stretch for the outer hip and thigh.
steps: Stand next to a wall and lean on it with one hand.
Cross your outer leg behind the inner one.
Lean your hips toward the wall.
Keep both feet flat.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

items.name: 全蹲灵活性练习
items.description: A deep squat hold with gentle movement to open the hips, ankles and lower back.
steps: Stand with feet slightly wider than your shoulders, toes turned out.
Lower into a deep squat, keeping your heels down.
Press your elbows against your inner knees with hands together.
Shift gently side to side and hold the bottom.
Keep your chest lifted.
Stand up slowly.

items.name: 内收肌拉伸
items.description: A seated stretch for the inner thighs. Improves hip flexibility.
steps: Sit on the floor with the soles of your feet together.
Hold your ankles and sit tall.
Let your knees fall out to the sides.
Gently press your elbows on your thighs.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release slowly.

items.name: 凳上全蹲
items.description: A deep squat down to a bench that builds the legs and hips.
steps: Stand in front of a bench with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Keep your chest up.
Sit your hips back and lower until you touch the bench.
Pause briefly without relaxing.
Push through your heels to stand.
Repeat for the planned reps.

items.name: 凳上单腿臀桥
items.nameEn: glute bridge one leg on bench
items.description: A single-leg bridge with a foot on a bench that targets the glutes harder.
steps: Lie on your back with one foot on a bench and the other leg extended.
Brace your core.
Push through the planted heel to lift your hips.
Keep your hips level.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 凳上反向挺身
items.description: Lie face down over a bench and lift your legs behind you. It strengthens the glutes and lower back.
steps: Lie face down on a bench with your hips at the edge and legs hanging.
Hold the bench for support.
Squeeze your glutes and lift your legs until level with your body.
Pause at the top.
Lower your legs slowly without swinging.

items.name: 凳上髋伸展
items.description: A hip extension from a bench, lifting the hips to work the glutes.
steps: 坐在长凳上，背部靠在长凳上，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在长凳上以获得支撑。
收紧臀肌和腿筋，然后将臀部抬离长凳，直到身体从膝盖到肩膀形成一条直线。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将臀部放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 凳垫反向腿弯举
items.nameEn: inverse leg curl with bench pads
items.description: A bodyweight hamstring curl where you lower your torso against the pads. It is very demanding for the back of the thighs.
steps: Anchor your ankles under the bench pads and kneel upright.
Cross your arms or hold them in front of you.
Lean forward slowly from the knees, keeping hips and torso in a straight line.
Lower as far as you can control.
Pull yourself back up with your hamstrings.

items.name: 分腿侧蹲加翻滚
items.description: A lateral squat done from a split position, followed by a roll, for leg strength and coordination.
steps: Stand with feet wide and toes forward.
Shift your weight to one side and squat on that leg, keeping the other leg straight.
Roll back with control and roll up again.
Push back to the centre.
Alternate sides.

items.name: 分腿短跑式低弓步
items.description: A low lunge hold in a sprinter stance for the legs and hips.
steps: Step into a long lunge.
Lower your back knee near the floor.
Keep your torso tall.
Hold the low position briefly.
Push up.
Switch legs.

items.name: 分腿短跑式高弓步
items.description: A high lunge with the arms driving like a sprinter's. It builds leg strength, balance and hip stability.
steps: Stand tall and step one foot well back into a staggered stance.
Bend both knees and lower into a lunge, back heel lifted.
Swing the arm opposite the front leg forward and the other arm back, like sprinting.
Keep your torso upright and the front knee over the ankle.
Push through the front foot to rise, then repeat all reps.
Switch legs and do the same number.

items.name: 分腿跳
items.description: An explosive lunge jump where you switch legs in the air. It builds power and conditioning.
steps: Start in a split stance with a slight lunge dip.
Drop down and jump up powerfully.
Switch leg positions in mid-air.
Land softly in a lunge with the other leg in front.
Keep your torso upright and repeat at a steady pace.

items.name: 分腿跳上箱
items.description: A jump from a split stance onto a box, building leg power.
steps: Stand in a lunge position facing a box.
Swing your arms and jump up.
Land with both feet softly on the box.
Stand tall.
Step down carefully.
Switch your front leg and repeat.

items.name: 分腿蹲
items.description: A staggered-stance squat where the back leg stays put. It works the quads and glutes one side at a time.
steps: Stand in a long stride with one foot forward and the other back.
Keep your torso upright and core tight.
Bend both knees and lower until the back knee hovers just above the floor.
Press through the front heel to stand back up.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 分腿蹲
items.description: A bodyweight split squat with a long stance. Builds the quads and glutes one leg at a time.
steps: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
一只脚向前迈出一步，并将其放在另一只脚前面约两英尺处。
弯曲膝盖和臀部，降低身体，保持背部挺直。
继续降低，直到前大腿与地面平行，后膝盖悬停在地面上方。
暂停片刻，然后推动前脚跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换腿并重复。

items.name: 分腿蹲 v. 2
items.description: A static lunge-style squat that trains the legs one at a time with balance and control.
steps: Stand in a long stride with one foot forward and one back.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front knee over your ankle.
Push through the front heel to rise.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 分腿蹲加翻滚
items.description: A split squat paired with a backward roll to challenge your control and leg strength.
steps: Start in a split stance with your torso upright.
Lower into a split squat until the front thigh is parallel.
Sit back and roll onto your back with control.
Roll up and return to the split stance.
Stand and repeat, then switch legs.

items.name: 分腿蹲提踵
items.description: A split squat with a heel raise added at the top. It works the quads, glutes and calves together.
steps: Stand in a split stance with one foot well forward.
Lower into a split squat with an upright torso.
Push up through your front foot to stand.
Rise onto the toes of your back foot or both feet.
Lower your heel and repeat.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 前侧腘绳肌拉伸
items.description: A simple stretch for the back of the thigh.
steps: Place one heel forward on the floor with the toes up.
Keep that leg straight.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back.
Feel the stretch behind your thigh.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs.

items.name: 前倾拉伸
items.description: A forward-leaning stretch that opens the hips and the back of the legs.
steps: Stand or sit in a stable position with one leg in front of the other.
Keep your back long and chest open.
Hinge forward from your hips until you feel a stretch in the glutes and hamstrings.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return upright and switch sides.

items.name: 前勾踢
items.description: A hooking kick with the lead leg that swings the heel across the target, building balance and hip control.
steps: Stand in a fighting stance with your hands up.
Lift the lead knee and point it forward.
Extend the leg and hook the heel across the target.
Keep your supporting foot grounded and your core tight.
Bring the leg back under control.
Return to stance and repeat, then switch sides.

items.name: 前后抬腿
items.description: A standing leg swing forward and backward, loosening the hips. A nice warm-up for the hips and hamstrings.
steps: Stand tall next to a wall or support and hold on with one hand.
Swing your outside leg forward with a straight knee.
Swing it back behind you, squeezing your glute.
Keep your torso upright and avoid arching your lower back.
Do all reps on one side, then turn around and switch legs.

items.name: 前后摆腿
items.description: A dynamic warm-up swinging one leg forward and back. It loosens the hips and hamstrings.
steps: Stand tall beside a wall or support and hold it for balance.
Shift your weight onto the inside leg.
Swing the outside leg forward and back in a controlled arc.
Keep your torso upright.
Increase the range gradually.
Switch legs after your reps.

items.name: 前弓步(男)
items.description: A bodyweight lunge stepping forward and pushing back, alternating legs. It builds the glutes, quads and balance.
steps: 站立，双脚分开与臀部同宽，双手放在臀部。
右脚向前迈出一大步，将身体降低到弓步位置。
将右膝盖弯曲约 90 度，保持膝盖与脚踝对齐。
用右脚推出并返回到起始位置。
用左腿重复上述动作，交替进行所需的重复次数。

items.name: 前弓步转侧弓步转后弓步
items.nameEn: forward to side to rear lunge
items.description: A lunge sequence that steps forward, to the side and then back with the same leg. It trains the legs and hips from three directions and challenges your balance.
steps: Stand tall with your feet together and hands on your hips.
Step one foot forward into a lunge, then push back to standing.
Step the same foot out to the side, sit back into the hip, then return to center.
Step the same foot backward into a lunge and push back to standing.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes, then switch legs after your set.

items.name: 前弹踢
items.description: A quick forward kick that snaps out from the knee, building leg speed and balance.
steps: Stand in a fighting stance with your hands up.
Lift your knee toward your chest.
Snap your lower leg forward to the target.
Pull the leg back quickly along the same line.
Keep your supporting foot grounded.
Return to stance and repeat, then switch legs.

items.name: 前脉冲弓步双手过头
items.nameEn: forward pulse lunge with hands overhead
items.description: A forward lunge held in the bottom position where you pulse up and down with your arms overhead. It burns the legs and challenges balance.
steps: Stand tall and raise both arms straight overhead.
Step one foot forward into a lunge and lower until both knees are about 90 degrees.
Pulse up and down a few inches in the low position.
Push back to standing.
Switch legs and repeat.

items.name: 前踢裆
items.description: A straight forward kick aimed low with the toes or the instep, practising speed and hip flexor power.
steps: Stand in a fighting stance with your hands up.
Lift your knee in front of you.
Snap the lower leg forward and low.
Keep your torso upright and balanced.
Pull the leg back quickly.
Return to stance and repeat, then switch legs.

items.name: 动态90 90髋部扭转
items.description: A flowing hip rotation drill that moves the hips through internal and external rotation.
steps: Sit on the floor with both knees bent at 90 degrees, feet wide.
Lean back a little and support yourself with your hands.
Rotate both knees to one side so they drop toward the floor.
Rotate smoothly to the other side.
Keep your movements slow and controlled.
Continue for 10-12 reps per side.

items.name: 北欧腘绳肌弯举
items.description: Kneel with your feet anchored and lower your body forward slowly. It is a demanding hamstring strengthener.
steps: Kneel on a pad with your ankles held down firmly.
Keep your body straight from knees to head.
Lower forward as slowly as you can.
Catch yourself with your hands at the bottom.
Push back up and repeat.

items.name: 半坐姿腿部画圈
items.description: Seated leg circles that loosen up your hips and gently work the muscles around them.
steps: Sit on the floor leaning back slightly on your hands.
Lift one leg a little off the floor.
Draw slow circles in the air with that foot.
Keep your core engaged and your torso steady.
Switch directions, then switch legs.

items.name: 半月式
items.description: Balance on one leg with the torso and top leg extended sideways. It strengthens the standing leg and hips and tests your balance.
steps: Start in a wide-legged stance and turn one foot out.
Bend over that leg and place your hand on the floor or a block ahead of the foot.
Lift the back leg until it is parallel to the floor.
Open your chest and stack your hips, reaching the top arm up.
Hold for a few breaths, then lower and switch sides.

items.name: 半蛙式(阿尔达巴凯)
items.description: A prone backbend with one foot pulled toward your hip. It stretches the quads and hip flexors.
steps: Lie on your belly, propped on your forearms.
Bend one knee and reach back to hold that foot.
Gently press the foot toward your hip.
Keep your hips grounded.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

items.name: 半跪侧弓步蹲
items.description: From a half kneeling position you shift your weight sideways to open the hips and inner thigh. It builds hip mobility.
steps: Start in a half kneeling position with one knee down and the other foot forward.
Turn your front foot out to the side.
Shift your hips sideways toward the straight leg.
Keep your chest up and feel the inner thigh open.
Return to the center with control.
Do all reps, then switch sides.

items.name: 半跪姿腘绳肌拉伸
items.description: From half kneeling, straighten the front leg and lean forward to stretch the hamstring. It lengthens the back of the thigh.
steps: Kneel on one knee with the other leg extended, heel on the floor.
Keep your toes pointing up.
Hinge forward from your hips with a flat back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs and repeat.

items.name: 半鸽式髋部拉伸
items.description: A floor stretch with one shin folded in front. It opens the outer hip and glutes.
steps: Start on all fours and bring one knee forward behind your wrist.
Slide the other leg straight back.
Square your hips to the floor.
Fold forward gently over the front leg.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Switch sides.

items.name: 单侧屈膝礼弓步蹲
items.description: A lunge stepping one leg back and across behind you. It targets the glutes and outer hips.
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Step one leg diagonally behind the other.
Bend both knees and lower your hips.
Keep your chest up and front knee over your toes.
Push up and return, then switch sides.

items.name: 单直腿臀桥保持
items.nameEn: single straight leg glute bridge hold
items.description: Holding a glute bridge with one leg straight. It trains the glutes and challenges hip stability.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent.
Straighten one leg.
Lift your hips with the planted foot.
Hold with hips level.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower and switch legs.

items.name: 单直腿臀桥保持(左)
items.nameEn: single straight leg glute bridge hold (left)
items.description: A glute bridge held with the left leg extended straight. Builds one-sided glute strength and pelvic control.
steps: Lie on your back with both knees bent.
Straighten your left leg in line with your torso.
Press through the right heel to lift your hips.
Hold for 20-30 seconds with your hips level.
Lower slowly.

items.name: 单腿上台阶 v. 2
items.description: Step up onto a box or bench with one leg to build single-leg strength.
steps: Stand facing a sturdy box or bench.
Place one foot fully on it.
Drive through that heel to stand tall on the box.
Lower slowly back down.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 单腿低箱深蹲
items.description: A one-leg squat down to a low box, giving you a target depth. It builds single-leg strength and balance.
steps: Stand in front of a low box or bench on one leg.
Extend the other leg forward and raise your arms for balance.
Sit your hips back and lower until you lightly touch the box.
Keep your chest up and knee tracking over your toes.
Drive through the heel to stand.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 单腿侧向跳
items.description: One-legged sideways hop that builds power and ankle stability.
steps: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend.
Hop sideways a short distance.
Land softly on the same foot and hold your balance.
Hop back the other way.
Complete reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 单腿凳上深蹲
items.description: A one-legged squat down to a bench behind you. It builds leg strength and balance while the bench keeps the depth safe.
steps: Stand in front of a bench with your back to it and lift one foot off the floor.
Reach your arms forward for balance.
Sit your hips back and lower until you lightly touch the bench.
Keep the working knee in line with your toes.
Drive through the heel to stand back up.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 单腿凳上踏阶
items.nameEn: single leg step up on bench
items.description: A step-up onto a bench using one leg at a time. It builds strength in the thighs and glutes and helps balance.
steps: Stand facing a sturdy bench and place one foot fully on top.
Lean slightly forward and press through that heel.
Step up until the leg is straight and you stand tall.
Lower yourself slowly back down with control.
Avoid pushing off the trailing foot.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 单腿后仰股四头肌拉伸
items.description: Kneeling with one leg folded and leaning back to stretch the quadriceps.
steps: Kneel on both knees, then lift one foot out in front so that the other leg is folded.
Place your hands behind you on the floor.
Lean back slowly until you feel a stretch in the front of the folded thigh.
Keep your hips lifted and avoid sagging into the lower back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

items.name: 单腿后踢(凳子支撑)
items.description: Support yourself on a bench and kick one leg back and up. It works the glutes without any equipment.
steps: Place your hands on a bench and step back into a hinged position.
Keep your back flat and your core braced.
Kick one leg straight back and up, squeezing your glute.
Lower without letting your hips rotate.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 单腿四分之一深蹲
items.description: A shallow single-leg squat that is easy on the knees. It builds balance and leg strength.
steps: Stand on one leg with the other foot lifted slightly off the floor.
Extend your arms in front for balance.
Bend your knee and sink down about a quarter of the way.
Keep your knee in line with your toes and your chest up.
Stand back up, then switch legs after your reps.

items.name: 单腿地面毛巾滑动桥式弯举
items.nameEn: single leg sliding floor bridge curl on towel
items.description: A one-leg bridge curl with the heel on a towel. It's a tougher hamstring and glute exercise.
steps: Lie on your back with one heel on a towel on a smooth floor.
Lift the other leg straight up.
Raise your hips into a bridge.
Slide your heel away until the leg is nearly straight.
Pull the heel back toward your glutes.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 单腿垂直跳
items.description: A vertical jump from one leg to build explosive power and balance. Each side gets its own work.
steps: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend.
Swing your arms back.
Jump straight up as high as you can.
Land softly on the same leg.
Reset your balance.
Finish your reps and switch legs.

items.name: 单腿外展屈曲拉伸
items.nameEn: abduction of one leg flexion stretch
items.description: Lying on your back, you open one leg out to the side to stretch the inner thigh and groin.
steps: Lie on your back with your legs straight.
Bend one knee, let it fall out to the side and, if needed, ease it down with your hand until the inner thigh stretches.
Keep your lower back and the opposite hip flat on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

items.name: 单腿平台滑行
items.description: Standing on one foot on a slide board, you slide your other leg back and forth. Works the legs and glutes with a balance challenge.
steps: 首先将一只脚站在平台或滑板上。
稍微弯曲膝盖，将脚向后滑动到平台上，伸展腿。
在整个运动过程中保持核心参与并保持笔直姿势。
将脚滑回初始位置，慢慢返回起始位置。
重复该动作达到所需的重复次数，然后换腿。

items.name: 单腿星形平衡
items.description: Balance on one leg while reaching the other foot toward points of an imaginary star. It builds stability, control and ankle strength.
steps: Stand on one leg with a soft knee.
Reach your free foot forward and tap lightly, then return.
Tap out to the side, then return.
Tap behind you, then return.
Keep your hips level and chest tall.
Switch legs after a set of taps.

items.name: 单腿桥式伸腿
items.nameEn: single leg bridge with outstretched leg
items.description: A single leg glute bridge with the other leg held straight out. It trains the glutes and hamstrings and tests the core.
steps: 仰卧，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将一条腿伸直在您面前。
收紧臀部并将臀部抬离地面，从膝盖到肩膀形成一条直线。
在顶部保持片刻，然后慢慢将臀部放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换腿。

items.name: 单腿桥式伸腿(左)
items.nameEn: single leg bridge with outstretched leg (left)
items.description: A bridge on one leg with the other leg stretched out, to strengthen the glutes and hamstrings and test hip stability.
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Extend your left leg straight out.
Drive through your right heel to lift your hips.
Keep your hips level.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps and switch legs.

items.name: 单腿桥式屈髋
items.nameEn: single leg bridge with hip flexion
items.description: A one-legged glute bridge with the other knee drawn up, building glute strength and pelvic control.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Lift one knee toward your chest.
Press through the other foot to raise your hips.
Keep your hips level and avoid arching.
Lower slowly and switch sides after the set.

items.name: 单腿横向屈体
items.description: A single-leg bend with a twist that trains balance and mobility through the hips and torso.
steps: Stand on one leg with a soft knee.
Hinge forward at the hips and reach across your body.
Rotate your torso slightly as you reach.
Return to standing with control.
Complete the reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 单腿深蹲
items.description: A squat on a single leg that challenges strength and balance. It targets the glutes and quads on one side at a time.
steps: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
向前伸出一条腿，使其离开地面。
弯曲站立的腿并降低身体，就像坐回椅子上一样。
保持挺胸、背部挺直。
推动脚后跟返回到起始位置。
换另一条腿重复上述步骤。

items.name: 单腿深蹲（手枪式）
items.description: A deep single-leg squat with the other leg held out in front. Builds leg strength, balance and mobility.
steps: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双臂在身前伸展。
将右脚抬离地面并向前伸展。
弯曲左膝并将臀部向后推，慢慢降低身体。
降低身体时，保持挺胸、背部挺直。
降低直到左大腿与地面平行，或者尽可能降低到您能舒服的高度。
在底部停顿片刻，然后推动左脚跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换腿。

items.name: 单腿深蹲至箱
items.description: A single-leg squat down to a box. The box gives you a target for depth as you build strength.
steps: Stand in front of a box with one leg extended forward.
Brace your core and reach your arms forward for balance.
Sit back and down slowly on the standing leg until you touch the box.
Drive through your heel to stand.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 单腿硬拉提膝
items.nameEn: single leg deadlift with knee lift
items.description: A single-leg hip hinge that ends with a knee drive, training balance, hamstrings and glutes.
steps: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend.
Hinge forward as the other leg extends behind you.
Return to upright by squeezing the glute.
Drive the free knee up toward your chest.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 单腿站立
items.description: A simple balance hold on one leg that trains stability in the ankle, hip and core.
steps: Stand tall with your feet together.
Lift one foot off the floor and bend the knee slightly.
Keep your hips level and eyes on a fixed point.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds.
Switch legs and repeat.

items.name: 单腿腘绳肌臀桥
items.description: A one-legged bridge with your heel planted that works the hamstrings and glutes.
steps: Lie on your back with one foot flat and the other leg raised.
Press your heel into the floor.
Lift your hips until your body forms a line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 单腿臀推
items.description: A one-leg hip thrust that works the glutes hard and challenges balance and hip stability.
steps: Sit with your upper back against a bench and one foot flat on the floor.
Extend the other leg or hold it up.
Drive through the heel to lift your hips until your body is flat.
Squeeze your glute at the top, then lower under control.
Complete the reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 单腿臀推
items.description: Hip thrusts done on one leg with your upper back on a support. Builds glute strength and hip stability.
steps: Rest your upper back on a bench with one foot flat and the other leg lifted.
Keep your arms out for balance.
Drive through your heel to lift your hips until level.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower with control and switch legs after your reps.

items.name: 单腿臀推 v. 2
items.description: A one-legged hip thrust with your upper back on a bench, a second variation. It hits the glutes hard without any equipment.
