steps: Rest your upper back on a bench with one foot flat on the floor.
Lift the other leg off the floor, knee bent or straight.
Drive through the planted heel and raise your hips.
Squeeze your glute at the top until your torso is level.
Lower your hips under control.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 单腿臀推跳
items.description: An explosive one-leg hip thrust where you jump your hips off the floor. It trains glute power.
steps: Sit with your upper back on a bench and one foot planted.
Lift the other leg.
Drive up through your heel and thrust your hips explosively.
Let your hips leave the floor briefly.
Land softly, finish the reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 单腿臀桥
items.description: A glute bridge on one leg. It builds glute strength and hip stability.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent.
Extend one leg straight.
Drive through the planted heel and lift your hips.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower with control.
Finish reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 单腿臀桥(双臂抱胸)
items.nameEn: single leg glute bridge (arms on chest)
items.description: A one-legged glute bridge with arms crossed on the chest. It focuses the work on the glutes and tests hip stability.
steps: Lie on your back with one knee bent, foot flat, and the other leg extended or raised.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Push through the planted heel and lift your hips.
Squeeze the glute at the top so your body forms a straight line.
Lower your hips slowly without touching the floor fully.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 单腿臀桥(直腿)
items.description: A one-leg hip bridge with the other leg held straight, strongly working glutes and hamstrings.
steps: Lie on your back with one knee bent and foot flat.
Extend the other leg straight.
Drive through your heel and lift your hips.
Keep your pelvis level.
Lower with control.
Switch legs after your set.

items.name: 单腿臀桥加外旋
items.nameEn: single leg glute bridge with external rotation
items.description: A one-legged glute bridge with the hip turned outward. It targets the glutes and the small hip stabilisers.
steps: Lie on your back with one knee bent and the other leg lifted.
Press through your planted heel and raise your hips.
Turn the raised knee gently outward as you hold the top.
Keep your hips level and squeeze your glutes.
Lower with control, finish your reps, then switch sides.

items.name: 单腿臀桥屈膝触胸
items.nameEn: single leg glute bridge with knee to chest
items.description: One leg glute bridge where the free knee is hugged toward the chest. It strengthens the glutes and challenges hip stability.
steps: Lie on your back with one knee bent and the foot flat, the other knee pulled toward your chest.
Brace your core.
Push through the planted heel and lift your hips.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 单腿触脚
items.description: A single-leg balance drill where you reach down to touch the floor or foot, training hip control and stability.
steps: Stand on one leg with a soft knee.
Hinge at the hips and reach down toward your foot or the floor.
Keep your back flat and your free leg extended behind you.
Return to standing by squeezing your glute.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 单腿触脚跟深蹲
items.description: A single-leg squat where you reach down to touch the heel of the working foot. It challenges balance and leg strength.
steps: Stand on one leg with the other foot slightly off the floor.
Sit your hips back and bend the knee to squat down.
Reach down toward the heel of your standing foot.
Keep your chest as tall as you can.
Push through your foot to rise.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 单腿跨步跳
items.description: A bounding jump from one leg to the other leg. It develops power and single-leg control.
steps: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend.
Push off and leap forward as far as you can.
Land on the opposite leg and absorb the impact with a soft knee.
Hold the landing for a moment to stay balanced.
Repeat, alternating legs or staying on one side.

items.name: 单腿跳
items.description: Low-impact hopping on one leg to build ankle stiffness, balance and leg power.
steps: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend and arms ready.
Hop up and forward or in place using your ankle and knee.
Land softly on the ball of the same foot.
Stay balanced and keep your hips level.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 单腿跳板
items.description: A one-leg jump over or onto a board to build power and landing control. It trains single-leg explosiveness.
steps: Stand on one leg next to or in front of a board.
Bend slightly and swing your arms.
Jump up and across or onto the board.
Land softly on the same leg with a bent knee.
Hold the landing for a second.
Finish your reps and switch legs.

items.name: 单腿跳箱
items.description: A one-legged jump onto a box. It builds explosive power and single-leg control.
steps: Stand facing a sturdy box on one foot.
Swing your arms and dip into a short quarter squat.
Jump up and land softly on the box on the same foot.
Stand tall, then step down carefully.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 单腿跳跃臀桥
items.description: An explosive one-leg glute bridge where you pop your hips off the floor. It builds glute power and balance.
steps: Lie on your back with one foot planted and the other leg lifted.
Drive through the planted heel and thrust your hips up.
Push hard enough that your hips leave the floor.
Land softly back in the bridge.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 单腿踏阶
items.description: A step-up on a box or bench using one leg. It builds the legs and balance.
steps: Stand in front of a sturdy step.
Place one foot fully on the step.
Press through that heel and stand up.
Bring the other foot up to the step.
Lower slowly.
Finish reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 单腿蹬地
items.description: An explosive single-leg push off the floor or a step. It builds leg drive useful for running and jumping.
steps: Stand in front of a low step with one foot planted on it.
Lean slightly forward and keep your core tight.
Push off the step explosively with that leg and drive your opposite knee up.
Land softly on the same foot.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 单腿靠墙坐
items.description: A one-legged wall sit that doubles the load on each leg and challenges balance and quad endurance.
steps: Lean your back against a wall and slide down into a wall sit.
Shift your weight onto one foot.
Lift the other leg and extend it in front of you.
Hold for 10-30 seconds while keeping your back flat on the wall.
Lower the leg and rest, then switch sides.
Keep your standing knee over your ankle.

items.name: 叉腰跳跃分腿蹲
items.nameEn: jump split with hands on hip
items.description: A jumping lunge where you switch your legs in the air with hands on hips. It builds explosive leg power.
steps: Stand tall with hands on your hips.
Step into a lunge position.
Jump and switch legs in the air.
Land softly in a lunge on the other leg.
Keep your chest up and repeat.

items.name: 双手交扣绕圈触脚尖(男)
items.description: A standing toe touch with the hands clasped and moved in a circular path. It stretches the hamstrings and warms up the hips and back.
steps: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手合十放在胸前。
稍微弯曲膝盖，髋部向前转动，保持背部挺直。
将双手向脚趾方向以打圈的方式降低，尽量伸得尽可能远，但不要用力。
在底部停顿片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 双次跳跃深蹲
items.description: A squat followed by two quick jumps in a row. It builds explosive leg power and stamina.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Lower into a squat and explode into a jump.
Land softly and immediately jump a second time.
Land with bent knees and sink back into the squat.
Keep your chest up and repeat.

items.name: 双腿凳上臀桥(男)
items.nameEn: glute bridge two legs on bench (male)
items.description: A bodyweight glute bridge with the shoulders on a bench and both feet on the floor. It trains the glutes and hamstrings.
steps: 坐在长凳边缘，背靠着长凳，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在臀部旁边的长凳上以获得支撑。
收紧臀肌和腿筋，然后将臀部抬离长凳，直到身体从膝盖到肩膀形成一条直线。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将臀部放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 双腿后仰股四头肌拉伸
items.description: Sitting back on your heels and leaning back to stretch both quadriceps at once.
steps: Kneel and sit back so your hips rest on your heels.
Place your hands on the floor behind you.
Lean back slowly and lift the hips slightly until you feel a stretch in the front of both thighs.
Stop if you feel any pinch in the knees.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then come back up slowly.

items.name: 双腿地面臀桥
items.nameEn: glute bridge two legs on floor
items.description: A floor bridge with both feet down that strengthens the glutes and hamstrings.
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Place your arms by your sides.
Push through your heels to lift your hips.
Make a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

items.name: 双腿转单腿跳
items.description: A jump taking off from two feet and landing on one. It builds power and landing control.
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Dip into a quarter squat and swing your arms back.
Jump up and land on one foot.
Absorb the landing with a bent knee and hold steady.
Reset and alternate landing legs.

items.name: 双臂交叉前踢腿
items.description: A standing front kick with your arms crossed over your chest. Warms up the hips and legs while challenging balance.
steps: Stand tall with your arms crossed over your chest.
Shift your weight onto one leg.
Kick the other leg forward to about hip height with control.
Lower it and repeat for your reps.
Switch legs and keep your torso upright.

items.name: 双臂展开绕圈触脚尖(男)
items.description: A standing toe touch with a circular path and a leg lifting behind you. It loosens the hamstrings and challenges balance.
steps: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双臂向两侧伸展。
保持双腿伸直，腰部向前弯曲，右手向下伸向脚趾。
当你向下伸展时，同时将左腿在身后伸直，保持平衡。
返回起始位置，重复该动作，左手伸向脚趾，右腿在身后抬起。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

items.name: 双鸽式
items.description: A seated pose with one shin stacked on the other. Opens the outer hips and glutes.
steps: Sit with your legs crossed and stack one shin on top of the other.
Flex your feet to protect your knees.
Sit tall, then hinge forward over your shins.
Hold for 5 slow breaths.
Swap which leg is on top and repeat.

items.name: 反向动作跳双手叉腰
items.description: A vertical jump with hands on your hips so the legs do all the work. It develops explosive leg power.
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hands on your hips.
Dip quickly into a quarter squat.
Explode upward, extending hips, knees and ankles.
Reach for maximum height without using your arms.
Land softly on bent knees and reset.

items.name: 反向动作跳摆臂
items.description: A vertical jump with a quick dip and an arm swing that adds momentum. It builds explosive leg power.
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and arms back.
Dip quickly into a quarter squat while swinging your arms down and back.
Swing your arms forward and up as you explode off the floor.
Extend fully through hips, knees and ankles.
Land softly with bent knees and reset.

items.name: 反向平板支撑
items.description: A plank held face up, supported on your hands and heels. It strengthens the back of the body and opens up the chest.
steps: Sit on the floor with legs straight and hands behind your hips, fingers pointing forward.
Press into your hands and heels to lift your hips.
Straighten your body from head to heels.
Squeeze your glutes and keep your shoulders away from your ears.
Hold for 20-45 seconds.
Lower your hips with control.

items.name: 反向弓步蹲(踢腿)
items.description: A reverse lunge that ends with a forward kick. It trains the glutes and legs, and tests balance.
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Step one leg back into a lunge.
Push through the front heel to stand.
Kick the rear leg forward.
Place the foot down behind you for the next rep.
Finish reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 反向战士式
items.description: A lunge with a back bend and one arm reaching up. Stretches the side body and strengthens the legs.
steps: Step into a wide warrior II stance.
Bend your front knee over your ankle.
Reach your front arm up and lean back.
Rest your back hand on your leg.
Hold for 5 slow breaths, then switch.

items.name: 反向腿屈伸
items.description: A prone or quadruped move where you extend the leg backward. It focuses on the glutes.
steps: Get on all fours with your hands under your shoulders.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Extend one leg back and up.
Squeeze the glute at the top.
Lower the leg without touching the floor.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 反向腿弯举(凳子支撑)
items.description: Lying or kneeling with your feet anchored on a bench, you bend the knees and bring your body upright. It strongly works the hamstrings.
steps: 脸朝下躺在长凳上，臀部位于边缘，双腿伸直在身后。
抓住长凳以获得支撑。
保持上半身不动，弯曲膝盖并将双腿向臀部弯曲。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将双腿伸展回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 反向腿弯举(引体向上绳索机)
items.nameEn: inverse leg curl (on pull-up cable machine)
items.description: A bodyweight inverse leg curl using a pull-up cable machine setup. Targets the hamstrings.
steps: 调整缆绳机，使踝带处于最低设置。
面朝下躺在长凳上，双腿伸展，脚踝带固定在脚上。
握住长凳的把手以保持稳定。
弯曲膝盖，将双腿向臀部弯曲，挤压腿筋。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 反手交扣绕圈触脚尖(男)
items.nameEn: hands reversed clasped circular toe touch (male)
items.description: A toe touch with the hands clasped in reverse and moved in a circle. It opens the hamstrings and back while warming up the hips.
steps: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双臂向两侧伸展。
腰部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直，膝盖稍微弯曲。
双手向下伸，并在腿后将它们握在一起。
慢慢地将双手举过头顶，做圆周运动，保持双腿伸直。
继续圆周运动，直到双手触及脚趾。
反转动作并将双手放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 合掌式瑜伽体式
items.description: A deep squatting pose with the palms pressed together in front of the chest. It opens the hips and inner thighs.
steps: Stand with your feet wider than your hips and toes turned out.
Lower into a deep squat.
Press your palms together at the chest.
Use your elbows to gently press your knees outward.
Keep your chest lifted and hold for 20-30 seconds.
Stand up slowly.

items.name: 后下斜桥式
items.description: Lying on your back, you lift your hips and hold with your feet on the floor. Works the glutes, hamstrings and lower back.
steps: 仰卧，双脚平放在地上，膝盖弯曲。
将手臂放在身体两侧，手掌朝下。
收紧臀肌和腿筋，将臀部抬离地面，直到身体从膝盖到肩膀形成一条直线。
保持这个姿势几秒钟，然后慢慢地将臀部放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 后倚下躯干伸肌拉伸
items.description: Lying on your back and pulling your knees in stretches your lower back and hips. A soothing option after long periods of sitting.
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat.
Draw both knees toward your chest and hold them with your hands.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

items.name: 后劈腿
items.description: A kick with the back leg that rises high and then drops down like an axe, training flexibility and control.
steps: Stand in a fighting stance with your hands up.
Swing your rear leg straight up in front of you.
Reach the top with the leg extended.
Bring the heel sharply down.
Keep your supporting leg slightly bent and balanced.
Return to stance and repeat, then switch sides.

items.name: 后勾踢
items.description: A martial arts kick with the back leg that swings in an arc to strike with the heel, training hip mobility and control.
steps: Stand in a fighting stance with your hands up.
Shift your weight onto the lead foot.
Lift the rear knee and extend the leg across the target.
Hook the heel around in an arc.
Bring the leg back under control.
Return to stance and repeat, then switch sides.

items.name: 后撤弓步蹲手臂伸展扭转
items.description: A reverse lunge with an overhead reach and a twist. It warms up the legs, hips and spine together.
steps: Stand tall with your arms by your sides.
Step one leg back into a lunge and reach both arms overhead.
Twist your torso toward the front leg.
Untwist, then push through your front foot to stand.
Alternate legs for the set.

items.name: 后撤弓步高抬膝接前弓步
items.nameEn: reverse lunge high knee forward lunge
items.description: Combo lunge: step back, drive the knee up, then step forward into a lunge.
steps: Stand tall with hands on hips.
Step back into a reverse lunge.
Drive that back leg forward into a high knee.
Step the same leg forward into a forward lunge.
Push back to standing and switch legs after your reps.

items.name: 后链柔韧性测试
items.description: A forward-fold style check of how flexible the back of your body is, from calves up to your lower back.
steps: Stand with your feet together and your knees straight.
Hinge at the hips and slowly reach down toward your toes.
Let your head and arms hang relaxed without bouncing.
Note how far your fingertips reach.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Rise slowly, rolling up one vertebra at a time.

items.name: 向前单脚跳
items.description: Short, springy hops forward that build leg power, elasticity and coordination.
steps: Stand on both feet with your knees slightly bent.
Swing your arms and hop forward a short distance.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Reset your posture and hop again.
Keep your hops controlled and your chest tall.

items.name: 向前跳
items.description: A bodyweight jump forward with a soft landing. It builds explosive power in the quads and glutes.
steps: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
弯曲膝盖并将身体降低至蹲姿。
向后摆动手臂以获得动力。
爆发性地向前跳跃，伸展臀部、膝盖和脚踝。
脚掌轻轻落地，然后立即进入下一个跳跃。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 向后跳
items.description: A bodyweight jump backward with a soft landing. It builds explosive power in the quads and trains control.
steps: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
稍微弯曲膝盖，向后跳跃，用双脚蹬地。
脚掌轻轻着地，弯曲膝盖以吸收冲击力。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 哥萨克深蹲
items.description: A wide side-to-side squat where you sink onto one leg while the other stays straight. It builds leg strength and hip mobility.
steps: Stand with your feet much wider than shoulder width and toes slightly out.
Shift your weight to one side and bend that knee, sitting your hips down and back.
Keep the other leg straight with the heel down and toes up.
Push through the bent leg to slide back to the centre.
Repeat on the other side and keep your chest tall.

items.name: 囚徒深蹲
items.description: A bodyweight squat with your hands behind your head. It keeps your chest open and builds leg strength.
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and place your hands behind your head.
Pull your elbows back and keep your chest up.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower down.
Go until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Drive through your heels to stand back up.

items.name: 四向单腿跳 v. 2
items.description: A balance hop on one leg in four directions. It trains power, balance and ankle stability.
steps: Stand on one leg with a soft knee.
Hop forward and land softly.
Hop back to the start, then out to the side and back.
Hop in the fourth direction.
Stick every landing.
Switch legs.

items.name: 四点跪姿股四头肌拉伸
items.description: On all fours you pull one foot toward your glutes to stretch the front of the thigh. It eases tight quads.
steps: 从四肢着地开始，双手直接放在肩膀下方，膝盖直接放在臀部下方。
将一条腿向后伸直，保持膝盖弯曲和脚弯曲。
慢慢地将臀部降低到地面，感觉股四头肌的伸展。
保持这个姿势20-30秒。
换腿并在另一侧重复拉伸。

items.name: 四足跪姿腿弯举
items.description: A hamstring curl from hands and knees position. It works the back of the thigh.
steps: Get on all fours with your hands under your shoulders.
Brace your core.
Curl one heel toward your glutes.
Squeeze the hamstring.
Lower slowly.
Finish reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 回旋踢
items.description: A kick that swings in an arc to hit with the shin or instep, powered by a hip turn.
steps: Stand in a fighting stance with your hands up.
Pivot on your supporting foot and turn the hip over.
Lift the knee and swing the leg in an arc across the target.
Extend the lower leg at the end.
Pull the leg back and return to stance.
Repeat, then switch legs.

items.name: 圆背背部伸展
items.description: Hip-extension variation on a back extension bench where you keep a relaxed, rounded upper back to bias the glutes and hamstrings.
steps: Set the pad at hip height and hook your heels under the rollers.
Cross your arms on your chest and let your upper back round slightly.
Lower your torso until you feel a stretch in the hamstrings.
Squeeze your glutes and lift until your body is nearly in line.
Stop before overarching and repeat with control.

items.name: 地面低位臀桥
items.description: A low glute bridge on the floor, lifting your hips. Works the glutes and hamstrings.
steps: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将手臂放在身体两侧，手掌朝下。
启动臀肌和核心肌群，然后将臀部抬离地面，直到身体从膝盖到肩膀形成一条直线。
在顶部暂停片刻，挤压臀部。
慢慢地将臀部放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 地面俯卧背伸
items.description: Lying face down, you lift your chest and legs off the floor. It strengthens your lower back and glutes.
steps: Lie face down with your arms extended or by your sides.
Squeeze your glutes and lift your chest and legs slightly.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower back down with control.
Keep your neck neutral.

items.name: 地面单腿臀桥(屈膝)
items.nameEn: glute bridge one leg on floor (bent knee)
items.description: A single-leg bridge with the free knee bent toward your chest.
steps: Lie on your back with one foot on the floor and the other knee pulled up.
Place your arms by your sides.
Push through the planted heel to lift your hips.
Keep your pelvis level.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 地面单腿臀桥(直腿)
items.nameEn: glute bridge one leg on floor (straight leg)
items.description: A single-leg bridge with the free leg straight, working the glutes and core.
steps: Lie on your back with one knee bent and the other leg straight up.
Keep your arms by your sides.
Push through your planted heel to lift your hips.
Keep your hips level.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 地面反向背部伸展
items.description: Lying face down, you lift your legs behind you to extend the hips. It strengthens the glutes and lower back.
steps: Lie face down with arms extended in front or under your head.
Keep your legs straight.
Raise both legs off the floor by squeezing your glutes.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

items.name: 地面挺身
items.description: A floor-based back extension that strengthens the glutes and lower back.
steps: Lie face down with your arms extended or by your head.
Squeeze your glutes and lift your chest and legs slightly off the floor.
Keep your neck neutral and look at the floor.
Pause at the top for a second.
Lower slowly to the floor.
Repeat without forcing a big arch.

items.name: 地面毛巾滑动桥式弯举
items.nameEn: sliding floor bridge curl on towel
items.description: A glute bridge with the heels on towels, sliding the feet in and out. It strongly works the hamstrings and glutes.
steps: Lie on your back with your heels on towels on a smooth floor.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Slide your heels away until your legs are nearly straight.
Pull your heels back toward your glutes.
Keep your hips high throughout.
Lower your hips to finish the set.

items.name: 地面毛巾滑动腿弯举
items.nameEn: sliding leg curl on floor with towel
items.description: A hamstring curl where your heels slide on a towel over a smooth floor.
steps: Lie on your back with your heels on towels on a smooth floor.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Slide your heels away until your legs are nearly straight.
Pull your heels back toward your hips.
Keep your hips high throughout.
Move slowly to stay in control.

items.name: 地面毛巾滑动腿弯举 v. 2
items.nameEn: sliding leg curl on floor with towel v. 2
items.description: A bodyweight hamstring curl where your heels slide on a towel across the floor.
steps: Lie on your back with your heels on towels on a smooth floor.
Lift your hips off the ground.
Slide your heels toward your butt, curling your legs.
Slowly slide them back out.
Keep your hips high throughout.

items.name: 坐姿单腿伸膝
items.description: Seated on a chair, you straighten one knee to lift your foot. A gentle move that wakes up the thigh.
steps: Sit tall on a chair with your feet flat.
Slowly straighten one knee to lift your foot.
Squeeze your thigh at the top for a second.
Lower the foot back to the floor with control.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 坐姿单腿伸膝 v. 2
items.nameEn: seated single leg knee extension v. 2
items.description: A variation of the seated knee extension. It builds thigh strength with a small, controlled range.
steps: Sit tall on a chair, holding the seat edge for support.
Straighten one knee until the leg is level.
Hold for a second, tightening your thigh.
Lower slowly to the start.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 坐姿单腿半圆
items.description: A seated hip mobility drill where you sweep one leg in a half circle. It warms up the hips.
steps: Sit tall on the floor with hands behind you for support.
Lift one leg slightly with the knee straight.
Draw a half circle with your foot from one side to the other.
Keep your torso steady.
Repeat for the reps.
Switch legs.

items.name: 坐姿单腿外侧拉伸
items.description: A seated stretch that opens one hip by turning the leg outward.
steps: Sit on the floor and bend one leg so the foot rests against the opposite thigh.
Lean your chest forward over the bent leg while pressing the knee toward the floor until the hip stretches.
Keep your back long.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

items.name: 坐姿单腿屈膝
items.description: Sitting down, you bend one knee by sliding your heel back. It is a gentle way to build knee mobility and hamstring control.
steps: Sit on a chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Slide one foot back under the chair, bending the knee.
Pause briefly at the end of the range.
Return the foot slowly to the start.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 坐姿单腿抬起
items.description: Seated on a bench or floor, you lift one straight leg to train the hip flexors and thigh. It is a simple core and leg exercise.
steps: Sit tall on the edge of a bench with your hands beside you.
Extend one leg straight out in front.
Lift the leg a few inches higher while keeping the knee straight.
Pause and lower it slowly.
Keep your back straight and your core tight.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 坐姿单腿抱膝屈膝
items.nameEn: seated single leg hugging knee flexion
items.description: Seated, you hug one knee toward your chest and bend it. It mobilizes the hip and knee gently.
steps: Sit tall on a chair with feet flat.
Lift one knee and clasp your hands around the shin.
Gently pull the knee toward your chest and flex it.
Hold for a moment, then release.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 坐姿单腿抱膝屈膝(用毛巾)
items.nameEn: seated single leg hugging knee flexion with towel
items.description: The same hugging knee flexion, using a towel around the shin to help. It adds a gentle assisted bend.
steps: Sit tall on a chair and loop a towel around one shin.
Hold the towel ends with both hands.
Pull the knee gently toward your chest, bending it.
Hold for a moment, then release.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 坐姿单腿腘绳肌拉伸
items.description: Sitting with one leg extended, you reach toward the foot. It stretches the back of the thigh.
steps: Sit on the floor with one leg straight and the other bent.
Keep your back long.
Hinge forward from the hips and reach toward your toes.
Stop when you feel a stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs.

items.name: 坐姿宽腿内收肌拉伸
items.description: Seated straddle that stretches the inner thighs.
steps: Sit on the floor with your legs spread wide.
Keep your knees pointing up.
Hinge forward from the hips with a long spine.
Walk your hands forward until you feel the stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Come up slowly.

items.name: 坐姿对侧腿从后方髋部拉伸
items.nameEn: seated hip stretch with opposite leg from behind
items.description: A seated hip stretch with one leg folded in front and the other tucked behind you.
steps: Sit on the floor with one leg bent in front of you and the other leg bent behind.
Lean your chest forward over the front shin until you feel the stretch deep in the hip and buttock.
Keep both sit bones as level as you can.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

items.name: 坐姿屈膝伸展旋转拉伸
items.nameEn: seated knee up extended rotation stretch
items.description: A seated twist with the raised knee and the back leg extended, giving the hip a longer stretch.
steps: Sit on the floor with one leg extended and the other knee bent and crossed over it.
Rotate your torso toward the bent knee, using the opposite elbow to guide it, until the hip stretches.
Keep your spine long and look over your back shoulder.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

items.name: 坐姿屈膝外展
items.description: Seated, you press your knees outward. It trains the outer hips.
steps: Sit tall with your knees bent and feet on the floor.
Place your hands on your outer knees.
Press your knees outward against your hands.
Hold briefly.
Release slowly.
Keep your back straight.

items.name: 坐姿屈膝外展(双脚离地)
items.nameEn: seated bent knee abduction feet floor off
items.description: Seated knee abduction with the feet lifted. It trains the outer hips and core.
steps: Sit tall and lift your feet off the floor.
Hold the seat edge.
Open your knees outward.
Pause.
Close slowly.
Keep your back straight.

items.name: 坐姿屈膝抱胸臀部拉伸
items.nameEn: seated bent knee to chest buttock stretch
items.description: Pulling a bent knee toward your chest to stretch the buttock muscles.
steps: Sit on the floor with your legs out in front.
Bend one knee, hold it with both hands and gently pull it toward your chest.
Keep your back tall and avoid rounding it as you pull.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

items.name: 坐姿屈膝旋转拉伸
items.description: A seated twist with one knee raised that stretches the hip and buttock.
steps: Sit on the floor with one leg straight and the other knee bent, foot flat on the floor.
Cross the bent leg over the straight one, and rotate your torso toward the raised knee, hugging it with the opposite arm.
Sit tall and twist from the middle of your back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

items.name: 坐姿广角式序列
items.description: A seated sequence with legs wide that stretches the inner thighs and hamstrings. Move slowly with the breath.
steps: 坐在地上，双腿大角度伸展。
弯曲你的脚并锻炼你的股四头肌。
将双手放在身后的地面上以获得支撑。
保持背部挺直，从臀部向前倾。
继续向前倾斜，直到感觉到腿筋被拉伸。
保持这个姿势几个呼吸。
慢慢释放拉伸并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 坐姿微屈腿髋部拉伸
items.nameEn: seated hip stretch with slightly bent leg
items.description: A relaxed seated hip stretch with the front leg slightly bent, easy on the knee.
steps: Sit on the floor with one leg slightly bent in front of you and the other leg folded comfortably.
Hinge forward from the hips with a long back until you feel the hip and buttock stretch.
Keep the knee of the front leg soft throughout.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

items.name: 坐姿梨状肌拉伸
items.description: A seated stretch for the piriformis and glute muscles. Helps loosen tight hips.
steps: 坐在地上，双腿在身前伸展。
弯曲右膝，将右脚放在左膝外侧。
将左肘放在右膝外侧，轻轻地将躯干向右扭转。
保持拉伸 20-30 秒，然后换边重复。

items.name: 坐姿深蹲
items.description: A squat down to a seat and back up. The chair gives you a depth target and builds confidence.
steps: Stand in front of a chair or bench with feet shoulder-width apart.
Push your hips back and lower yourself toward the seat.
Lightly touch the seat without relaxing completely.
Keep your chest up and your knees over your toes.
Press through your heels to stand back up.

items.name: 坐姿相扑双臂上举灵活性拉伸
items.nameEn: sitting sumo with arms up mobility stretch
items.description: A wide seated stretch with arms overhead to open the hips, inner thighs and shoulders.
steps: Sit with legs spread wide and back straight.
Raise both arms overhead.
Lean forward slowly from the hips.
Keep your arms extended and your chest open.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then sit tall.

items.name: 坐姿相扑向右扭转拉伸
items.description: From a wide seated position, twist toward the right leg to stretch the inner thigh and torso.
steps: Sit with legs spread wide and back tall.
Rotate your torso to the right.
Reach both hands toward your right foot.
Keep your hips grounded.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
Release slowly and repeat on the other side if needed.

items.name: 坐姿相扑向左扭转拉伸
items.description: From a wide seated position, twist toward the left leg to stretch the inner thigh and torso.
steps: Sit with legs spread wide and back tall.
Rotate your torso to the left.
Reach both hands toward your left foot.
Keep your hips grounded.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
Release slowly and repeat on the other side if needed.

items.name: 坐姿相扑灵活性拉伸
items.description: Sit with legs wide and lean forward to open the inner thighs and hips.
steps: Sit on the floor with legs spread wide.
Keep your back straight and toes pointing up.
Lean forward from the hips.
Place your hands on the floor in front of you.
Stay for 20-30 seconds, then return slowly.

items.name: 坐姿股四头肌拉伸
items.description: Stretches the front of the thigh from a seated position by folding one leg back while the other stays supported.
steps: Sit sideways on a bench or sturdy seat with one leg hanging off the side.
Bend the hanging knee and bring the heel back toward your glutes.
Hold the foot or ankle with your hand and gently pull the heel closer.
Keep your torso upright and your knees close together.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release and switch legs.

items.name: 坐姿股四头肌拉伸 v. 2
items.description: Seated stretch for the front of your thigh.
steps: Sit sideways on a bench or chair edge.
Bend one knee, tucking your foot behind you.
Hold your ankle and gently pull it toward your glutes.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.

items.name: 坐姿脚拉向胸臀部拉伸
items.nameEn: sitting foot to chest buttocks stretch
items.description: A seated stretch pulling the foot toward the chest to open the hips and buttocks.
steps: Sit on the floor with your back tall and legs extended.
Bend one knee and hold the foot and shin.
Pull the foot gently toward your chest while keeping your spine upright.
Feel the stretch deep in the buttock and hip.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

items.name: 坐姿腹股沟拉伸
items.description: A seated butterfly-style stretch for the inner thighs.
steps: Sit tall on the floor and bring the soles of your feet together.
Hold your feet or ankles and let your knees fall out.
Keep your back straight and chest lifted.
Lean forward slightly from the hips until you feel a stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds and breathe slowly.

items.name: 坐姿膝屈肌和髋内收肌拉伸
items.nameEn: seated knee flexor and hip adductor stretch
items.description: Seated wide leg stretch that opens the inner thighs while lengthening the hamstrings.
steps: Sit on the floor with your legs spread wide and knees straight.
Sit tall with your toes pointing up.
Hinge forward from the hips, walking your hands out in front of you.
Stop when you feel a stretch along the inner thighs and backs of the legs.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly, then sit back up.

items.name: 坐姿膝屈肌拉伸
items.description: A seated reach toward the toes that lengthens the hamstrings.
steps: Sit on the floor with one leg straight out in front of you.
Reach toward your toes with a long back until you feel the back of the thigh stretch.
Keep your knee straight but not locked, and avoid rounding your back too much.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

items.name: 坐姿膝盖下压
items.description: A seated hip opener that lets one knee drop to the side to loosen the hips and inner thighs.
steps: Sit tall on the floor or a bench with the soles of your feet together or one leg crossed in.
Let one knee drop slowly out to the side toward the floor.
Keep your back straight and your chest lifted as the knee lowers.
Pause briefly at the end of the comfortable range, then lift the knee back up.
Repeat for 8-12 reps per side.

items.name: 坐姿臀部拉伸
items.description: Sit on the floor and cross one ankle over the opposite knee, then lean in. It stretches the glutes and the outer hip.
steps: 坐在地上，双腿在身前伸展。
弯曲右膝，将右脚踝交叉在左大腿上。
将右手放在身后的地面上以获得支撑。
用左手轻轻按下右膝盖以加深伸展。
保持拉伸 30 秒到 1 分钟。
换边并重复。

items.name: 坐姿臀部拉伸 v. 2
items.description: A seated figure-four stretch that lengthens the glutes and outer hip.
steps: Sit on a chair or the floor with your back tall.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Keep your back straight and lean your chest forward slowly.
Feel the stretch in the glute of the crossed leg.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs.

items.name: 坐姿起跳
items.description: An explosive jump that starts from a seated position on a box or chair, building power in the legs.
steps: Sit on a sturdy box or bench with feet flat.
Lean slightly forward with arms ready.
Explode upward, swinging your arms.
Land softly on both feet with bent knees.
Sit back down and reset.
Repeat with a short pause each time.

items.name: 坐姿髋外旋
items.description: A seated rotation turning the thigh outward. It improves hip mobility and activates the deep rotators.
steps: Sit tall on a bench or chair with feet flat.
Lift one foot slightly off the floor.
Keep your knee still and rotate the lower leg inward so the thigh turns outward.
Pause when you feel the hip working.
Return slowly.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 坐姿髋外旋肌和髋伸肌拉伸
items.nameEn: seated hip external rotator and hip extensor stretch
items.description: A seated figure four style stretch for the buttocks and deep hip rotators.
steps: Sit upright on the floor or a chair and cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Gently press the raised knee down and lean your chest forward with a long back until the buttock stretches.
Keep your spine long instead of collapsing forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

items.name: 坐姿髋部旋转拉伸
items.description: A seated rotation that works the hip through a twisting stretch.
steps: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and both feet flat.
Let both knees drop to one side and rotate your torso the opposite way until you feel the hip stretch.
Keep your hands behind you for support.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

items.name: 坐姿髌骨松动
items.description: Gentle kneecap sliding while seated that loosens the tissue around the knee and warms up the front of the thigh.
steps: Sit tall on a chair or bench with one leg extended and the thigh muscle relaxed.
Place your fingertips or the heel of your hand on the edges of your kneecap.
Gently glide the kneecap side to side and up and down in small, slow motions.
Keep the quad relaxed and stay in a comfortable range with no sharp pain.
Move for 30-60 seconds, then switch legs.

items.name: 坐角式前屈
items.nameEn: spread leg forward fold upavista konasana
items.description: Sit with legs wide and fold forward over them. It stretches the inner thighs and hamstrings.
steps: Sit on the floor with legs spread as wide as is comfortable.
Flex your feet and keep your knees pointing up.
Walk your hands forward and fold from the hips.
Keep your spine long instead of rounding.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.

items.name: 坐骨神经滑动松解
items.description: A seated nerve glide that alternates straightening the leg and moving the head to ease the back of the leg and improve mobility.
steps: Sit tall at the edge of a chair with your hands on the seat or resting in your lap.
Slowly straighten one knee while you lower your chin toward your chest.
Bend the knee back down while you lift your head and look up.
Keep the motion smooth and gentle, never forcing into a strong stretch or tingling.
Repeat for 10-15 slow reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 垫高侧弓步蹲
items.description: A side lunge performed with the lunging foot on a raised platform for extra range. Works glutes and inner thighs.
steps: Stand tall next to a low step or platform.
Step one foot sideways onto the platform.
Push your hips back and bend that knee while the other leg stays straight.
Keep your chest up and the planted foot flat.
Push back to the start.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

items.name: 垫高分腿蹲
items.description: A split squat with the rear foot on a bench builds leg strength and balance, one leg at a time.
steps: Stand a stride length in front of a bench and rest your back foot on it.
Keep your torso upright.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front knee over your foot.
Drive through the front heel to stand.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 垫高单腿深蹲
items.description: A one legged squat with the working foot raised on a step. It builds leg strength and balance.
steps: Stand on a bench or box on one leg with the other leg hanging off the edge.
Reach your arms forward for balance.
Sit your hips back and bend the standing knee to lower.
Go as deep as you can while the knee tracks over your toes.
Push through the foot to stand back up.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 垫高单腿臀推
items.description: A one-legged hip thrust with the foot or upper back raised on a platform. It increases the range for the glutes.
steps: Rest your upper back on a bench and put one foot on the floor or a raised step.
Lift the other leg off the ground.
Drive through the planted heel and lift your hips.
Squeeze the glute at the top with your torso level.
Lower slowly under control.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 垫高双腿髋推
items.description: A hip thrust with your upper back on a bench, driving both hips up to train the glutes.
steps: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench and knees bent.
Plant your feet hip-width apart.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly.
Repeat for the planned reps.

items.name: 垫高后撤弓步蹲
items.description: A reverse lunge starting from a raised platform so you go deeper. Great for glutes and quads.
steps: Stand on a low step with your feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot back and down off the step.
Lower until the front thigh is about parallel.
Keep your torso tall and front knee stable.
Push through the front heel to return to the step.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 垫高后移弓步蹲
items.description: Lunge stepping backward from a raised surface, which increases the range of motion.
steps: Stand on a low step with feet together.
Step one leg back and down to the floor.
Lower into a lunge with the front knee over the foot.
Push through the front heel to step back up.
Complete reps and switch legs.

items.name: 垫高靠墙静蹲
items.description: Wall sit with heels raised for a tougher quad hold.
steps: Stand with your heels on a low platform and your back on a wall.
Slide down until thighs are parallel.
Keep your back flat.
Hold for 20-45 seconds.
Slide up carefully.

items.name: 基础触脚尖(男)
items.description: A simple standing forward fold to reach your toes. It loosens the hamstrings and lower back and gets the hips moving.
steps: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双臂放在身体两侧。
腰部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直，膝盖稍微弯曲。
双手向下伸向脚趾，尽可能保持双腿伸直。
在底部停顿片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 基础转交叉驴踢
items.description: A quadruped kick that goes up behind you, then crosses over. It hits the glutes from two angles.
steps: Start on hands and knees.
Lift one leg back with a bent knee, sole toward the ceiling.
Lower it, then kick it across behind your other leg.
Alternate basic and cross kicks.
Keep your hips level, then switch legs.

items.name: 增强式侧弓步拉伸
items.description: A bouncy side lunge that stretches the inner thighs and trains light explosive movement.
steps: Stand with feet wide apart.
Shift your weight to one side and sit into a side lunge.
Straighten the other leg and feel the inner thigh stretch.
Push off to hop to the other side.
Continue alternating at a controlled pace.

items.name: 增强式深蹲
items.description: A squat followed by an explosive jump. Builds power and conditioning in the legs.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit into a squat with your chest up.
Explode upward and jump as high as you can.
Land softly on bent knees and go straight into the next squat.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.

items.name: 夏威夷深蹲
items.description: A deep bodyweight squat variation that builds leg strength and hip mobility.
steps: Stand with feet slightly wider than your shoulders and toes turned out.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Sit your hips down and back into a deep squat.
Pause at the bottom without rounding your back.
Drive through your feet to stand up.

items.name: 外侧踢腿俯卧撑
items.description: A push-up where you kick one leg out to the side at the top. Adds core and hip work to the chest and arm effort.
steps: 从俯卧撑位置开始，双手分开略宽于肩宽，双脚并拢。
弯曲肘部，将身体降低到地面，保持背部挺直，核心参与。
当你向后推时，将一条腿踢向一侧，完全伸展并启动臀部。
将腿恢复到起始位置并重复俯卧撑，每次重复时交替腿。
继续交替踢腿和俯卧撑，达到所需的重复次数。

items.name: 天堂鸟式
items.nameEn: bird of paradise pose svarga dvijasana
items.description: A standing bind pose that straightens one leg upward. It demands balance and flexibility in the hamstrings.
steps: Stand and bind one arm behind your back around your bent knee.
Grab your hand with the other arm.
Step in and stand tall on the grounded leg.
Slowly straighten the lifted leg.
Hold for a few breaths, then switch.

items.name: 宽凳空气深蹲
items.description: An air squat with a wide stance, touching a bench to guide your depth. It works the glutes and inner thighs.
steps: Stand in front of a bench with your feet wide and toes turned out.
Push your hips back and lower down.
Lightly touch the bench.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Press through your heels to stand.
Keep your chest tall.

items.name: 宽站距跳跃深蹲转窄站距跳跃深蹲
items.nameEn: wide stance jump squat to narrow stance jump squat
items.description: Jump squats that alternate between a wide and a narrow stance. It builds explosive leg power and gets your heart rate up.
steps: Stand with your feet wide and squat down.
Jump up, bringing your feet together mid-air.
Land softly in a narrow stance and squat.
Jump again, landing back in the wide stance.
Keep your chest up and move at a steady pace.

items.name: 宽腿前屈
items.nameEn: wide legged forward bend prasarita padottanasana
items.description: Fold forward with your feet far apart. It stretches the hamstrings and inner thighs and eases the back.
steps: Stand with feet about one leg-length apart and toes pointing slightly in.
Place your hands on your hips and hinge forward with a flat back.
Lower your hands to the floor under your shoulders.
Let your head hang long.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.

items.name: 宽距徒手深蹲
items.description: A bodyweight squat with a wide stance and toes turned out. It puts extra work on the glutes and inner thighs.
steps: Stand with feet well wider than your shoulders and toes angled out.
Raise your arms in front for balance.
Sit your hips down and back, pushing your knees out over your toes.
Lower until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Drive through your heels to stand back up.

items.name: 宽距臀桥脉冲
items.description: A glute bridge with feet set wide and small pulses at the top. Burns the glutes with constant tension.
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet wide apart.
Lift your hips to the top of a bridge.
Pulse your hips up and down in small, controlled movements.
Keep your glutes squeezed throughout.
Lower fully after your set.

items.name: 屁股行走
items.description: Sitting on the floor with legs extended, you shuffle forward on your glutes to warm up the hips and work the glutes.
steps: Sit on the floor with legs straight and arms crossed.
Lean back slightly.
Shift your weight to one side and swing the other hip forward.
Alternate sides to walk forward.
Keep your torso upright.
Walk back to reverse.

items.name: 屈体转眼镜蛇俯卧撑
items.description: A push-up flow that moves from pike position down and through to a cobra. It trains the shoulders, chest and spine mobility.
steps: 从俯卧撑位置开始，双手分开略宽于肩宽，双脚并拢。
收紧核心肌群，将臀部抬向天花板，与身体形成倒V字形。
弯曲肘部，使上半身靠近地面，使上半身靠近地面。
当你下降时，将你的重心向前移动，并通过伸直手臂并抬起胸部来过渡到眼镜蛇姿势。
通过弯曲肘部并将胸部放回到地面来扭转运动。
双手用力推回到倒V字形。
通过将臀部放回地面继续运动，回到起始俯卧撑位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 屈腿侧踢(跪姿)
items.description: From all fours, you lift one bent leg out to the side. It works the outer hip and glutes.
steps: Start on hands and knees with a flat back.
Keep your knee bent at about 90 degrees.
Lift the bent leg out to the side to hip height.
Squeeze your outer hip at the top without rotating your torso.
Lower under control.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 屈腿后踢(跪姿)
items.description: From all fours, you drive one bent knee up toward the ceiling. It targets the glutes without any equipment.
steps: Start on hands and knees with your hands under your shoulders.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Lift one leg with the knee bent at 90 degrees.
Push the sole of your foot toward the ceiling and squeeze your glute.
Lower slowly without arching your back.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 屈腿画圈踢(跪姿)
items.description: A kneeling Pilates move where one bent leg draws circles in the air. It works the glutes and hips while the core keeps you steady.
steps: Start on hands and knees with your hands under your shoulders.
Lift one leg out to the side with the knee bent.
Draw slow circles in the air with your knee.
Keep your hips level and your spine still.
Switch direction, then repeat on the other leg.

items.name: 屈腿踢
items.description: A kneeling glute kick back with the knee bent. It targets the glutes with a controlled squeeze.
steps: Get on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Keep your core tight and back flat.
Lift one leg with the knee bent, pressing your foot toward the ceiling.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower and repeat, then switch legs.

items.name: 屈腿踢 v. 2
items.description: On hands and knees, you press one bent leg up toward the ceiling. It targets the glutes with a simple, controlled kickback.
steps: Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Keep your core tight and your back flat.
Lift one leg with the knee bent at 90 degrees.
Press the sole of your foot toward the ceiling until your thigh is in line with your back.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower with control and finish all reps, then switch sides.

items.name: 屈膝仰卧扭转(男)
items.description: A lying twist with the knees bent, lowering them to each side. It loosens the lower back and hips.
steps: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将手臂向两侧伸展，与身体垂直。
保持膝盖并拢，慢慢地将它们降低到一侧，旨在用膝盖接触地面。
暂停片刻，然后启动核心并慢慢将膝盖抬回到起始位置。
到另一侧重复该动作。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

items.name: 屈膝后踢转侧踢
items.nameEn: bent knee back to side kick
items.description: A kneeling leg movement combining a rear lift with a side kick to work the glutes and hips.
steps: Start on all fours with a flat back.
Lift one bent knee back and up.
Swing the leg out to the side into a kick.
Return the knee under control.
Switch legs after the set.

items.name: 屈膝礼深蹲
items.description: A squat where the leg steps diagonally behind and across the body, like a curtsy. It trains the glutes and outer thighs.
steps: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
右脚向斜后方跨出一步，跨过身体，交叉在左腿后面。
弯曲双膝，就像行屈膝礼一样，将身体降低到地面。
保持躯干直立，将体重放在前脚上。
推动前脚返回起始位置。
在另一侧重复，用左脚斜向后方跨过身体。

items.name: 左右摆腿
items.description: A dynamic warm-up swinging one leg across your body and out to the side to loosen the hips.
steps: Stand tall and hold a wall or support for balance.
Shift onto one leg.
Swing the other leg across your body, then out to the side.
Keep your torso upright and the swing controlled.
Do your reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 平凳反向山羊挺身
items.description: Lie face down with your hips at the end of a bench and swing your legs up behind you. It works the glutes and lower back.
steps: 脸朝下躺在平坦的长凳上，臀部位于边缘，双腿悬在长凳上。
抓住长凳以保持稳定。
保持双腿伸直，尽可能将它们抬向天花板。
在动作的最高点挤压臀部。
慢慢地将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 平衡三点点地
items.description: A balance drill where you stand on one leg and tap the other foot to three points, training hip control and stability.
steps: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend and your hands on your hips.
Tap the free foot out in front of you, then lightly out to the side.
Tap it behind you, keeping your torso upright.
Return to center and repeat the sequence under control.
Complete all reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 平衡板
items.description: Standing on a balance board to challenge stability. Improves balance and wakes up the muscles of the legs and ankles.
steps: 将平衡板放在平坦的表面上。
用一只脚踩在平衡板上，确保其居中。
慢慢地将体重转移到平衡板上的脚上，保持核心肌群参与。
在保持该姿势所需的时间内保持平衡和稳定。
用另一只脚重复该练习。

items.name: 幻椅式
items.description: Sit back into an imaginary chair with arms overhead. It strengthens the thighs and glutes while challenging balance.
steps: Stand with feet together or hip-width apart.
Bend your knees and send your hips back, keeping your chest lifted.
Raise your arms overhead with palms facing each other.
Keep your knees over your ankles and your tailbone tucked slightly.
Hold for 5 slow breaths, then stand up.

items.name: 幻椅式 v. 2
items.description: A deeper version of chair pose where you sit lower with arms lifted. It builds leg strength and balance.
steps: Stand with feet together and arms at your sides.
Bend your knees and sit your hips back and down as if lowering into a chair.
Reach your arms up beside your ears and lengthen your spine.
Sink a little deeper while keeping your weight in your heels.
Hold for 5 slow breaths, then straighten your legs to stand.

items.name: 延展侧角瑜伽式
items.description: A wide-legged yoga lunge with a long side stretch. It opens the hips and sides of the body.
steps: Step your feet wide apart and turn one foot out.
Bend the front knee over the ankle.
Rest your forearm on your thigh and reach the other arm overhead.
Lengthen the whole side body and look up if comfortable.
Hold for 20-30 seconds and switch sides.

items.name: 弓式瑜伽姿势
items.description: A yoga backbend where you lie on your belly and hold your ankles. It stretches the thighs, chest and front of the hips.
steps: Lie on your stomach with your arms along your sides.
Bend your knees and reach back to hold your ankles.
Lift your chest and kick your feet gently into your hands to raise your thighs.
Keep your gaze forward and breathe steadily.
Hold for 15-30 seconds, then release slowly and rest on the mat.

items.name: 弓步抬腿
items.description: A lunge followed by lifting the back leg, working the glutes and balance.
steps: Stand tall and step one leg forward into a lunge.
Lower until both knees reach about 90 degrees.
Press up and lift the rear leg behind or beside you.
Hold briefly with your core tight.
Lower and repeat, then switch sides.

items.name: 弓步拉伸
items.description: A low lunge held to stretch the front of the hip and thigh. It opens up the hips.
steps: Step one foot forward into a lunge, back knee down on a mat.
Keep your torso upright.
Push your hips gently forward.
Feel the stretch in the front of the back hip and thigh.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs.

items.name: 弓步热身(一)
items.description: A dynamic lunge warm-up drill (part 1 of 7) that opens the hips and prepares your legs.
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your core braced.
Step into the lunge position described by this variation with control.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and your torso upright.
Move smoothly through the full range without bouncing.
Return to standing and repeat on the other side.
Do 8-10 slow reps per side as part of a warm-up.

items.name: 弓步热身(七)
items.description: A dynamic lunge warm-up drill (part 7 of 7) that opens the hips and prepares your legs.
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your core braced.
Step into the lunge position described by this variation with control.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and your torso upright.
Move smoothly through the full range without bouncing.
Return to standing and repeat on the other side.
Do 8-10 slow reps per side as part of a warm-up.

items.name: 弓步热身(三)
items.description: A dynamic lunge warm-up drill (part 3 of 7) that opens the hips and prepares your legs.
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your core braced.
Step into the lunge position described by this variation with control.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and your torso upright.
Move smoothly through the full range without bouncing.
Return to standing and repeat on the other side.
Do 8-10 slow reps per side as part of a warm-up.

items.name: 弓步热身(二)
items.description: A dynamic lunge warm-up drill (part 2 of 7) that opens the hips and prepares your legs.
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your core braced.
Step into the lunge position described by this variation with control.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and your torso upright.
Move smoothly through the full range without bouncing.
Return to standing and repeat on the other side.
Do 8-10 slow reps per side as part of a warm-up.

items.name: 弓步热身(五)
items.description: A dynamic lunge warm-up drill (part 5 of 7) that opens the hips and prepares your legs.
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your core braced.
Step into the lunge position described by this variation with control.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and your torso upright.
Move smoothly through the full range without bouncing.
Return to standing and repeat on the other side.
Do 8-10 slow reps per side as part of a warm-up.

items.name: 弓步热身(六)
items.description: A dynamic lunge warm-up drill (part 6 of 7) that opens the hips and prepares your legs.
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your core braced.
Step into the lunge position described by this variation with control.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and your torso upright.
Move smoothly through the full range without bouncing.
Return to standing and repeat on the other side.
Do 8-10 slow reps per side as part of a warm-up.

items.name: 弓步热身(四)
items.description: A dynamic lunge warm-up drill (part 4 of 7) that opens the hips and prepares your legs.
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your core braced.
Step into the lunge position described by this variation with control.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and your torso upright.
Move smoothly through the full range without bouncing.
Return to standing and repeat on the other side.
Do 8-10 slow reps per side as part of a warm-up.

items.name: 弓步跳
items.description: A lunge followed by a jump where the legs switch in mid-air. It builds leg power and raises your heart rate.
steps: 首先站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
右脚向前迈出一步，将身体降低至弓步位置。
右脚蹬地，跳到空中，在空中改变脚的位置。
左脚向前轻柔落地，并立即将身体降低至弓步位置。
继续在弓步和跳跃之间交替进行所需的重复次数。

items.name: 弓步蹲
items.description: A classic step forward and drop for the legs. It builds the quads and glutes and improves balance.
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Take a big step forward with one leg.
Lower your hips until both knees are bent about 90 degrees.
Keep your torso upright and front knee over your ankle.
Push through the front heel to return to standing.
Repeat and switch legs.

items.name: 弓步蹲大腿(动作检查)
items.description: A form check drawing for the lunge, showing correct and incorrect positions. It reminds you how to train the thighs safely.
steps: Stand tall with feet hip width.
Step forward into a lunge.
Keep your front knee over your ankle.
Keep your torso upright.
Push back up to the start.
Compare with the incorrect position to correct your form.

items.name: 弹力带快速踏步
items.description: A quick lateral stepping drill with a band around the legs to speed up the feet and fire the glutes.
steps: Place a band around your thighs or ankles.
Stand in a quarter squat.
Take quick small steps to the side.
Keep tension on the band and your chest up.
Move in both directions.

items.name: 徒手b式站姿早安式体前屈
items.description: A hip hinge with one foot staggered slightly behind. It biases one leg to train the hamstrings and glutes and builds balance.
steps: Stand with one foot flat and the other slightly behind, toe resting on the floor.
Place your hands behind your head.
Push your hips back and hinge forward with a flat back.
Go down until you feel a stretch in the hamstring of the front leg.
Return to standing and switch legs after your set.

items.name: 徒手仰卧交替腿弯举
items.description: A floor hamstring curl using your own weight, alternating legs to keep it easy on the joints.
steps: Lie face down with your legs straight and your forehead on your hands.
Bend one knee and bring the heel toward your glute.
Squeeze the back of your thigh at the top.
Lower the leg slowly.
Repeat with the other leg.
Alternate for the planned reps.

items.name: 徒手低位分腿蹲
items.description: A split squat with a deep, low range that challenges your front thigh and glutes while building balance and hip mobility.
steps: Step one foot forward into a long split stance.
Keep your torso upright and your hands on your hips.
Lower your back knee toward the floor as far as you can control.
Drive through your front foot to stand back up.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 徒手俯卧腿弯举
items.description: A floor-based curl where you bend the knees against no added load. It targets the hamstrings in a simple way.
steps: Lie on your front with your legs straight.
Rest your forehead on your hands.
Bend your knees and bring your heels toward your glutes.
Squeeze the hamstrings at the top.
Lower your feet slowly back to the floor.
Keep your hips pressed down throughout.

items.name: 徒手凳上深蹲
items.description: A squat down to a bench and back up. The bench gives you a depth target and builds leg strength with control.
steps: Stand in front of a bench with feet shoulder-width apart.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower.
Lightly touch the bench with your glutes without dropping onto it.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your whole foot to stand back up.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.

items.name: 徒手分腿蹲保持
items.description: A held split stance that opens the front of the hip and loads the front thigh.
steps: Step one foot far forward and the other back into a split stance.
Lower your hips until the front knee is bent to about 90 degrees.
Keep your torso upright and your front heel down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing steadily.
Rise up and switch legs.

items.name: 徒手前弓步蹲(窄步幅躯干直立)
items.nameEn: bodyweight forward lunge (smaller stance upright torso)
items.description: A forward lunge with a shorter step and an upright torso. It emphasizes the quads.
steps: Stand tall with hands on your hips.
Take a short step forward.
Lower straight down, keeping your torso upright.
Keep the front knee over the ankle.
Push through the front foot to stand.
Alternate legs.

items.name: 徒手前弓步蹲(髋部折叠)
items.description: A forward lunge with a forward hinge at the hips. It shifts more work to the glutes and hamstrings.
steps: Stand tall with feet hip width.
Step forward into a lunge.
Hinge your torso forward at the hips.
Lower until both knees are bent.
Push off the front foot to return.
Alternate legs.

items.name: 徒手半分腿蹲保持
items.description: A half split position that stretches the back of the front leg while you sit back on the rear leg.
steps: Kneel on one knee with the other leg extended in front, heel on the floor.
Sit your hips back toward the rear heel.
Keep the front leg straight and your back long.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs.

items.name: 徒手单腿卡斯臀桥
items.nameEn: bodyweight single leg kas glute bridge
items.description: A one-leg glute bridge with the knee kept forward. Works each glute on its own and tests hip balance.
steps: Lie on your back with one foot flat and the other leg lifted.
Keep your standing shin close to vertical.
Drive through your heel and lift your hips until in line with your torso.
Squeeze your glute at the top without arching.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 徒手单腿深蹲
items.description: Squat on one leg, building strength and balance.
steps: Stand on one leg with the other lifted in front.
Extend your arms for balance.
Lower down with control.
Keep your knee over your toes.
Push up and switch legs.

items.name: 徒手单腿深蹲(带支撑)
items.nameEn: bodyweight single leg squat with support
items.description: Supported single leg squat that helps you progress toward the full version.
steps: Hold a stable support with one hand.
Stand on one leg with the other lifted.
Lower down as far as you can with control.
Use the support only as much as needed.
Push up and switch legs.

items.name: 徒手单腿硬拉
items.description: Hinge forward on one leg while the other reaches back. It builds hamstring and glute strength and trains balance.
steps: Stand on one foot with a soft knee and your arms hanging in front.
Hinge at the hips and extend the free leg straight behind you.
Lower your torso until it is nearly parallel to the floor, back flat.
Squeeze your glute to stand tall again.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 徒手单腿硬拉(手臂和腿伸直)
items.nameEn: single leg bodyweight deadlift with arm and leg extended
items.description: A single-leg hinge with your arms extended that trains hamstrings, glutes and balance.
steps: Stand on one leg with arms reaching forward.
Soften your standing knee slightly.
Hinge at the hips as your free leg lifts behind you.
Keep your back flat and body in a long line.
Return to standing and repeat, then switch legs.

items.name: 徒手单腿硬拉(顶球)
items.nameEn: bodyweight single leg deadlift against ball
items.description: A single-leg hinge with a ball against the wall for balance. It trains hamstrings and balance.
steps: Stand facing a wall with a ball between your hand and the wall.
Lift one foot slightly.
Hinge at the hip as the free leg extends back.
Keep your back flat.
Return to standing.
Switch legs after the set.

items.name: 徒手单腿硬拉保持
items.description: A one-legged hinge held at the bottom. It builds balance and the hamstrings.
steps: Stand on one leg with a soft knee.
Hinge forward from the hips as the other leg extends behind you.
Keep your back flat until your torso is nearly parallel to the floor.
Hold for several seconds, hips level.
Return upright and switch legs.

items.name: 徒手单腿硬拉触脚尖
items.nameEn: bodyweight single leg deadlift toe touch
items.description: A single-leg hinge where you reach to touch your toes. It trains balance and the hamstrings.
steps: Stand on one leg with a soft knee.
Hinge forward as the free leg lifts behind you.
Reach your hands toward the toes of the standing foot.
Keep your back flat and hips square.
Stand back up with control. Finish your reps and switch legs.

items.name: 徒手单腿罗马尼亚硬拉
items.description: A single leg Romanian deadlift without weight. It trains the hamstrings and balance.
steps: Stand on one leg with a slight bend in the knee.
Hinge forward as the other leg lifts behind you.
Keep your back flat.
Lower until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Squeeze your glutes to stand.
Finish reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 徒手单腿靠墙深蹲
items.description: One leg squat with your back against a wall for balance. It builds single leg strength.
steps: Lean your back on a wall and lift one foot off the floor.
Place your standing foot forward.
Slide down into a squat as far as you can control.
Press through your heel to rise.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 徒手后撤弓步蹲
items.description: A lunge where you step back instead of forward. It is gentler on the knees and focuses on the glutes.
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot back and lower until both knees are bent at about 90 degrees.
Keep your torso upright and your front heel planted.
Push through your front foot to return to standing.
Alternate legs or finish all reps on one side first.

items.name: 徒手后撤弓步蹲过头伸展
items.nameEn: bodyweight reverse lunge with overhead reach
items.description: A reverse lunge with an overhead reach that works your legs and stretches your torso.
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot back and lower into a lunge.
Reach both arms overhead as you lower.
Push through your front foot to stand.
Alternate legs.

items.name: 徒手四分之一深蹲
items.description: A shallow squat that goes only a quarter of the way down. Good for beginners and for warm-ups.
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Push your hips back and bend your knees a short way.
Keep your chest up and heels down.
Press through your feet to stand tall.
Repeat at a steady pace.

items.name: 徒手垫高脚跟深蹲
items.description: A squat with the heels raised on a small platform, shifting more work to the quads and allowing a deeper knee bend.
steps: Place your heels on a small plate or wedge, feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold your arms in front for balance.
Bend your knees and sink down with your chest tall.
Let your knees travel forward over your toes.
Drive back up through your whole foot.
Keep your core tight throughout.

items.name: 徒手帕特里克步
items.description: A step-down drill that builds knee and hip control. It strengthens the quads and glutes.
steps: Stand on a low step on one leg.
Slowly bend the knee and lower the other heel to the floor.
Keep your knee tracking over your toes.
Tap the floor lightly.
Push through the standing leg to rise.
Do your reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 徒手彼得森步(箱上)
items.description: A step-down drill with a slow, controlled lowering. It builds quad strength and knee stability.
steps: Stand on a step box on one leg.
Lower the other foot slowly toward the floor.
Keep your knee stable and your torso tall.
Touch the floor lightly.
Rise back up through the working leg.
Do your reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 徒手慢速转爆发深蹲
items.description: A squat that goes down slowly and then jumps up fast, training control, leg strength and power together.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Lower into a squat over about three seconds.
Pause briefly at the bottom with your chest up.
Explode upward into a jump.
Land softly with bent knees and go straight into the next rep.

items.name: 徒手摆荡
items.description: A hip hinge swing with your arms moving like a kettlebell swing, but with no weight. It teaches the hip drive and warms up the glutes.
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and arms hanging.
Hinge back at your hips and swing your arms between your legs.
Snap your hips forward and stand tall.
Let your arms float up to chest height.
Repeat in a smooth rhythm.

items.name: 徒手支撑深蹲
items.description: A squat where you hold on to a support to stay balanced, ideal for learning depth and form.
steps: Hold on to a sturdy support at chest height.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit your hips back and down into a squat.
Keep your chest up and your heels down.
Stand back up by pushing through your feet.

items.name: 徒手早安式体前屈
items.description: Hip-hinge pattern with no load that warms up the hamstrings and lower back.
steps: Stand with feet hip width and hands behind your head.
Soften your knees and push your hips back.
Lower your torso with a flat back until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand.
Keep your spine neutral.

items.name: 徒手波利金步
items.description: A controlled step-up and down drill often used for knee strength. It trains the quads and glutes.
steps: Stand with one foot on a low step.
Lower the other foot toward the floor with control.
Keep your knee in line with your toes.
Touch the floor lightly.
Drive back up through the working leg.
Do your reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 徒手深蹲
items.description: A basic bodyweight squat that builds leg strength and mobility.
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Reach your arms forward for balance.
Sit your hips back and down until your thighs are parallel.
Keep your chest up.
Drive through your feet to stand.

items.name: 徒手深蹲(版本2)
items.description: A basic bodyweight squat that trains the legs and hips and builds a solid movement pattern.
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly out.
Push your hips back and bend your knees.
Lower until thighs are at least parallel with chest up.
Drive through your heels to stand.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.

items.name: 徒手窄站距深蹲
items.description: Squat with feet close together to emphasise the quads.
steps: Stand with feet close together.
Extend your arms forward for balance.
Sit down and back, keeping your heels down.
Descend until your thighs are parallel.
Press up to stand.

items.name: 徒手窄距深蹲弓步
items.description: A lunge done with a narrow stance and no weight. It targets the quads and glutes while challenging balance.
steps: Stand with feet close together and hands on your hips or in front of you.
Step one foot back and lower into a lunge, keeping your feet in a narrow line.
Drop your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and chest up.
Push through the front heel to stand back up.
Switch legs and repeat.

items.name: 徒手站姿西西深蹲
items.description: A standing squat where your knees travel forward as you lean back, strongly working the quads.
steps: Stand holding a support, feet hip-width apart.
Rise onto the balls of your feet.
Bend your knees forward and lean back.
Lower as far as you can control.
Press back up.

items.name: 徒手箱上帕特里克步
items.description: A step-down from a box that strengthens the quads and teaches knee control.
steps: Stand on the edge of a step box on one leg.
Lower the other foot toward the floor.
Keep your knee in line with your toes.
Touch the floor lightly.
Push up through the standing leg.
Do your reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 徒手箱上波利金步
items.description: A box step-down drill that builds knee strength and control in the quads and glutes.
steps: Stand on a step box on one leg.
Lower the other foot toward the floor with control.
Keep your torso upright.
Lightly tap the floor.
Press up through your working leg.
Do your reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 徒手箱式深蹲
items.description: A squat that lightly touches a box behind you to teach depth, hip hinge and control.
steps: Place a box behind you and stand with feet a bit wider than shoulders.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower toward the box.
Lightly touch the box without dropping onto it.
Drive through your heels to stand back up.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.

items.name: 徒手脉冲高脚杯深蹲
items.description: A squat held low with small pulses, with your hands clasped at your chest as if holding a weight. It builds thigh endurance.
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hands clasped at your chest.
Squat down to a deep position.
Pulse up and down a few centimetres at the bottom.
Keep your chest tall and heels down.
Stand up after the planned pulses.

items.name: 徒手脚跟垫高保加利亚分腿蹲
items.nameEn: bodyweight heel elevated bulgarian split squat
items.description: Split squat with the front heel raised, loading the quads more directly.
steps: Place your rear foot on a bench and front heel on a small plate.
Hold your hands at your chest.
Lower straight down.
Keep your front knee over your toes.
Push up and switch legs.

items.name: 徒手脚跟垫高前蹲
items.description: A bodyweight squat with your heels raised. It shifts the work to the quads and allows a deeper position.
steps: Place your heels on a low plate or wedge.
Hold your hands in front of your chest.
Sit down into a deep squat with your chest tall.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Press up to stand and repeat.

items.name: 徒手脚跟垫高深蹲
items.description: Squat with heels raised to emphasize the quads.
steps: Stand with your heels on a small plate.
Extend your arms in front.
Squat deep with your chest up.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Stand back up.

items.name: 徒手臀部主导踏阶
items.description: A step-up that emphasises the glutes by leaning slightly forward. It builds single-leg strength.
steps: Stand in front of a bench and place one foot on it.
Lean your torso slightly forward.
Press through your heel and step up until standing.
Lower slowly back down.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 徒手蛙式髋推
items.description: A glute bridge with the soles of your feet together and knees open, which shifts the focus onto your glutes.
steps: Lie on your back with the soles of your feet together and knees falling out.
Keep your feet close to your hips.
Push through your feet to lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

items.name: 徒手行走低位弓步蹲
items.description: A walking lunge with a deep, low position that opens the hips and works the glutes and thighs.
steps: Stand tall with your hands on your hips.
Step forward into a long stride.
Lower your back knee close to the floor.
Push through your front foot and step the back leg forward.
Continue walking forward, alternating legs.

items.name: 徒手跪姿保持到站立
items.description: Rise from a half-kneeling position to standing. It is a bodyweight move for hip and leg strength and balance.
steps: Kneel on one knee with the other foot flat in front.
Hold your arms in front of you for balance.
Drive through the front foot to stand tall.
Lower back down under control.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 徒手跪姿西西深蹲
items.description: A kneeling lean-back that isolates the quads with a deep stretch at the front of the thigh.
steps: Kneel with your knees hip-width apart and a support nearby.
Squeeze your glutes to keep your hips forward.
Lean back slowly as far as you can.
Pull back up with your quads.
Keep a straight line from knees to head.

items.name: 徒手踏箱上台阶
items.description: A basic step-up onto a box that builds leg and hip strength and single-leg control.
steps: Stand facing a step box with feet hip-width apart.
Place one foot fully on the box.
Push through your heel to step up and stand tall.
Bring the other foot up to meet it.
Step down with control.
Finish your reps, then switch the lead leg.

items.name: 徒手过头前弓步蹲
items.description: A forward lunge with your arms stretched overhead, adding a core and shoulder challenge to the leg work.
steps: Stand tall with your arms extended overhead.
Step forward into a long stride.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your ribs down and arms in line with your ears.
Push back to the start and alternate legs.

items.name: 徒手过头深蹲
items.description: A deep squat performed with your arms locked out overhead. It trains the legs while testing shoulder and hip mobility.
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and raise both arms straight overhead.
Brace your core and keep your arms in line with your ears.
Sit your hips back and down into a deep squat, chest tall.
Drive through your heels to stand, keeping your arms locked overhead.

items.name: 徒手靠墙静蹲
items.description: A squat with your back against a wall, which keeps your torso upright and takes pressure off the lower back. Good for building leg endurance.
steps: Lean your back against a wall with your feet about a step in front of you.
Slide down until your thighs are roughly parallel to the floor.
Keep your knees in line with your toes and your back flat on the wall.
Press through your heels to slide back up.
Repeat for the planned number of reps.

items.name: 快乐婴儿式
items.description: Lying on your back and holding your feet with knees wide. Opens the hips and relaxes the lower back.
steps: Lie on your back and bend your knees toward your chest.
Hold the outsides of your feet.
Open your knees wide toward your armpits.
Rock gently side to side and hold for 5 slow breaths.
Release your feet and rest.

items.name: 快速小步跑 v. 2
items.description: A quick on-the-spot footwork drill with fast, light steps. It raises the heart rate and builds foot speed.
steps: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双臂放在身体两侧。
首先快速上下移动双脚，就像原地跑步一样。
保持动作快速而轻盈，重点放在脚掌上。
继续所需的持续时间或重复次数。

items.name: 怪物步
items.description: With a band around your ankles, you step sideways in a slight squat. Fires up the glutes and outer hips.
steps: 在脚踝周围放置一根阻力带。
双脚分开与肩同宽站立，稍微弯曲膝盖。
右脚向一侧迈出一步，保持阻力带的张力。
