左脚跟随，向一侧迈步以返回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。

items.name: 悬挂带分腿蹲
items.description: A split squat with the rear foot in a suspension strap. It builds the quads and glutes and challenges balance.
steps: 背对悬吊训练器站立，双脚与肩同宽。
向前伸展一条腿，将脚背放在悬吊训练器的脚托中。
弯曲站立的腿，将身体降低到弓步位置，保持胸部向上，膝盖与脚趾对齐。
推动脚后跟返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换腿。

items.name: 战士一式
items.description: A lunge with arms raised overhead. It stretches the hip flexors and chest and strengthens the legs.
steps: Step one foot back into a long stance, with the back foot turned out slightly.
Bend the front knee over the ankle.
Square your hips toward the front.
Raise both arms overhead and lift your chest.
Hold for 5 breaths, then switch sides.

items.name: 战士三式
items.description: A one-leg balance with the torso and back leg parallel to the floor. Builds balance and strength.
steps: Stand on one leg with your arms overhead.
Hinge forward and lift the back leg behind you.
Bring your torso and back leg level with the floor.
Hold for 5 slow breaths with your hips square.
Lower and switch legs.

items.name: 战士二式
items.description: A wide lunge with arms extended to the sides. It strengthens the legs and opens the hips.
steps: Stand with feet wide, turn your front foot out and back foot slightly in.
Bend your front knee over the ankle.
Extend both arms parallel to the floor.
Gaze over your front hand.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

items.name: 战士二式 v. 2
items.description: A wide lunge with arms stretched to the sides. It strengthens the legs and builds stamina.
steps: Stand with feet wide and turn your front foot out.
Bend the front knee over the ankle.
Extend your arms out to the sides at shoulder height.
Turn your head to look over the front hand.
Hold for 5 breaths, then switch sides.

items.name: 战士二式瑜伽体式
items.description: A strong standing pose with wide legs and arms outstretched, building leg strength, hip opening and stamina.
steps: Stand with your feet wide apart and turn your front foot out.
Bend the front knee over the ankle.
Extend your arms out to the sides at shoulder height.
Gaze over your front fingertips and keep your torso upright.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

items.name: 战士式
items.description: A standing yoga pose that builds strength and stretches the hips.
steps: Take a long stance.
Bend your front knee over your ankle.
Raise your arms.
Keep your back leg straight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.

items.name: 手触脚式
items.description: Fold forward and slide your hands under your feet. It stretches the hamstrings, calves and back.
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Hinge at the hips and fold forward with a long spine.
Slide your hands under your feet with palms up, toes on your fingers.
Pull gently to deepen the stretch while keeping your knees slightly soft.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.

items.name: 托马斯正面测试
items.description: The frontal-view version of the Thomas test, checking for tight hip flexors and inner thighs while you lie on a bench.
steps: Sit at the end of a bench and lie back, pulling one knee to your chest.
Let the other leg hang down off the edge, fully relaxed.
Keep your lower back pressed down and your pelvis still.
Watch whether the hanging leg drifts outward or the thigh lifts.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Switch legs and compare.

items.name: 托马斯测试
items.description: A hip flexor length test where you lie on the edge of a bench and see how freely the thigh hangs.
steps: Sit at the end of a bench, then lie back and hug one knee to your chest.
Let the other leg hang off the edge with the thigh relaxed.
Keep your lower back flat on the bench.
Notice whether the hanging thigh rises above the bench or the knee straightens.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Switch legs and compare.

items.name: 扭矩坦克推
items.description: A hard push of a torque tank sled across the floor that fires up the legs and the heart.
steps: Grip the handles of the tank and lean forward.
Keep your back flat and core tight.
Drive with short, powerful steps.
Keep your hips low and push over the distance.
Rest and repeat.

items.name: 扭腿弓步式
items.description: A lunge with a twist toward the front leg. Opens the hips and spine.
steps: Step into a low lunge with your back knee down.
Bring your palms together at your chest.
Twist toward the front leg and hook your elbow outside the knee.
Hold for 5 slow breaths.
Switch legs.

items.name: 扭转三角式
items.description: A standing forward bend with a twist. Stretches the back of the legs and rotates the spine.
steps: Stand with your feet wide, back foot turned slightly.
Hinge forward with a flat back.
Place one hand down and reach the other arm up as you twist.
Hold for 5 slow breaths.
Come up and switch sides.

items.name: 扭转侧角式
items.nameEn: revolved side angle pose parivrtta parsvakonasana
items.description: A deep lunge with a twist and hands pressed together. It strengthens the legs and wrings out the spine.
steps: Step into a long lunge with the back heel lifted.
Bring your palms together at your chest.
Twist your torso and hook the opposite elbow outside the front knee.
Press your palms together and look up or ahead.
Hold for 3 to 5 breaths, then switch sides.

items.name: 扭转侧角式
items.description: A deep lunge with a twist and the arms stretched wide. Builds leg strength and opens the spine.
steps: Step into a lunge with your back heel lifted.
Bring your palms together at your chest.
Twist and hook your elbow outside the front knee.
Hold for 5 slow breaths.
Switch sides.

items.name: 扭转抬髋
items.description: Lying on your back, you lift your hips and add a gentle twist. It wakes up the glutes and obliques.
steps: 仰卧，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在身体两侧以获得支撑。
收紧臀部并将臀部抬离地面，从膝盖到肩膀形成一条直线。
在保持臀部抬起的同时，将下半身扭转到右侧，使膝盖靠近地面。
返回起始位置并向左侧重复扭转。
继续交替扭转所需的重复次数。

items.name: 扭转椅式
items.description: A chair squat with a twist. Strengthens the legs while rotating the spine.
steps: Stand and sink your hips back into a chair pose.
Bring your palms together at your chest.
Twist and hook one elbow outside the opposite knee.
Hold for 5 slow breaths with your knees together.
Untwist and repeat on the other side.

items.name: 扭转深蹲
items.description: A squat that adds a torso twist as you stand. It trains the legs and rotational control.
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hands together at your chest.
Sit down into a squat.
As you stand, rotate your torso to one side.
Return to the centre and squat again.
Alternate twisting sides.

items.name: 扭转跨步拉伸
items.description: Step into a lunge with a twist to open the hips and loosen the trunk.
steps: Stand tall.
Step forward into a lunge.
Twist your torso toward the front leg.
Return to centre and step back.
Alternate sides for 8-10 reps each.

items.name: 扶持便盆式深蹲
items.description: A deep squat done holding a support for balance. Works the glutes and legs.
steps: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，脚趾稍微向外。
抓住稳定的支撑物，例如椅子或墙壁，以保持平衡。
弯曲膝盖并将臀部向后推，将身体降低至蹲姿。
在整个动作过程中保持挺胸、背部挺直。
在底部停顿片刻，然后推动脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 扶持单腿深蹲
items.description: A one-leg squat using a support for balance, building strength in each leg.
steps: Stand next to a sturdy support and hold it lightly with one hand.
Lift one foot slightly off the floor in front of you.
Sit your hips back and lower on the standing leg.
Keep your knee tracking over your toes.
Push through your heel to stand back up.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 扶持单腿站姿髋屈肌和膝伸肌拉伸
items.nameEn: supported one leg standing hip flexor and knee extensor stretch
items.description: A supported standing quad stretch that also opens the front of the hip.
steps: Stand tall holding a wall or chair for support.
Bend one knee and hold the ankle behind you.
Pull the heel toward your glutes and push the hip slightly forward.
Keep your knees close together.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

items.name: 抬腿腘绳肌拉伸
items.description: Lying on your back with one leg raised, you draw it toward you to stretch the hamstring.
steps: 平躺，双腿伸展。
弯曲一侧膝盖，将其靠近胸部，握住大腿或小腿。
尽可能伸直腿，同时保持腿抬高。
保持拉伸 20-30 秒。
换另一条腿重复上述步骤。

items.name: 抬腿膝屈肌拉伸
items.description: A hamstring stretch with one leg raised onto a support, easing tension in the back of the thigh.
steps: Place one heel on a low bench or step in front of you with the leg straight.
Stand tall with the standing knee soft.
Hinge forward from the hips, keeping your back flat, until you feel a stretch behind the raised thigh.
Keep your toes pointing up and breathe slowly.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

items.name: 抬膝
items.description: Lifting your knee toward your chest to warm up the hips and activate the hip flexors. A simple dynamic drill.
steps: Stand tall with your arms at your sides.
Lift one knee up toward your chest.
Hold it for a moment.
Lower the foot with control.
Alternate legs.
Keep your standing leg steady and your back straight.

items.name: 抬髋桥式
items.description: A hip bridge that lifts the hips off the floor from a lying position. It builds the glutes and hamstrings.
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat.
Place your arms at your sides.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your ribs down and your neck relaxed.

items.name: 抬髋桥式 v. 2
items.description: A second version of the hip bridge lifting the hips from the floor. It strengthens the glutes and hamstrings.
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat.
Place your arms at your sides.
Press through your heels and lift your hips toward the ceiling.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly to the floor.
Keep your ribs down and avoid overarching.

items.name: 抬高单腿臀桥
items.description: A single-leg glute bridge with your feet raised. It strongly works the glutes and hamstrings.
steps: Lie on your back with one foot raised on a bench or step.
Extend the other leg straight up.
Drive through your heel and lift your hips.
Squeeze your glute at the top without arching your back.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 抱头起身
items.description: A bodyweight get-up with your hands behind your head. It builds leg strength, balance and hip control.
steps: Kneel on the floor, with your hands behind your head.
Keep your chest tall and your core braced.
Step one foot forward and drive up through it to stand.
Lower back down with control to kneeling.
Alternate the leading leg on each rep.

items.name: 抱头跳跃深蹲
items.description: A jump squat with hands behind your head for an explosive leg workout.
steps: Stand with your hands behind your head and feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down until your thighs are about parallel.
Explode upward into a jump.
Land softly on bent knees.
Go straight into the next rep.

items.name: 抱膝贴胸
items.description: Stand and pull one knee up to your chest with both hands. It stretches the glutes and loosens the hip and lower back.
steps: 首先站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
弯曲膝盖并将身体降低至蹲姿。
当你蹲下时，将膝盖抬向胸部，并用手臂抱住它们。
保持这个姿势一会儿，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 摇摆蛙式拉伸
items.description: A rocking frog stretch that opens the hips and inner thighs. Helps loosen the glutes and groin.
steps: 首先跪在地上，膝盖分开与臀部同宽。
将双手放在身前的地面上以获得支撑。
慢慢向前倾，将重心转移到双手上，并将双腿伸到身后。
当你将臀部向后推向天花板时，保持背部挺直并收紧臀部。
保持这个姿势几秒钟，感受臀部的拉伸。
弯曲膝盖并降低臀部，慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 支撑深蹲
items.description: A squat where you hold onto something for balance. It is a friendly way to practise depth and build leg strength.
steps: Stand holding a stable support at about chest height, feet shoulder width apart.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Sit your hips back and bend your knees to lower down.
Go as deep as you can with your heels down.
Push through your feet to stand back up.
Use the support for balance, not to pull yourself up.

items.name: 斜卧膝屈肌拉伸
items.description: Lying on your back, you lift one straight leg to stretch the hamstring with the lower back supported.
steps: Lie on your back with both legs straight.
Lift one leg toward the ceiling, holding behind the thigh or calf.
Keep the knee as straight as is comfortable and the other leg flat on the floor.
Gently draw the leg toward you until you feel a pull behind the thigh.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

items.name: 斜卧膝屈肌拉伸(用毛巾)
items.nameEn: recumbent knee flexor stretch with towel
items.description: A lying hamstring stretch where a towel around the foot lets you pull the leg closer without strain.
steps: Lie on your back and loop a towel around the ball of one foot.
Raise that leg toward the ceiling, holding both ends of the towel.
Keep the knee nearly straight and the other leg flat on the floor.
Gently pull the towel until you feel a stretch behind the thigh.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

items.name: 斜卧髋外旋肌和髋伸肌拉伸
items.nameEn: recumbent hip external rotator and hip extensor stretch
items.description: A lying stretch for the deep hip rotators and glutes, pulling the knee toward the chest.
steps: Lie on your back and bend both knees.
Bring one knee toward your chest and turn it slightly outward.
Hold the shin and ankle and draw the leg closer.
Keep your lower back resting on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

items.name: 斜卧髋外旋肌和髋伸肌拉伸(交叉腿)
items.nameEn: recumbent hip external rotator and hip extensor stretch (crossed leg)
items.description: A reclined figure four stretch for the buttocks and deep hip muscles.
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee, then pull the legs toward your chest until the buttock stretches.
Keep your head and shoulders relaxed on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

items.name: 斜向弓步蹲
items.description: A lunge stepped out at an angle that trains the legs and hips in a different plane, with a quick, springy pace.
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot out diagonally, about 45 degrees away from you.
Bend both knees and lower into a lunge, keeping your chest up.
Push off the front foot to return to the start.
Alternate legs each rep.
Keep your front knee pointing the same way as your toes.

items.name: 旋转勾踢
items.description: A spinning kick where you turn your body and sweep the heel in a hook around the target. Great for balance and coordination.
steps: Stand in a fighting stance with your hands up.
Turn your head and shoulders to look behind you.
Spin on the ball of your supporting foot.
Swing your kicking leg around and hook the heel across the target.
Land in a balanced stance.
Repeat, then switch sides.

items.name: 旋转后踢
items.description: A kick where you turn your back to the target and thrust the heel straight back, building rotation and balance.
steps: Stand in a fighting stance with your hands up.
Turn your head and shoulders to look behind you.
Pivot on your supporting foot.
Kick your leg straight back with the heel leading.
Keep your torso leaning slightly forward for balance.
Return to stance and repeat, then switch sides.

items.name: 无臂祈祷式拉伸
items.description: A kneeling stretch that opens up your shoulders and lats as you sink your chest toward the floor.
steps: Kneel on the floor and sit your hips back toward your heels.
Reach your arms forward and lower your chest.
Let your forehead rest near the floor.
Relax your shoulders and breathe deeply.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.

items.name: 早安式深蹲
items.description: A combo of a hip hinge and a squat that warms up and strengthens the glutes, hamstrings and lower back.
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hands behind your head.
Push your hips back and hinge forward with a flat back.
Come back up to standing.
Bend your knees and sink into a squat with your chest tall.
Stand up and repeat the hinge, then the squat.
Keep your core braced and your weight over your mid-foot.

items.name: 树式
items.description: Balance on one leg with the other foot resting on your inner thigh. It builds balance, focus and hip strength.
steps: Stand tall and shift your weight onto one foot.
Place the sole of the other foot on your inner calf or thigh, never on the knee.
Bring your palms together at your chest or raise them overhead.
Fix your eyes on one point to stay steady.
Hold for 5 breaths, then switch legs.

items.name: 桌面式桥
items.description: Face-up bridge on hands and feet that lifts the hips into a table shape. It builds the glutes, hamstrings and shoulder stability.
steps: Sit on the floor with knees bent and feet flat, hands behind you with fingers pointing toward your feet.
Press through your hands and heels to lift your hips.
Raise until your torso and thighs are level like a tabletop.
Squeeze your glutes and keep your head in line with your spine.
Hold briefly, then lower your hips back to the floor under control.

items.name: 桌面式桥转体
items.description: A table top bridge with an arm sweep and trunk rotation. It trains the glutes while opening the chest and challenging balance.
steps: Set up in a table top bridge with hips lifted and hands under your shoulders.
Shift your weight onto one hand and both feet.
Lift the free arm and reach it up and over your body as you rotate your chest.
Keep your hips high and level throughout.
Return the arm to the floor and repeat, then switch sides.

items.name: 桌面桥开合跳
items.description: From a reverse tabletop, you hop your feet apart and together like a jumping jack. It works the glutes and legs.
steps: Sit with hands behind you, then lift hips into a tabletop with knees bent.
Squeeze your glutes to keep your hips high.
Hop your feet wide.
Hop them back together.
Keep going at a steady pace.
Keep your hips high and don't let them sag.

items.name: 桥式瑜伽体式(setu bandhasana)
items.description: A yoga backbend that strengthens the glutes and opens the chest and hip flexors.
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet hip width apart.
Place your arms alongside your body, palms down.
Press through your feet and lift your hips.
Roll your shoulders under and lengthen your chest.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
Lower down slowly.

items.name: 桥式髋外展
items.description: A glute bridge where you press the knees apart at the top. It fires up the outer hips and glutes.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips into a bridge.
Keeping the hips high, open both knees out to the sides.
Bring the knees back together without dropping the hips.
Lower slowly to the floor and repeat.
Keep your ribs down so your lower back does not arch.

items.name: 棍棒弓步蹲过头上举拉伸
items.nameEn: stick lunge with overhead raise stretch
items.description: A lunge combined with a stick held overhead. Opens the hip flexors of the back leg and the shoulders at the same time.
steps: Hold a stick in both hands and step into a long lunge.
Lower your back knee toward the floor while keeping your torso upright.
Raise the stick overhead with straight arms.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling the stretch at the front of the back hip.
Step back and repeat on the other leg.

items.name: 棍棒扭转弓步蹲拉伸
items.description: A lunge with a trunk twist while holding a stick. Stretches the hip flexors and loosens the spine.
steps: Hold the stick across your chest or in front with both hands and step into a lunge.
Keep your front knee over your ankle.
Twist your torso over the front leg.
Hold for 15-20 seconds, breathing evenly.
Untwist, step back and switch legs.

items.name: 棍棒过头完整相扑深蹲拉伸
items.nameEn: stick overhead full sumo squat stretch
items.description: A deep wide-stance squat while holding a stick overhead. Opens the inner thighs and hips and challenges shoulder mobility.
steps: Stand with your feet wider than your shoulders and toes turned out.
Raise the stick overhead with straight arms.
Sit down between your legs, keeping your chest tall and knees tracking over your toes.
Hold the bottom position for 20-30 seconds.
Press up through your feet to stand.

items.name: 椅上伸腿拉伸
items.description: Using a chair for support, you extend one leg to stretch the thigh and hip. It loosens up the quads.
steps: 坐在椅子边缘，背部挺直，双脚平放在地面上。
将一只腿伸直在身前，脚跟保持在地面上。
稍微向前倾，感受股四头肌的拉伸。
保持这个姿势20-30秒。
换腿并重复拉伸。

items.name: 椅上坐姿交替伸膝
items.nameEn: seated alternate knee extension on chair
items.description: A seated leg extension done by alternating legs, working the thighs without equipment.
steps: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Straighten one knee by lifting the foot until the leg is level.
Squeeze your thigh, then lower slowly.
Switch legs and keep alternating.

items.name: 椅上坐姿交替外展扭转
items.nameEn: sitting alternate abduction twist on a chair
items.description: A seated move combining a leg out to the side with a twist. It gently works the hips and waist.
steps: Sit tall near the edge of a chair.
Lift one leg and open it out to the side.
Twist your torso toward that leg.
Return to centre.
Alternate sides.

items.name: 椅上坐姿前屈拉伸
items.nameEn: seated forward bend stretch on a chair
items.description: A seated forward fold that stretches the hamstrings and lower back.
steps: Sit near the front of a sturdy chair and extend one leg with the heel on the floor.
Keep your back long.
Hinge forward from the hips and reach toward your toes.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs and repeat.

items.name: 椅上坐姿腘绳肌拉伸
items.nameEn: seated hamstring stretch on a chair
items.description: A gentle seated stretch for the back of the thigh, done on a chair. It helps loosen tight hamstrings.
steps: Sit near the front edge of a chair.
Extend one leg straight with your heel on the floor and toes up.
Hinge forward from your hips with a flat back until you feel a stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing steadily.
Switch legs and repeat.

items.name: 椅子上台阶
items.description: A step-up onto a sturdy chair, a simple single-leg exercise.
steps: Face a sturdy chair.
Place one foot fully on the seat.
Drive through that heel to stand up.
Bring the other foot up.
Step down with control.
Do all reps on one leg, then switch.

items.name: 椅子保加利亚分腿蹲
items.description: A single-leg squat with your rear foot resting on a chair, which builds strength and balance.
steps: Stand facing away from a chair and rest the top of one foot on it.
Step your front foot forward so it is stable.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Push through your front foot to stand.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 椅子辅助坐姿腘绳肌拉伸
items.description: A seated stretch using a chair to lengthen the back of the thigh without a deep fold.
steps: Sit on the front edge of a chair.
Straighten one leg with the heel on the floor and toes up.
Keep the other foot flat and your back long.
Hinge forward at the hips until you feel a stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Switch legs.

items.name: 楼梯跳
items.description: Explosive jumps up a flight of stairs that build leg power and speed.
steps: Stand at the bottom of a staircase with your feet together.
Bend your knees and swing your arms back.
Jump up onto a step, landing softly with both feet.
Step back down carefully.
Reset and repeat.

items.name: 横向上台阶
items.description: A step-up performed side-on to the bench. It works the glutes and quads while challenging your balance.
steps: Stand sideways next to a bench or step.
Place the inside foot fully on top.
Drive through that heel and step up until your leg is straight.
Bring your other foot up to meet it.
Step back down with control, finish your reps, then switch sides.

items.name: 毛巾地面俯卧背伸
items.description: A lying back extension while holding a towel taut. It builds your lower back and glutes with extra upper back work.
steps: Lie face down holding a taut towel in front of you.
Lift your chest and legs off the floor.
Keep pulling the towel apart.
Pause at the top.
Lower back down with control.

items.name: 毛巾地面反向滑行腿弯举
items.nameEn: reverse sliding leg curl on floor with towel
items.description: A hamstring curl on a towel where you slide the heels away and pull them back. It is a challenging bodyweight hamstring move.
steps: Lie on your back with your heels on a towel on a smooth floor.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Slide your feet away from you by extending the knees.
Pull the heels back toward your hips with your hamstrings.
Keep your hips high the whole set.
Lower to the floor when you finish.

items.name: 气球训练
items.description: A playful balance and leg drill where you keep a balloon in the air using quick footwork and small jumps.
steps: Toss a balloon into the air in an open space.
Stay on the balls of your feet with bent knees.
Move under the balloon and tap it up.
Use small hops to reach it.
Keep it up for 30-60 seconds.

items.name: 沙发拉伸
items.description: A deep kneeling stretch with the back foot raised, aimed at the thighs and hip flexors.
steps: Kneel facing away from a wall or couch with one shin up against it.
Place your other foot flat on the floor in front in a lunge.
Squeeze your glute and tuck your pelvis under.
Lift your torso upright until you feel the stretch in the front of your rear thigh.
Hold for 30-60 seconds.
Switch legs.

items.name: 深屈膝
items.description: A full-depth bodyweight squat. It builds leg strength and works the mobility of hips and ankles.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit your hips back and down as deep as you can.
Keep your heels down and chest up.
Pause at the bottom.
Drive up to standing.

items.name: 深度跳
items.description: A drop from a box followed by a quick vertical jump. It develops reactive power.
steps: Stand at the edge of a low box.
Step off and land on both feet.
Rebound immediately into a maximum vertical jump.
Spend as little time on the ground as you can.
Land softly and reset for the next rep.

items.name: 深度跳接立定跳远
items.description: A drop off a box into an immediate broad jump. It trains reactive leg power.
steps: Stand at the edge of a low box.
Step off and land on both feet.
Immediately explode forward into a broad jump.
Swing your arms for momentum.
Land softly with bent knees and reset.

items.name: 深弓步接腘绳肌拉伸
items.description: A flowing stretch from a deep lunge into a straight front leg. It opens the hip flexors and stretches the hamstrings.
steps: Step into a deep lunge with both hands on the floor.
Hold for a breath and feel the front of the back hip open.
Shift your hips back and straighten the front leg.
Flex your front foot and fold gently over it.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds.
Return to the lunge and switch legs.

items.name: 深跳接跨栏跳
items.description: Drop off a box and hop over a hurdle.
steps: Stand on a box.
Step off.
Land softly.
Jump over the hurdle immediately.
Land softly.
Reset.

items.name: 深蹲
items.description: The basic bodyweight squat. It trains the thighs and glutes and teaches solid lower body mechanics.
steps: Stand with your feet about shoulder width apart and toes slightly out.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower down.
Go as deep as you can while keeping your heels down and chest up.
Drive through your feet to stand back up.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.

items.name: 深蹲(手臂上举)
items.description: A bodyweight squat with arms reaching overhead. It trains the legs and challenges shoulder mobility and trunk stability.
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and reach both arms overhead.
Keep your arms in line with your ears and your ribs down.
Sit your hips back and down until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Keep your heels down and knees tracking over your toes.
Drive up through your feet to stand tall.

items.name: 深蹲侧踢
items.description: Squatting down and then kicking one leg out to the side. It trains the thighs and glutes.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Squat down with your chest up.
Stand up and kick your right leg out to the side.
Return the foot to the floor and drop into the next squat.
Alternate sides each rep.

items.name: 深蹲团身跳
items.description: A squat that explodes into a tuck jump. It trains explosive leg power and fast landings.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Lower into a squat with your arms back.
Explode upward and pull your knees toward your chest.
Land softly with bent knees.
Sink straight into the next squat and repeat.

items.name: 深蹲开合跳
items.description: Jumping jack variation that stays in a squat for a leg-burning cardio move.
steps: Start in a squat with hands at your chest.
Jump your feet out wide.
Hop back to the narrow squat stance.
Stay low the whole time.
Land softly and keep your chest up.

items.name: 深蹲灵活性练习
items.description: A deep squat hold with gentle movements. It opens up the hips and ankles.
steps: Stand with feet slightly wider than your shoulders.
Squat down as deep as is comfortable.
Press your elbows against your knees and keep your chest up.
Rock gently side to side.
Stay for 20-30 seconds, then stand.

items.name: 深蹲灵活性练习
items.description: A deep squat hold and rock that opens the hips and ankles.
steps: Stand with feet slightly wider than shoulder width.
Sink into a deep squat, keeping your heels down.
Press your elbows gently against your knees.
Rock side to side and sit tall.
Spend 30-45 seconds there, then stand up.

items.name: 深蹲灵活性组合练习
items.description: A short flow of deep squat positions that opens up the hips, knees and ankles. Good as a warm-up before leg work.
steps: Stand with your feet a little wider than shoulder width and toes turned out slightly.
Sink into a deep squat and keep your heels on the floor.
Press your elbows against your knees to open the hips and hold for a moment.
Shift gently from side to side, then rock forward and back.
Stand up tall and repeat the flow for 6-8 rounds.
Keep your chest lifted and your back long throughout.

items.name: 深蹲膝盖位置
items.description: A bodyweight squat focused on where your knees travel, helping you learn to track them over your toes.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart and toes slightly out.
Brace your core and lift your chest.
Bend at the hips and knees to lower into a squat.
Push your knees out so they follow the line of your toes.
Go down as deep as feels controlled.
Drive up through your whole foot to stand.

items.name: 深蹲至过头伸展
items.description: A squat followed by reaching your arms overhead. It trains the quads and glutes and opens up the shoulders.
steps: 站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，脚趾稍微外翻。
弯曲膝盖并将臀部向后推，将身体降低至蹲姿。
当你从深蹲中站起来时，将手臂伸过头顶，伸向天花板。
放下手臂并弯曲膝盖再次蹲下，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 深蹲至过头伸展并转体
items.nameEn: squat to overhead reach with twist
items.description: A squat with an overhead reach and a twist. It trains the legs and mobilizes the torso.
steps: 站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，脚趾稍微外翻。
弯曲膝盖并将臀部向后推，将身体降低至蹲姿。
当你从深蹲中站起来时，将手臂举过头顶并将躯干扭转到一侧。
返回起始位置并重复下蹲，这次将躯干扭转到另一侧。
每次深蹲重复时继续交替进行。

items.name: 深蹲跨步
items.description: A squat that steps one leg out to the side before returning. It works the legs and hips with a bit of lateral movement.
steps: Stand with your feet together.
Squat down by pushing your hips back.
Stand up while stepping one foot out to the side.
Bring that foot back in and squat again.
Alternate sides each rep.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.

items.name: 游泳式腿部画圈
items.description: A lying leg circle drill with a swimming-style rhythm. It loosens the hips and trains the glutes and core control.
steps: Lie face down with your arms extended in front of you.
Lift one leg slightly off the floor.
Draw small, controlled circles with that leg.
Reverse the direction after several circles.
Lower the leg and repeat on the other side.
Keep your hips pressed down and your core braced.

items.name: 游泳打腿 v. 2(男)
items.description: A face-down flutter kick, lifting the chest and legs off the floor and kicking in a swimming motion. It trains the glutes and lower back.
steps: 脸朝下躺在垫子上，双臂伸过头顶。
启动核心肌群，同时将胸部和腿部抬离地面。
以扑动的动作上下踢腿，就像在游泳一样。
继续踢所需的重复次数。
将胸部和双腿放低至起始位置。

items.name: 滑冰步
items.description: A side-to-side leap like a speed skater. It trains leg power, balance and stamina.
steps: Stand on one leg with a slight bend in the knee.
Leap sideways to the other leg.
Land softly and sweep the back leg behind you.
Swing your arms across your body for balance.
Immediately bound back the other way.
Keep your hips low and your chest forward.

items.name: 滑冰深蹲
items.description: A single-leg squat with the free leg swept behind, like a speed skater, for leg strength and balance.
steps: Stand on one leg with the other knee bent and the foot lifted behind you.
Swing your arms forward for balance.
Sit your hips back and lower on the standing leg.
Lightly tap the back knee near the floor.
Stand up through the front foot, then switch legs after your reps.

items.name: 滚动仰卧髋外旋与髋伸肌拉伸(交叉腿)
items.nameEn: roll recumbent hip external rotator and hip extensor stretch (crossed leg)
items.description: Lying on your back with one ankle crossed over the other knee, pull the legs in to stretch the glutes and deep hip rotators.
steps: Lie on your back with both knees bent and feet flat.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Pull the bottom thigh toward your chest with both hands.
Keep your head and shoulders relaxed on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
Release slowly and repeat on the other side if needed.

items.name: 火箭跳
items.description: A deep squat followed by a big vertical jump with your arms reaching up. It builds explosive leg power.
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down while swinging your arms back.
Explode upward and reach both arms overhead as you jump.
Extend your whole body like a rocket.
Land softly on bent knees and reset before the next jump.

items.name: 熊爬平板后踢
items.description: From a hovering bear plank position, you kick one leg back to fire up your glutes while your core stays steady.
steps: Start on hands and knees, then lift your knees a few centimetres off the floor.
Keep your back flat and core braced.
Extend one leg back and up, squeezing your glute.
Bring the knee back in without touching down.
Repeat, then switch legs.

items.name: 爆发式悬垂深蹲
items.description: A squat jump while hanging from a bar that lets you focus on explosive leg drive.
steps: Hang from a bar with arms straight and knees slightly bent.
Lower into a deep squat position.
Explode upward through your legs.
Absorb the movement softly and return to the start.
Keep your core tight and repeat.

items.name: 爆发式靠墙坐蹲
items.description: A jumping variation of the wall sit. You drop into a wall squat and then explode upward, building leg power.
steps: Stand with your back close to a wall, feet shoulder width apart.
Lower into a wall sit with your thighs parallel to the floor.
Drive through your feet and jump up explosively.
Land softly with bent knees.
Drop straight back into the sit and repeat.
Keep your chest tall and land quietly.

items.name: 玩具兵动态拉伸
items.description: A walking stretch where you kick straight legs up toward outstretched hands, warming up the hamstrings and hips.
steps: Stand tall with your arms stretched out in front of you.
Kick one straight leg up toward your hands.
Lower it and step forward.
Kick the other leg up.
Keep your chest upright and walk for about 10 reps per side.

items.name: 环绕世界超人式保持
items.description: A face-down superman hold with the arms sweeping in a circle. It strengthens the glutes, lower back and rear shoulders.
steps: Lie face down with your arms extended overhead and legs straight.
Lift your arms, chest and legs a few centimetres off the floor.
Sweep your arms out to the sides and down toward your hips in a wide arc.
Sweep them back overhead along the same path.
Keep your neck neutral and legs lifted throughout.
Lower down with control after your set.

items.name: 登箱
items.description: A simple step onto a box that trains the thighs and glutes one leg at a time.
steps: Stand facing a sturdy box or bench at a comfortable height.
Place one foot fully on the box.
Press through that heel and stand up on the box.
Step back down with control.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 直腿后踢(跪姿)
items.description: From all fours, you extend one straight leg back and up. It isolates the glutes and hamstrings.
steps: Start on hands and knees with a flat back.
Brace your core.
Extend one leg straight back.
Lift it to hip height and squeeze your glute.
Lower without letting your back arch.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 直腿臀桥
items.description: A bridge with straight legs that shifts more work to the hamstrings and glutes.
steps: Lie on your back with your legs straight and your heels on the floor.
Press your heels down and lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Keep your ribs down.
Lower slowly.
Repeat for the planned reps.

items.name: 直腿髋外侧外展
items.description: Lie on your side with your legs straight and lift the top leg. It works the outer hip and glute muscles that stabilise your pelvis.
steps: 侧躺，双腿伸直并叠放在一起。
将下臂放在头下方以获得支撑。
启动你的核心并尽可能高地抬起你的上腿，不要旋转你的臀部或向后倾斜。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。

items.name: 直腿髋桥
items.description: A hip bridge with your legs straight and heels on the floor. It shifts more work to the hamstrings and glutes.
steps: Lie on your back with your legs straight and heels on the floor.
Place your arms by your sides.
Press through your heels and lift your hips.
Form a straight line from shoulders to heels.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly.

items.name: 直角式瑜伽体式
items.description: A wide-legged forward fold that stretches the hamstrings and inner thighs.
steps: Stand with your feet wide apart and toes pointing forward.
Place your hands on your hips and lengthen your spine.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back.
Lower your hands to the floor or to your shins.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then rise slowly.

items.name: 相扑徒手深蹲
items.description: A bodyweight squat with a wide stance and toes turned out. It trains the glutes and inner thighs.
steps: Stand with feet wide and toes turned out.
Hold your hands in front of your chest.
Sit down between your legs.
Keep your chest up and knees over the toes.
Push through your heels to stand.
Squeeze the glutes at the top.

items.name: 相扑深蹲
items.description: A bodyweight squat in a wide stance with toes turned out. It targets the glutes and inner thighs.
steps: Stand with feet wide and toes turned out.
Hold your hands together at your chest.
Sit your hips down and back between your legs.
Keep your knees over your toes and chest upright.
Lower to thigh level.
Push through your heels to stand and squeeze your glutes.

items.name: 相扑深蹲触地
items.description: A wide-stance squat in which you touch the floor between your feet. It trains the glutes, thighs and hip mobility.
steps: Stand with your feet wide and toes turned out.
Push your hips back and squat down.
Touch the floor with your fingertips between your feet.
Keep your chest lifted and your knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your heels to stand.

items.name: 祈祷深蹲瑜伽体式
items.description: A deep squat with palms together that opens the hips and inner thighs and builds ankle and hip mobility.
steps: Stand with feet wider than hips and toes turned out.
Lower into a deep squat, keeping your heels down if you can.
Press your palms together at your chest.
Use your elbows to gently press your knees outward.
Hold for 30-60 seconds while breathing slowly.

items.name: 移动婴儿式
items.description: A flowing version of child's pose that rocks the body to stretch the back, hips and shoulders.
steps: Start on all fours with your knees slightly wider than your hips.
Sit your hips back toward your heels and reach your arms forward.
Let your chest sink toward the floor.
Rock forward and back slowly, then walk your hands to each side.
Breathe deeply and relax your neck.
Move gently for 30 to 60 seconds.

items.name: 穿臂跳箱
items.description: A box jump with a swing-through arm action. It builds explosive power and coordination.
steps: Stand facing a sturdy box.
Swing your arms back and bend your knees.
Jump onto the box, driving your arms through.
Land softly with both feet.
Stand tall at the top.
Step down and reset.

items.name: 窄腿凳上臀桥
items.description: A glute bridge with your feet close together on a bench. It places more load on the glutes and hamstrings.
steps: Lie on your back with your feet close together on a bench.
Bend your knees and keep arms by your sides.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Hold briefly.
Lower slowly.

items.name: 立定跳远
items.description: A jump for distance from a standing start. It builds explosive power in the hips and legs.
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart at a clear starting line.
Swing your arms back and bend your knees.
Swing your arms forward and jump as far as you can.
Land on both feet with your knees bent to absorb the impact.
Reset and repeat.

items.name: 立定跳远转垂直跳
items.description: A forward jump followed straight away by a jump up. It trains explosive power in two directions.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and swing your arms back.
Jump forward as far as you can.
Land softly with bent knees.
Immediately explode into a vertical jump with your arms up.
Land softly and reset.
Take a short rest between reps.

items.name: 站姿交叉腿向下够取腘绳肌拉伸
items.nameEn: standing reach down hamstring crossed legs stretch
items.description: A standing forward fold with the legs crossed, which shifts the stretch to the back of the rear leg.
steps: Stand tall and cross one foot over the other.
Hinge forward at the hips and reach toward the floor until the back of the thighs stretch.
Keep both legs fairly straight and let your head hang relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

items.name: 站姿交叉腿外展肌拉伸
items.description: Cross one leg behind the other to stretch the outer hip and thigh.
steps: Stand tall, next to a wall if you need balance.
Cross one leg behind the other.
Lean your hips toward the side of your back leg.
Feel the stretch along the outer hip.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

items.name: 站姿侧抬腿
items.description: Lift one leg out to the side while standing. It works the outer hip and helps with balance.
steps: Stand tall, hands on your hips or on a support.
Keep your toes pointing forward and lift one leg out to the side.
Raise it as high as you can without leaning your torso.
Lower with control and repeat, then switch legs.

items.name: 站姿分腿前屈
items.description: Fold forward from a wide-legged stance to stretch the inner thighs and hamstrings.
steps: Stand with feet wide apart and toes pointing forward.
Hinge forward at the hips with a long spine.
Lower your hands to the floor or your shins.
Relax your head and neck.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.

items.name: 站姿前屈
items.description: Fold forward from standing and let the head hang. It lengthens the hamstrings and back.
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Hinge at your hips and fold forward, keeping your knees slightly soft.
Let your hands rest on the floor or hold opposite elbows.
Relax your neck and let the weight of your head drop.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.

items.name: 站姿半前屈
items.description: A halfway forward fold with a flat back. Lengthens the back of the legs.
steps: Stand with your feet hip-width apart.
Hinge forward from your hips and bring your hands to your shins or thighs.
Lengthen your spine until your back is flat.
Hold for 5 slow breaths.
Roll up slowly to stand.

items.name: 站姿半跪髋屈肌拉伸
items.nameEn: standing half kneeling hip flexors stretch
items.description: A half-kneeling position that opens the front of the hip and the quad of the back leg.
steps: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward and a pad under your knee.
Keep your torso upright and tuck your pelvis under.
Shift your weight forward until you feel a stretch at the front of the back hip.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and your core engaged.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

items.name: 站姿单腿前后左右点地
items.nameEn: standing single leg front back side to side toe tap
items.description: Tap your toes in different directions while balancing. It works hip stability.
steps: Stand on one leg.
Tap the other toe forward.
Tap to the side, then back.
Keep your balance.
Switch legs.

items.name: 站姿单腿弯举
items.description: A bodyweight hamstring curl done standing on one leg, bringing the heel toward the glutes. It trains the hamstrings and balance.
steps: 站立，双脚分开与臀部同宽，双手放在臀部。
将体重转移到左腿上，将右脚抬离地面，弯曲膝盖。
慢慢地将右脚跟卷向臀部，挤压腿筋。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将右脚放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换腿。

items.name: 站姿单腿髋部画圈(椅子支撑)
items.nameEn: standing single leg hip swirl with chair support
items.description: Hold a chair and swirl one leg in circles. It loosens the hip joint and warms up the glutes.
steps: Stand beside a chair and hold it for balance.
Lift one leg slightly off the floor.
Draw slow, controlled circles with your leg.
Do half of the reps one way, then reverse the direction.
Switch legs and repeat.

items.name: 站姿单腿高抬腿转后踢腿(有支撑)
items.nameEn: standing single leg high knee to butt kick (with support)
items.description: A supported single-leg drill that alternates a high knee and a heel kick, working balance and the hips.
steps: Stand next to a wall or support and hold it with one hand.
Raise the opposite knee to hip height.
Lower it and kick that heel up toward your glutes.
Repeat smoothly for the reps.
Switch sides and keep your torso upright.

items.name: 站姿向下够取腘绳肌拉伸
items.description: A standing forward fold that stretches the hamstrings and calves.
steps: Stand with your feet hip width apart.
Hinge at the hips and reach your hands down toward your shins or toes until you feel the back of the thighs stretch.
Let your head and neck hang relaxed and keep a slight bend in the knees.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

items.name: 站姿四字式
items.description: A one-leg balance with the ankle crossed over the opposite knee. Stretches the outer hip.
steps: Stand tall and shift your weight onto one leg.
Cross the other ankle over the standing thigh.
Bend your standing knee and sit your hips back.
Hold for 5 slow breaths with a long spine.
Switch legs.

items.name: 站姿夹臀
items.description: A simple standing contraction that wakes up the glutes and helps you feel them working before heavier lifts.
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip width apart and your arms relaxed.
Tighten your abs lightly so your ribs stay stacked over your hips.
Squeeze your glutes together as hard as you comfortably can.
Hold for 3-5 seconds without leaning back or tucking your hips excessively.
Relax fully, then repeat for 10-15 reps.

items.name: 站姿宽腿内收肌拉伸
items.description: A standing side lunge position that lengthens the inner thighs.
steps: Stand with your feet wide apart, toes pointing slightly out.
Shift your weight to one side and bend that knee while the other leg stays straight, and feel the inner thigh stretch.
Keep your chest up and the straight leg's foot flat on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

items.name: 站姿宽膝内收肌拉伸
items.description: A standing wide-stance stretch for the inner thighs.
steps: Stand with your feet wide apart and toes pointing slightly out.
Bend your knees and place your hands on your thighs.
Shift your weight from side to side, sinking into the stretch.
Keep your chest tall and your back flat.
Hold for 20-30 seconds on each side.

items.name: 站姿屈膝8字
items.description: A standing hip mobility move where you draw a figure eight with the bent knee. It loosens the hips.
steps: Stand tall and hold a support if needed.
Lift one knee in front of you.
Trace a slow figure eight with your knee.
Keep your standing leg steady.
Keep your torso upright.
Switch legs.

items.name: 站姿屈膝髋内收肌拉伸
items.nameEn: standing bent knee hip adductor stretch
items.description: Standing stretch with a bent knee that opens the inner thigh and hip.
steps: Stand with your feet wide.
Bend one knee and lower into that side.
Keep your other leg straight.
Push the bent knee gently out with your hand.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

items.name: 站姿平衡股四头肌拉伸
items.description: A standing quad stretch with balance. It lengthens the front of the thigh and hips.
steps: Stand tall, holding a wall for balance if needed.
Bend one knee and grab your ankle behind you.
Pull your heel toward your glutes with knees together.
Keep your hips tucked and your chest up.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release and switch legs.

items.name: 站姿平衡髋外侧拉伸
items.description: A standing stretch for the outer hip that also challenges balance.
steps: Stand tall near a support.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Sit back slightly.
Feel the stretch in your outer hip.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.

items.name: 站姿平衡髋旋转
items.description: A one-leg balance with controlled hip rotation. It works hip mobility and stability together.
steps: Stand tall on one leg with a soft knee, holding a wall if needed.
Lift the other knee to hip height.
Rotate the lifted knee out to the side, then back to the front.
Keep your torso steady.
Move slowly and smoothly.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 站姿抬腿搭放髋部拉伸
items.description: Rest one leg on a raised surface and lean in to stretch the hips.
steps: Stand facing a bench or step.
Place one heel on it with the knee slightly bent.
Keep your chest tall and hinge forward at the hips.
Feel the stretch in the hip and glute.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

items.name: 站姿抬腿腘绳肌拉伸
items.description: Rest one heel on a raised surface and lean forward to stretch the back of the thigh.
steps: Stand facing a low support and place one heel on it with the leg straight.
Hinge forward from the hips with a long back until you feel the back of the thigh stretch.
Keep your toes pointing up and your standing knee soft.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

items.name: 站姿抬腿髋内收肌拉伸
items.nameEn: standing raised leg hip adductor stretch
items.description: A standing stretch with one leg raised on a support that opens the inner thigh.
steps: Stand tall and place one foot on a bench or raised surface to the side.
Keep your standing leg straight and your toes forward.
Shift your weight toward the raised leg side until you feel a stretch.
Keep your chest upright and your hips square.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

items.name: 站姿收腿髋部拉伸
items.description: A standing stretch drawing one knee up and in to open the hip and glutes.
steps: Stand tall, holding a wall or support for balance.
Lift one knee and hold the shin and ankle with both hands.
Pull the leg gently toward your chest and slightly across the body.
Keep your standing leg soft and your back straight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

items.name: 站姿毛巾滑腿
items.description: A standing exercise where one foot slides on a towel to work the hips and thighs while the standing leg balances you.
steps: Stand on a smooth floor with one foot on a towel and hold a support if needed.
Bend the standing knee slightly and keep your chest tall.
Slide the towel foot out to the side or back as far as you can control.
Pull it back to the start using your hip and thigh muscles.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 站姿股四头肌拉伸
items.description: Pull your heel toward your glute while standing to stretch the front of the thigh. It is a classic quad stretch.
steps: Stand tall and hold something for balance if needed.
Bend one knee and grab your ankle.
Pull your heel toward your glute, knees together.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs and repeat.

items.name: 站姿脚尖上翘腘绳肌拉伸
items.description: Standing stretch with one heel on the floor and toes pulled up, lengthening the back of the thigh and calf.
steps: Stand tall and step one foot forward, resting the heel on the floor with the toes pulled up.
Keep the front leg straight and the back knee slightly bent.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back until you feel a pull behind the thigh.
Keep your chest open and avoid rounding your spine.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

items.name: 站姿脚尖下压腘绳肌拉伸
items.description: Stretches the back of the thigh with the toes lowered.
steps: Stand with one heel on the floor in front of you.
Point your toes down.
Hinge forward from the hips with a flat back.
Keep the front leg nearly straight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

items.name: 站姿腘绳肌和背部拉伸
items.description: Fold forward from standing to lengthen the hamstrings and lower back.
steps: Stand tall with feet hip width apart.
Hinge forward at the hips with a long spine.
Let your arms hang toward the floor.
Keep your knees soft.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
Release slowly and repeat on the other side if needed.

items.name: 站姿腘绳肌拉伸
items.description: A simple standing stretch for the back of the thigh. It helps loosen tight hamstrings.
steps: Stand tall and place one heel forward on the floor with the toes up.
Keep that leg straight and the other knee slightly bent.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back until you feel a stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs and repeat.

items.name: 站姿腿上抬内收肌拉伸
items.description: Stretch for the inner thigh with one leg raised and out to the side.
steps: Stand next to a bench or low support.
Place one foot on it with the leg out to the side.
Keep your hips square.
Shift your weight toward the raised leg.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

items.name: 站姿腿置下方外展肌拉伸
items.description: Tuck one leg under the other in standing to stretch the outer hip.
steps: Stand tall near a support.
Pass one leg behind and under the other.
Push your hips gently to the side of the back leg.
Keep your torso upright.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

items.name: 站姿腿部绕圈
items.description: Circles with a straight leg while standing. It loosens the hips and warms up the glutes.
steps: Stand tall and hold a support for balance.
Lift one leg slightly off the floor.
Draw a smooth circle with the leg.
Keep your torso still.
Reverse the direction after several reps.
Switch legs.

items.name: 站姿膝碰胸拉伸
items.description: Standing on one leg and hugging the other knee to your chest stretches your glutes and tests your balance. A good warm-up move.
steps: Stand tall, using a wall for balance if needed.
Lift one knee and pull it gently toward your chest with both hands.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

items.name: 站姿靠墙下滑半蹲
items.description: A half squat with your back sliding against a wall. It builds leg strength with support and good alignment.
steps: Stand with your back against a wall and your feet slightly forward.
Slide down until your knees are bent to about 45 degrees.
Keep your back flat on the wall.
Press through your heels to rise.
Repeat for the set.

items.name: 站姿靠墙下滑四分之一深蹲保持
items.nameEn: standing wall slide quarter squat hold
items.description: A wall-supported quarter squat that you hold. It gently loads the thighs.
steps: Stand with your back against a wall and feet slightly forward.
Slide down until your knees bend about a quarter of the way.
Keep your back flat to the wall.
Hold for 15-30 seconds.
Slide back up.

items.name: 站姿靠墙滑动半蹲保持
items.nameEn: standing wall slide half squat hold
items.description: A wall-supported half squat held in place to build quad endurance with low joint stress.
steps: Stand with your back against a wall and feet about a step in front of you.
Slide down until your knees are bent to about 45-60 degrees.
Keep your back flat on the wall and your knees over your ankles.
Press through your whole foot and breathe steadily.
Hold for 20-45 seconds, then slide back up.

items.name: 站姿骨盆抬升
items.description: A gentle standing move where you tilt and lift the pelvis by squeezing the glutes and abs. It teaches pelvic control and activates the hips.
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip width apart and your hands on your hips.
Soften your knees slightly.
Tuck your tailbone under and lift the front of your pelvis by squeezing your glutes and lower abs.
Hold for 2 seconds.
Release slowly to a neutral pelvis.
Keep your upper body still and breathe normally.

items.name: 站姿髂胫束拉伸
items.description: A standing side lean that stretches the iliotibial band along the outside of the thigh.
steps: Stand next to a wall or support and cross your outer leg behind the other.
Lean your hips toward the wall and reach the outer arm overhead until the outside of the hip and thigh stretches.
Keep your chest facing forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

items.name: 站姿髋伸展(屈膝)
items.description: Driving a bent knee back behind you while standing. It targets the glutes with a short, controlled range.
steps: Stand tall holding a support, with your core tight.
Shift onto one leg and bend the other knee.
Press that heel back and up, squeezing your glute.
Do not arch your lower back.
Lower with control, then switch legs after your reps.

items.name: 站姿髋伸展(直腿)
items.description: A standing kickback with a straight leg that targets the glutes.
steps: Stand tall and hold a support for balance.
Keep your standing knee slightly soft.
Lift one straight leg back behind you without arching your lower back.
Squeeze the glute at the top.
Lower with control and switch legs after your reps.

items.name: 站姿髋内收 v. 2
items.description: Standing leg swings across the body to work the inner thigh. A simple move for the adductors.
steps: Stand tall next to a wall or chair and hold on for balance.
Lift the outer leg slightly off the floor.
Swing it across the front of your standing leg.
Return slowly to the start without leaning.
Finish your reps, then turn around and switch legs.

items.name: 站姿髋内收拉伸
items.description: Crossing one leg behind the other and leaning aside to stretch the outer hip.
steps: Stand tall and cross one leg behind the other, feet close together.
Lean your torso away from the back leg and push the hip out slightly until you feel the outer hip stretch.
Keep both feet flat on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

items.name: 站姿髋外侧拉伸
items.description: A standing side stretch that lengthens the outer hip and thigh.
steps: Stand next to a wall and cross one leg behind the other.
Push your hips sideways toward the wall.
Lean your upper body away from the hips until you feel the outer hip stretch.
Keep both feet flat on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

items.name: 站姿髋外展
items.description: Raising a straight leg out to the side while standing. It strengthens the outer hip and glutes.
steps: Stand tall beside a wall or chair for balance.
Keep your hips square and toes pointing forward.
Lift one leg out to the side with the knee straight.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 站姿髋外展(屈膝)
items.description: Lifting a bent knee out to the side while standing. It works the outer hip and glutes and trains balance.
steps: Stand tall and hold onto a support if needed.
Shift your weight onto one leg and bend the other knee.
Lift the bent knee out to the side without leaning.
Lower with control.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

items.name: 站姿髋外展内收肌拉伸
items.description: Standing stretch that pushes the hip out to the side to lengthen the inner thigh.
steps: Stand tall with your feet wider than hip width.
Shift your weight onto one leg and bend that knee.
Keep the other leg straight, foot flat.
Push your hip out until you feel a stretch in the inner thigh.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

items.name: 站姿髋屈肌拉伸
items.description: A standing stretch for the front of the hip and thigh, useful after long periods of sitting.
steps: Stand tall and hold a wall or support for balance.
Bend one knee and bring your heel toward your glute, holding the ankle.
Tuck your pelvis slightly and push your hips gently forward.
Keep your knees close together and your chest upright.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

items.name: 站姿髋屈肌拉伸
items.description: A standing lunge-style stretch for the front of the hip and thigh.
steps: Stand and step one foot forward and the other back into a staggered stance.
Tuck your pelvis and squeeze the glute of the back leg.
Shift your hips slightly forward until you feel a stretch at the front of the back hip.
Keep your torso upright.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

items.name: 站姿髋部旋转拉伸
items.description: Rotates the hip in standing to stretch the glutes and deep hip muscles.
steps: Stand tall near a support.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Sit your hips back as if sitting into a chair.
Feel the stretch in the hip of the crossed leg.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

items.name: 站姿髋部绕环
items.description: Circle your hips to loosen the hip joints and warm up the glutes.
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hands on your hips.
Push your hips out to one side, then forward, back and around.
Draw a large smooth circle.
Keep your shoulders still.
Do 10 circles, then reverse direction.

items.name: 站姿高抬腿屈膝腘绳肌拉伸
items.nameEn: standing high leg bent knee hamstring stretch
items.description: A hamstring stretch with the foot raised high and the knee slightly bent for a deeper but friendlier pull.
steps: Stand tall and place one heel on a high support with the knee slightly bent.
Lean your chest toward your thigh with a flat back until you feel the stretch behind the thigh.
Straighten the knee a little more as you get looser.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

items.name: 简易坐瑜伽体式
items.description: A calm cross-legged seat that opens the hips and teaches you to sit tall.
steps: Sit on the floor and bend your knees.
Place one heel against your inner thigh and the other foot in front of it.
Rest your hands on your knees and lengthen your spine.
Relax your shoulders and look straight ahead.
Hold for 30-60 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch the cross of your legs and repeat.

items.name: 箱上股四头肌拉伸
items.description: A quad stretch with the back foot resting on a box or bench, opening the front of the thigh.
steps: Stand facing away from a box or bench and place the top of one foot on it behind you.
Stand tall on the front leg with a soft knee.
Tuck your pelvis and lower the hips slightly until you feel a stretch in the front of the thigh.
Hold a support for balance if needed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

items.name: 股四头肌
items.description: A bodyweight squat variation focused on the front of the thighs. It trains the quads and glutes.
steps: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
弯曲膝盖并将臀部向后推，降低身体，就像坐在椅子上一样。
保持挺胸、背部挺直。
降低身体直到大腿与地面平行。
推动脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 股四头肌拉伸
items.description: A standing stretch for the front of the thigh. Easy to do anywhere to ease tight quads.
steps: Stand tall, using a wall or support for balance if needed.
Bend one knee and grab the ankle behind you.
Pull your heel toward your glutes, keeping your knees together and hips square.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

items.name: 股四头肌静态收缩(等长)
items.description: Seated or lying with your leg straight, you tighten the thigh muscle and hold, an easy way to activate the quads.
steps: Sit or lie with one leg straight in front.
Relax your upper body.
Tighten the front of the thigh and press the knee down.
Hold for 5-10 seconds.
Relax fully.
Repeat, then switch legs.

items.name: 肩桥
items.description: A bridge that lifts the hips and adds a leg raise, working the glutes and hamstrings.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Extend one leg up.
Lower it and switch legs.
Roll down slowly.

items.name: 背部支撑髋伸展
items.description: Lifts the hips while the upper back is supported, teaching the glutes to extend the hip through a full range.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Place your arms by your sides for support.
Push through your heels and lift the hips until the body forms a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top without arching the lower back.
Lower the hips back down with control.
Repeat for 10-12 reps.

items.name: 胫骨盒切换
items.description: A seated hip rotation drill where you switch both knees from one side to the other, loosening the hips.
steps: Sit on the floor with both knees bent at 90 degrees, one leg in front and one to the side.
Sit tall and keep your hands on the floor if needed.
Rotate your knees to the other side so the legs swap positions.
Move smoothly without using your hands to push too hard.
Repeat back and forth for the set.

items.name: 脊柱后弯拉伸
items.description: A gentle backbend that stretches the spine, hips and abs.
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Place your hands on your lower back.
Squeeze your glutes and push your hips forward.
Lean back gently, lifting your chest.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return upright slowly.

items.name: 脚跟推踢
items.description: A pushing front kick that drives the heel forward to create distance, working hips and quads.
steps: Stand in a fighting stance with your hands up.
Lift the knee and point the toes up.
Push your heel straight forward, leaning back slightly.
Keep your supporting foot grounded.
Bring the leg back and set it down.
Repeat, then switch legs.

items.name: 脚跟臀桥
items.description: A bridge with heels pushed into the floor and toes lifted. It biases the glutes and hamstrings.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and heels on the floor, toes lifted.
Keep your arms by your sides.
Press through your heels and raise your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly.

items.name: 脚跟靠墙深蹲滑行
items.description: Sliding down a wall into a squat with your heels planted teaches good squat depth and control. It trains the quads and glutes.
steps: Stand with your back against a wall and your feet a little forward.
Press your heels into the floor.
Slide down the wall until your thighs are near parallel.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Press through your heels to slide back up.
Keep your back in contact with the wall.

items.name: 腘绳肌拉伸
items.description: A stretch for the back of the thigh. You reach toward your toes with a long spine and feel the hamstrings lengthen.
steps: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
右脚向前迈出一步，将重心转移到右腿上。
保持背部挺直，臀部慢慢向前弯曲，双手伸向右脚。
保持伸展动作 20-30 秒，然后回到起始位置。
在另一侧重复。

items.name: 腘绳肌桥 v. 2
items.description: A bridge with heels planted that emphasises the back of the thighs. Good for the hamstrings and glutes.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and heels on the floor, a bit further from your hips.
Press through your heels.
Lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Squeeze your hamstrings and glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

items.name: 腘绳肌桥踢腿 v. 2
items.description: A hamstring bridge with an added leg extension. It adds a balance challenge for hips and thighs.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and heels on the floor.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Straighten one leg out in front, keeping hips level.
Bring the foot back to the floor without dropping your hips.
Alternate legs or finish one side first.

items.name: 腘绳肌臂桥
items.description: A bridge with the heels placed farther away so the hamstrings and glutes do more of the lifting.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and heels placed a bit farther from your hips.
Press your heels into the floor.
Lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

items.name: 腿向侧面
items.description: Bring one leg out to the side to stretch the inner thigh. It improves hip mobility and flexibility.
steps: Lie on your back with both legs straight.
Lift one leg and let it open out to the side, keeping the other leg down.
Keep your hips squared and your lower back relaxed.
Hold the stretch gently, breathing steadily.
Return to the middle and repeat with the other leg.

items.name: 腿搭膝臀桥
items.description: A single-leg style glute bridge with one ankle resting on the opposite knee.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and one ankle crossed over the other knee.
Press through the grounded foot.
Lift your hips until your body forms a line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and switch sides.

items.name: 腿长测试
items.description: A lying check comparing the length of both legs. It is done gently and with a relaxed body.
steps: Lie flat on your back with legs straight and feet together.
Relax your hips and arms.
Compare the position of your heels or ankles.
Bend your knees and lift your hips, then lower and straighten again.
Check again for any difference.
Stay relaxed throughout.

items.name: 膝伸展
items.description: Straightening the knee, which works the front of the thigh.
steps: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Sit tall on a bench or chair with your feet off the floor.
Straighten one knee until the leg is almost fully extended.
Squeeze your thigh at the top, then lower slowly.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

items.name: 膝屈曲
items.description: Bending the knee to bring the heel toward the glutes, working the back of the thigh.
steps: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall holding a support, with your weight on one leg.
Bend the other knee to bring your heel up toward your glutes.
Keep your thighs side by side, pause, then lower slowly.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

items.name: 膝碰胸拉伸
items.description: Lying on your back, you hug one knee toward your chest. It stretches the glutes and eases the lower back.
steps: Lie on your back with both legs straight.
Bend one knee and clasp your hands around the shin or behind the thigh.
Gently pull the knee toward your chest.
Keep the other leg relaxed on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.
Release and switch sides.

items.name: 臀推
items.description: A glute-focused bridge with the upper back on a bench, lifting the hips to build strong glutes.
steps: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench and knees bent.
Plant your feet flat, hip-width apart.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips until your torso is level.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

items.name: 臀桥
items.description: A hip bridge lifting the buttocks off the floor while lying on your back. It strengthens the glutes and hamstrings.
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat, hip width apart.
Place your arms at your sides.
Press through your heels and lift your hips toward the ceiling.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly to the floor.
Keep your ribs down and avoid overarching your back.

items.name: 臀桥行走
items.description: A glute bridge held high while stepping the feet out and back. It adds a dynamic challenge for glutes and hamstrings.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Lift your hips into a glute bridge.
Keep the hips high and walk your feet out a few small steps.
Then walk them back in toward your body.
Keep your hips level and avoid sagging.
Lower with control when finished.

items.name: 臀桥行进
items.description: A glute bridge held at the top while you alternate marching the knees. It trains the glutes and core stability.
steps: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
收紧臀部并将臀部抬离地面，从膝盖到肩膀形成一条直线。
在保持臀部抬起的同时，将一只脚抬离地面，并将膝盖靠近胸部。
将脚放回地面，然后用另一条腿重复该动作。
继续交替双腿进行行进动作，同时保持桥式姿势。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 臀肌静态收缩(等长)
items.description: Squeezing the glutes and holding without moving, a simple way to activate the hips.
steps: Lie on your back or stand with your body relaxed.
Squeeze both glute muscles together.
Keep your legs and back still.
Hold the squeeze for 5-10 seconds.
Release fully.
Repeat for several reps.

items.name: 臀腿抬升
items.description: A hamstring exercise where you lift your torso from a face-down position on a glute-ham bench. It strengthens the hamstrings, glutes and lower back.
steps: 调整臀肌提升机以适合您的身体。
将自己面朝下放在机器上，固定脚踝。
将双手放在胸前或交叉在胸前。
调动腿筋和臀肌，将上半身抬向天花板。
继续抬起，直到身体从头部到脚后跟成一条直线。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将身体放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 臀部行进
items.description: A hip-bridge hold with alternating knee lifts that trains glutes and pelvic stability.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Raise one knee toward your chest without letting your hips drop.
Place that foot down and lift the other.
Keep squeezing your glutes the whole time.
Continue alternating for 10-20 marches.

items.name: 自助反向腿弯举
items.description: Lying on your back, you curl your heels toward your glutes. A body weight move for the hamstrings.
steps: 平躺在垫子或长凳上，双腿伸展。
将双手放在身体两侧或臀部下方以获得支撑。
弯曲膝盖，将脚抬离地面，将大腿靠近胸部。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 自助反向腿弯举
items.description: A bodyweight leg curl on a lying leg curl station. Works the hamstrings with a controlled curl and slow lowering.
steps: 面朝下躺在腿弯举机上，双腿伸展，脚踝钩在带衬垫的杠杆下。
将双手放在机器的侧手柄上以获得支撑。
保持上半身静止，呼气并尽可能向上弯曲双腿。
挤压腿筋时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气时慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 自助反向腿弯举(地面)
items.nameEn: self assisted inverse leg curl (on floor)
items.description: Lying on your back, you slide your heels toward your glutes to train the hamstrings. Uses only your body weight.
steps: 平躺，双腿伸展，双臂放在身体两侧。
弯曲膝盖，将双脚平放在地面上，距离与臀部同宽。
将臀部抬离地面，锻炼臀肌和腿筋。
慢慢地将双腿向臀部弯曲，保持臀部抬起。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将双腿伸展回起始位置。
将臀部放回地面。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 自我辅助反向腿弯举 v. 2
items.nameEn: self assisted inverse leg curl v. 2
items.description: A bodyweight Nordic-style leg curl where you lower yourself and use your hands to help back up. It builds strong hamstrings.
steps: Kneel with your ankles anchored under something stable.
Keep your body straight from knees to head.
Lower your torso forward slowly, using your hamstrings to resist.
Catch yourself with your hands near the floor.
Push off lightly and use your hamstrings to return.
Keep your hips extended.

items.name: 自重脉冲深蹲
items.description: A squat held at the bottom with small pulses. It burns the quads and glutes.
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down until thighs are parallel.
Pulse up and down a few centimetres.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.
Keep your weight on your heels.
Stand up fully to finish.

items.name: 自重落地跳深蹲
items.description: A squat that ends with an explosive jump, bringing the feet together in the air. It builds leg power and cardio.
steps: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
弯曲膝盖并将臀部向后推，将身体降低至蹲姿。
爆发性地跳起来，伸展臀部、膝盖和脚踝。
在半空中时，快速将双脚并拢。
脚掌轻轻着地，然后立即回到蹲姿。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 自重蛙式臀推
items.description: A glute bridge with the soles of your feet together, taking glute work to the next level.
steps: Lie on your back with the soles of your feet together and knees dropped open.
Bring your heels close to your hips.
Drive your hips up by squeezing your glutes.
Pause at the top.
Lower and repeat in quick pumps.

items.name: 舞王式
items.description: A standing balance with a back-held leg and a forward reach. It stretches the quads and opens the chest.
steps: Stand tall and bend one knee, holding that foot behind you.
Kick your foot back into your hand.
Reach your free arm forward.
Tilt your torso forward as the leg lifts.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch.

items.name: 花环式
items.description: A deep squat with elbows pressing the knees apart and palms together. It stretches the hips, groin and ankles.
steps: Stand with feet slightly wider than hips and toes turned out.
Lower into a deep squat, keeping your heels down if you can.
Bring your palms together at your chest.
Press your elbows against your inner knees and lengthen your spine.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.

items.name: 英雄式
items.description: Kneel and sit between your feet, stretching the thighs and ankles. A grounded seat for breathing or meditation.
steps: Kneel with knees together and feet slightly wider than your hips.
Sit your hips down between your heels, using a block if needed.
Rest your hands on your thighs and lengthen your spine.
Relax your shoulders and breathe evenly.
Hold for 30-60 seconds, then come out slowly.

items.name: 莲花坐
items.description: Sit cross-legged with each foot resting on the opposite thigh. It opens the hips and encourages a calm, upright posture.
steps: Sit tall with legs stretched out in front of you.
Bend one knee and place that foot high on the opposite thigh.
Bend the other knee and place that foot on top, if your hips allow it.
Rest your hands on your knees and lengthen your spine.
Breathe slowly for 30-60 seconds, then switch which leg goes on top.

items.name: 莲花坐瑜伽姿势
items.description: A seated yoga posture with both feet resting on opposite thighs. It opens the hips and needs good flexibility.
steps: Sit tall on the floor with your legs extended.
Bring one foot onto the opposite thigh, then the other foot on top of the other thigh.
Only go as far as your hips allow, and never force your knees.
Rest your hands on your knees and lengthen your spine.
Hold for 20-30 seconds with calm breathing, then switch the leg order next time.

items.name: 虾式深蹲
items.description: A single-leg squat with the back foot held behind you, demanding strong quads and good balance.
steps: Stand on one leg and bend the other knee, holding that foot behind you.
Reach your free arm forward for balance.
Lower slowly until the back knee lightly touches the floor.
Drive through the front foot to stand.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 蛙式(曼杜卡)
items.description: A deep hip opener on all fours with knees wide. It stretches the inner thighs and groin.
steps: Start on hands and knees on a mat.
Slide your knees wide, with feet turned out and inline with knees.
Lower onto your forearms.
Push your hips back gently.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.

items.name: 蛙式反向背伸(凳上)
items.description: A reverse hyperextension with the legs in a frog position, aimed at the glutes and lower back.
steps: Lie face down on a bench with your hips at the edge and hold the bench for support.
Let your legs hang and bring the soles of your feet together, knees out.
Squeeze your glutes and lift your legs up behind you.
Pause when your thighs are in line with your torso.
Lower slowly and repeat.
Avoid arching your lower back too far.

items.name: 蛙式深蹲
items.description: A wide squat that finishes with a jump, landing back in a deep position like a frog. It builds leg power and endurance.
steps: Stand with your feet wider than shoulders and your toes turned out.
Lower into a deep squat with your hands between your knees.
Explode up into a jump.
Land softly back in the deep squat.
Keep your chest up and your knees out.
Rest briefly between sets.

items.name: 蛙式臀推
items.description: A hip thrust with the soles of the feet together and knees out, which shifts work to the glutes and inner thighs.
steps: Lie on your back with the soles of your feet together and knees falling out.
Keep your heels near your hips.
Drive through the feet to lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

items.name: 蛙跳
items.description: Explosive hops from a deep squat, like a frog. They build leg power and get your heart pumping.
steps: Stand with your feet wider than your shoulders and sink into a deep squat.
