Place your fingertips on the floor between your feet.
Jump forward and up, swinging your arms.
Land softly back in the squat.
Reset and hop again right away.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.

items.name: 蜘蛛爬行俯卧撑
items.description: A push-up combined with a knee drive toward the elbow, like a crawling spider. It trains the chest, core and hips together.
steps: 从俯卧撑位置开始，双手分开略宽于肩宽，双脚并拢。
将右膝靠近右肘，使其离开地面。
当您将右膝向后拉时，同时弯曲肘部将身体降低到地面。
推回起始位置，然后将左膝朝向左肘重复此动作。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

items.name: 蜥蜴式
items.description: A low lunge with both hands inside the front foot. Opens the hips and groin.
steps: Start in a low lunge with your back knee down or lifted.
Walk your front foot to the outer edge of your mat.
Place both hands inside the front foot.
Hold for 5 slow breaths.
Switch legs.

items.name: 蜻蜓式
items.description: A seated wide-leg arm balance with legs extended out to the sides. It needs hip flexibility and core strength.
steps: Squat with hands on the floor in front of you.
Place your knees high on your upper arms.
Lean forward and lift your feet off the floor.
Extend your legs wide to the sides.
Hold for a few breaths, then release.

items.name: 蝴蝶式瑜伽姿势
items.description: A seated pose with the soles of your feet together and knees dropped out. It opens the inner thighs and hips.
steps: 坐在地板上，双腿伸到身前。
弯曲膝盖，将脚底并拢，让膝盖向两侧倾斜。
用手抓住脚踝或脚。
坐直并拉长脊柱。
轻轻地将膝盖压向地板，感觉大腿内侧有拉伸感。
保持这个姿势几个呼吸。
要放松，请慢慢抬起膝盖并伸展双腿。

items.name: 蝴蝶式瑜伽扇动
items.description: Seated butterfly pose with gentle knee flapping. It loosens the inner thighs and hips.
steps: Sit with the soles of your feet together.
Hold your feet.
Gently flap your knees up and down.
Keep your spine tall.
Continue for 30 seconds.

items.name: 行走弓步蹲
items.description: Stepping forward into one lunge after another, moving across the room. It works the quads and glutes and challenges balance.
steps: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
右腿向前迈出一步，将身体降低至弓步位置。
保持躯干直立，前膝与脚踝对齐。
右脚蹬地，左脚向前，左腿呈弓步姿势。
继续交替双腿向前行走，保持受控且稳定的步伐。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 西西里深蹲
items.description: A squat where your knees travel far forward as you lean back. It isolates the quads with only your body weight.
steps: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，脚趾稍微向外。
如果需要，请抓住一个稳定的物体以保持平衡。
弯曲膝盖并向后倾斜，慢慢降低身体，保持躯干直立。
继续降低，直到大腿与地面平行或尽可能舒适地下降。
暂停片刻，然后用力推动脚后跟，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 触脚尖坐姿(靠墙)
items.description: A wall sit with a toe touch added. The reach makes your trunk work while your legs hold the squat.
steps: Lean against a wall and slide down into a wall sit.
Hold the squat position with your feet flat.
Reach forward and down with your hands toward your toes.
Return to an upright position against the wall.
Repeat for the set, keeping the sit steady.
Slide back up when finished and keep your knees at about 90 degrees.

items.name: 谦卑战士式
items.description: A lunge with a forward fold and clasped hands behind you. It stretches the hips, hamstrings and shoulders.
steps: Step into a wide lunge with the front knee bent.
Clasp your hands behind your back.
Fold your torso inside your front thigh.
Let your arms float overhead.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

items.name: 跑者拉伸
items.description: A lunge position stretch for the hips, thighs and hamstrings, often used by runners to loosen up.
steps: 双脚分开与臀部同宽站立。
右脚向前迈出一步，保持左脚踩地。
弯曲右膝，降低身体，保持左腿伸直。
将双手放在右大腿上以获得支撑。
保持拉伸 20-30 秒，然后换边重复。

items.name: 跪姿伸腿内收肌拉伸
items.description: A kneeling stretch with one leg extended to the side to open the inner thigh and groin.
steps: Kneel on all fours with your knees under your hips.
Extend one leg out to the side with the foot flat.
Sit your hips back toward the opposite heel.
Keep your back straight and your extended leg straight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

items.name: 跪姿侧腿踢
items.description: A kneeling side kick that works the glutes and outer hips while challenging balance.
steps: Kneel on all fours with hands under shoulders.
Lift one leg out to the side, bent.
Extend it into a kick out to the side.
Bend it back in and lower.
Finish the reps and switch legs.

items.name: 跪姿侧踢
items.description: A kneeling Pilates side kick that works the outer hip and core stability.
steps: Kneel on one knee with the opposite leg extended to the side.
Place your bottom hand on the mat and keep the top hand light behind your head.
Kick the top leg forward, then sweep it back with control.
Keep your torso steady and tall.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

items.name: 跪姿俯身内收肌拉伸
items.description: A floor stretch that opens up the inner thighs while you rest face down on your forearms.
steps: Kneel on a mat, then lower your chest and forearms to the floor.
Slide your knees wide apart and sink your hips back toward your heels until you feel the inner thighs stretch.
Keep your breathing slow and stay relaxed, without bouncing.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

items.name: 跪姿到站姿深蹲
items.description: A flowing move from kneeling up into a squat, working the legs, glutes and balance.
steps: Kneel on both knees with your torso upright.
Step one foot forward and then the other so both feet are flat.
Press up to stand, then sit back into a squat.
Return to kneeling under control.
Alternate which foot steps first.

items.name: 跪姿单腿腿弯举
items.description: A hamstring curl done from a kneeling position, one leg at a time. It works the back of the thigh.
steps: Get on all fours with hands under shoulders.
Keep your back flat and core tight.
Bend one knee and curl your heel toward your glute.
Squeeze the hamstring at the top.
Lower the foot slowly.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 跪姿向前髋部绕圈
items.description: Circle your hips in a kneeling position. It warms up the hip joints and glutes.
steps: Kneel with your hands on your hips.
Push your hips forward slightly.
Draw large circles with your hips, leading forward and around.
Do several circles in one direction.
Switch direction and repeat.

items.name: 跪姿屈膝(椅子支撑)
items.description: Kneeling beside a chair for support, you gently bend the knee. It builds comfortable knee range of motion.
steps: Hold the back of a chair and kneel on one knee on a soft surface.
Keep your torso upright.
Slowly sit back toward your heel to bend the knee.
Stay within a comfortable range.
Return to the start and switch sides after your reps.

items.name: 跪姿直腿侧踢
items.description: A kneeling side kick with a straight leg. It works the outer hip and glutes.
steps: Get on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Extend one leg out to the side with the knee straight.
Lift the leg to about hip height.
Keep your hips and back steady.
Lower with control without touching down.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 跪姿直腿后踢 v. 2
items.description: A kneeling kickback with the working leg kept straight, a second variation. It targets the glutes and the back of the thigh.
steps: Get on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Extend one leg straight behind you with the toes on the floor.
Squeeze the glute and lift the straight leg to hip height.
Pause briefly, then lower the leg without letting the back arch.
Keep your hips level and your core tight.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 跪姿直腿后踢 v. 2(左)
items.description: A kneeling kickback with a straight leg on the left side. It targets the glutes.
steps: Start on all fours.
Extend your left leg straight behind you.
Lift it to hip height.
Squeeze the glute at the top.
Lower with control.
Keep your hips level.

items.name: 跪姿缝匠肌拉伸
items.description: A kneeling stretch for the long strap muscle across the front of the thigh and hip.
steps: Kneel on one knee in a half-kneeling position.
Tuck your pelvis and squeeze the glute of the back leg.
Shift your hips forward slightly.
Lean slightly to the side of the back leg.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Switch legs.

items.name: 跪姿脉冲
items.description: Small pulsing leg lifts from a kneeling position. It gives your glutes a burning, focused workout.
steps: Kneel on all fours with your hands under your shoulders.
Lift one leg back with the knee bent at about 90 degrees.
Pulse the foot upward in small, controlled movements.
Keep your hips square and your back flat.
Finish the set, then switch legs.

items.name: 跪姿脚尖上翘腘绳肌拉伸
items.description: Kneeling on one knee with the other leg extended and toes up to stretch the hamstring and calf.
steps: Kneel on one knee and extend the other leg in front, heel on the floor and toes pulled up.
Place your hands on the floor or the front thigh for support.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back until you feel a pull behind the extended leg.
Keep the extended knee straight but not locked.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

items.name: 跪姿腿半圆
items.description: A kneeling leg arc that works the glutes and outer hip through a half circle.
steps: Start on all fours, hands under shoulders.
Lift one leg out straight behind you.
Sweep it in a half circle out to the side.
Return the same way.
Keep your hips square and switch sides.

items.name: 跪姿臀推
items.description: A hip thrust from a kneeling position. It works the glutes and teaches strong hip extension.
steps: Kneel upright with your hips over your knees and your arms by your sides.
Sit your hips back toward your heels.
Drive your hips forward, squeezing your glutes.
Stand tall at the top without leaning back.
Return slowly and repeat.

items.name: 跪姿臀部推举
items.description: A kneeling move pressing one leg back to fire the glute. Great for learning to feel the glutes work.
steps: Get on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Press one foot back and up, leading with the heel.
Squeeze the glute at the top without arching your back.
Lower with control.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 跪姿起身站立
items.description: A smooth transition from kneeling to standing. It builds leg strength and control.
steps: Kneel with your torso upright.
Place one foot forward into a lunge.
Push through that foot to stand.
Bring your back foot to meet it.
Reverse the motion to return to kneeling.
Alternate the lead leg.

items.name: 跪姿跳箱
items.description: An explosive move that goes from kneeling straight into a box jump. It trains hip drive and power.
steps: Kneel in front of a sturdy box.
Swing your arms back and drive your hips forward.
Pop up from your knees onto your feet.
Jump onto the box in one motion.
Land softly and stand tall.
Step down and reset.

items.name: 跪姿髂腰肌拉伸
items.description: A kneeling lunge stretch for the deep hip flexor. It helps loosen the front of the hip.
steps: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward.
Tuck your pelvis and brace your abs.
Shift your weight forward until you feel the stretch at the front of the hip.
Raise the arm on the kneeling side overhead.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Switch legs.

items.name: 跪姿髋伸展
items.description: Opens the front of the hips from a kneeling position by pushing the pelvis forward, which also wakes up the glutes.
steps: Kneel on a soft surface with knees hip-width apart and thighs upright.
Place your hands on your hips or the back of your pelvis.
Squeeze your glutes and push your hips forward.
Keep your ribs down and avoid over-arching your lower back.
Hold for a moment, then return to the start.
Repeat for 8-12 reps.

items.name: 跪姿髋屈肌拉伸
items.description: A kneeling lunge stretch that opens the front of the hip and thigh. Good after sitting or leg training.
steps: Kneel on one knee with the other foot flat in front of you.
Place a pad under your back knee if needed.
Tuck your pelvis and squeeze the glute of the back leg.
Shift your hips gently forward until you feel a stretch at the front of the hip.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs and repeat.

items.name: 跪姿髋屈肌拉伸
items.description: A lunge-style stretch on one knee that lengthens the front of the hip. It helps with tightness from sitting.
steps: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward in a lunge.
Tuck your pelvis under and squeeze your back glute.
Shift your hips forward gently.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, keeping your torso tall.
Switch sides and repeat.

items.name: 跳上健身箱
items.description: A box jump that builds explosive power in the legs and hips.
steps: Stand facing a plyo box with feet shoulder-width apart.
Swing your arms back and bend your knees.
Jump up and land softly on top of the box with both feet.
Stand fully upright at the top.
Step down carefully.
Reset and repeat.

items.name: 跳上台阶箱
items.description: An explosive jump onto a low step box that builds power in the legs and trains soft, controlled landings.
steps: Stand facing a step box with your feet hip width apart.
Dip into a quarter squat and swing your arms back.
Jump explosively up onto the box, landing softly with bent knees.
Stand tall on top, then step back down one foot at a time.
Reset and repeat, staying quick but controlled.

items.name: 跳箱
items.description: An explosive jump onto a box that builds leg power.
steps: Stand facing a sturdy box with feet shoulder width apart.
Swing your arms back and dip your hips.
Jump up and land softly on top of the box.
Stand fully upright.
Step down carefully and reset.

items.name: 跳箱 v. 2
items.description: A box jump that builds explosive leg power. It trains the whole lower body.
steps: Stand facing a box with feet shoulder width.
Dip and swing your arms back.
Jump onto the box with both feet.
Land softly with bent knees.
Stand tall on the box.
Step down carefully.

items.name: 跳箱左右侧跳
items.nameEn: side to side jump over stepbox
items.description: A lateral jump back and forth over a step box. It builds agility and leg power.
steps: Stand beside a low box with your feet together.
Bend your knees and swing your arms.
Jump sideways over the box.
Land softly on both feet.
Jump back the other way at once.
Keep the pace fast but controlled.

items.name: 跳箱手枪式跳跃深蹲
items.description: A single leg squat to a box followed by a jump. It builds balance and explosive leg strength.
steps: Stand in front of a box on one leg, other leg forward.
Squat down on one leg to touch the box.
Drive through your heel and jump upward.
Land softly on the same leg.
Control your balance and reset.
Complete reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 跳箱落下双脚着地
items.description: You step off a box and land on both feet to practise soft landings. It builds impact control.
steps: Stand at the edge of a low box.
Step off without jumping.
Land on both feet at the same time.
Bend your hips and knees to absorb the impact.
Hold the landing for a second.
Step back up and repeat.

items.name: 跳箱落地跳
items.description: A plyometric where you step off a box, land, and jump up immediately. It trains reactive strength in the legs.
steps: Stand on the edge of a low box with feet hip-width apart.
Step off, do not jump, and land on both feet.
Absorb the landing by bending your knees and hips.
Immediately explode upward into a jump.
Land softly and reset.

items.name: 跳箱跳下双脚落地
items.description: A drop from a box with a soft two foot landing that trains landing control and leg power.
steps: Stand on a sturdy box with your toes near the edge.
Step off the box, do not jump.
Land on both feet at the same time with soft, bent knees.
Sink into a quarter squat to absorb the impact and hold the landing.
Step back up and repeat. Keep your knees in line with your toes.

items.name: 跳跃单腿弓步蹲
items.description: A lunge jump where you land on a single leg. It builds explosive leg power and balance.
steps: Stand in a lunge position.
Lower down, then jump explosively off your front leg.
Land softly on the same leg.
Control the next repetition, keeping your torso upright.
Switch legs after your reps.

items.name: 跳跃手枪式深蹲
items.description: A single leg squat with an explosive jump at the top. It trains leg power and balance.
steps: Stand on one leg with the other extended forward.
Lower into a single leg squat.
Explode upward off the standing leg.
Land softly on the same leg.
Sink back into the next squat.
Complete reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 跳跃深蹲
items.description: A bodyweight squat finished with an explosive jump. It builds leg power and conditioning.
steps: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
弯曲膝盖并将臀部向后推，将身体降低至蹲姿。
爆发性地跳离地面，伸展臀部、膝盖和脚踝。
在半空中时，快速将手臂向前伸以保持平衡。
脚掌轻轻落地，然后立即进入下一个重复动作。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 跳跃深蹲 v. 2
items.description: A bodyweight squat finished with an explosive jump, second variation. It builds leg power and conditioning.
steps: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
弯曲膝盖并将臀部向后推，将身体降低至蹲姿。
爆发力跳跃，充分伸展臀部和膝盖。
脚掌轻轻着地，然后立即将身体放回蹲姿。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 跳跃钟摆
items.description: Side to side hopping that swings your legs like a pendulum, training balance and leg power.
steps: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend.
Hop sideways to land on the other foot.
Swing the free leg across behind you for balance.
Land softly and stay controlled.
Keep alternating at a steady pace.

items.name: 跳过箱
items.description: A jump onto and over a box that builds explosive leg power and coordination.
steps: Stand facing a sturdy box with feet shoulder-width apart.
Swing your arms back and load your hips.
Jump onto the box and land softly with bent knees.
Step or hop down on the other side.
Turn around and repeat in the other direction.
Reset your balance between reps.

items.name: 踏阶
items.description: Stepping onto a bench or box one leg at a time. It builds leg strength and single-leg control.
steps: Stand facing a sturdy step or bench.
Place one foot fully on it.
Press through that heel to lift your body up until the leg is straight.
Lower back down slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 踏阶对侧肘碰膝扭转
items.nameEn: step up opposite elbow to knee twist
items.description: A step up that finishes with a twist, bringing an elbow toward the opposite knee. It trains the legs, trunk and coordination.
steps: Stand facing a sturdy step with hands by your head.
Step up with your right foot and drive the left knee up.
Twist to bring your right elbow toward your left knee.
Step down carefully and reset.
Repeat on the other side, alternating.

items.name: 踢击前弹踢(打沙袋)
items.nameEn: front snap kick kickboxing (with boxing bag)
items.description: A quick snapping front kick at a bag that trains speed and control in the thigh and hip.
steps: Stand in a fighting stance facing the bag.
Raise your knee quickly.
Snap your lower leg out to hit the bag with the ball of your foot.
Recoil right away to bend the knee again.
Keep your hands up.
Set your foot down and switch sides.

items.name: 踢击前弹踢(搭档)
items.description: A quick snapping front kick into a partner's pad that trains speed and leg control.
steps: Face your partner, who holds a pad at body height.
Raise your knee quickly.
Snap your lower leg out to hit the pad with the ball of your foot.
Recoil right away to bend the knee again.
Keep your hands up.
Set your foot down and switch sides.

items.name: 踢击前撩踢(打沙袋)
items.nameEn: front groin kick kickboxing (with boxing bag)
items.description: A straight front kick thrown low at a bag, training leg power and balance.
steps: Stand in a fighting stance facing the bag with hands up.
Lift your rear knee toward your chest.
Extend your leg and drive the ball of your foot into the bag.
Lean back slightly to stay balanced.
Pull your leg back quickly.
Return to your stance and switch sides.

items.name: 踢击前踢(打沙袋)
items.description: A front push kick aimed at a bag that builds leg power, balance and hip flexibility.
steps: Stand in a fighting stance facing the bag.
Lift your rear knee up in front of you.
Extend your leg and push your heel or ball of your foot into the bag.
Lean back slightly and keep your guard up.
Pull the leg back to bend it.
Plant your foot and switch sides.

items.name: 踢击前踢(搭档)
items.description: A front push kick aimed at a partner's pad, training leg power, balance and timing.
steps: Face your partner, who holds a kick pad at body height.
Stand in a fighting stance with hands up.
Raise your rear knee in front of you.
Extend your leg and push the ball of your foot into the pad.
Pull your leg back quickly.
Switch sides after your reps.

items.name: 踢击前顶膝(搭档)
items.description: A knee strike driven forward into a partner's pad, working the thighs, hips and core.
steps: Face your partner, who holds a pad at waist height.
Stand in a fighting stance with hands up.
Drive your rear knee up and forward into the pad.
Rise slightly onto the toes of your standing foot.
Keep your torso upright.
Lower the leg and switch sides.

items.name: 踢击勾踢(打沙袋)
items.description: A roundhouse-style kick that swings in an arc into the bag, building hip rotation and power.
steps: Stand in a fighting stance facing the bag.
Pivot on your standing foot and lift your rear knee out to the side.
Rotate your hips and swing your leg in an arc.
Hit the bag with the top of your foot or shin.
Keep your hands up and your torso steady.
Bring the leg back and switch sides.

items.name: 踢击勾踢(搭档)
items.description: A roundhouse-style hook kick delivered to a partner's pad, building hip rotation and power.
steps: Face your partner, who holds a kick pad to the side.
Stand in a fighting stance with hands up.
Pivot on your standing foot and lift your rear knee out.
Rotate your hips and swing your leg in an arc into the pad.
Keep your torso steady.
Bring the leg back and switch sides.

items.name: 踢腿坐
items.description: A seated core move where you lean back and kick your legs out and in. Works the abs and hip flexors without any equipment.
steps: 坐在长凳或椅子的边缘，双脚平放在地上，膝盖弯曲成 90 度角。
稍微向后倾斜，将双手放在长凳或椅子的边缘以获得支撑。
启动腿筋，将脚抬离地面，并将双腿伸直到身前。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢弯曲膝盖，将脚放回身体。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 踮脚深蹲
items.description: A squat performed on your tiptoes that challenges balance, the quads and the calves.
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and rise onto your toes.
Hold your arms in front for balance.
Squat down while staying up on your toes.
Pause at the bottom.
Stand back up.
Keep your chest tall.

items.name: 身体伸展
items.description: A kneeling lean-back that stretches and strengthens the front of the thighs and the core.
steps: Kneel with your knees hip-width apart and your body upright.
Cross your arms or put your hands on your hips.
Squeeze your glutes and lean back from the knees as one straight line.
Go back as far as you can control.
Pull yourself back up to the start.
Keep your hips forward.

items.name: 辅助保加利亚分腿蹲
items.description: A single-leg squat with the rear foot raised on a bench and a hand lightly holding a support for balance. Trains quads and glutes with less wobble.
steps: Stand facing away from a bench and hold a sturdy post or rack with one hand for balance.
Place the top of your rear foot on a bench behind you.
Step your front foot far enough forward to stay balanced.
Lower straight down until your front thigh is about parallel to the floor.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee tracking over your toes.
Drive through the front heel to stand, then switch legs after your set.

items.name: 辅助单腿深蹲(手枪式)
items.description: A pistol squat where you hold onto a support to help with balance. It builds single-leg strength and control on the way to an unassisted pistol.
steps: Stand next to a sturdy support and hold it with one or both hands.
Lift one leg out in front of you and balance on the other.
Sit your hips back and bend your knee, lowering as far as you can control.
Keep your heel down and your knee tracking over your toes.
Press through your foot to stand, using the support only as needed, then switch legs.

items.name: 配重滑冰者深蹲
items.description: A single-leg squat with arms forward as a counterweight. It builds balance and strength.
steps: Stand on one leg and extend the other behind you.
Reach your arms forward for balance.
Bend your standing knee and lower slowly.
Touch lightly with your back knee if needed.
Drive back up and switch legs.

items.name: 金刚坐瑜伽体式
items.description: Sitting back on your heels in a kneeling pose that stretches your thighs, shins and ankles while keeping your spine tall.
steps: Kneel on the floor with your knees together.
Point your toes back and sit on your heels.
Rest your hands on your thighs.
Lengthen your spine and breathe slowly.
Hold for 30-60 seconds.

items.name: 金字塔式
items.description: A standing forward fold with one leg back. Deeply stretches the back of the front leg.
steps: Step one foot back with both feet facing forward.
Keep both legs straight and your hips square.
Hinge forward from your hips with a long back.
Hold for 5 slow breaths.
Rise slowly and switch legs.

items.name: 铁十字拉伸
items.description: Lie on your back with your arms out and cross one leg over your body toward the opposite hand. It stretches the glutes and lower back.
steps: 平躺，双臂向两侧伸展。
将双腿抬向天花板，保持伸直。
慢慢地将双腿降低到一侧，旨在用脚接触地板。
保持伸展几秒钟，然后将双腿恢复到起始位置。
在另一侧重复拉伸。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

items.name: 错位腿臀桥
items.description: A glute bridge with one foot placed forward to shift more load to one side.
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent, one foot forward of the other.
Press through both heels to lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Keep your hips level.
Lower slowly.
Switch the foot position halfway through.

items.name: 长杠杆站姿髋伸展
items.description: Standing on one leg, you extend the straight leg behind you. It strengthens the glutes and trains balance.
steps: Stand tall holding a support if needed.
Keep your leg straight.
Lift it back behind you.
Stop when your hips begin to tilt.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower it slowly and switch legs.

items.name: 长距离弓步蹲(低位弓步)
items.description: A lunge with an extra-long stride into a low position. It stretches the hips while working the glutes and thighs.
steps: Stand tall with hands on your hips.
Take a very long step forward.
Sink down until your back knee hovers above the floor.
Keep your torso upright and front knee over the ankle.
Push back to the start and switch legs.

items.name: 静态弓步踢腿
items.description: A lunge held in place that ends with a kick from the back leg. It works the legs and balance.
steps: Step into a lunge with your front knee over your ankle.
Lower down until both knees are bent.
Drive up through the front foot.
Swing the back leg forward in a kick.
Return to the lunge and repeat, then switch legs.

items.name: 静态弓步蹲
items.description: A lunge held in one place with no stepping. It builds the legs and balance.
steps: Step one foot forward and stay in a split stance.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front knee above the ankle.
Push through the front heel.
Finish reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 靠墙仰卧单腿腘绳肌拉伸
items.nameEn: lying single leg hamstring stretch against wall
items.description: Lie by a wall and rest one leg up against it to stretch the hamstring. Easy to relax into and good after leg days.
steps: Lie on your back with your hips close to a wall.
Rest one heel on the wall with your leg as straight as feels comfortable.
Keep the other leg flat on the floor.
Relax and breathe, letting the hamstring lengthen.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

items.name: 靠墙倒腿瑜伽体式
items.nameEn: legs up the wall yoga pose
items.description: A restful pose where your legs rest up a wall, gently stretching the backs of the legs and easing tension in the lower back.
steps: Sit sideways next to a wall and lie back as you swing your legs up the wall.
Move your hips close to the wall, with your arms relaxed at your sides.
Keep your knees soft if the hamstrings feel tight.
Breathe slowly and relax your shoulders and jaw.
Hold for 1-5 minutes, then bend your knees and roll to one side to come up.

items.name: 靠墙静蹲
items.description: The wall sit, a hold that builds endurance in the thighs without any equipment.
steps: Stand with your back against a wall and walk your feet forward.
Slide down until your knees are bent to about 90 degrees.
Keep your back flat against the wall and your weight on your heels.
Hold the position while breathing steadily.
Hold for 20-60 seconds, then slide back up the wall to finish.

items.name: 靠墙行进坐
items.description: With your back against a wall, you hold a seated position with knees bent to 90 degrees. Builds endurance in the quads and glutes.
steps: 背靠墙站立，双脚分开与臀部同宽。
慢慢地将背部滑下墙壁，直到膝盖弯曲成 90 度角。
将右脚抬离地面，并将膝盖靠近胸部。
将右脚放低，将左脚抬离地面，将膝盖靠近胸部。
继续交替抬起右脚和左脚，达到所需的重复次数。

items.name: 靠墙静蹲(窄站距)
items.description: Wall sit with feet close together to focus on the quads.
steps: Lean your back on a wall with feet close together.
Slide down until your thighs are about parallel.
Keep knees over ankles.
Hold for 20-60 seconds.
Slide back up slowly.

items.name: 飞蜥式瑜伽体式
items.nameEn: flying lizard yoga pose utthan pristhasana
items.description: A deep lunge-based hip opener with a twist and reach, stretching the hips and inner thighs.
steps: Start in a low lunge with your front foot between your hands.
Lower your forearms to the floor or blocks.
Drop your back knee or keep it lifted.
Let your hips sink.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Step back and switch sides.

items.name: 骆驼式
items.description: A kneeling backbend with hands on your heels. It opens the chest and stretches the thighs and hips.
steps: Kneel with knees hip-width apart and hands on your lower back.
Push your hips forward.
Lean back and reach for your heels.
Lift your chest and let your head drop gently if comfortable.
Hold for 15-30 seconds, then rise.

items.name: 骨盆后倾至臀桥
items.description: Lie on your back with your knees bent, tilt your pelvis, then lift into a bridge. It warms up the glutes, lower back and core.
steps: 仰卧，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将手臂放在身体两侧，手掌朝下。
调动你的臀肌和核心肌肉。
向上倾斜骨盆，将臀部抬离地面。
保持桥位置几秒钟。
慢慢地将臀部放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 髋伸展
items.description: Moving the leg back behind the body, which works the glutes and hamstrings.
steps: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall holding a support, with your weight on one leg.
Swing the other leg straight back, keeping your knee mostly straight.
Squeeze the glute at the top, avoiding any arching of your lower back.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

items.name: 髋伸展拉伸
items.description: A standing or kneeling stretch that lengthens the front of the hip while the glutes work.
steps: Stand or kneel with one foot forward in a lunge position.
Tuck your pelvis under and squeeze the back glute.
Lean slightly forward to feel the stretch at the front of the hip.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.

items.name: 髋内收
items.description: Bringing the leg inward across the body, working the inner thigh.
steps: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall holding a support, with your weight on one leg.
Lift the other leg slightly out to the side.
Bring it back in and across the front of the standing leg, then pause.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

items.name: 髋内旋
items.description: Rotating the thigh inward at the hip, working the muscles that turn the leg in.
steps: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Sit tall on a bench or chair, one knee bent at 90 degrees.
Keep your thigh still and swing your lower leg outward, which rotates the hip inward.
Pause briefly, then return to the starting position under control.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

items.name: 髋内旋测试
items.description: A simple check of how far the hip turns inward. You do it gently to see your range.
steps: Sit or lie with the knee bent 90 degrees.
Keep the thigh still.
Swing the lower leg outward so the hip rotates inward.
Stop where you feel a stretch or end of range.
Note how far each side goes.
Repeat on the other leg.

items.name: 髋外展
items.description: Lifting the leg out to the side away from the body, working the outer hip and glutes.
steps: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall holding a support, with your weight on one leg.
Lift the other leg straight out to the side, toes pointing forward.
Pause briefly, then lower slowly without leaning your torso.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

items.name: 髋外展前屈拉伸
items.nameEn: hip abduction with flexion in front stretch
items.description: Brings the leg forward and out to open the outer hip.
steps: Sit on the floor with one leg bent in front of you.
Place the other leg to the side.
Lean your torso forward over the front shin.
Keep your hips grounded.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

items.name: 髋外旋
items.description: Rotating the thigh outward at the hip, working the deep hip rotators and glutes.
steps: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Sit tall on a bench or chair, one knee bent at 90 degrees.
Keep your thigh still and swing your lower leg inward, which rotates the hip outward.
Pause briefly, then return to the starting position under control.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

items.name: 髋外旋测试
items.description: A simple check of how far the hip turns outward. You do it gently to see your range.
steps: Sit or lie with the knee bent 90 degrees.
Keep the thigh still.
Swing the lower leg inward so the hip rotates outward.
Stop where you feel a stretch or end of range.
Note how far each side goes.
Repeat on the other leg.

items.name: 髋外旋肌拉伸
items.description: A floor stretch for the deep hip rotators and buttock muscles.
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee and pull the lower thigh toward your chest until the buttock stretches.
Keep your head and shoulders relaxed on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

items.name: 髋屈曲
items.description: Lifting the thigh forward and up, working the hip flexors and front of the thigh.
steps: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall holding a support, with your weight on one leg.
Lift the other knee up in front of you toward hip height.
Pause briefly, then lower slowly without rounding your back.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

items.name: 髋屈肌拉伸(后脚垫高)
items.description: A deep lunge stretch with the back foot raised on a bench, targeting the quads and hip flexors.
steps: Place the top of your back foot on a bench behind you.
Step your front foot forward into a lunge.
Tuck your pelvis and push your hips forward.
Keep your chest tall and hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.

items.name: 髋膝屈曲深蹲拉伸
items.nameEn: hip and knee flexion squatting stretch
items.description: A deep squat hold that opens the hips and loosens the knees and ankles.
steps: Stand with your feet a little wider than your shoulders and toes turned slightly out.
Sink down into a deep squat and press your elbows against your inner knees to open the hips.
Keep your heels on the floor and your chest tall.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

items.name: 髋部屈伸拉伸
items.description: A gentle hip stretch that moves through flexion and extension to loosen the hips and glutes.
steps: Lie on your back with your legs extended.
Pull one knee toward your chest with both hands.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Extend the leg again and press it down to the floor.
Repeat on the other leg.
Breathe slowly and stay relaxed.

items.name: 髋部画圈
items.description: Standing hip circles that loosen the hip joints and warm up the pelvis.
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hands on your hips.
Slightly bend your knees.
Move your hips in a large smooth circle, as if drawing it with your belt buckle.
Do several circles one way, then switch direction.
Keep your shoulders still and relaxed.

items.name: 髋部绕圈拉伸
items.description: Big circles with your hips that loosen the joint and the muscles around it. A good warm-up for leg days.
steps: Stand with your feet slightly wider than shoulder width.
Place your hands on your hips.
Rotate your hips in a wide circle.
Do 10 circles in one direction.
Reverse and circle the other way.
Keep your shoulders still and your knees soft.

items.name: 髋部蚌式开合
items.description: A side-lying clamshell opening of the knees. It strengthens the outer hips.
steps: Lie on your side with knees bent and feet together.
Keep your feet touching.
Lift your top knee.
Lower slowly.
Switch sides after your reps.

items.name: 高弓步
items.description: A deep lunge with the back heel lifted and arms overhead. Strengthens the legs and stretches the hips.
steps: Step one foot back into a long lunge with your back heel lifted.
Bend your front knee to about 90 degrees over your ankle.
Sweep your arms overhead and stand tall.
Hold for 5 slow breaths.
Step forward and switch legs.

items.name: 高抬膝深蹲
items.description: A squat followed by a high knee drive as you stand. It combines leg strength with a cardio push.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Squat down with your chest up.
Drive up through your feet to stand.
Lift one knee toward your chest as you reach the top.
Lower the foot and go back into the squat.
Alternate knees on each rep.

items.name: 高抬膝深蹲 v. 2
items.description: A squat followed by a high knee drive, combining leg strength with a bit of cardio.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down with your chest lifted.
Stand up explosively and drive one knee up toward your chest.
Land softly and drop into the next squat.
Alternate knees on each rep.

items.name: 高抬膝行走
items.description: A walking warm-up where you lift each knee high. It primes the hips and legs.
steps: Stand tall with your arms relaxed.
Lift one knee toward your chest.
Step forward and lower it to the floor.
Repeat on the other side.
Keep your torso upright.
Walk 10-20 steps per leg.

items.name: 高抬膝踏阶
items.description: A step-up on a bench or box finishing with a high knee drive. It trains the legs and balance.
steps: Stand in front of a sturdy bench or step.
Place one foot fully on it.
Drive through that foot to step up and lift the other knee high.
Step back down with control.
Keep your torso upright.
Repeat, then switch legs.

items.name: 高箱踏阶
items.description: Stepping up onto a tall box. It builds the quads and glutes.
steps: Stand facing a high box.
Place one foot fully on top.
Drive through that heel to stand up.
Bring the other foot up.
Step down with control.
Switch leading legs.

items.name: 鸭子步
items.description: A walk in a deep squat that challenges the quads, hips and balance.
steps: Lower into a deep squat with your chest up.
Place your hands on your hips or in front of you for balance.
Step forward with one foot, keeping the squat low.
Step with the other foot and continue walking.
Keep your heels down and your back straight.
Walk for a set distance or time.

items.name: 鸽式髋部拉伸
items.description: A yoga-style hip opener with one shin folded in front, stretching the glutes and the hip flexors of the back leg.
steps: Start on hands and knees and slide one knee forward behind your wrist.
Extend the other leg straight behind you.
Lower your hips toward the floor and keep your chest tall.
Fold forward over the front leg for a deeper stretch if comfortable.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

items.name: 鹰式
items.description: A balancing pose with legs and arms wrapped. It stretches the hips and shoulders and trains balance.
steps: Stand and bend your knees slightly.
Cross one thigh over the other, hooking the foot behind the calf if you can.
Wrap your arms, one under the other, palms together.
Sit your hips low and lift your elbows.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch.

items.name: 鹰式瑜伽体式
items.description: A balancing pose with wrapped legs and arms. It stretches the hips and shoulders and builds focus.
steps: Stand tall and bend both knees slightly.
Lift one leg and wrap it across the other thigh.
Cross your arms in front, one elbow over the other, palms together.
Lift your elbows and sink your hips slightly.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

items.name: 3/4仰卧起坐
items.description: A shortened sit-up that stops at about 45 degrees, keeping tension on the abs the whole time.
steps: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，慢慢将上半身抬离地面，向前卷曲，直到躯干呈 45 度角。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 45度侧弯
items.description: A standing side bend that works the obliques by leaning the torso sideways and coming back up.
steps: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双臂在身体两侧笔直向下伸展。
保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与，慢慢将躯干向一侧弯曲，将手向膝盖方向放低。
在底部停顿片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
在另一侧重复。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

items.name: 45度侧弯
items.description: A side bend done on a 45 degree bench that trains the obliques through a long range of motion.
steps: Set up on a 45 degree bench, lying on your side with your feet anchored.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Lower your upper body toward the floor.
Bend up sideways by contracting your oblique.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

items.name: 45度扭转山羊挺身
items.description: A back extension on a 45 degree bench with a rotation at the top that adds work for the obliques and lower back.
steps: Position yourself on the bench with your ankles under the pads and your hips just off the edge.
Cross your arms over your chest and lower your torso with a flat back.
Raise your torso back up, squeezing your glutes.
At the top, rotate your upper body gently to one side, then return to center.
Alternate sides each rep and keep the movement slow and controlled.

items.name: 45度自行车扭转卷腹
items.description: A twisting bicycle crunch with the torso leaning back at 45 degrees. It strongly targets the abs and obliques.
steps: Sit and lean back to about 45 degrees with your feet raised.
Place your hands behind your head.
Bring one knee in as you twist the opposite elbow toward it.
Alternate sides in a pedalling motion.
Keep your chest lifted and your core tight.

items.name: 90度触脚跟
items.description: Lie with legs raised and reach toward your heels. It works the abs and obliques.
steps: Lie with your legs up and knees bent at 90 degrees.
Lift your shoulders.
Reach one hand toward the heel.
Switch sides.
Keep your legs still.

items.name: 90度触脚跟 v. 2
items.description: Lying on your back with your knees bent, you reach side to side to tap your heels, working your obliques.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Lift your shoulders slightly off the floor.
Reach your right hand toward your right heel.
Switch and reach your left hand to your left heel.
Keep your core tight and continue alternating.

items.name: L坐
items.description: An isometric hold where your body is supported by your arms and your legs stay straight out in front, forming an L.
steps: Sit between two supports or on the floor and place your hands beside your hips.
Press down through your hands to lift your hips and legs off the floor.
Extend your legs straight in front of you.
Keep your shoulders pressed down and your core tight.
Hold for as long as you can with good form, then lower.

items.name: L坐抬腿
items.description: A raise from an L-sit position. It builds strong abs and hip flexors.
steps: Sit on the floor with your hands on parallettes or flat beside you.
Press down to lift your hips.
Extend your legs in front of you.
Raise your legs higher and lower them back to the L position.
Keep your arms straight and shoulders down.

items.name: V字双卷腹
items.description: A V up where you crunch your arms and legs together twice. It hits the whole abdominal wall.
steps: Lie flat with arms overhead.
Lift your arms and legs into a V.
Crunch in again.
Lower with control.
Keep your legs straight.

items.name: V字坐交叉出拳
items.description: Hold a V sit and punch across your body. You train the abs and obliques while balancing.
steps: Sit with knees bent and lean back, lifting your feet off the floor.
Raise your fists in front of your chest.
Punch one arm across your body while twisting your torso.
Return to center and punch with the other arm.
Keep your chest tall and your balance steady.

items.name: V字坐摸脚尖
items.description: Hold a V sit and reach to tap your toes. It strengthens the abs and challenges balance.
steps: Sit on the floor and lean back, lifting your legs into a V.
Reach both arms forward.
Crunch up and tap your toes with your fingers.
Lower slightly back while keeping your feet up.
Keep your chest open and repeat.

items.name: V字起
items.description: Lift your legs and torso together to form a V, a demanding core move.
steps: Lie flat with arms extended overhead.
Raise legs and torso at the same time.
Reach your hands toward your toes.
Lower with control without touching the floor.
Keep your legs as straight as you can.

items.name: V字起保持
items.description: Hold a V-shaped position with legs and torso lifted. Builds strong abs and balance.
steps: Sit on the floor with knees bent and lean back slightly.
Lift your legs and straighten them to form a V.
Reach your arms forward alongside your legs.
Hold for 15-30 seconds.
Keep your chest open and back from rounding.
Lower with control.

items.name: V字起身击掌
items.description: A V up finishing with a clap above the legs. It trains the core and coordination.
steps: Lie flat with arms overhead.
Lift your arms and legs into a V.
Clap above your shins.
Lower with control.
Repeat smoothly.

items.name: 上斜交替打水腿
items.description: Lying on an incline, you alternate straight-leg flutter kicks. It trains the lower abs.
steps: Lie back on an incline bench and hold the edges behind your head.
Lift your legs a few inches off the floor.
Kick your legs up and down alternately in small motions.
Keep your lower back pressed down.
Continue for the set time or reps.

items.name: 上斜开合跳平板支撑
items.description: A plank with hands on a raised surface, jumping your feet in and out like a jumping jack. It builds core and gets the heart rate up.
steps: Place your hands on a bench in an incline plank.
Brace your core and keep your body straight.
Jump your feet wide.
Jump them back together.
Keep your hips level and the pace steady.

items.name: 上斜扭转仰卧起坐
items.description: On an incline, you sit up and twist toward each side. It works the abs and obliques.
steps: 设置一个 45 度角的上斜凳。
躺在长凳上，双脚固定在脚垫下。
将双手放在脑后或放在胸前。
收紧腹肌，将上半身抬离长凳，向前卷曲。
当你蜷缩起来时，将你的躯干扭转到一侧，将你的肘部拉向另一侧的膝盖。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复这个动作，这次将你的躯干扭转到另一侧。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

items.name: 上斜扭转仰卧起坐 v. 2
items.description: An incline sit-up with a twist to work the obliques as well as the abs.
steps: Lie on an incline bench with your feet secured.
Place your hands lightly behind your head.
Curl up while rotating your torso to one side.
Lower slowly.
Alternate sides each rep.

items.name: 上斜抬腿抬髋(直腿)
items.description: Lying on an incline with straight legs, you raise your hips by lifting the legs. It works the lower abs.
steps: 躺在倾斜的长凳上，背部平放在长凳上，双腿伸直在身前。
将双手放在长凳两侧以获得支撑。
收紧腹肌，将双腿抬离长凳，尽可能抬高双腿，同时保持伸直。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 上斜抬髋
items.description: Lying on an incline bench, you lift your hips off the pad by curling the pelvis. It targets the lower abs.
steps: Lie on an incline bench and hold the top edge behind your head.
Bring your legs up so your knees are over your hips.
Curl your pelvis up to lift your hips off the bench.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly without swinging.
Keep the movement small and controlled.

items.name: 下斜仰卧起坐
items.description: A sit-up on a decline bench with the feet secured. The slope makes it harder and works the abs and hip flexors.
steps: 躺在倾斜的长凳上，双脚固定，膝盖弯曲。
将双手放在脑后或放在胸前。
收紧腹肌，将上半身抬离长凳，向前向膝盖弯曲。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 下斜仰卧起坐 v. 3
items.description: Sit-up on a decline bench that increases the range and load on the abs.
steps: Hook your feet under the pads on a decline bench and lie back.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Curl your torso up until you are sitting tall.
Lower back slowly without dropping.
Keep your neck relaxed.

items.name: 下斜仰卧起坐(直臂)
items.description: A sit-up on a decline bench with your arms held straight out in front. It trains the abs through a longer range, and straight arms make it a bit harder.
steps: Lie on a decline bench and hook your feet under the pads.
Extend your arms straight in front of you, parallel to the floor.
Curl your torso up, rolling off the bench one section at a time.
Reach your arms toward your knees as you sit up.
Lower back down slowly with control.
Keep your chin off your chest and don't yank with your arms.

items.name: 下斜仰卧起坐加俄罗斯转体
items.nameEn: decline sit up and russian twist
items.description: A decline sit up followed by a Russian twist at the top. It trains the abs and obliques.
steps: Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured.
Sit up toward your knees.
Twist your torso to one side at the top.
Twist to the other side.
Lower slowly to the bench.
Keep your movements controlled.

items.name: 下斜卷腹
items.description: A crunch performed on a decline bench with the feet secured. The slope adds resistance for the abs.
steps: 躺在倾斜的长凳上，双脚固定，膝盖弯曲成 90 度角。
将双手放在脑后或放在胸前。
收紧腹肌，将上半身抬向膝盖，卷曲躯干。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 下斜屈膝反向卷腹
items.description: Reverse crunch on a decline bench that curls the hips toward the chest and trains the lower abs.
steps: Lie on a decline bench and hold the top edge above your head.
Bring your knees up and bend them.
Curl your hips off the bench, drawing your knees toward your chest.
Lower back down slowly without swinging.
Keep the movement controlled throughout.

items.name: 下斜屈膝抬腿
items.description: Knee raises on a decline bench. The slope adds difficulty and focuses on the lower abs.
steps: Lie on a decline bench and grip the top behind your head.
Extend your legs with a slight knee bend.
Pull your knees up toward your chest, curling the pelvis off the bench.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower your legs slowly without letting the hips drop hard.
Keep the movement smooth, not jerky.

items.name: 下斜扭转仰卧起坐
items.description: A sit up on a decline bench with a twist to work the abs and obliques.
steps: Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured.
Place your hands lightly behind your head.
Sit up while rotating your torso to one side.
Pause at the top.
Lower with control.
Alternate sides each rep.

items.name: 下斜抬腿抬髋
items.description: A leg raise on a decline bench, finishing with a hip lift for the lower abs.
steps: Lie on a decline bench and hold the top edge.
Bring your legs up over your hips.
Lift your hips toward the ceiling.
Lower your hips first.
Lower your legs with control.
Avoid swinging.

items.name: 下躯干屈肌拉伸
items.description: A backbend style stretch that lengthens the front of the abdomen and hips.
steps: Lie face down with your hands under your shoulders.
Press up through your hands and let your hips sink toward the floor until the lower abdomen stretches.
Keep your hips on the floor and your shoulders relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

items.name: 中式平板支撑
items.description: A plank variation held with a modified base that challenges core stability.
steps: Set up in a plank on your forearms with elbows under shoulders.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs.
Keep your body in one straight line.
Breathe steadily and hold for 20-40 seconds.
Lower down to rest.

items.name: 交叉卷腹
items.description: A crunch where you rotate to bring one elbow toward the opposite knee. It targets the abs and the obliques.
steps: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，将上半身抬离地面，然后扭转，使右肘靠近左膝盖。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
在另一侧重复，将左肘靠近右膝盖。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 交叉扭转仰卧起坐
items.description: A sit-up with a twist to bring one elbow toward the opposite knee.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and hands behind your head.
Curl up and twist toward one knee.
Lower slowly.
Alternate sides.
Avoid pulling on your neck.

items.name: 交叉扭转仰卧起坐 v. 2
items.description: A sit-up with a cross-body twist, a second variation. It works the abs and obliques together.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and hands behind your head.
Sit up while rotating your torso.
Bring one elbow toward the opposite knee.
Lower back down slowly.
Alternate sides each rep.
Avoid pulling on your neck.

items.name: 交叉扭转卷腹
items.description: A crunch that twists across the body, bringing the elbow toward the opposite knee. It emphasises the obliques.
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your hands behind your head.
Lift your shoulders and twist your torso to one side.
Bring your elbow toward the opposite knee.
Lower back down and repeat on the other side.
Keep your lower back on the floor.
Do not pull on your neck.

items.name: 交叉抬腿
items.description: Lying leg raises with legs crossing over each other. It targets the lower abs and inner thighs.
steps: Lie on your back with legs straight and raised.
Lower them slightly.
Cross one leg over the other.
Switch the cross.
Keep your lower back down.

items.name: 交叉站姿卷腹
items.description: A standing crunch that brings your elbow across to the opposite knee. It trains the abs and obliques.
steps: Stand tall with your hands behind your head.
Lift one knee and rotate your torso.
Bring the opposite elbow toward that knee.
Return to standing.
Alternate sides for the set.

items.name: 交替地面仰卧抬腿
items.description: Raise one leg at a time while lying on the floor, working the lower abs.
steps: Lie on your back with legs straight and arms at your sides.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Raise one leg to about 90 degrees.
Lower it slowly and lift the other leg.
Alternate without arching your back.

items.name: 交替打腿 v. 2
items.description: Small alternating leg kicks that burn the lower abs.
steps: Lie on your back with hands under your hips.
Lift both legs a few inches off the floor.
Kick your legs up and down in small, quick alternating moves.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Continue for 20-40 seconds.

items.name: 交替打腿 v. 3
items.description: Small alternating leg kicks while lying down. They fire up the lower abs and hip flexors.
steps: Lie on your back with your legs straight and hands under your hips.
Lift your legs a few inches off the floor.
Kick your legs up and down in small alternating motions.
Keep your lower back pressed to the floor.
Continue for a set time and breathe steadily.

items.name: 交替打腿(手放臀下抬头)
items.nameEn: flutter kicks (hands under hips head up)
items.description: Fast alternating leg lifts with your head raised that fire up the lower abs.
steps: Lie on your back with hands tucked under your hips.
Lift your head and shoulders slightly off the floor.
Raise both legs a few inches above the ground.
Kick your legs up and down in small alternating pulses.
Keep your lower back pressed down and breathe steadily.

items.name: 交替抬腿
items.description: Lying on your back, you raise one leg at a time. It works the lower abs and hip flexors.
steps: Lie flat on your back with your legs straight and arms at your sides.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Raise one leg up toward the ceiling.
Lower it slowly while lifting the other leg.
Keep alternating without arching your back.

items.name: 交替点脚尖抬腿
items.description: Lie on your back and tap each toe up toward the ceiling in turn. It targets the lower abs.
steps: Lie on your back with both legs raised straight up.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Reach one leg up so your toes tap toward the ceiling.
Alternate legs with control.
Keep your core tight and breathe steadily.

items.name: 交替腹斜肌卷腹
items.description: A crunch that alternates elbow-to-knee across the body, hitting the obliques.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and hands behind your head.
Lift your shoulders off the floor.
Twist and bring one elbow toward the opposite knee.
Return to center and switch sides.
Move slowly and avoid pulling on your neck.

items.name: 交替触脚跟
items.description: Lying on your back, you crunch sideways to reach each hand toward its heel in turn. Works the obliques and abs.
steps: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双臂伸直至两侧，与地面平行。
收紧腹肌，将肩膀抬离地面，并将右手伸向右脚跟。
返回起始位置并在左侧重复，将左手伸向左脚跟。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

items.name: 人体旗
items.description: A gymnastics hold where you grip a vertical pole and hold your body out to the side. It trains the obliques, shoulders and lats.
steps: 首先，双手握住一根垂直杆，手掌相对，双臂完全伸展。
启动你的核心并将双腿抬离地面，保持伸直。
利用核心和上半身的力量，抬起双腿，直到它们与地面平行。
尽可能长时间地保持这个姿势，保持身体线条笔直。
慢慢地将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 仰卧上身旋转
items.description: Rotate your upper body while lying down to loosen the mid-back.
steps: Lie on your side with knees bent and arms stretched in front of you.
Keep your knees stacked.
Lift the top arm and open it across to the other side, following it with your eyes.
Return the arm to the start.
Do 10 reps, then switch sides.

items.name: 仰卧交叉腿
items.description: Lying on your back, you cross your legs back and forth. It works the lower abs.
steps: Lie on your back with legs raised slightly off the floor.
Press your lower back down.
Cross one leg over the other.
Switch and cross the other way.
Continue smoothly.

items.name: 仰卧交叉腿
items.description: Lying on your back, you cross straight legs over each other. It works the lower abs and inner thighs.
steps: Lie on your back with your hands by your sides.
Lift both legs a little off the floor with your lower back pressed down.
Open them wide, then cross one leg over the other.
Open again and cross with the other leg on top.
Keep your core tight throughout.

items.name: 仰卧交替触脚尖(地面)
items.description: Lying on your back with legs raised, you reach up to touch your toes alternately. It works the abs and obliques.
steps: Lie on your back with both legs raised toward the ceiling.
Extend your arms up.
Crunch up and reach one hand toward the opposite foot.
Lower and reach with the other hand.
Keep your legs steady.

items.name: 仰卧侧向抬腿
items.description: Lower your legs to the side from a raised position to hit the lower abs and obliques.
steps: Lie on your back with arms out to the sides and legs raised straight up.
Keep your shoulders on the floor.
Lower both legs toward one side, stopping just above the floor.
Bring them back up through the middle.
Repeat to the other side and keep alternating.

items.name: 仰卧全程抬腿
items.description: Raise both straight legs from the floor to work the lower abs and hip flexors.
steps: Lie on your back with legs straight and hands under your hips or by your sides.
Press your lower back gently into the floor.
Lift both legs together until they point at the ceiling.
Lower them slowly, stopping just above the floor.
Keep your legs straight and do not let your back arch.

items.name: 仰卧剪刀卷腹
items.description: A crunch combined with alternating leg scissors. It targets the abs and lower belly.
steps: Lie on your back with hands behind your head.
Lift your legs a few inches off the floor.
Crunch your shoulders up.
Scissor your legs, crossing one over the other.
Keep your lower back pressed down.
Switch which leg crosses on top each rep.

items.name: 仰卧剪刀腿
items.description: Alternating small leg kicks while lying down. It challenges the lower abs and hip flexors.
steps: Lie on your back with hands under your hips.
Lift both legs a few inches off the floor.
Raise one leg higher while the other stays low.
Switch legs in a smooth scissor motion.
Keep your lower back pressed to the floor.
Breathe steadily throughout.

items.name: 仰卧卷腹(直腿)
items.description: A crunch with straight legs on the floor that trains the upper abs.
steps: Lie on your back with your legs straight.
Place your hands behind your head or across your chest.
Curl your shoulders off the floor.
Pause and squeeze your abs.
Lower slowly without pulling on your neck.

items.name: 仰卧双腿同时交替抬腿
items.description: Lying down, you lift legs in opposite directions at the same time. It works the lower abs and hips.
steps: Lie on your back with your arms by your sides.
Raise one leg toward the ceiling while the other hovers near the floor.
Switch the legs at the same time.
Keep both legs mostly straight.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Move at a controlled pace.

items.name: 仰卧同时交替直腿抬腿
items.nameEn: lying simultaneous alternating straight leg raise
items.description: A floor core move where both legs work together in an alternating pattern, challenging the lower abs and hip flexors.
steps: Lie on your back with your legs straight and your hands under your hips or at your sides.
Press your lower back into the floor and brace your abs.
Raise one leg while the other lowers toward the floor, keeping both straight.
Switch legs in a smooth scissor pattern without letting your back arch.
Continue for the planned reps or time.

items.name: 仰卧地面6英寸保持
items.description: A floor hold where you lie on your back with your legs and shoulders lifted about six inches. It trains deep abdominal tension and endurance.
steps: Lie on your back with your legs straight and arms by your sides.
Press your lower back into the floor and brace your abs.
Lift your heels and shoulders about 15 cm off the floor.
Keep your lower back flat and breathe steadily.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then lower and rest.

items.name: 仰卧地面侧向拉伸
items.nameEn: lateral stretch on floor lying down
items.description: A lying side stretch that gently lengthens one side of the body.
steps: Lie on your back with your arms extended overhead.
Shift your feet and your upper body to one side to form a gentle banana curve until the opposite side stretches.
Keep both shoulders and hips on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

items.name: 仰卧地面单腿离心龙旗
items.nameEn: lying floor single leg negative dragon flag
items.description: A dragon flag lowering with one leg extended and one tucked. It's a step between the half and full versions.
steps: Lie on a mat and hold something fixed behind your head.
Raise your body into a straight line with one leg tucked.
Extend the other leg straight.
Lower slowly while keeping your hips level.
Stop just above the floor.
Reset and switch legs.

items.name: 仰卧地面水平打水腿
items.description: Small alternating kicks while lying down. It trains the lower abs and hip flexors.
steps: Lie on your back with your legs straight and hands under your hips.
Lift your feet a few inches off the floor.
Kick your legs up and down in small alternating motions.
Keep your lower back pressed down.
Breathe steadily.
Continue for 20 to 40 seconds.

items.name: 仰卧地面离心半龙旗
items.nameEn: lying floor negative half dragon flag
items.description: A gentler dragon flag lowering with your knees bent. It builds the strength needed for the full move.
steps: Lie on a mat and hold something fixed behind your head.
Lift your hips and tuck your knees.
Brace your core.
Lower your body slowly with bent knees.
Stop just above the floor.
Reset and repeat.

items.name: 仰卧地面离心龙旗
items.description: Lying on the floor, you lower your straight body slowly for the dragon flag. A tough ab and core strengthener.
steps: Lie on a mat and hold something fixed behind your head.
Raise your body into a straight line on your upper back.
Brace your core.
Lower your body slowly keeping it straight.
Stop just above the floor.
Bring your legs back up and reset.

items.name: 仰卧屈腿抬起
items.description: Floor ab exercise where you lift bent knees toward your chest, working the lower abs with less lever length than straight legs.
steps: Lie on your back with hands under your hips or by your sides.
Bend your knees and lift your feet off the floor.
Curl your hips up slightly as you bring your knees toward your chest.
Lower your legs slowly without letting your lower back arch.
Repeat for the target reps.

items.name: 仰卧屈膝卷腹
items.description: A crunch where your knees pull in as your chest comes up. It trains the abs.
steps: Lie on your back with your legs extended just off the floor.
Place your hands behind your head.
Pull your knees in and crunch your chest toward them.
Squeeze your abs at the top.
Extend and lower slowly.

items.name: 仰卧屈膝抬腿
items.description: From lying on your back, you draw your knees toward your chest. It works the lower abs.
steps: Lie on your back with your legs extended.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Draw your knees up toward your chest.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly without arching.

items.name: 仰卧抬腿
items.description: A floor exercise that raises straight legs to hit the lower abs.
steps: Lie on your back with legs straight and hands under your hips.
Press your lower back gently into the floor.
Lift your legs together until they point at the ceiling.
Lower them slowly, stopping just above the floor.
Keep your back from arching throughout.

items.name: 仰卧抬腿 v. 2
items.description: Raising your legs while lying on your back. It works the lower abs and the hip flexors.
steps: Lie on your back with legs straight and arms by your sides.
Press your lower back gently into the floor.
Lift both legs together until they point to the ceiling.
Lower them slowly, stopping before your back arches.
Keep your legs as straight as you comfortably can.
Breathe steadily through each rep.

items.name: 仰卧抬腿 v. 3
items.description: Raising your legs while lying on your back. It works the lower abs and the hip flexors.
steps: Lie on your back with legs straight and arms by your sides.
Press your lower back gently into the floor.
Lift both legs together until they point to the ceiling.
Lower them slowly, stopping before your back arches.
Keep your legs as straight as you comfortably can.
Breathe steadily through each rep.

items.name: 仰卧抬腿(改良版)
items.description: An easier lying leg raise that trains the lower abs. Bent knees reduce the strain on the lower back.
steps: Lie on your back with your hands by your sides.
Bend your knees slightly and press your lower back into the floor.
Raise your legs until your hips flex to about 90 degrees.
Lower them slowly without arching your back.
Stop short of the floor and repeat.

items.name: 仰卧抬腿并保持
items.description: Raising your legs from the floor and holding them up. It targets the lower abs.
steps: Lie on your back with your legs straight and your hands by your sides.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Raise your legs until they are vertical.
Lower them to just above the floor and hold for a couple of seconds.
Repeat without letting your back arch.

items.name: 仰卧抬腿抬髋
items.description: A lying leg raise that also lifts the hips off the floor at the top. It trains the lower abs.
steps: 平躺，双腿伸展，双臂放在身体两侧。
将双手放在臀部下方以获得支撑。
启动你的核心并将双腿抬离地面，将它们抬向天花板。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 仰卧拉颈
items.description: A roll up from lying with your hands behind your head, training the abs.
steps: Lie on your back with hands behind your head.
Curl your head and shoulders up.
Roll up to sit.
Reach forward.
Roll down with control.

items.name: 仰卧点脚尖
items.description: From a tabletop position, alternate lowering a foot to tap the floor while keeping the lower back steady.
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent at 90 degrees over your hips.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Lower one foot to tap the floor.
Bring it back to tabletop.
Alternate legs with control.

items.name: 仰卧盆底放松与深呼吸
items.nameEn: lying pelvic floor relaxation and deep breathing
items.description: A gentle lying breathing drill that lets the pelvic floor and belly relax. It helps you learn calm, deep breathing.
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Rest your hands on your lower belly.
Breathe in slowly through your nose and let your belly rise.
Let your pelvic floor and hips soften as you inhale.
Breathe out slowly through your mouth.
Continue for 1 to 2 minutes at a relaxed pace.

items.name: 仰卧直腿抬腿 v. 2
items.description: A lying leg raise that targets the lower abs and hip flexors while you keep your legs long.
steps: Lie on your back with your legs straight and your hands under your hips.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Raise both legs together until they point to the ceiling.
Lower them slowly, stopping just above the floor.
Keep your core braced and your back from arching.

items.name: 仰卧直腿踏步
items.description: Alternating straight-leg raises while lying on your back, like a slow march. It trains the lower abs and hip flexors.
steps: Lie on your back, arms by your sides.
Press your lower back gently into the floor.
Raise one straight leg toward the ceiling.
Lower it as you raise the other leg.
Keep alternating in a slow, steady march.
Keep your back from arching.

items.name: 仰卧空中蹬车
items.description: A floor cycling move that keeps the core working while the legs pedal in the air. It builds abdominal endurance.
steps: Lie on your back with your hands by your head or at your sides.
Lift your shoulders and legs slightly off the floor.
Pedal your legs as if riding a bicycle.
Keep your lower back pressed into the floor.
Breathe steadily and keep a smooth rhythm.
Lower your legs and rest when your form slips.

items.name: 仰卧肘碰膝
items.description: A floor crunch that brings elbow to opposite knee. Works the abs and obliques.
steps: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，将上半身抬离地面，将右肘靠近左膝盖。
同时，将右腿伸直并抬离地面。
暂停片刻，然后回到起始位置。
重复该动作，这次将左肘移向右膝盖并伸展左腿。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

items.name: 仰卧脊柱扭转瑜伽姿势
items.description: A relaxing lying twist that mobilises the spine and stretches the hips and sides of the trunk.
steps: Lie on your back with your arms out to the sides.
Pull one knee toward your chest.
Guide that knee across your body toward the floor on the opposite side.
Keep both shoulders on the floor and turn your head the other way if comfortable.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

items.name: 仰卧腹式呼吸
items.description: A calm lying breathing drill that focuses on belly breathing. It helps you relax and learn core control.
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your hands on your belly.
Breathe in slowly through your nose.
Feel your belly rise under your hands.
Breathe out slowly through your mouth.
Let your belly lower gently.
Continue for 1 to 2 minutes.

items.name: 仰卧腹直肌激活卷腹
items.description: A small, focused crunch from lying down. It helps you feel the front abdominal muscle working.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Place your hands lightly on your abs or behind your head.
Exhale and curl your shoulders off the floor.
Feel the abs tighten at the top.
Lower back slowly.
Keep your neck relaxed.

items.name: 仰卧腹部剪刀卷腹
items.description: Lying on your back, you crunch up while scissoring your legs. It works the upper and lower abs together.
steps: Lie on your back with your hands behind your head.
Lift your shoulders and your legs slightly off the floor.
Scissor your legs up and down in alternating motion.
Crunch your ribs toward your hips.
Keep your lower back pressed down.
Continue for a set count of reps.

items.name: 仰卧腹部推压
items.description: A lying core move where you press your arms and legs together to crunch the abs. Targets the front of the trunk.
steps: Lie on your back with arms and legs extended.
Brace your abs and press your lower back to the floor.
Lift your shoulders and bring your knees toward your chest.
Reach your hands to your knees and squeeze.
Return slowly without letting your feet touch down.
Repeat for reps.

items.name: 仰卧腿部8字
items.description: Lying on your back, you trace a figure eight in the air with your legs. It keeps the lower abs and hip flexors under tension.
steps: Lie on your back with your hands under your hips and legs lifted.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Trace a figure eight in the air with your feet, slowly and in control.
Keep your legs close together.
Change direction halfway through the set.

items.name: 仰卧膝部滚动拉伸
items.description: Rolls the knees to one side while lying on your back to twist the lower spine and loosen the hips and sides.
steps: Lie on your back with arms out to the sides and knees bent.
Keep your shoulders flat on the floor.
Slowly lower both knees to one side.
Turn your head the other way if it feels comfortable.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Bring the knees back to centre and roll to the other side.

items.name: 仰卧自行车卷腹
items.description: A lying alternating crunch that pedals the legs while the elbow meets the opposite knee. It works the abs and obliques.
steps: Lie on your back with your hands behind your head.
Lift your shoulders and bring your knees up.
Extend one leg while turning your opposite elbow toward the other knee.
Switch sides in a smooth pedalling motion.
Keep your lower back pressed down.

items.name: 仰卧触脚尖
items.description: Lying with the legs up, reach your hands toward your toes. It trains the upper abs.
steps: Lie on your back with your legs straight up.
Reach your arms up toward your toes.
Lift your shoulders off the floor and touch your toes.
Lower your shoulders slowly.
Keep your legs steady.

items.name: 仰卧起坐
items.description: The classic sit up, curling your torso from the floor to upright. It builds strength in the abs and hip flexors.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Cross your arms over your chest or rest your fingertips by your head.
Curl your torso up until your chest nears your thighs.
Lower slowly back to the floor with control.
Avoid yanking on your neck; lead with your chest.

items.name: 仰卧起坐 v. 2
items.description: You lie on your back and curl your torso up toward your knees. Works the abs and hip flexors.
steps: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，慢慢将上半身抬离地面，向前卷曲，直到躯干呈 45 度角。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 仰卧雨刷
items.description: Lying on your back, you swing the legs side to side like wipers. It strengthens the obliques and trunk control.
steps: Lie on your back with arms out to the sides, palms down.
Lift your legs straight up over your hips.
Lower both legs to one side without touching the floor.
Bring them back up through the middle.
Lower to the other side and keep alternating.

items.name: 仰卧骨盆倾斜
items.description: A small floor movement that teaches you to control the tilt of your pelvis and relax the lower back.
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Take a breath in with a neutral spine.
Exhale, tilting your pelvis so your lower back presses into the floor.
Hold for a moment.
Release back to neutral.
Repeat slowly.

items.name: 伸腿平板支撑
items.description: A plank where you lift and extend one leg at a time, testing core stability and strengthening the glutes.
steps: Get into a forearm or high plank with a flat back.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes.
Lift one leg straight behind you without rotating your hips.
Lower it with control.
Repeat on the other leg and alternate.

items.name: 侧向与前向进出
items.description: A seated in and out leg drill that goes to the side and then to the front. It works the abs and obliques.
steps: Sit on the floor leaning back, hands behind you for support.
Lift your feet off the floor with knees bent.
Extend your legs out to one side and pull them back in.
Extend them straight in front and pull back in.
Repeat the pattern on the other side.

items.name: 侧向仰卧起坐
items.description: A sit-up performed with a sideways angle. It emphasizes the obliques.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent.
Place your hands behind your head.
Sit up while reaching one elbow toward the opposite knee.
Lower slowly.
Keep your feet planted.
Alternate sides.

items.name: 侧向侧平板支撑
items.description: A classic side plank that trains the obliques and hip stabilisers.
steps: Lie on your side with your forearm under your shoulder and your legs straight.
Stack your feet or stagger them for balance.
Lift your hips to form a straight line from head to feet.
Keep your core tight and your hips from sagging.
Hold for the planned time, then switch sides.

items.name: 侧向侧平板支撑(屈腿)
items.description: An easier side plank with the bottom knee bent, building oblique and hip stability.
steps: Lie on your side with your forearm under your shoulder and your knees bent.
Stack your hips and shoulders in a line.
Lift your hips off the floor until your body forms a straight line from knee to head.
Keep your core tight and your hips from sagging.
Hold for the planned time, then switch sides.

items.name: 侧向卷腹
items.description: A crunch focusing on the sides of the waist. It strengthens the obliques.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and tilted to one side.
Place your hands behind your head.
Crunch up, lifting your shoulders.
Squeeze your side.
Lower with control.
Finish reps, then switch sides.

items.name: 侧向卷腹 v. 2
items.description: A side-lying crunch that brings the ribs toward the hip. It works the obliques.
steps: Lie on your side with your knees bent.
Place your hands lightly behind your head.
Lift your upper body and legs toward each other.
Squeeze your side.
Lower slowly.
Finish reps, then switch sides.

items.name: 侧向卷腹 v. 3
items.description: A side crunch, a second variation, aimed at the obliques. It shortens the side of the waist with a small controlled movement.
steps: Lie on your side with knees bent and one hand behind your head.
Rest the other hand on the floor for balance.
Lift your shoulders and knees toward each other.
Squeeze the side of your waist at the top.
Lower slowly without relaxing fully.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

items.name: 侧向双手前触脚尖
items.description: A wide-stance toe touch reaching both hands toward one side to loosen the trunk and legs.
steps: Stand with feet wide apart.
Turn your torso slightly to one side.
Reach both hands to the foot on that side.
Rise, then turn to the other side.
Repeat at a steady pace.

items.name: 侧向垂直上举(直腿)
items.description: Lying down with legs straight and vertical, you lift your hips sideways. It targets the lower abs and obliques.
steps: Lie on your back with legs straight up.
Place your arms by your sides.
Lift your hips off the floor.
Tilt your legs slightly to one side.
Lower with control.
Alternate sides.

items.name: 侧向垂直转体上举(直腿)
items.description: A leg-up hip lift with a rotation. It works the lower abs and obliques.
steps: Lie on your back with legs straight up.
Press your arms into the floor.
Lift your hips and rotate them to one side.
Lower slowly.
Repeat to the other side.
Keep legs straight.

items.name: 侧向扭转
items.description: A Pilates twist from a side-supported position that trains the obliques and shoulder stability.
steps: Set up in a side support with one hand on the mat and your feet stacked.
Lift your hips and reach your top arm to the ceiling.
Thread the top arm under your body as you rotate your torso.
Open back up and reach to the ceiling again.
Keep your hips lifted throughout, then switch sides.

items.name: 侧向拉伸卷腹
items.description: A side crunch that combines a side stretch and a contraction. It works the obliques.
steps: Lie on your side with your bottom arm extended overhead.
Place your top hand behind your head.
Stretch along your side.
Crunch your top elbow toward your hip.
Return to the stretch.
Switch sides.

items.name: 侧向拉腿
items.description: A side-plank style Pilates move where one leg lifts, challenging the obliques and shoulders.
steps: Start in a side plank on one hand.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Lift your top leg.
Hold briefly.
Lower and switch sides.

items.name: 侧向点地平板支撑
items.description: A plank where you tap a hand to the floor at the side, challenging the obliques and anti-rotation control.
steps: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders and feet wide.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Reach one hand out to tap the floor at the side without twisting your hips.
Return it and tap with the other hand.
Keep the pace steady and controlled.

items.name: 侧平板屈腿抬腿
items.description: A side plank with a bent top leg that you lift, challenging your obliques and outer hips.
steps: Lie on one side and prop yourself on your forearm.
