Lift your hips so your body forms a line.
Bend your top knee and lift it upward.
Lower it without dropping your hips.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

items.name: 侧平板扭转手臂三角肌上举
items.nameEn: side plank twist arm delt raise
items.description: A side plank with a twist that ends in an arm raise. It challenges your obliques and shoulders.
steps: Set up in a side plank on your forearm.
Raise your top arm up toward the ceiling.
Rotate and thread your arm under your torso.
Open back up and raise the arm again.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

items.name: 侧平板支撑
items.description: A sideways plank balanced on one forearm. It builds strength in the obliques and the muscles that stabilise your trunk.
steps: Lie on your side with your elbow under your shoulder and legs stacked.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line from head to feet.
Keep your hips high and your neck neutral.
Hold for 20-45 seconds.
Lower with control and switch sides.
Don't let your hips drop or roll forward.

items.name: 侧平板支撑 v. 2
items.description: A side plank variation held on one forearm. It builds the obliques and shoulder stability.
steps: Lie on your side and prop up on your forearm.
Stack your feet or stagger them.
Lift your hips into a straight line.
Keep your core tight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.

items.name: 侧平板支撑 v. 3
items.description: A side plank hold, a second variation. It strengthens the obliques and the muscles that keep your trunk stable.
steps: Lie on your side and prop yourself on your forearm under your shoulder.
Stack or stagger your feet.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.
Keep your neck neutral and your core tight.
Hold for 20-40 seconds.
Lower down and repeat on the other side.

items.name: 侧平板支撑(初级)
items.description: A bent-knee side plank that builds oblique and hip strength for beginners.
steps: Lie on your side with knees bent and your elbow under your shoulder.
Stack your hips and knees.
Press into your forearm to lift your hips off the floor.
Hold a straight line from knees to head.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

items.name: 侧平板支撑抬腿
items.description: A side plank with the top leg lifted. It trains the obliques and hip stabilisers.
steps: Lie on your side and prop up on your forearm.
Lift your hips into a side plank.
Raise your top leg.
Lower it slowly.
Switch sides after your reps.

items.name: 侧平板支撑抬腿 v. 2(左)
items.nameEn: side plank with raised leg v. 2 (left)
items.description: A side plank on the left side with the top leg lifted. It trains the obliques, hips and shoulder stability.
steps: Lie on your left side and prop up on your left forearm, elbow under your shoulder.
Stack your feet and lift your hips into a straight line.
Raise your top leg to hip height.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower and repeat, then switch sides if you like.

items.name: 侧平板支撑抬腿(左)
items.description: A side plank with a leg raise on the left side. It works the obliques and outer hip.
steps: Lie on your left side and prop up on your forearm.
Lift your hips into a side plank.
Raise your top leg slowly.
Lower the leg without dropping your hips.
Repeat for your set.
Switch sides for the right-side version.

items.name: 侧平板支撑拉
items.description: A side plank with a pulling arm motion, to build core stability and shoulder strength.
steps: Get into a side plank on your forearm with your body in a straight line.
Reach your top arm overhead.
Pull your elbow down toward your ribs.
Keep your hips lifted.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

items.name: 侧平板支撑腹斜肌卷腹
items.description: A side plank with a knee-to-elbow crunch. It trains the obliques and shoulder stability together.
steps: Set up in a side plank on one forearm, feet stacked or staggered.
Put your free hand behind your head.
Bring your top knee and elbow together beneath your torso.
Extend back to the side plank position.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

items.name: 侧平板支撑臀部(动作检查)
items.description: A side plank form check that compares a piked butt with a straight body line.
steps: Lie on your side with your forearm on the floor and elbow under your shoulder.
Stack your feet and lift your hips off the floor.
Make a straight line from your head to your feet.
Avoid letting your butt stick out or your hips drop.
Squeeze your abs and glutes to stay level.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

items.name: 侧平板支撑转体
items.description: A side plank with an arm rotation under the body. It builds the obliques and shoulder stability.
steps: Set up in a side plank on one forearm or hand with your top arm raised.
Lift your hips so your body is in a straight line.
Thread your top arm under your torso, rotating your chest toward the floor.
Rotate back and reach the arm up to the ceiling.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

items.name: 侧弯
items.description: A Pilates side bend from a seated or side-supported position that works the obliques and the sides of the trunk.
steps: Sit tall on your side with your bottom hand pressed into the mat and your legs stacked.
Lift your hips so your body forms a long diagonal line.
Reach your top arm overhead and bend sideways over the supporting arm.
Lift back up to the long line while keeping your hips high.
Lower with control and repeat, then switch sides.

items.name: 侧桥
items.description: A side plank held on one forearm. It strengthens the sides of your trunk.
steps: Lie on your side with legs stacked.
Place your elbow under your shoulder.
Lift your hips until you form a straight line.
Brace your abs.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower and switch sides.

items.name: 侧桥 v. 2
items.description: Lying on your side, you hold your hips up off the floor on your forearm. Works the obliques and core.
steps: 侧躺，双腿伸展并叠放在一起。
将前臂放在肩膀正下方的地面上，肘部弯曲成 90 度角。
启动你的核心并将臀部抬离地面，从头到脚形成一条直线。
保持此位置所需的时间。
将臀部放低至起始位置。
在另一侧重复。

items.name: 侧桥(屈膝)
items.description: An easier side plank with the knees bent. It builds the obliques and side stability.
steps: Lie on your side with your knees bent.
Place your forearm under your shoulder.
Lift your hips off the floor.
Keep your body in a straight line from knees to head.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower and switch sides.

items.name: 侧桥(收膝)
items.description: A side plank with a knee tuck for extra core work. It trains the obliques and hip flexors.
steps: Start in a side plank on your forearm.
Raise your top leg slightly.
Pull your top knee toward your chest.
Extend the leg back.
Keep your hips lifted.
Finish reps, then switch sides.

items.name: 侧桥摆臂摆腿
items.nameEn: side bridge with arm leg swing
items.description: A side plank with the top arm and leg swinging, challenging the obliques and balance.
steps: Lie on one side and prop yourself on your forearm.
Lift your hips into a straight line.
Raise the top leg and arm.
Swing them toward each other under control.
Keep your hips high, then switch sides.

items.name: 侧腹卷腹 v. 2
items.description: An oblique crunch where you curl up and to the side, version 2. It trains the side abs.
steps: 仰卧，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在脑后或交叉放在胸前。
收紧腹肌，将肩胛骨抬离地面，将躯干旋转到一侧。
暂停片刻，然后将肩胛骨放回起始位置。
在另一侧重复。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

items.name: 侧触脚尖
items.description: A standing toe touch with a sideways reach to warm up the obliques and hamstrings.
steps: Stand with your feet wide apart.
Reach one hand toward the opposite foot.
Keep your other arm extended behind you.
Rise and switch sides.
Alternate at an easy pace.

items.name: 侧跨步正面平板支撑
items.description: Walk your hands and feet sideways in a front plank to train the core and shoulders.
steps: Start in a high plank.
Step one hand and foot out to the side.
Bring the other hand and foot to meet them.
Keep your hips level.
Repeat in one direction, then reverse.

items.name: 侧跳转体
items.description: Jump while twisting your hips and legs to the side. It warms up the core and legs.
steps: Stand with your feet together and arms bent.
Jump and twist your hips and legs to one side while your shoulders face forward.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Jump again and twist to the other side.
Keep a steady rhythm for 30-45 seconds.

items.name: 侧踢穿越
items.description: A floor move where you sweep one leg under your body from a side-facing support, working your obliques, shoulders and coordination.
steps: Start in a high plank, then rotate onto one hand with your chest turned to the side.
Lift your hips and keep your core tight.
Sweep your top leg under your body and through the gap.
Return the leg to the start with control.
Repeat, then switch sides.

items.name: 侧髋(双杠上)
items.description: Between parallel bars, you lift your body and swing your hips side to side. Works the obliques and core.
steps: 站在两根平行杠之间，双脚分开与肩同宽。
将双手放在横杆上，将身体抬离地面，用手臂支撑体重。
收紧腹肌，慢慢将双腿向一侧抬起，保持伸直。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 便盆式深蹲
items.description: A bodyweight squat done as a deep, comfortable squat. Works the legs, glutes and core.
steps: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，脚趾稍微向外。
弯曲膝盖并将臀部向后推，降低身体，就像坐在椅子上一样。
在整个动作过程中保持挺胸、背部挺直。
降低自己，直到大腿与地面平行或尽可能低。
在底部停顿片刻，然后推动脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 俄罗斯转体
items.description: Seated and leaning back, you rotate your torso from side to side. Works the obliques and abs.
steps: 坐在地上，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地板上。
稍微向后倾斜，同时保持背部挺直并且核心参与。
如果需要，双手合拢放在胸前或举重物。
将脚抬离地面，在坐骨上保持平衡。
将你的躯干向右扭转，将你的手或重量移向身体的右侧。
暂停片刻，然后将躯干向左扭转，将手或体重移向身体的左侧。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

items.name: 俄罗斯转体劈砍
items.description: A seated twist with a diagonal chopping arm motion. Works the abs and obliques.
steps: Sit with your knees bent and lean back slightly.
Clasp your hands together in front of you.
Twist and chop your arms diagonally across your body.
Return to center and chop the other way.
Keep your chest tall and your core tight.

items.name: 俯卧撑加提膝
items.description: A push-up followed by a knee drive toward the chest. It combines upper-body strength with core work.
steps: Start in a high plank.
Lower into a push-up.
Push back up.
Drive one knee toward your chest.
Return and alternate legs.

items.name: 俯卧撑转侧平板支撑
items.description: You do a push-up, then rotate into a side plank. Works the chest, arms, shoulders and obliques.
steps: 从俯卧撑位置开始，双手分开与肩同宽，身体呈一条直线。
弯曲肘部，将身体降低到地面，保持核心参与。
推回到起始位置。
将体重转移到左手上，然后将身体向右旋转，将右臂举向天花板。
保持侧板姿势几秒钟，然后返回到起始位置。
在另一侧重复俯卧撑和侧板支撑。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

items.name: 俯卧腹部拉伸
items.description: A face-down stretch that lengthens the abdominals, similar to a cobra position.
steps: Lie face down with your hands under your shoulders.
Press up slowly, straightening your arms as far as is comfortable.
Keep your hips on the floor and relax your glutes.
Look forward and feel the stretch along your belly.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then lower down.

items.name: 俯身扭转
items.description: A standing bent-over rotation that mobilizes the spine and works the obliques.
steps: Stand with feet wide and hinge forward at the hips with a flat back.
Extend your arms out to the sides.
Rotate your torso and reach one hand toward the opposite foot.
Return through the middle and twist to the other side.
Move with control and keep your hips square.
Do 10-12 reps per side.

items.name: 倒立式
items.description: A bodyweight ab exercise that rocks the hips up toward the ceiling. Works the abs.
steps: 平躺，双腿伸展，双臂放在身体两侧。
弯曲膝盖并将其靠近胸部，保持双脚离开地面。
收紧腹肌，将臀部抬离地面，将膝盖靠近头部。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将臀部放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 倾斜俯撑
items.description: A leaning plank where the shoulders move forward past the hands. It trains the shoulders, wrists and core on the way to the planche.
steps: 从俯卧撑位置开始，双手分开与肩同宽，身体伸直。
启动你的核心，慢慢地将你的重心向前移动，让你的肩膀越过你的手。
向前倾时，保持肘部稍微弯曲，身体伸直。
保持这个姿势几秒钟，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 全俯撑
items.description: A gymnastics hold where the body is parallel to the floor and balanced on the hands. It builds extreme strength in the shoulders, chest and core.
steps: 从俯卧撑位置开始，双手与肩同宽，手指指向前方。
启动你的核心并缓慢地将你的重心向前移动，将你的脚抬离地面。
继续向前移动体重，直到身体与地面平行，并用双手保持平衡。
尽可能长时间地保持这个姿势，保持身体线条笔直。
慢慢地将双脚放回地面，然后回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 全马耳他十字
items.description: An advanced gymnastics hold on rings with the arms out wide and the body straight. It demands huge strength in the chest, shoulders and core.
steps: 首先站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，双臂伸直至两侧。
慢慢向前倾斜，保持手臂伸直，直到上半身与地面平行。
启动你的核心并保持这个姿势几秒钟。
通过双脚推动并站起来，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 凳上反向卷腹画圈
items.description: A bench reverse crunch where your knees trace a circle. It works the lower abs and obliques.
steps: Lie on a bench and grip behind your head for support.
Bring your knees up over your hips.
Curl your hips up and draw a small circle with your knees.
Reverse the circle on the next rep.
Lower your hips slowly each time.

items.name: 分腿俯撑
items.description: A planche hold with the legs spread wide, which makes the lever shorter. It trains the shoulders, chest and core.
steps: 从俯卧撑位置开始，双手与肩同宽，双脚分开。
启动你的核心，慢慢地将你的重心向前移动，将你的肩膀放在你的手上。
弯曲肘部，将身体放低至地面，保持肘部靠近身体两侧。
在底部停顿片刻，然后双手用力伸直手臂，将身体抬回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 分腿拉伸脊柱滚动
items.description: A seated straddle position with a rolling spine movement. It loosens your back and inner thighs.
steps: Sit on the floor with your legs spread wide in a comfortable split.
Sit tall and reach your arms forward.
Round your spine and roll down slowly, one segment at a time.
Roll back up slowly until you are upright.
Repeat for 8-10 slow reps without forcing the stretch.

items.name: 分腿马耳他十字
items.description: A ring hold with the arms out and the legs straddled. It builds the chest and shoulders and is a stepping stone toward the full maltese.
steps: 首先，悬挂在一对环上，双臂完全伸展，身体呈一条直线。
双腿分开，形成跨坐姿势。
启动你的核心并慢慢降低你的身体，直到你的手臂与地面平行。
保持这个姿势几秒钟，然后将自己推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 划船式瑜伽体式
items.description: A seated V-shaped balance, also called boat pose, that works the abs and hip flexors.
steps: Sit with your knees bent and your feet on the floor.
Lean back slightly, keeping your chest lifted and back long.
Lift your feet and extend your legs into a V shape.
Reach your arms forward alongside your legs.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.

items.name: 平板支撑
items.description: The classic forearm plank. Holding a straight line from head to heels builds core endurance and stability.
steps: Lie face down and prop yourself on your forearms, elbows under your shoulders.
Lift your hips and knees off the floor, resting on your toes.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Squeeze your abs and glutes.
Hold for 20-60 seconds while breathing steadily.
Don't let your hips sag or pike up.

items.name: 前平板支撑侧跳
items.description: Hop your feet side to side from a high plank for a core and cardio challenge.
steps: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders.
Brace your core.
Hop both feet a short way to one side.
Hop them back to the other side.
Keep your shoulders stable and your hips low.

items.name: 前平板支撑加扭转
items.description: A front plank with a trunk twist. It works the abs, obliques and shoulders while you stay stable.
steps: 从高平板支撑位置开始，双手直接放在肩膀下方，身体从头到脚成一条直线。
调动你的核心和臀部以保持稳定的位置。
将躯干向右旋转，抬起右臂并向天花板延伸。
扭转时保持臀部和腿部稳定。
保持片刻，然后回到起始位置。
在左侧重复扭转。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

items.name: 前平板支撑手走
items.description: From standing, you walk your hands out to a plank and back. It trains your core, shoulders and hamstring flexibility.
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip width apart.
Hinge forward and place your hands on the floor.
Walk your hands out to a front plank.
Hold briefly with your hips level.
Walk your hands back and stand up.

items.name: 前平板支撑抬腿
items.description: A forearm plank with alternating leg lifts. It builds core stability and glute strength.
steps: Set up in a forearm plank with elbows under your shoulders.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Lift one leg a few inches without rotating your hips.
Lower it and lift the other leg.
Keep your core tight and your hips level.
Breathe steadily.

items.name: 前平板支撑抬臂
items.description: A plank where one arm lifts at a time, challenging core stability and anti-rotation.
steps: Set up in a forearm plank with elbows under shoulders.
Squeeze your glutes and keep a straight line from head to heels.
Lift one arm forward without letting your hips twist.
Return it and lift the other arm.
Alternate in a slow, controlled rhythm.

items.name: 前平板支撑抬臂(俯卧撑姿势)
items.nameEn: front plank with arm lift (push up position)
items.description: A high plank where you lift one arm at a time, training anti-rotation core strength.
steps: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders.
Set your feet slightly wider for balance.
Lift one hand and reach it forward without twisting your hips.
Place it down and switch arms.
Keep your core braced throughout.

items.name: 前平板支撑抬臂抬腿(俯卧撑姿势)
items.nameEn: front plank with arm and leg lift (push up position)
items.description: A high plank holding the opposite arm and leg in the air, which tests balance and core strength.
steps: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders.
Lift one arm and the opposite leg at the same time.
Hold them in line with your body for a moment.
Lower them back to the floor with control.
Switch to the other arm and leg and repeat.

items.name: 前平板支撑抬臂抬腿(动作检查)
items.nameEn: front plank with arm and leg lift (form check)
items.description: A plank where you lift an arm and the opposite leg. Challenges your core stability.
steps: Start in a forearm or high plank with your body in a straight line.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes.
Lift one arm forward and the opposite leg back.
Hold for a couple of seconds.
Return and switch sides.
Keep your hips level.

items.name: 前平板支撑点脚
items.description: A front plank where you tap one foot out to the side at a time. It challenges core stability and hips.
steps: Start in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders.
Brace your abs and keep your hips level.
Tap one toe out to the side and bring it back.
Repeat with the other foot.
Keep your body steady and avoid rocking.

items.name: 前平板支撑臀部(动作检查)
items.description: A front plank form check that compares a raised butt with a straight body line.
steps: Place your forearms on the floor with elbows under your shoulders.
Extend your legs behind you with your toes on the floor.
Lift your body into a straight line from head to heels.
Avoid pushing your butt up or letting your hips sag.
Squeeze your abs and glutes to keep the line.
Hold for 20-40 seconds and breathe steadily.

items.name: 前支撑拉腿
items.description: A Pilates plank variation with a leg lift that builds core and shoulder stability.
steps: Start in a high plank with hands under your shoulders.
Keep your body in one straight line from head to heels.
Lift one leg a few inches without shifting your hips.
Lower it and repeat on the other leg.
Keep your abs tight and your neck long.

items.name: 前水平举
items.description: A gymnastics hold with the body straight and parallel to the ground while hanging from a bar. It trains the abs, lats and upper back.
steps: 首先，用正手握法悬挂在引体向上杆上，双手与肩同宽。
启动你的核心并将肩胛骨向下拉和向后拉。
弯曲膝盖并将其向胸部靠拢。
同时，抬起双腿并将其伸直在您面前，保持身体与地面平行。
尽可能长时间地保持此位置，以达到完全前杆位置。
要释放，请慢慢降低双腿并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 前触脚尖
items.description: A standing movement reaching down to touch your toes for a warm-up of the hamstrings and back.
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Hinge forward and reach toward your toes.
Let your head hang relaxed.
Rise slowly.
Repeat at a steady pace.

items.name: 前跨步正面平板支撑
items.description: Walk forward in a front plank, stepping hands and feet to challenge the core and shoulders.
steps: Start in a high plank.
Step one hand forward, then the other.
Follow with your feet.
Keep your hips level.
Walk forward a few steps, then back.

items.name: 前踢腿
items.description: A standing leg swing forward that warms up the hip flexors and hamstrings and challenges your balance.
steps: Stand tall with your arms out for balance or hands on your hips.
Shift your weight onto one foot.
Swing the other leg forward and up in a controlled kick, keeping it fairly straight.
Lower it with control without leaning back.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

items.name: 剪刀腿
items.description: A leg-switching move lying on your back, building lower abdominal strength.
steps: Lie on your back with your hips lifted and hands supporting them.
Raise your legs up.
Lower one leg while the other stays up.
Switch legs.
Keep the movement steady.

items.name: 剪刀腿(初级)
items.description: A beginner floor exercise crossing the legs like scissors to train the lower abs.
steps: Lie on your back with arms by your sides.
Lift both legs a little off the floor.
Open them wide, then cross one over the other.
Alternate which leg is on top with each rep.
Keep your lower back flat on the floor.

items.name: 剪刀腿(进阶)
items.description: Hold both legs low and cross them repeatedly like scissors, working the lower abs.
steps: Lie on your back with legs extended and hands under your hips.
Lift your head, shoulders and legs slightly off the floor.
Cross one leg over the other in a scissor motion.
Alternate sides in a controlled rhythm.
Keep your lower back pressed down.

items.name: 力量点平板支撑
items.description: A plank where you shift from your hands to your forearms and back, one arm at a time. It trains the abs and shoulders.
steps: 从高平板支撑位置开始，双手直接放在肩膀下方，身体从头到脚成一条直线。
启动你的核心并挤压你的臀肌以保持稳定的位置。
将身体放低到前臂上，一次一只手臂，从头到脚保持一条直线。
保持这个姿势所需的时间，保持核心肌群和臀肌的参与。
要返回到起始位置，请推动前臂并将身体抬回到高位平板支撑位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 加强下斜仰卧起坐
items.description: A steeper decline sit-up that increases the load on the abs.
steps: Set a decline bench to a steep angle and hook your feet under the pads.
Lie back and cross your arms over your chest.
Curl your torso up until you are sitting.
Squeeze your abs at the top.
Lower slowly back down.

items.name: 半程仰卧起坐(男)
items.description: A sit-up that stops at roughly half height, keeping constant tension on the abs. A gentle way to train the midsection.
steps: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，慢慢将上半身抬离地面，向前卷曲，直到躯干呈 45 度角。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 半船式
items.description: A V-shaped balance on your sit bones. It strengthens the abs and hip flexors.
steps: Sit with knees bent and lean back a little.
Lift your feet so your shins are parallel to the floor.
Extend your arms forward.
Keep your chest open and spine long.
Hold for 15-30 seconds.

items.name: 半跪姿躯干扭转
items.description: From a half-kneeling stance, rotate your torso. It opens the spine and warms up the trunk.
steps: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward.
Hold your arms crossed in front of your chest.
Rotate your upper body toward the front leg.
Return to the centre and keep your hips square.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

items.name: 半蹲侧伸
items.description: A half squat with a side bend that trains the obliques and legs while loosening the trunk.
steps: Stand with feet wider than shoulder-width.
Sit into a half squat.
Reach one arm overhead and lean sideways.
Return to center.
Reach to the other side.
Keep your chest up.

items.name: 半雨刷式(屈腿)
items.description: Lying on your back and swinging bent legs side to side. It trains the obliques and lower abs.
steps: Lie on your back with your arms out to the sides for support.
Lift your knees to 90 degrees.
Lower both knees to one side, stopping before the floor.
Bring them back to the middle and go to the other side.
Keep your shoulders on the floor.

items.name: 半鱼王式瑜伽体式
items.description: The half spinal twist, a seated yoga pose. It stretches the spine and outer hip and improves rotation.
steps: Sit tall with your legs extended.
Bend one knee and place that foot outside the opposite thigh.
Hug the bent knee with the opposite arm.
Place your other hand behind you and twist toward it.
Lengthen the spine and hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release and repeat on the other side.

items.name: 单直腿伸展
items.description: A pilates exercise where you scissor your straight legs while holding the raised one. It trains the abs and tests hamstring flexibility.
steps: Lie on your back, lift your head and shoulders off the mat.
Extend one leg straight up and the other hovering low.
Hold the raised leg with both hands and pulse twice toward you.
Switch legs and repeat, keeping your torso steady.
Keep your lower back anchored throughout.

items.name: 单腿伸展(屈膝)
items.description: A pilates move where you alternate pulling one knee in while the other leg extends. It builds core control and coordination.
steps: Lie on your back, lift your head and shoulders, and bring both knees toward your chest.
Place your hands on one shin and extend the other leg out low.
Switch legs smoothly, drawing the other knee in.
Keep your lower back pressed down and your abs tight.
Continue alternating with a steady breath rhythm.

items.name: 单腿伸展(屈膝) v. 2
items.description: A Pilates ab move with alternating knee pulls that builds core endurance and coordination.
steps: Lie on your back and curl your head and shoulders off the mat.
Pull one knee toward your chest, with hands on that shin.
Extend the other leg long at a low angle.
Switch legs in a steady rhythm.
Keep your lower back anchored to the mat.

items.name: 单臂悬垂脚趾触杠
items.nameEn: single arm hanging toes to bar
items.description: A hanging core move done from one hand. Lifting your toes to the bar trains the abs and grip.
steps: Hang from a bar with one hand and keep your shoulder active.
Brace your core and keep your legs together.
Lift your toes up toward the bar.
Lower your legs slowly without swinging.
Finish your reps, then switch hands.

items.name: 单臂正面平板支撑
items.description: A front plank held with one arm lifted. It tests anti-rotation core strength.
steps: Start in a high plank with feet wide.
Lift one hand off the floor.
Hold your hips steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch arms.

items.name: 卧姿侧弯
items.description: Curves the body sideways while lying down, which stretches the flank without any need to balance.
steps: Lie on your back with legs together and arms stretched overhead.
Slide both feet and both hands to the same side so the body forms a gentle arc.
Keep your hips and shoulders on the floor.
Breathe slowly and relax into the curve.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return to centre and bend to the other side.

items.name: 卷腹(凳上)
items.description: A crunch performed lying on a bench. It trains your abs with a slightly larger range of motion.
steps: Lie on a bench with your knees bent and feet flat.
Place your hands by your temples.
Curl your shoulders up, bringing your ribs toward your hips.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly without pulling on your neck.

items.name: 卷腹(双手过头)
items.description: A crunch with the arms stretched overhead. Reaching long makes the move harder and works the abs.
steps: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双臂伸直至头顶上方。
收紧腹肌，将上半身抬离地面，向前向膝盖弯曲。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 卷腹(双臂放胸前)
items.description: A basic crunch with your arms crossed over your chest. It trains the abs without pulling on the neck.
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Curl your head and shoulders off the floor.
Squeeze your abs at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

items.name: 卷腹(抬腿)
items.description: A crunch combined with a leg lift so the lower abs work along with the upper. It is a compact full-abs move.
steps: Lie on your back with your hands by your head and your legs up.
Curl your shoulders off the floor while keeping your legs raised.
Squeeze your abs.
Lower your shoulders slowly.
Lift your legs slightly higher at the top for extra work.
Keep your lower back pressed down.

items.name: 卷腹(直腿上举)
items.description: A crunch with your legs pointing straight up so you reach toward your toes. It works the abs with less hip flexor pull.
steps: Lie on your back with your legs straight up toward the ceiling.
Extend your arms toward your feet.
Curl your shoulders off the floor and reach toward your toes.
Squeeze your abs at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your legs still and your neck relaxed.

items.name: 卷腹(直臂)
items.description: A crunch with your arms reaching toward your knees. It focuses on your upper abs.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Extend your arms straight toward your knees.
Curl your shoulders off the floor, keeping your arms reaching.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly without pulling on your neck.

items.name: 卷腹停顿
items.description: A crunch held at the top to keep the abs under tension. Simple and burns quickly.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Place your hands lightly behind your head or across your chest.
Curl your head and shoulders off the floor.
Hold the top position for 20-30 seconds, breathing steadily.
Lower down with control.

items.name: 卷腹加抬腿
items.description: A crunch paired with a leg raise to train both the upper and lower abdominals.
steps: Lie on your back with your hands behind your head and legs extended.
Crunch your shoulders off the floor.
At the same time lift your legs toward the ceiling.
Hold for a moment, then lower slowly.
Keep your lower back pressed into the floor.

items.name: 卷腹单腿抬起
items.description: A crunch where one leg lifts as you curl up. It adds a lower-abs challenge to the basic crunch.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and hands behind your head.
Extend one leg and lift it a few inches off the floor.
Curl your shoulders up toward your hips.
Lower slowly, then repeat.
Switch legs halfway through or alternate each rep.

items.name: 卷腹背部(动作检查)
items.description: A side-by-side form check for back position during a crunch, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and hands by your head.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your lower back stays gently on the floor while only the upper back curls up.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

items.name: 卷腹起身
items.description: A curl-up lifting your shoulders off the floor. Works the abs.
steps: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，慢慢将上半身抬离地面，向前卷曲，直到躯干呈 45 度角。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 卷起 v. 2
items.description: A slow roll up from lying to sitting, training abdominal control and spine flexibility.
steps: Lie on your back with arms overhead.
Lift your arms and curl your head and chest up.
Roll up one vertebra at a time.
Reach over your legs.
Roll back down slowly.

items.name: 双手前触脚尖
items.description: A wider standing toe touch that reaches down with both hands to warm up the legs and back.
steps: Stand with feet wide apart.
Hinge forward with both arms reaching down.
Touch the floor or your toes.
Rise slowly.
Repeat for the set.

items.name: 双手抱胸侧向卷腹
items.nameEn: side crunch with hands on chest
items.description: A side-lying crunch with the arms crossed over the chest. It works the obliques along the side of the trunk.
steps: Lie on your side with knees slightly bent and arms crossed over your chest.
Brace your core and lift your shoulders and legs toward each other.
Crunch sideways, squeezing the side of your waist.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
Keep the movement small and controlled, without pulling on your neck.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

items.name: 双手放胸前俄罗斯转体
items.nameEn: russian twist with hands on chest
items.description: A seated twist with your hands crossed on your chest. It trains the obliques and core rotation.
steps: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and lean back slightly.
Cross your hands over your chest.
Lift your feet slightly off the floor if you can.
Rotate your torso to one side, then to the other.
Move with control and keep your chest lifted.

items.name: 双腿伸展
items.description: A core-driven move where arms and legs stretch out together and then draw back in.
steps: Lie on your back and curl your head and shoulders up.
Hug your knees to your chest.
Reach your arms overhead while extending your legs.
Circle your arms and draw your knees back in.
Keep your lower back down.

items.name: 双臂抱胸仰卧起坐
items.description: A sit-up with the arms crossed on the chest. It trains the abs and hip flexors.
steps: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
双臂交叉于胸前。
收紧腹肌，将上半身抬离地面，靠近膝盖。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 双臂过头全程仰卧起坐(男)
items.description: A full sit-up with the arms stretched overhead, which makes the lever longer and the move harder. It trains the abs and hip flexors.
steps: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将手臂伸过头顶，保持伸直。
收紧腹肌，慢慢将上半身抬离地面，向前卷曲直到躯干直立。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 反向卷腹
items.description: A crunch that curls the hips off the floor with the knees bent. It targets the lower abs.
steps: 平躺，双臂沿着身体两侧伸展。
弯曲膝盖，将脚抬离地面，使大腿垂直于地板。
收缩腹肌，将臀部卷离地板，使膝盖靠近胸部。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将臀部放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 反向卷腹 v. 2
items.description: Curl the knees and hips up toward the chest. It works the lower abs.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent.
Lift your legs.
Curl hips off the floor.
Lower slowly.
Do not swing.

items.name: 反向卷腹 v. 3
items.description: Lying on your back, you curl your hips off the floor to bring your knees toward your chest. It targets the lower abs.
steps: Lie on your back with your arms by your sides.
Lift your knees to a tabletop position.
Curl your hips off the floor, bringing your knees toward your chest.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly without swinging.

items.name: 反向卷腹踢腿
items.description: A reverse crunch finished with a leg kick upward, hitting the lower abs.
steps: Lie on your back with arms by your sides and knees bent over your hips.
Curl your hips off the floor, bringing your knees toward your chest.
Kick your feet up toward the ceiling.
Lower your hips slowly and bend your knees again.
Avoid swinging; use your abs to lift.

items.name: 反向卷腹转死虫式
items.description: A reverse crunch that flows into a dead bug, training lower abs and control of the trunk.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent over your hips.
Curl your pelvis off the floor in a reverse crunch.
Lower your hips and extend one leg and the opposite arm.
Return to the start, then repeat on the other side.
Keep your lower back flat.

items.name: 反向平板支撑 v. 2
items.description: A plank done face up, with a slightly different arm setup. It strengthens the back of the body and the core.
steps: Sit with your legs straight and your hands behind you.
Press into your hands and lift your hips.
Form a straight line from head to heels.
Keep your chin neutral.
Squeeze your glutes.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.

items.name: 反向平板支撑抬腿
items.description: A reverse plank where you lift one leg at a time. It trains the abs, glutes and the back of the body.
steps: 坐在地上，双腿向前伸展，双手放在身后的地面上，手指指向脚部。
双手用力，将臀部抬离地面，进入反向平板支撑位置。
启动你的核心并将一条腿抬离地面，将其笔直向上伸向天花板。
保持一会儿，然后将腿放下。
换另一条腿重复上述步骤。
继续交替双腿达到所需的重复次数。

items.name: 反向空中蹬车
items.description: Lie on your back with your hips raised, pedalling the legs in a backward motion. It targets the lower abs.
steps: Lie on your back and lift your hips slightly with hands under your glutes.
Raise your legs.
Pedal backward in a smooth circle.
Keep your lower back pressed down.
Continue for a set time or reps.

items.name: 后仰腹部拉伸
items.description: Arch back to stretch the front of the trunk. It lengthens the abs.
steps: Lie face down with hands under your shoulders.
Press your chest up.
Keep your hips on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower slowly.

items.name: 后撤上步至过头伸展
items.description: A step back with an overhead reach. It warms up the hips and core and stretches the front of the body.
steps: 站立，双脚分开与臀部同宽，双臂放在身体两侧。
右脚向后退一步，用脚掌着地。
弯曲左膝并将身体降低至弓步位置。
当你降低弓步时，同时将手臂举过头顶。
在弓步底部暂停片刻，然后通过推动左脚跟并将右脚向前拉回到起始位置。
在另一侧重复该动作，左脚向后退一步并弯曲右膝盖。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

items.name: 向后翻滚
items.description: A rolling move that massages the spine and trains abdominal control.
steps: Sit with your knees tucked and hold your shins.
Round your back.
Roll back onto your shoulders.
Roll back up to balance.
Keep your chin tucked.

items.name: 呼啦圈髋部绕圈
items.description: Hooping around your waist with a hula hoop for light cardio and core engagement.
steps: Stand with feet shoulder width apart, holding the hoop against your lower back.
Give it a push and start swinging your hips in circles.
Keep the motion smooth and steady.
Stay tall with a braced core.
Continue for a set time, then switch direction.

items.name: 四分之一仰卧起坐
items.description: A short-range sit-up where you curl only partway up. It keeps tension on the abs and is easier on the lower back than a full sit-up.
steps: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，慢慢将上半身抬离地面，向前卷曲，直到躯干呈 45 度角。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 回旋镖
items.description: An advanced Pilates sequence of rolling and balancing that tests core control.
steps: Sit tall with legs extended and crossed at the ankles.
Roll back and lift your legs overhead, then switch the cross.
Roll up to a teaser with your legs lifted.
Hold your hands behind you and then reach forward over your legs.
Move smoothly, using your abs to control each roll.

items.name: 团身收腹
items.description: Seated or reclined, you pull knees and chest together and then extend out again. It works the abs and hip flexors, especially the lower abs.
steps: Sit on the floor, lean back slightly and hold the floor or your sides for support.
Extend your legs out in front, hovering just above the floor.
Pull your knees toward your chest while curling your torso forward.
Pause briefly at the top with your abs tight.
Extend back out under control without letting your feet touch down, and repeat.

items.name: 圣哲马里奇一式
items.description: A seated forward fold with a twist and a bent knee. It stretches the back, hips and hamstrings.
steps: Sit with one leg straight and the other knee bent, foot flat beside the straight leg.
Wrap your opposite arm around the bent knee.
Sit tall, then twist toward the bent knee.
Keep your spine long.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

items.name: 地面L型支撑
items.description: A seated hold on the floor, hands beside the hips, with the legs lifted straight out. It trains the abs, hip flexors and triceps.
steps: 坐在地板上，双腿伸到身前。
将双手放在臀部旁边的地板上，手指指向前方。
启动你的核心并将双腿抬离地面，保持伸直。
尝试使双腿与地面平行，与身体形成“L”形。
尽可能长时间地保持这个姿势。
慢慢地将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 地面V型支撑
items.description: A seated hold with both the legs and the upper body lifted into a V shape. It trains the abs, hip flexors and balance.
steps: 坐在地板上，双腿伸到身前。
稍微向后倾斜，将双腿抬离地面，保持伸直。
同时，将上半身抬离地面，并将手臂伸向腿部。
保持这个姿势几秒钟，然后慢慢降低上半身和双腿回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 地面仰卧抬腿抬髋
items.nameEn: lying leg hip raise on floor
items.description: A floor leg raise that lifts the hips off the ground for a stronger lower-abs contraction.
steps: Lie on your back with arms by your sides or holding something behind your head.
Raise your legs to vertical.
Lift your hips off the floor, pushing your feet toward the ceiling.
Lower your hips slowly.
Lower your legs without arching your back.
Keep movements smooth, not swinging.

items.name: 地面仰卧抬髋抬腿 v. 2
items.nameEn: lying leg hip raise on floor v. 2
items.description: Lift your hips off the floor with your legs raised. It focuses on the lower abs.
steps: Lie on your back with your legs raised.
Press your arms into the floor.
Lift your hips off the floor.
Lower with control.
Avoid swinging.

items.name: 地面侧卧抬髋抬腿
items.nameEn: lying leg hip side raise on floor
items.description: A side lying raise where you lift both legs together toward the ceiling. It works the obliques and the sides of your trunk.
steps: Lie on your side with legs stacked and straight.
Rest your head on your lower arm and brace your core.
Lift both legs together a short way off the floor.
Pause at the top, squeezing your side.
Lower slowly without touching the floor.
Complete reps, then switch sides.

items.name: 地面卷腹
items.description: A basic floor crunch. You curl the shoulders off the ground to work the upper abs.
steps: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，将肩膀抬离地面，向前向膝盖弯曲。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将肩膀放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 地面卷腹 v. 2
items.description: A classic floor crunch. It strengthens the abs with a short, controlled curl.
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat.
Place your hands lightly by your head or across your chest.
Curl your shoulders off the floor.
Pause and squeeze your abs.
Lower with control.
Keep your chin off your chest and your lower back on the floor.

items.name: 地面反向打水腿(手放头下)
items.nameEn: reverse flutter kick on floor (hand under head)
items.description: Lying face up with your hands under your head, you do small alternating kicks. It works the lower abs.
steps: Lie on your back and place your hands under your head.
Lift your legs a few inches off the floor.
Kick up and down alternately in small, quick motions.
Keep your lower back pressed down.
Continue for the set time.

items.name: 地面反向打水腿(手放头下) v. 2
items.nameEn: reverse flutter kick on floor (hand under head) v. 2
items.description: Alternating small leg kicks while lying on your back with hands under your head. It works the lower abs and hip flexors.
steps: Lie on your back with your hands under your head and legs extended.
Lift both heels a few inches off the floor and press your lower back down.
Kick one leg up higher while the other goes down, then switch in a steady rhythm.
Keep your legs fairly straight and your core tight.
Stop the set when your lower back starts to arch.

items.name: 地面坐姿开合抬腿
items.nameEn: seated in out leg raise on floor
items.description: A seated leg tuck, with legs pulled in then extended out. It trains the lower abs and hip flexors.
steps: Sit on the floor, hands behind you for support.
Lean back slightly with legs extended and lifted.
Pull your knees toward your chest.
Extend your legs back out without touching the floor.
Keep your back long and your core tight.
Breathe steadily.

items.name: 地面折刀式
items.description: Lying on your back, you fold up to bring hands and feet together over your hips. It works the abs hard and builds hip flexor strength.
steps: Lie on your back with legs straight and arms extended overhead.
Brace your abs and press your lower back into the floor.
Lift your arms and legs at the same time, folding up at the hips.
Reach your hands toward your toes at the top.
Lower with control until arms and legs hover just above the floor.
Keep your movement smooth and avoid swinging.

items.name: 地面斜向V字起
items.description: A side-lying V-up that targets the obliques.
steps: Lie on one side with legs together and an arm extended overhead.
Lift your legs and upper body at the same time.
Reach your top hand toward your feet.
Lower with control, not resting.
Keep your movement smooth.
Do your reps, then switch sides.

items.name: 地面斜向卷腹
items.description: Lying on your back, you crunch up and rotate toward one knee, then the other. Targets the obliques and abs.
steps: 仰卧，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地板上。
将双手放在脑后或交叉放在胸前。
收紧腹肌，将肩胛骨抬离地面，将躯干旋转到一侧。
暂停片刻，然后将肩胛骨放回到地板上。
在另一侧重复，每次重复时交替进行。

items.name: 地面蛙式卷腹
items.description: A floor ab move where knees and arms come together in a frog-like crunch. It works the abs.
steps: Lie on your back with arms and legs extended.
Lift your shoulders and legs slightly off the floor.
Pull your knees in while reaching your hands toward your shins.
Squeeze your abs.
Extend back out without resting on the floor.
Keep your lower back pressed down.

items.name: 坐姿8字腿卷腹
items.description: Seated crunch where the legs trace a figure eight in the air. It works the lower abs and hip flexors while you balance on your seat.
steps: Sit on the floor, lean back slightly and support yourself with your hands behind you.
Lift both feet off the floor and brace your core.
Draw a figure eight in the air with your legs, slow and controlled.
Keep your chest lifted and your lower back from collapsing.
Lower your feet and rest, then repeat.

items.name: 坐姿上身旋转
items.description: A seated twist of the upper body. It mobilises the spine and warms up the obliques.
steps: Sit tall with arms crossed on your chest.
Keep your hips facing forward.
Rotate your torso to one side.
Return to the centre.
Rotate to the other side.
Move smoothly without forcing the twist.

items.name: 坐姿下躯干侧屈肌拉伸
items.nameEn: seated lower trunk lateral flexor stretch
items.description: A seated side bend that lengthens the muscles along the side of the waist.
steps: Sit tall on the floor or a chair with your legs crossed or feet flat.
Reach one arm overhead and bend sideways away from it until you feel the side of the waist stretch.
Keep both hips grounded and avoid leaning forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

items.name: 坐姿交替卷腹
items.description: A seated crunch where you bring one knee and the opposite elbow together, then switch sides. It works the abs and obliques.
steps: Sit on the floor, lean back slightly and lift your feet.
Place your hands behind your head.
Bring one knee in while rotating your torso toward it.
Return and repeat on the other side.
Keep your chest open and move with control.

items.name: 坐姿交替打水腿
items.description: Small alternating leg kicks while seated and leaning back. It trains the lower abs and hip flexors.
steps: Sit with your hands behind you and lean back slightly.
Lift both legs off the floor.
Kick your legs up and down in short alternating moves.
Keep your core tight and your back from rounding.
Continue for time.

items.name: 坐姿交替膝触肘扭转
items.nameEn: sitting alternate knee to elbow twist
items.description: From a seated position, twist to bring an elbow toward the opposite knee. It works the abs and obliques.
steps: Sit tall on the floor, leaning back slightly with your hands behind your head.
Lift your feet off the floor.
Twist and bring one elbow toward the opposite knee.
Return to centre and repeat on the other side.
Alternate sides at a steady pace.

items.name: 坐姿体侧拉伸
items.description: A seated side bend that stretches the sides of the waist and the lats.
steps: Sit tall with your legs crossed or feet flat on the floor.
Reach one arm overhead and lean sideways away from it, placing the other hand on the floor for support.
Keep both sit bones grounded.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

items.name: 坐姿侧向卷腹(靠墙)
items.description: Seated against a wall, you crunch from side to side. Works the obliques with back support.
steps: 坐在地板上，背靠墙，双腿在身前伸展。
弯曲膝盖，将双脚平放在地板上，与臀部同宽。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌并向一侧倾斜，将肘部靠近臀部。
暂停片刻，然后回到起始位置。
在另一侧重复。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

items.name: 坐姿地面抬腿
items.description: From a seated position with hands behind you, you lift your legs to train the lower abs and hip flexors.
steps: Sit on the floor with your hands planted behind your hips and legs extended.
Lean back slightly and brace your abs.
Raise both legs together a short way off the floor.
Lower them slowly without letting your heels drop to the ground.
Repeat for the planned reps.

items.name: 坐姿左右抬腿卷腹(地面)
items.nameEn: seated side to side leg raise crunch on floor
items.description: Seated crunch with the legs swinging to one side and then the other. It works the abs and obliques.
steps: Sit and lean back on your hands, legs lifted.
Swing both knees to one side while crunching in.
Return through the middle.
Swing to the other side.
Keep the motion smooth and controlled.

items.name: 坐姿抬腿
items.description: Seated on a bench, you lift your legs and lower them again. Works the lower abs and hip flexors.
steps: 坐在平坦的长凳上，背部挺直，双脚平放在地面上。
将双手放在长凳两侧以获得支撑。
保持双腿伸直，慢慢将它们抬起到您面前，直到它们与地面平行。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 坐姿旋转拉伸
items.description: A seated twist held as a stretch. It opens the spine and the muscles around your waist.
steps: Sit tall with legs crossed or extended.
Place one hand behind you and the other on the opposite knee.
Rotate your torso toward the back hand.
Keep your spine long.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.

items.name: 坐姿蛙式半起到全起仰卧起坐
items.nameEn: seated frog half to full sit up
items.description: Sit-up started from a seated frog position, with knees out and soles together, to work the abs and open the hips.
steps: Sit on the floor with the soles of your feet together and knees dropped out.
Lower your back halfway to the floor under control.
Pause, then lower fully to lie flat.
Curl your torso back up to sitting, using your abs.
Keep your feet together and avoid yanking on your neck.

items.name: 坐姿转体(直臂)
items.description: A seated rotation with your arms held straight out, loosening the spine and working the waist gently.
steps: Sit tall on the floor with your legs crossed or extended.
Extend both arms straight out to the sides at shoulder height.
Rotate your torso slowly to one side, keeping your spine long.
Hold for a moment, then rotate to the other side.
Repeat for 8-10 slow rotations each way.

items.name: 垂直仰卧起坐
items.description: A sit-up performed with the legs raised vertically, which keeps the focus on the abs by taking the hip flexors out of the pull.
steps: Lie on your back with your legs raised straight toward the ceiling.
Place your hands behind your head or across your chest.
Curl your torso up and reach toward your feet.
Pause at the top.
Lower your upper body slowly to the floor.

items.name: 垂直抬腿(双杠)
items.description: A leg raise done hanging or supported between parallel bars, lifting straight legs in front. It trains the abs and hip flexors.
steps: 悬挂在双杠上，双臂完全伸展，身体伸直。
启动你的核心并将双腿抬起到你面前，保持伸直。
继续抬起，直到双腿与地面平行或稍高。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 垂直抬腿(双杠) v. 3
items.nameEn: vertical leg raise (on parallel bars) v. 3
items.description: Support yourself on parallel bars and lift your legs to train the lower abs and hip flexors.
steps: Support yourself on parallel bars with straight arms and shoulders down.
Let your legs hang together.
Raise your legs in front of you until they are about parallel to the floor or higher.
Lower slowly without swinging.
Keep your torso still.

items.name: 垂直抬腿(双杠上) v. 2
items.nameEn: vertical leg raise (on parallel bars) v. 2
items.description: Hanging-style leg raise performed supported on parallel bars, taking the legs high to challenge the lower abs.
steps: Support yourself on parallel bars with straight arms and shoulders pushed down.
Keep your legs together and slightly bent or straight.
Raise your legs until they reach hip height or higher, curling your pelvis.
Lower them slowly without swinging.
Repeat for the target reps.

items.name: 大猩猩引体
items.description: A chin-up variation with a crunch at the top. It works the lats and abs together.
steps: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，膝盖稍微弯曲。
正手握住引体向上杆，握距略宽于肩宽。
悬挂在杠上，双臂完全伸展，手掌背向自己。
收紧核心肌群，将身体拉向杠铃杆，将下巴置于杠铃上方。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将身体放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 孔雀式(马尤拉)
items.description: An advanced arm balance with your torso held horizontally on your elbows. It builds core and wrist strength.
steps: Kneel and place your hands on the floor with fingers pointing back toward your feet.
Bring your elbows together under your belly.
Lean forward and rest your torso on your upper arms.
Extend your legs back and lift them.
Hold for a few breaths, then lower.

items.name: 宽站距胸椎旋转
items.description: In a wide stance you rotate your upper back to loosen the thoracic spine. It helps with trunk twisting.
steps: Stand with your feet wide and your knees slightly bent.
Hinge slightly forward with your hands behind your head.
Rotate your chest to one side as far as you can.
Keep your hips facing forward.
Return to the center.
Rotate to the other side and repeat.

items.name: 宽距平板侧点地
items.description: Wide-stance plank with alternating side taps that challenge core stability.
steps: Start in a high plank with feet wider than your hips.
Brace your core and keep your hips level.
Lift one hand and tap your opposite hip or thigh.
Return the hand and tap with the other side.
Move slowly without rocking.

items.name: 对侧卷腹
items.description: Crunch where opposite arm and leg move toward each other. It hits the abs and obliques together.
steps: Lie on your back with hands lightly behind your head.
Lift one leg bent while curling your torso up.
Bring the opposite elbow toward the raised knee.
Lower slowly with control.
Alternate sides on each rep.

items.name: 尺蠖爬行
items.description: You walk your hands out from standing into a plank and walk them back. It warms up the hamstrings, shoulders and core in one go.
steps: 从站立位置开始，双脚分开与臀部同宽。
腰部向前弯曲，双手放在身前的地面上。
双手向前移动，直到处于高位平板支撑位置，身体从头到脚成一条直线。
暂停片刻，然后将双手移回双脚，尽可能保持双腿伸直。
一旦你的手到达你的脚，站回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 尺蠖爬行 v. 2
items.description: An inchworm walk-out, walking the hands forward into a plank and the feet back in. It stretches the hamstrings and trains the core and shoulders.
steps: 从站立位置开始，双脚分开与臀部同宽。
腰部向前弯曲，双手放在身前的地面上。
双手向前移动，直到处于高位平板支撑位置，身体从头到脚成一条直线。
保持双腿伸直，将脚移向双手，将臀部抬向天花板。
继续向前移动双手，重复该动作达到所需的重复次数。

items.name: 屈腿仰卧起坐(屈膝)
items.description: A sit-up with bent knees. It strengthens the abs and hip flexors.
steps: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，慢慢将上半身抬离地面，向前卷曲，直到躯干呈 45 度角。
同时，将双腿抬离地面，弯曲膝盖并将其拉向胸部。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低上半身和双腿回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 屈腿仰卧起坐(直臂)
items.description: A sit-up with the arms straight. It works the abs and hip flexors.
steps: 平躺，双腿伸直，双臂伸直至头顶上方。
收紧腹肌，将上半身抬离地面，同时将双腿抬向胸部。
抬起上半身和腿部时，将双手伸向脚趾。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低上半身和双腿回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 屈腿侧桥
items.description: Side plank with the knees bent for a gentler version. It builds the obliques and hip stability.
steps: Lie on your side with knees bent and your forearm under your shoulder.
Lift your hips so your body forms a line from shoulder to knee.
Keep your hips stacked and core tight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower and switch sides.

items.name: 屈膝侧平板支撑
items.description: A side plank with the knees bent, a more approachable version of the full move. It strengthens the obliques and the side of the hip.
steps: Lie on your side with your knees bent and your elbow under your shoulder.
Stack your hips and knees.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line from knee to head.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower your hips with control.
Repeat on the other side.

items.name: 屈膝卷腹
items.description: A crunch that pulls the knees toward the chest as the upper body curls up. It trains the abs.
steps: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，将肩胛骨抬离地面，将膝盖靠近胸部，同时将上半身卷向膝盖。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低肩胛骨并将双腿伸展回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 屈膝抬腿斜向卷腹
items.nameEn: oblique crunches with bent knee leg lift
items.description: A side crunch combined with a bent knee lift. It trains the obliques and lower abs together.
steps: Lie on your back with your hands by your head and knees bent.
Lift your shoulders and knees at the same time.
Twist and bring one elbow toward the opposite knee.
Hold briefly, then lower with control.
Alternate sides through the set.

items.name: 左右触脚尖(男)
items.description: A standing side bend where each hand slides down toward the same-side foot in turn. It mobilises the trunk and trains the obliques.
steps: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双臂向两侧伸展。
腰部向右弯曲，将右手伸向右脚，同时保持左手向一侧延伸。
返回起始位置，然后腰部向左弯曲，将左手伸向左脚，同时保持右手向侧面延伸。
重复左右弯曲动作达到所需的重复次数。

items.name: 平凳仰卧抬腿
items.description: Lying on a flat bench, you raise and lower straight legs. Works the lower abs and hip flexors.
steps: 平躺在平坦的长凳上，背部紧贴长凳。
将双手放在臀部下方以获得支撑。
保持双腿伸直并拢，然后将它们抬向天花板。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 平凳收腿
items.description: Seated on a flat bench, you pull your knees in toward your chest and extend them again. Works the lower abs and hip flexors.
steps: 坐在平坦的长凳上，双腿在身前伸直。
将双手放在臀部旁边的长凳上以获得支撑。
收紧腹肌，将双腿抬离地面，使膝盖靠近胸部。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 平板支撑交替反重力引体
items.nameEn: plank alternate anti gravity pull up
items.description: From a plank you alternately pull one arm up toward your chest as if climbing. It builds core stability and shoulder control.
steps: Start in a forearm or high plank with your body in a straight line.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Pull one arm up and back toward your ribs.
Return it to the floor under control.
Alternate arms without rocking your hips.

items.name: 平板支撑侧平举
items.description: A plank where you lift one arm out to the side. It challenges your core and shoulders.
steps: Start in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders.
Brace your abs and keep your hips level.
Lift one arm out to the side to shoulder height.
Lower it with control.
Alternate arms and avoid twisting.

items.name: 平板支撑侧跳
items.description: From a plank, you hop your feet side to side. It challenges the core and gets your heart rate up.
steps: Start in a high plank with hands under your shoulders.
Brace your abs and keep your back flat.
Jump both feet a short way to one side.
Jump them back through the centre to the other side.
Keep a steady rhythm for 20-30 seconds.

items.name: 平板支撑开合滑行(用毛巾)
items.description: From a plank, slide your feet apart and together on towels. It works the core and hips without any impact.
steps: Put your feet on towels on a smooth floor and get into a high plank.
Brace your core.
Slide your feet wide apart.
Slide them back together.
Keep your hips level and repeat.

items.name: 平板支撑开合跳
items.description: A plank where your feet jump apart and together like a jumping jack. It trains the core and raises your heart rate.
steps: Start in a forearm or high plank with your body in a straight line.
Jump both feet out wide.
Jump them back together.
Keep your hips level and your abs tight throughout.
Continue for the planned reps or time.

items.name: 平板支撑抬腿登山者
items.description: A plank with a leg lift into a mountain climber. It trains the core and raises the heart rate.
steps: Start in a high plank with hands under your shoulders.
Lift one leg straight back.
Bring that knee in toward your chest.
Return and switch legs.
Keep your hips level and your core tight.

items.name: 平板支撑抬臂
items.description: A plank where you lift one arm at a time, training core stability and anti-rotation strength.
steps: Get into a forearm or high plank with your body in a straight line.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes.
Lift one arm forward without letting your hips rotate.
Place it back down with control and lift the other.
Keep your neck neutral and alternate arms for the planned reps.

items.name: 平板支撑臀部(动作检查)
items.description: A side-by-side form check for hip position in a plank, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
steps: Set your forearms on the floor with elbows under the shoulders and legs extended.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your butt stays level with your shoulders, not piked up or sagging down.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

items.name: 平板支撑触膝
items.description: A plank with alternating knee taps to the floor. It trains the abs and anti-rotation control.
steps: Start in a forearm or high plank.
Brace your core.
Lower one knee gently toward the floor.
Return it and switch sides.
Keep your hips level.
Breathe steadily.

items.name: 平躺抬髋
items.description: A hip raise done lying flat on the floor. It works the lower abs by lifting your hips with a controlled curl.
steps: Lie on your back with arms by your sides or under your hips.
Raise your legs so they point to the ceiling.
Tighten your abs and lift your hips a few centimetres.
Hold for a moment at the top.
Lower your hips slowly to the floor.
Keep the motion small and controlled.

items.name: 开合分腿卷腹
items.description: A crunch with legs that split apart like a jumping jack while lying down. It trains the abs and keeps the legs working.
steps: Lie on your back with your arms extended overhead and legs together.
Lift your shoulders and legs as you crunch up.
Open your legs wide in a split while your hands reach forward.
Bring the legs back together as you lower.
Keep your lower back pressed down.
Repeat at a smooth, steady pace.

items.name: 开合跳平板支撑
items.description: A plank where your feet jump in and out like a jumping jack, combining core stability with cardio.
steps: Start in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders.
Brace your core and keep your hips level.
Jump your feet apart, then jump them back together.
Keep your upper body steady and your hips from rising.
Continue at a steady pace for the planned time.

items.name: 开瓶器
items.description: A Pilates move where the legs trace circles overhead, training the obliques and lower abs.
steps: Lie on your back with arms by your sides and legs raised up.
Lift your hips slightly and swing your legs across to one side.
Circle them down and around.
Bring them back up to the start.
Reverse the direction.

items.name: 开腿摇椅
items.description: A balance and rolling move with the legs open in a V shape.
steps: Sit and hold your ankles with your legs in a V.
Balance on your tailbone.
Roll back onto your shoulders.
Roll up to balance again.
Keep your back rounded.

items.name: 弓步蹲加转体
items.description: A lunge with a torso twist. It works the legs and the obliques.
steps: 首先站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
右脚向前迈出一步，将身体降低至弓步位置。
当你弓步时，将你的躯干向右扭转，将你的左肘拉向你的右膝盖。
暂停片刻，然后回到起始位置。
在另一侧重复，左脚向前迈出，并将躯干向左扭转。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

items.name: 徒手斜向劈砍深蹲
items.description: A squat with a diagonal chopping arm motion that trains the legs and teaches the trunk to rotate with control.
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hands clasped above one shoulder.
Squat down while chopping your hands diagonally toward the opposite knee.
Rotate through your trunk and let your back foot pivot.
Stand up as you swing your arms back up.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

items.name: 徒手站姿斜向转体
items.description: A standing trunk rotation without load. It warms up the obliques and spine.
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and arms at chest height.
Rotate your torso to one side.
Return to center.
Rotate to the other side.
Keep your hips facing forward.

items.name: 微屈膝抬腿
items.description: A leg raise with slightly bent knees, a gentler version for the lower abs.
steps: Lie on your back with your hands under your hips.
Bend your knees slightly and lift your feet off the floor.
Raise your legs until they are above your hips.
Lower slowly without letting your back arch.
Keep your core tight throughout.

items.name: 悬垂L坐
items.description: A hanging hold with legs straight out in front that challenges the abs and grip.
steps: Hang from a bar with straight arms.
Lift your legs straight in front until they are parallel to the floor.
Keep your toes pointed and your knees locked.
Avoid swinging.
Hold for 10-20 seconds, then lower.

items.name: 悬垂交替打水腿
items.description: Hanging from a bar, you alternate small, fast kicks with straight legs. It trains the lower abs and grip.
steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with arms straight.
Tighten your core and lift your legs slightly in front of you.
Kick your legs up and down in alternating small movements.
Keep your swing minimal.
Continue for the set time or reps.

items.name: 悬垂交替抬膝
items.description: A hanging ab move where you lift one knee at a time. It strengthens the lower abs and hip flexors.
steps: Hang from a bar with arms straight.
Brace your core and keep your body still.
Lift one knee toward your chest.
Lower it slowly and lift the other knee.
Avoid swinging.
Alternate for the reps.

items.name: 悬垂侧倾
items.description: While hanging from a bar, you lean your body to each side to work the obliques and grip.
steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip and legs together.
Brace your abs and keep your arms straight.
Lean your legs and hips toward one side, bending through the waist.
Return to centre under control.
Lean to the other side and alternate for the planned reps.

items.name: 悬垂前水平保持
items.description: The full front lever: a straight horizontal body hold under a bar. It is an advanced test of back and core strength.
steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip.
Pull your shoulder blades down and tighten your core.
Raise your whole body to horizontal with your legs straight.
Keep your arms locked and your body in one line.
Hold for as long as you can with good form.
Lower down slowly.

items.name: 悬垂前水平抬起
items.description: Hanging straight-body raise toward a front lever position that challenges your abs and lats.
steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with a firm grip.
Pull your shoulders down and tighten your core.
Raise your straight body up toward horizontal, keeping your arms straight.
Hold the top position for a moment.
Lower slowly without swinging.

items.name: 悬垂半风车
items.description: From a hang you lift the legs and sweep them to one side in a half circle. It builds oblique strength and grip.
steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with a firm overhand grip.
Raise both legs together toward one side of the bar.
Sweep them across the front in a half circle.
Lower the legs on the other side under control.
Keep the swing small and your shoulders active.
Repeat, alternating the direction.

items.name: 悬垂团身前水平保持
items.description: Hanging from a bar, you hold your body horizontal with your knees tucked. It builds lats and core strength.
steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip.
Pull your shoulder blades down and tuck your knees to your chest.
Lean back and raise your hips until your back is horizontal.
Keep your arms straight.
Hold for 5-15 seconds.
Lower back down with control.

items.name: 悬垂屈体
items.description: Hanging from a bar, you fold your legs up toward the bar in a pike. It works the abs and hip flexors.
steps: 悬挂在引体向上杆上，双臂完全伸展，手掌背向自己。
收紧核心肌群，将双腿向杠铃方向抬起，保持伸直。
继续抬起身体，直到身体形成“V”形，双腿与地面平行。
保持该姿势片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 悬垂屈膝抬腿
items.description: From a hang, you bring your knees up toward your chest to work the lower abs.
steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with arms straight.
Brace your abs and avoid swinging.
Raise your knees toward your chest.
Tilt your pelvis up at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

items.name: 悬垂屈膝甩臂
items.nameEn: arm slingers hanging bent knee legs
items.description: A hanging knee raise bringing knees toward your elbows. Strengthens the abs and hip flexors.
steps: 悬挂在引体向上杆上，双臂完全伸展，膝盖弯曲成 90 度角。
收紧核心并将膝盖抬向胸部，尽可能靠近肘部。
慢慢地将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 悬垂屈膝绕圈抬腿
items.description: Hanging from a bar, you raise your knees in a circular path. It targets the lower abs and obliques.
steps: Hang from a bar with arms straight and legs together.
Raise your knees toward your chest.
Move them in a circle to one side and back down.
Keep your body from swinging.
Alternate the circle direction each rep.

items.name: 悬垂抬腿
items.description: Hanging from a bar, you raise your legs in front of you. It works the lower abs and hip flexors.
steps: 悬挂在引体向上杆上，双臂完全伸展，手掌背向自己。
启动你的核心并将双腿抬起到你面前，保持伸直。
继续抬起，直到双腿与地面平行或达到您可以舒适地达到的高度。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 悬垂抬腿抬髋
items.description: A hanging raise where you lift your legs and curl your hips up. Strengthens the lower abs and hip flexors.
steps: 悬挂在引体向上杆上，双臂完全伸展，手掌背向自己。
弯曲臀部和膝盖，收紧核心并抬起双腿，直到大腿与地面平行。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 悬垂斜向抬膝
items.description: A hanging knee raise with a twist to each side. Targets the obliques and abs, and challenges your grip.
steps: 悬挂在引体向上杆上，双臂完全伸展，手掌背向自己。
收紧核心并将膝盖抬向胸部，同时将躯干扭转到一侧。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
在另一侧重复上述步骤，向相反方向扭转躯干。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

items.name: 悬垂死虫式
items.description: A hanging variation of the dead bug, extending opposite arm and leg. It builds core control.
steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with a firm grip.
Lift your knees to hip height.
Extend one leg while keeping control of your torso.
Return and switch legs.
Avoid swinging.

items.name: 悬垂直腿扭转抬髋
items.nameEn: hanging straight twisting leg hip raise
items.description: Hanging from a bar, you raise your straight legs while twisting your hips. It trains the abs and obliques.
steps: 悬挂在引体向上杆上，双臂完全伸展，双腿伸直。
启动你的核心并将双腿抬向胸部，保持伸直。
一旦双腿与地面平行，将臀部向一侧扭转，将双腿移向一侧。
暂停片刻，然后回到起始位置。
重复这个动作，但这次将臀部扭向另一侧。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

items.name: 悬垂直腿抬腿
items.description: Hanging from a bar, you raise your straight legs in front of you. It builds the abs and hip flexors.
steps: 悬挂在引体向上杆上，双臂完全伸展，手掌背向自己。
启动你的核心并将双腿抬起到你面前，保持伸直。
继续抬起，直到双腿与地面平行或达到您可以舒适地达到的高度。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 悬垂直腿抬髋
items.description: Hanging from a bar, you lift your straight legs and raise the hips. It trains the lower abs.
steps: 悬挂在引体向上杆上，双臂完全伸展，手掌背向自己。
启动你的核心并将双腿抬起到你面前，直到它们与地面平行。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 悬垂直腿甩臂
items.description: A hanging straight-leg raise. Strengthens the abs and hip flexors and challenges your grip.
steps: 悬挂在引体向上杆上，双臂完全伸展，双腿伸直向下。
启动你的核心并将双腿抬起到你面前，直到它们与地面平行。
在顶部保持片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 悬垂空心保持
items.description: A hold hanging from a bar with the body in a slight hollow curve. It builds deep abdominal tension and grip.
steps: Grab a pull-up bar with an overhand grip and hang with straight arms.
Brace your abs and tuck your pelvis slightly.
Lift your legs forward a little so your body forms a gentle hollow shape.
Keep your shoulders active and avoid swinging.
Hold the position for as long as you can with good form.
Lower down under control.

items.name: 悬垂脚触杠
items.description: A tough hanging core move that brings the toes all the way up to the bar.
steps: Hang from a bar with a firm grip.
Engage your lats and brace your core.
Raise your straight legs up until your toes touch the bar.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower your legs with control.
Avoid excessive swinging.

items.name: 悬垂膝触肘
items.description: A hanging leg raise where the knees travel up to the elbows, working the abs and hip flexors hard.
steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with a firm grip.
Brace your core and tuck your knees.
Raise your knees up toward your elbows.
Curl your pelvis up at the top.
Lower slowly without swinging.
Repeat for the desired reps.

items.name: 悬垂进阶团身前水平保持
items.nameEn: hanging advanced tucked front lever hold
items.description: A harder front lever hold with the knees tucked but the hips open. It demands strong lats and core.
steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with straight arms.
Lift your body to horizontal in a tucked position.
Open your hips slightly so your back is flat.
Keep your shoulder blades pulled down.
Hold for 5-10 seconds.
Lower down slowly.

items.name: 悬挂带反向卷腹
items.description: A hanging reverse crunch, curling the knees and pelvis up toward the chest. It targets the lower abs.
steps: 悬挂在引体向上杆上，双臂完全伸展，手掌背向自己。
收紧核心肌群，将膝盖抬向胸部，将骨盆卷向胸腔。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将膝盖放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 悬挂带腹部前推
items.description: A fallout with suspension straps, leaning forward and lowering the body with straight arms. It builds deep core strength in the abs.
steps: 将悬挂训练器连接到高锚点并将带子调整至腰部高度。
背对锚点站立，并握住手柄，双臂向前伸展。
腰部向前倾，保持身体挺直，核心肌群参与。
尽可能降低身体，同时保持腹肌的控制和紧张。
在底部停顿片刻，然后慢慢抬起身体回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 战绳俄罗斯转体
items.description: A seated twist where you swing the ropes side to side. It trains the obliques and conditioning.
steps: Sit on the floor with knees bent and lean back slightly.
Hold the rope ends in front of you.
Twist your torso to one side and swing the ropes.
Twist to the other side.
Keep your chest lifted and continue for the set time.

items.name: 手撑平板支撑
items.description: A straight-arm plank held on the hands. It builds trunk stiffness and shoulder stability.
steps: Place your hands under your shoulders and extend your legs behind you.
Tuck your toes and lift your hips so the body forms a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs.
Keep your neck neutral and look at the floor.
Hold for 20-40 seconds, then lower your knees.

items.name: 手触对侧膝卷腹
items.description: A crunch where you bring a hand toward the opposite knee. It works the abs and the obliques.
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your hands behind your head.
Lift your shoulders and bring one knee up.
Reach the opposite hand toward that knee.
Lower and repeat on the other side.
Keep your lower back on the floor.
Do not pull on your neck.

items.name: 扬达仰卧起坐
items.description: A sit-up with the glutes and quads squeezed to take the hip flexors out of play. It focuses on the abs.
steps: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，慢慢将上半身抬离地面，向前卷曲，直到躯干呈 45 度角。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 扭转仰卧起坐
items.description: A sit up with a twist at the top. It adds oblique work to the usual abs focus.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and hands by your head.
Curl your torso up off the floor.
Rotate to bring one elbow toward the opposite knee.
Lower back down with control.
Alternate sides each rep.

items.name: 扭转侧桥
items.description: A side bridge with a rotation of the top arm under your body. It challenges the obliques and shoulder stability.
steps: Lie on your side and prop up on one forearm, feet stacked.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.
Reach your top arm under your torso, twisting slightly.
Return to the straight line.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

items.name: 扭转卷腹
items.description: A crunch with a rotation that adds work for the obliques on top of the abs.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and hands lightly behind your head.
Curl your shoulders off the floor.
Rotate your torso to bring one elbow toward the opposite knee.
Lower with control and repeat on the other side.
Avoid pulling on your neck.

items.name: 扭转卷腹 v. 2
items.description: A crunch with a rotation to bring each elbow toward the opposite knee. Works the abs and obliques.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and hands behind your head.
Curl your shoulders off the floor.
Twist to bring one elbow toward the opposite knee.
Lower slowly.
Alternate sides for your reps.

items.name: 扭转卷腹(双腿上抬)
items.description: Crunch with legs raised and a rotation at the top that hits the abs and obliques.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and legs raised.
Place your hands lightly behind your head.
Crunch up and rotate one shoulder toward the opposite knee.
Lower with control and repeat to the other side.
Do not pull on your neck.

items.name: 扭转卷腹(手臂伸直)
items.description: A crunch with straight arms reaching across to the side. It focuses on the abs and obliques.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and arms extended toward the ceiling.
Curl your shoulders off the floor.
Reach your straight arms toward one side of your knees.
Lower slowly.
Alternate sides, keeping your neck relaxed.

items.name: 扭转卷腹(直臂)
items.description: A crunch with a twist and arms extended to work the abs and obliques.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and arms straight up.
Lift your shoulders off the floor.
Twist to reach one side.
Return to center and twist the other way.
Keep your lower back on the floor.

items.name: 扭转头触膝式
items.description: A seated side bend and twist over one extended leg. Stretches the side body and hamstrings.
steps: Sit with one leg extended and the other foot against your inner thigh.
Rotate your chest toward the extended leg.
Reach one arm overhead and bend over the leg.
Hold for 5 slow breaths.
Rise and switch sides.

items.name: 扭转抬腿
items.description: A lying leg raise with a hip twist and hands under the glutes. Works the abs and obliques.
steps: 平躺，双腿伸展，双臂放在身体两侧。
将双手放在臀部下方以获得支撑。
收紧腹肌，将双腿抬离地面，保持伸直。
当你抬起双腿时，将臀部扭向一侧，将双腿拉向对面的肩膀。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复这个动作，这次将臀部扭到另一侧。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

items.name: 扭转抬腿(女)
items.description: A lying leg raise with a hip twist. Works the abs and obliques.
steps: 平躺，双腿伸展，双臂放在身体两侧。
弯曲膝盖，将双腿抬离地面，将它们拉向胸部。
当你抬起双腿时，将臀部扭向一侧，将膝盖移向另一侧的肩膀。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复这个动作，这次将臀部扭到另一侧。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

items.name: 扭转超人式
items.description: A floor exercise where you lift your limbs off the ground and add a rotation, training the lower back and glutes.
steps: Lie face down with your arms extended overhead and legs straight.
Lift your arms, chest and legs off the floor.
Rotate your torso slightly to one side while holding the lift.
Return to the center, then rotate to the other side.
Lower down with control and keep your neck neutral.

items.name: 扭转转身上举
items.description: A floor core move that combines a twist with a leg or torso lift. It works the abs and obliques through rotation.
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent and arms extended.
Lift your shoulders and legs off the floor.
Twist your torso and bring your knees toward one side.
Turn back through the centre and lift again.
Repeat to the other side, keeping the movement smooth and controlled.

items.name: 扭髋手臂支撑
items.description: A seated twist with the legs lifted, working the obliques and core.
steps: Sit with your hands behind you and legs lifted.
Keep your chest open.
Rotate your hips to one side.
Circle your legs back to the centre.
Switch sides.

items.name: 折刀式
items.description: A Pilates move where you lift your legs and trunk together to fold at the hips. It challenges the abs and balance.
steps: Lie on your back with your legs extended and your arms by your sides.
Lift both legs up toward the ceiling.
Press your arms into the floor and lift your hips slightly.
Raise your trunk and reach toward your toes.
Roll back down slowly with control.
Keep your movement smooth, without swinging.

items.name: 折刀式仰卧起坐
items.description: You lie flat and fold your body, bringing hands and feet together. It strongly trains the abs.
steps: 平躺，双腿伸展，双臂举过头顶。
启动你的核心，同时抬起双腿和上半身，将双手伸向脚趾。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢放下双腿和上半身回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 抬前腿触膝下
items.nameEn: front leg lift under knee tap
items.description: A standing move where you drive a knee up and tap beneath it with your hands. It warms up the hips and works the abs.
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your hands out in front.
Lift one knee up and forward to hip height.
Reach both hands under that thigh and tap beneath the knee.
Lower the foot with control and switch legs.
Keep your chest up and stay light on your feet.
Alternate sides at a steady, bouncy pace.

items.name: 抬头交替抬腿
items.nameEn: alternate leg raise with head up
items.description: Raise one leg at a time while lying with your head lifted. It works the lower abs.
steps: Lie on your back with your head slightly lifted.
Raise one leg to vertical.
Lower it without touching the floor.
Raise the other leg.
Keep your lower back pressed down.

items.name: 抬胸转体
items.description: A curl up with a twist that trains the abs and obliques.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and hands behind your head.
Curl your head and shoulders up.
Rotate your torso to one side.
Return to centre and lower.
Alternate sides.

items.name: 抬腿(屈膝)
items.description: A lying leg raise with bent knees that makes it easier to focus on the lower abs.
steps: Lie on your back with arms by your sides.
Bend your knees.
Raise your legs until your thighs are vertical.
Lower slowly without arching.
Keep your lower back on the floor.

items.name: 抬腿侧平板支撑 v. 2
items.nameEn: side plank with raised leg v. 2
items.description: A side plank with the top leg lifted, a second variation. It adds hip work to the oblique hold.
steps: Set up in a side plank on your forearm with your body in a line.
Lift your top leg to hip height.
Keep your hips high and your core tight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without dropping.
Lower down gently.
Repeat on the other side.

items.name: 抬腿抬髋
items.description: A lying leg raise finished with a hip lift that targets the lower abs.
steps: Lie on your back with your legs straight and your hands by your sides.
Raise your legs to vertical.
Curl your hips up off the floor, pushing your feet toward the ceiling.
Lower your hips, then your legs, with control.
Keep your movement smooth and avoid swinging.

items.name: 抬腿抬髋抬头
items.nameEn: leg raise hip lift with head up
items.description: Lying leg raise finished with a hip lift while the head stays raised, working the whole abdominal wall.
steps: Lie on your back with your legs straight and your hands by your sides.
Lift your head and shoulders slightly off the floor.
Raise your legs to vertical.
Push your hips a little off the floor, lifting your feet toward the ceiling.
Lower your hips and legs slowly with control.

items.name: 抬腿斜向卷腹
items.description: Raise your legs and crunch to the side. It targets the lower abs and the obliques together.
