steps: Lie on your back with your hands behind your head.
Lift your legs together toward the ceiling.
Crunch your shoulders up and toward one side as the legs tilt the other way.
Lower and repeat to the other side.
Keep movements slow and controlled.

items.name: 抬腿触胸正面平板支撑
items.nameEn: leg lift to chest front plank
items.description: From a front plank, drive one knee to the chest and alternate. It trains the core and hip flexors.
steps: Start in a high plank.
Draw one knee toward your chest.
Return it to the floor.
Alternate legs.
Keep your hips level.

items.name: 抬腿龙旗
items.description: Advanced core move where the body stays straight while you raise and lower the legs from a bench. It strongly trains the abs.
steps: Lie on a bench and grip it behind your head.
Lift your hips and legs so your body is straight from shoulders to toes.
Keep your body rigid and lower slowly without sitting.
Raise your legs back up under control.
Stop before your lower back arches.

items.name: 抬髋(屈膝)
items.description: Lying on your back with bent knees, you raise your hips toward the ceiling. It works the lower abs and glutes.
steps: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在身体两侧，掌心朝下。
收紧核心肌群和臀肌，然后将臀部抬离地面，直到身体从膝盖到肩膀形成一条直线。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将臀部放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 抬髋卷腹
items.description: A reverse crunch that lifts the hips while the legs rise over the torso. It targets the lower abs.
steps: Lie on your back with your legs lifted and knees bent.
Place your hands at your sides or under your hips.
Curl your hips off the floor, bringing your knees toward your chest.
Hold briefly at the top.
Lower with control.
Avoid using momentum.

items.name: 抬髋腰部离地
items.nameEn: hip lift low back off floor
items.description: A lying move where you lift the hips so the lower back leaves the floor. It targets the lower abs.
steps: Lie on your back with legs raised toward the ceiling.
Press your arms into the floor.
Lift your hips so your lower back comes off the floor.
Lower slowly with control.
Avoid swinging.

items.name: 抱头半程仰卧起坐(男)
items.description: A half sit-up with the hands held behind the head, like a prisoner. It trains the abs through a short, controlled range.
steps: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，慢慢将上半身抬离地面，向前卷曲，直到躯干呈 45 度角。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 拉腿
items.description: A plank-based Pilates move where you lift one leg at a time, training core stability.
steps: Start in a high plank.
Brace your core.
Lift one leg a few inches.
Lower and switch legs.
Keep your hips level.

items.name: 拍肩
items.description: A high plank where you tap the opposite shoulder with each hand. It trains the abs and builds shoulder stability.
steps: 从高平板支撑位置开始，双手直接放在肩膀下方，身体呈一条直线。
启动你的核心并将右手抬离地面，伸手拍打你的左肩。
将右手放回地面，然后用左手轻拍右肩，重复此操作。
继续交替轻拍肩膀，同时保持臀部和躯干稳定。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 挑战式
items.description: A classic Pilates V-sit that challenges abdominal strength and balance.
steps: Lie on your back with legs extended and arms overhead.
Roll up while lifting your legs to form a V shape.
Reach your arms parallel to your legs and balance on your sit bones.
Hold briefly with a flat, strong back.
Roll down slowly with control and repeat.

items.name: 控制平衡
items.description: A challenging Pilates move where you balance on your shoulders while switching legs, building control and core strength.
steps: Lie on your back and roll your legs overhead.
Hold one ankle with both hands.
Extend the other leg out above you.
Switch legs with control.
Roll down slowly.

items.name: 摇摆棕榈树式瑜伽体式
items.description: A standing side stretch with your arms overhead that lengthens the sides of the body and opens the shoulders.
steps: Stand tall with feet together and arms overhead, palms joined.
Reach up through your fingertips.
Lean gently to one side without twisting.
Breathe and hold for 15-20 seconds.
Return to center and repeat on the other side.

items.name: 收腹抱膝
items.description: A seated or lying tuck that draws knees and chest together to train the abs.
steps: Sit on the floor and lean back slightly.
Extend your legs in front of you.
Pull your knees to your chest as you bring your torso forward.
Extend again under control.
Keep your core braced.

items.name: 收膝斜向卷腹
items.description: Drive a knee toward the opposite elbow to crunch the side of your waist. It trains the obliques and lower abs.
steps: Lie on your back with your hands behind your head.
Lift your shoulders off the floor.
Tuck one knee in while rotating your opposite elbow toward it.
Return and repeat to the other side.
Move with control instead of pulling on your neck.

items.name: 斜躺抬髋
items.description: A hip raise done lying on an incline. It trains the lower abs by curling your pelvis toward your ribs.
steps: Lie back on an incline surface and hold the top with your hands.
Bring your legs up with knees slightly bent.
Curl your pelvis and lift your hips off the surface.
Pause with your feet pointing toward the ceiling.
Lower your hips slowly.
Avoid swinging your legs.

items.name: 新月式
items.description: Stand and arch sideways with arms overhead to lengthen one side of the body. It opens the ribs, sides and shoulders.
steps: Stand tall with feet together and raise your arms overhead, palms joined.
Reach up through your fingertips and keep your hips level.
Lean your upper body slowly to one side in a gentle curve.
Hold for 3 to 5 breaths without twisting forward or back.
Return to center and repeat on the other side.

items.name: 旋转俯卧撑(跪姿)
items.description: A knee push-up that adds a rotation to reach upward. It works the chest and the trunk.
steps: Start in a push-up position on your knees.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up.
Rotate your torso and lift one arm toward the ceiling.
Return the arm to the floor.
Alternate sides.

items.name: 桥式(直臂)
items.description: A bridge hold on straight arms like the top of a push-up. It trains the abs and shoulder stability.
steps: Start in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders.
Extend your legs behind you with your toes on the floor.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower your knees to rest.

items.name: 桥式(跪姿)
items.description: A plank-style bridge hold supported on the knees. It builds trunk endurance with less load than a full plank.
steps: Kneel on a mat and lean forward onto your forearms.
Position your elbows under your shoulders.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line from knees to head.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower gently and rest.

items.name: 桥式登山跑(交叉)
items.description: A plank-position mountain climber driving knee across the body. Works the abs and obliques, and raises your heart rate.
steps: 从高平板支撑位置开始，双手直接放在肩膀下方，身体呈一条直线。
启动你的核心并将右脚抬离地面，将右膝移向左肘。
将右脚放回到起始位置，然后将左脚朝向右肘重复该动作。
继续交替两侧，以受控的速度移动。
保持臀部水平，避免臀部抬得太高或下垂得太低。
在整个练习过程中保持稳定的呼吸模式。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 棍棒侧向到前向弯曲拉伸
items.nameEn: stick side to front bend stretch
items.description: Combines a side bend with a forward fold while holding a stick overhead. Stretches the side body, lower back and hamstrings.
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hold the stick overhead.
Bend sideways to one side and hold briefly.
Then turn the torso forward and fold from your hips with a long back.
Hold for 15-20 seconds, then rise slowly.
Repeat on the other side.

items.name: 棍棒侧弯拉伸
items.description: A standing side bend with a stick raised overhead. Lengthens the side of your trunk and the lats.
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hold the stick overhead.
Keep your arms straight and your chest open.
Bend slowly to one side without leaning forward.
Hold for 15-20 seconds.
Return to center and bend to the other side.

items.name: 棍棒站姿转体拉伸
items.description: A gentle standing rotation with a stick across your shoulders. Loosens the mid back and trunk.
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and rest a stick across your upper back.
Hold it with both hands and keep your hips facing forward.
Rotate your upper body slowly to one side.
Pause for a moment, then rotate to the other side.
Repeat for 10-12 slow turns and keep your knees soft.

items.name: 棍棒辅助核心等长收缩
items.description: Holding a stick overhead or in front while you brace your midsection. Builds trunk stability and teaches you to keep the ribs down.
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and hold a stick in both hands.
Raise the stick to the position you are cued for and keep your arms steady.
Brace your abs as if preparing for a light punch and tuck the ribs down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
Lower the stick slowly and shake out your arms.

items.name: 椅上坐姿上勾拳
items.description: Seated punching move that fires the abs and shoulders with quick uppercut punches.
steps: Sit tall on the edge of a chair with your fists up by your chin.
Brace your core.
Rotate your torso and punch one fist upward in an uppercut.
Snap it back and punch with the other hand.
Keep a quick, steady rhythm for the set.

items.name: 椅上坐姿伐木
items.description: A seated woodchop with the hands clasped. It works the obliques with no equipment.
steps: Sit tall on a chair and clasp your hands together.
Raise your arms diagonally up to one side.
Chop down across your body to the opposite knee.
Rotate through your torso.
Alternate sides at an easy pace.

items.name: 椅上坐姿侧弯
items.nameEn: sitting side bend on a chair
items.description: A gentle seated side bend that works the obliques and loosens the sides. Easy to do at a desk.
steps: Sit tall on a chair with feet flat.
Place one hand behind your head.
Bend sideways toward the floor.
Return to upright using your side muscles.
Repeat on the other side.

items.name: 椅上坐姿侧弯
items.nameEn: seated side bend on a chair
items.description: A gentle seated side bend that works the obliques and loosens the sides of the trunk.
steps: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Reach one arm overhead and lean slowly to the opposite side without twisting.
Pause briefly, then return to upright.
Repeat on the other side and keep alternating.

items.name: 椅上坐姿俄罗斯转体
items.nameEn: sitting russian twist on a chair
items.description: A Russian twist done seated on a chair. It works the obliques with low impact.
steps: Sit near the edge of a chair and lean back slightly.
Clasp your hands in front of your chest.
Rotate your torso to one side.
Return to centre and rotate to the other side.
Keep your chest tall.

items.name: 椅上坐姿前卷起
items.nameEn: seated forward roll up on a chair
items.description: A seated roll-up that curls the spine forward one segment at a time. It trains the abs and spinal control.
steps: Sit tall on the edge of a chair with your arms crossed or reaching forward.
Tuck your chin and round your lower back.
Roll your spine forward one segment at a time.
Reach toward your knees and pause.
Roll back up slowly to a tall position.
Keep the motion smooth and controlled.

items.name: 椅上坐姿后仰
items.nameEn: seated lean back on a chair
items.description: A seated lean back that wakes up the abs by holding the torso against gravity.
steps: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Lean back slowly while keeping your back straight.
Stop where you can still hold your form, then return to upright using your abs.

items.name: 椅上坐姿直立扭转
items.nameEn: seated upright twists on a chair
items.description: A seated trunk twist done tall on a chair. It loosens the spine and works the obliques gently.
steps: Sit tall with feet flat and arms crossed over your chest.
Rotate your torso to one side.
Pause briefly.
Rotate to the other side.
Keep your hips still.

items.name: 椅上对角伸展
items.description: A seated reach across the body toward the opposite foot. It loosens the trunk and works the obliques gently.
steps: Sit tall on the front edge of a chair with feet flat.
Extend your arms out in front of you.
Reach one hand diagonally down toward the opposite foot, rotating your torso.
Return to upright with control.
Reach to the other side and keep alternating.

items.name: 椅子辅助仰卧起坐
items.description: A sit-up with your feet or legs supported on a chair to focus on the abs.
steps: Lie on your back and rest your lower legs on a chair seat, knees bent.
Cross your arms over your chest or place your hands by your ears.
Curl your torso up toward your knees.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower back down slowly.
Do not pull on your neck.

items.name: 椒盐卷饼拉伸
items.description: A twisting stretch lying on your side. It loosens the hips, trunk and lower back.
steps: Lie on one side and bend your top knee.
Pull the bottom foot toward your glutes.
Rotate your top knee back toward the floor behind you.
Keep your shoulders relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.

items.name: 正面平板支撑触脚尖
items.description: A forearm or high plank where you reach a foot out to tap the floor. It trains core stability and hip control.
steps: Start in a front plank with your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes.
Lift one foot and tap the toes out to the side without twisting your hips.
Bring the foot back to the start.
Repeat on the other leg and keep alternating.

items.name: 正面转侧平板支撑
items.description: Rotate from a front plank into a side plank to train the core.
steps: Start in a front plank on your forearms or hands.
Rotate your body to one side, lifting one arm up.
Hold briefly in a side plank.
Return to the front plank.
Alternate sides.

items.name: 死虫式
items.description: A core drill where you extend opposite arm and leg while keeping the lower back pressed to the floor. It builds stability in the abs.
steps: 平躺，双臂伸向天花板。
弯曲膝盖，将双腿抬离地面，使臀部和膝盖形成 90 度角。
接合你的核心和下背部，将你的下背部压入地面。
慢慢地将右臂和左腿放低至地面，保持它们伸直并悬停在地板上方。
暂停片刻，然后回到起始位置。
用左臂和右腿重复该动作。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

items.name: 死虫式 v. 2
items.description: A lying core drill where arms and legs reach out while your back stays down. It trains core control.
steps: Lie on your back with arms pointing up and knees bent at 90 degrees.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Lower your right arm and left leg toward the floor.
Return and switch sides.
Move slowly and keep your back flat.

items.name: 死虫式 v. 3
items.description: A back-lying core drill that moves opposite arms and legs while keeping the lower back flat.
steps: Lie on your back with arms straight above you and knees bent at 90 degrees.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Lower one arm and the opposite leg toward the floor.
Return to the start.
Alternate sides with a slow tempo.
Keep your ribs down.

items.name: 毛巾平板支撑屈体滑行
items.description: From a plank with your feet on towels, slide your feet in to lift the hips into a pike. It hits your abs hard and challenges shoulder stability.
steps: Put your toes on towels on a smooth floor and get into a straight-arm plank.
Brace your abs and keep your arms straight.
Slide your feet toward your hands as your hips rise into a pike.
Pause briefly at the top.
Slide your feet back to the plank without letting your hips drop.

items.name: 毛巾登山者滑行
items.description: From a plank, slide your feet on towels to bring your knees to your chest. A core and cardio move that is easy on the joints.
steps: Place your feet on towels on a smooth floor and get into a plank.
Keep your core tight and shoulders over your wrists.
Slide one knee toward your chest.
Slide it back and switch legs.
Keep a steady pace and a flat back.

items.name: 海星卷腹(初级)
items.description: A crunch where your arms and legs spread like a starfish and then come together. It is a beginner-friendly ab move.
steps: Lie on your back with your arms and legs spread wide.
Brace your abs and press your lower back down.
Crunch up, bringing your elbows toward your knees as they pull in.
Lower back to the starfish position under control.
Breathe out as you crunch.

items.name: 海星卷腹(进阶)
items.description: A wide-limb crunch that works the abs while your arms and legs open and close like a starfish.
steps: Lie on your back with arms and legs spread wide.
Brace your core and press your lower back into the floor.
Crunch up, bringing your arms and legs toward the center.
Slowly open back out to the starfish shape.
Keep your movements controlled and repeat.

items.name: 海豹式
items.description: A rolling Pilates exercise that massages the spine and builds ab control.
steps: Sit balanced on your tailbone with knees open and hands inside your ankles.
Tuck your chin and round your back into a ball.
Roll back to your shoulders and clap your feet together.
Roll up to the balance position and clap again.
Keep the roll smooth and avoid rolling onto your neck.

items.name: 深蹲活动度扭转
items.description: A deep squat paired with a trunk rotation. It opens the hips and upper back and improves rotation.
steps: Lower into a deep squat with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Place one hand on the floor or inside your knee.
Rotate your chest and reach the other arm up toward the ceiling.
Follow your hand with your eyes.
Return to the center and switch sides.
Keep your heels on the floor.

items.name: 滑腿鸟狗式
items.description: A bird dog variation where the leg slides along the floor, improving core stability and coordination.
steps: Start on all fours with a sliding disc or towel under one foot.
Brace your core and keep your hips level.
Slide that leg straight back as you extend the opposite arm forward.
Return to the start in a controlled way.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

items.name: 滚动桥式
items.description: A slow bridge where you roll up and down your spine. It strengthens the abs and glutes and improves spinal control.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Curl your pelvis up and peel your spine off the floor.
Lift to a bridge position.
Pause at the top.
Roll back down one vertebra at a time.
Move slowly and breathe.

items.name: 熊式平板支撑
items.description: A plank on hands and toes with knees hovering just off the floor. It challenges the core and shoulders.
steps: Start on hands and knees with wrists under shoulders.
Tuck your toes and lift your knees a few centimetres off the floor.
Keep your back flat and hips level.
Brace your abs and breathe steadily.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower your knees to rest.

items.name: 爆发式动态平板支撑
items.description: A plank with fast, powerful movements from the hands or feet. It builds core strength and shoulder stability.
steps: Start in a high plank, hands under shoulders.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Move quickly, hopping or shifting your hands and feet.
Keep your hips level and avoid sagging.
Rest when your form slips.

items.name: 牛式拉伸
items.description: Lets the belly sink and the chest lift from all fours to stretch the front of the trunk and mobilise the spine.
steps: Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Inhale and let your belly drop toward the floor.
Lift your chest and tailbone while looking slightly forward.
Keep your arms straight and shoulders away from your ears.
Hold for a couple of seconds, then return to neutral.
Repeat for 8-10 slow reps.

items.name: 猫式拉伸 v. 2
items.description: Rounds the spine upward from all fours to loosen the back and gently engage the abs. A classic mobility move for stiff backs.
steps: Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Tuck your chin and tilt the pelvis as you push the floor away.
Round your back up toward the ceiling like a cat.
Hold the rounded position for a few seconds.
Return slowly to the neutral starting position.
Repeat for 8-10 slow reps.

items.name: 登山者 v. 2
items.description: A mountain climber in plank position, a second variation. It raises your heart rate and works the core.
steps: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders.
Brace your core.
Drive one knee toward your chest.
Switch legs quickly.
Keep your hips low and level.
Continue for 20-40 seconds.

items.name: 百次拍击
items.description: The classic Pilates warm-up where you pump your arms while holding your legs up, building abdominal endurance.
steps: Lie on your back and lift your head and shoulders.
Raise your legs to a tabletop or extend them.
Pump your arms up and down in small beats.
Breathe in for five beats and out for five.
Aim for one hundred beats.

items.name: 直腿仰卧起坐
items.description: A sit up with straight legs. It trains the abs and hip flexors.
steps: Lie on your back with legs straight.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Curl up to sitting.
Lower with control.
Do not pull on your neck.

items.name: 直腿侧桥
items.description: A side plank with both legs straight, held on one forearm. It strengthens the obliques and hips.
steps: Lie on your side with your elbow under your shoulder and legs stacked.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.
Keep your core tight and your neck neutral.
Hold for 20-40 seconds without letting your hips sag.
Lower down and repeat on the other side.

items.name: 直腿抬腿斜向卷腹
items.nameEn: oblique crunches with straight leg lift
items.description: A twisting crunch with your legs lifted straight, making your core work harder through the lever.
steps: Lie on your back with legs raised straight and hands by your head.
Lift your shoulders off the floor.
Rotate to bring one elbow toward the opposite hip.
Keep your legs steady and low back pressed down.
Return slowly and alternate sides.

items.name: 直腿死虫式
items.description: A dead bug with straight legs lowering alternately. It is a tougher core challenge with a long lever.
steps: Lie on your back with arms and legs straight up toward the ceiling.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Lower one arm and the opposite leg toward the floor.
Return to the start and switch sides.
Keep your lower back flat the whole time.

items.name: 眼镜蛇式瑜伽姿势
items.description: A gentle yoga backbend that opens the chest and stretches the front of the abs while strengthening the back.
steps: Lie on your stomach with your palms under your shoulders and legs extended.
Press the tops of your feet into the floor.
Lift your chest by straightening your arms partway, keeping your hips down.
Keep your shoulders away from your ears and your neck long.
Hold for 15-30 seconds, then lower slowly.

items.name: 短跑式卷腹
items.description: A running-style crunch where opposite elbow and knee drive together to work the abs and obliques.
steps: Lie on your back with your hands lightly behind your head.
Lift your shoulders off the floor and bring one knee toward the opposite elbow.
Extend the other leg out low above the floor.
Switch sides in a smooth running rhythm.
Keep your lower back pressed down.
Continue for the set.

items.name: 碗式保持
items.description: A gymnastics-style hollow position on your back with arms and legs reaching away. It builds strong, braced abs.
steps: Lie on your back with arms overhead and legs straight.
Press your lower back into the floor and tighten your abs.
Lift your arms, shoulders and legs a few centimetres off the floor.
Keep your body in a shallow dish shape and breathe.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then relax.

items.name: 离心前水平举
items.description: An advanced hanging move where you lower slowly toward a front lever. It builds serious core and lat strength.
steps: Hang from a bar and pull your body up so your hips and legs are above you.
Straighten your body and keep your arms locked.
Lower slowly toward a horizontal position, keeping your body in a straight line.
Stop when you cannot hold the line, then bend your knees to come back up.
Rest and repeat for a few careful reps.

items.name: 离心卷腹
items.description: A slow lowering crunch where you control the way down. Works the abs with extra time under tension.
steps: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，慢慢将上半身抬离地面，向前卷曲，直到躯干呈 45 度角。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 离心龙旗
items.description: The lowering half of the dragon flag. You control a straight body down toward the bench, which builds serious core strength.
steps: Lie on a bench and grip the edge behind your head.
Raise your body into a straight vertical line on your upper back.
Lower your body slowly as one stiff plank, keeping hips from bending.
Stop just above the bench with your core tight.
Bend your knees to return to the start, then repeat.

items.name: 空中扭转卷腹
items.description: A twisting crunch with the legs held in the air. It works your abs and obliques.
steps: Lie on your back with your knees raised.
Place your hands behind your head.
Lift your shoulders and twist toward one knee.
Return and twist toward the other side.
Keep a slow rhythm and press your lower back down.

items.name: 空心摇摆
items.description: Rocking on your back in a hollow body position to challenge your core.
steps: Lie on your back and lift your arms and legs into a hollow position.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Rock back and forth like a boat.
Keep your body rigid.
Continue for reps or time.

items.name: 空心支撑
items.description: A gymnastics-style hold with your shoulders and legs lifted. It builds deep core strength.
steps: Lie on your back with your arms overhead and legs straight.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Lift your shoulders and legs a few inches off the ground.
Hold the shape and breathe steadily.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then rest.

items.name: 空气自行车
items.description: A bicycle-style crunch where opposite elbow and knee meet while the other leg straightens. Hits the abs and obliques.
steps: 平躺，双手放在脑后。
将双腿抬离地面，并以 90 度角弯曲膝盖。
将右肘靠近左膝盖，同时伸直右腿。
返回起始位置，在另一侧重复该动作，将左肘拉向右膝盖，同时伸直左腿。
继续交替进行蹬踏动作，达到所需的重复次数。

items.name: 空气自行车 v. 2
items.description: A bicycle crunch variation that trains the abs and obliques through alternating twists.
steps: Lie on your back with your hands behind your head.
Lift your shoulders and bring your knees up.
Bring one elbow toward the opposite knee while extending the other leg.
Switch sides in a smooth pedalling motion.
Keep your lower back pressed down.
Continue for the planned reps or time.

items.name: 站姿上身旋转
items.description: A standing rotation of the upper body that mobilises the thoracic spine and warms up the waist.
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hands clasped in front of your chest.
Keep your hips facing forward.
Rotate your upper body to one side as far as is comfortable.
Return through the centre and rotate the other way.
Keep it smooth for 10-15 reps per side.

items.name: 站姿下身旋转
items.description: A standing trunk rotation at lower body level to loosen the hips and waist.
steps: Stand with feet slightly wider than your hips and knees soft.
Hold your hands in front of your waist.
Rotate your hips and trunk to one side.
Return through the centre and rotate to the other side.
Move smoothly for 10-15 reps per side.

items.name: 站姿下躯干侧屈肌拉伸
items.nameEn: standing lower trunk lateral flexor stretch
items.description: Bends the lower trunk sideways from a standing position to stretch the muscles along the flank and low back.
steps: Stand with feet slightly wider than hip-width.
Place one hand on your hip and reach the other arm overhead.
Push the hips slightly to the side opposite your reach.
Bend sideways from the waist without leaning forward or back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return to upright and switch sides.

items.name: 站姿交叉腿核心拉伸
items.description: A standing stretch with your legs crossed that lengthens the sides of the trunk. It loosens the obliques and waist.
steps: Stand tall and cross one leg in front of the other.
Raise the arm on the same side as the back leg overhead.
Reach and lean gently toward the opposite side.
Feel the stretch along your side and abs.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
Return to standing and repeat on the other side.

items.name: 站姿体侧拉伸
items.description: A standing side bend for the sides of the waist and ribs.
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip width apart.
Reach one arm overhead and bend sideways away from it until you feel the side stretch.
Keep your chest open and your hips level.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

items.name: 站姿侧向卷腹
items.description: A standing crunch where you lift a knee to the side toward your elbow. It works the obliques.
steps: Stand tall with your hands behind your head.
Lift one knee out to the side.
Crunch your elbow down toward it.
Return to standing.
Repeat on both sides.

items.name: 站姿侧弯
items.description: A standing side bend that loosens the trunk and works the obliques.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Raise one arm overhead.
Bend sideways, reaching over to the other side.
Return to upright.
Switch sides and repeat.

items.name: 站姿侧弯 v. 2
items.description: A standing bend to the side, a second variation. It works the obliques and loosens the sides of the trunk.
steps: Stand tall with feet hip width apart and one arm overhead.
Brace your core lightly.
Bend sideways at the waist, reaching over with the raised arm.
Pause when you feel the side muscles work.
Return to upright with control.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

items.name: 站姿侧弯(屈臂)
items.description: Bend sideways with one arm overhead and bent. It stretches the side of the trunk.
steps: Stand tall with feet hip width apart.
Bend one arm overhead.
Lean to the opposite side.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.

items.name: 站姿侧弯(屈臂) v. 2
items.description: A bodyweight side bend with one arm bent behind your head, working the obliques.
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and one hand behind your head, elbow bent.
Place your other hand on your hip.
Bend sideways toward the hand on your hip without leaning forward.
Squeeze your side to return upright.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

items.name: 站姿侧拉伸
items.description: Reaches an arm overhead and leans to the side to lengthen the flank, lats and obliques.
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Raise one arm overhead with the palm facing inward.
Lean your torso sideways away from the raised arm.
Keep both hips level and your chest facing forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return upright and repeat on the other side.

items.name: 站姿双侧弯
items.description: A standing side bend with both arms overhead for a longer reach through the trunk.
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Clasp your hands overhead.
Bend to one side, keeping your hips still.
Return to the center.
Bend to the other side and repeat.

items.name: 站姿双侧弯(屈臂)
items.description: A standing side bend with your elbows bent that loosens the sides of the trunk.
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Place your hands behind your head with elbows out.
Bend to one side without twisting.
Return to the center.
Bend to the other side and repeat.

items.name: 站姿后仰腹部拉伸
items.description: A standing lean back that stretches the abdominal wall.
steps: Stand tall with your hands on your hips.
Gently lean back and push your hips slightly forward until you feel a stretch across the stomach.
Keep your movement small and avoid cranking your lower back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

items.name: 站姿弯腰交替触脚尖
items.description: A quick standing toe touch where you reach to opposite feet in turn, warming up the hamstrings and midsection.
steps: Stand tall with your feet wider than your hips and arms out to the sides.
Hinge forward and twist to reach one hand toward the opposite foot.
Return to standing with arms out.
Reach the other hand to the opposite foot.
Keep a flat back and move at a lively pace.

items.name: 站姿拧毛巾
items.description: Twist your torso with arms wrapped as if wringing a towel, mobilising the waist and shoulders.
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hands clasped in front of you.
Rotate your torso to one side while your hands twist across.
Return to the centre and rotate the other way.
Keep your hips mostly facing forward.
Continue for 10-15 reps per side.

items.name: 站姿持棍侧拉伸
items.description: Uses a stick held overhead to guide a deeper side bend, stretching the flank and the lats.
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart holding a stick with both hands overhead.
Keep your arms straight and your shoulders relaxed.
Lean your torso slowly to one side without twisting.
Keep your hips steady and your chest facing forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return to upright and lean to the other side.

items.name: 站姿空中自行车
items.description: A standing cycling crunch bringing the elbow to the opposite knee. It trains the abs and obliques.
steps: Stand with hands behind your head.
Lift one knee while rotating your torso.
Touch your elbow to the knee.
Switch sides in a pedaling rhythm.
Stay upright.

items.name: 站姿腹部旋转拉伸
items.description: Rotates the upper body from a standing position to stretch the abs and obliques and loosen the trunk.
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and arms relaxed.
Place your hands on your hips or hold them out to the sides.
Keep the hips facing forward and turn your upper body slowly to one side.
Look over your shoulder and breathe steadily.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return to the front and rotate to the other side.

items.name: 站姿腹部真空收缩
items.description: Drawing your belly in as far as you can while standing. Trains the deep abdominal muscles that keep your trunk tight.
steps: Stand tall with your hands on your hips and feet hip-width apart.
Exhale fully until your lungs feel empty.
Pull your belly button toward your spine and hold it there.
Hold for 10-20 seconds without breathing in deeply.
Relax and breathe normally, then repeat.

items.name: 站姿腹部转体
items.description: Twist your torso from side to side while standing. It warms up the trunk and works the obliques lightly.
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, arms bent in front of your chest.
Keep your hips facing forward.
Rotate your upper body to one side.
Come back through the center and rotate the other way.
Keep a smooth rhythm for 20-30 twists.

items.name: 站姿躯干扭转甩臂
items.description: A dynamic standing twist where your arms swing with the rotation. It loosens up the spine and obliques.
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and arms relaxed.
Rotate your torso to one side, letting your arms swing around.
Let your back heel lift slightly if needed.
Rotate smoothly to the other side.
Continue at an easy rhythm for 30 seconds.

items.name: 罗马椅仰卧起坐
items.description: A sit up on a roman chair that gives you a big range of motion for your abs and hip flexors.
steps: Sit on the roman chair with your feet locked under the pads.
Cross your arms over your chest and lean back slightly.
Curl your torso up until your chest nears your thighs.
Pause at the top and keep your neck relaxed.
Lower back slowly under control and repeat.

items.name: 罗马椅仰卧起坐 v. 2
items.description: A sit up done with your legs supported on a chair, which keeps the movement strict. It trains the abs and hip flexors.
steps: Sit on the floor and rest your lower legs on a chair or bench, knees bent.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Curl your torso up until your chest nears your knees.
Lower slowly back to the floor.
Do not pull on your neck.

items.name: 罗马椅扭转
items.description: Hips lifted into a bridge, you twist from side to side. It trains the trunk rotators and glutes.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat and arms out wide.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Rotate your knees and hips to one side.
Return to center and rotate to the other side.
Stay controlled and keep your shoulders on the floor.

items.name: 罗马椅抬腿
items.description: Raise your legs while supported by the arm pads of a captain's chair. It is a classic lower-ab exercise.
steps: Rest your forearms on the pads and press your back against the support.
Let your legs hang straight down.
Raise your knees or straight legs to hip height or higher.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower your legs slowly without swinging.

items.name: 罗马椅直腿抬腿
items.description: A straight leg raise on a captain's chair, lifting your legs in front of you. Works the abs and hip flexors.
steps: 坐在船长椅上，背部靠在靠背上，前臂放在扶手垫上。
保持上半身稳定，背部挺直。
收紧腹肌并将双腿抬起到身前，保持伸直。
继续抬起，直到双腿与地面平行或达到您可以舒适地达到的高度。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 美人鱼式
items.description: A seated Pilates side stretch that opens the sides of the torso and ribs.
steps: Sit with your legs folded to one side in a comfortable position.
Place one hand on the mat beside you.
Reach the other arm overhead and bend sideways over the supporting hand.
Hold for a breath, feeling the side stretch.
Return to tall sitting and switch sides.

items.name: 翻滚至V字坐
items.description: You roll back over your shoulders and then roll forward into a V sit, working the abs and building control.
steps: Sit with knees bent and arms reaching forward.
Roll back, lifting your legs up and over toward your head.
Roll forward with control and extend your legs.
Land in a balanced V sit, with arms reaching toward your feet.
Move smoothly and use your abs to drive the motion.

items.name: 翻转
items.description: A controlled move where the legs travel overhead and back, challenging the abs.
steps: Lie on your back with legs raised.
Roll your legs overhead.
Open them to hip width.
Roll down slowly.
Keep your arms pressing down.

items.name: 肋木抬腿
items.description: A hanging leg raise performed on stall bars.
steps: Hang on a stall bar with arms straight.
Brace your core and keep your body still.
Raise your legs up in front of you.
Lift as high as you can without swinging.
Lower slowly and repeat.

items.name: 肘撑上下动态平板支撑
items.nameEn: elbow up and down dynamic plank
items.description: Moving between a forearm plank and a high plank, one arm at a time. It builds the core and shoulders under constant tension.
steps: Start in a forearm plank with your body in a straight line.
Place one hand on the floor and press up to a high plank.
Place the other hand down.
Lower back to your forearms one arm at a time.
Alternate the leading arm and keep your hips still.

items.name: 肘撑俯卧撑
items.description: Move between a forearm plank and a high plank, one arm at a time, to train the core and shoulders.
steps: Start in a forearm plank with body in a straight line.
Press up onto one hand, then the other, into a high plank.
Lower back down to your forearms one arm at a time.
Keep your hips steady and avoid rocking side to side.
Alternate which arm leads each rep.

items.name: 肘撑反向平板支撑
items.description: A hold with your back to the floor, supported on your elbows. It strengthens the entire back of the body.
steps: Sit with legs extended and elbows under your shoulders.
Press into your elbows and lift your hips.
Form a straight line from head to heels.
Squeeze your glutes and breathe steadily.
Hold for 20-40 seconds.

items.name: 肘撑平板支撑开合跳
items.description: Hold a forearm plank and jump your feet apart and together. It trains the core while raising your heart rate.
steps: Get into a forearm plank with your elbows under your shoulders.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Jump your feet wide apart.
Jump them back together.
Keep your hips level and continue for 20-40 seconds.

items.name: 肘碰膝
items.description: A standing or floor crunch where you bring an elbow toward the opposite knee. It trains the abs and obliques.
steps: 首先平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，将上半身抬离地面，将右肘靠近左膝盖。
同时，将左膝移向右肘，形成扭转动作。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低上半身并将双腿伸展回到起始位置。
重复该动作，这次将左肘移向右膝，将右膝移向左肘。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

items.name: 肘触膝仰卧起坐
items.description: A sit-up that finishes by driving one elbow toward the opposite knee. It works the abs and obliques.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and hands behind your head.
Curl up and rotate your torso, bringing one elbow toward the opposite knee.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower your back to the floor with control.
Repeat on the other side, alternating.
Avoid pulling on your neck.

items.name: 肘触膝侧平板卷腹(左)
items.nameEn: elbow to knee side plank crunch (left)
items.description: A side plank on the left with a crunch that brings elbow and knee together. It challenges the obliques.
steps: Set up in a left side plank on your forearm, top hand behind your head.
Lift your top leg slightly.
Bring your top elbow and knee together in front of you.
Extend back out to the straight position.
Repeat for reps, then do the other side.

items.name: 肘触膝侧平板支撑卷腹
items.nameEn: elbow to knee side plank crunch
items.description: A side plank where you crunch the top elbow toward the knee. It targets the obliques and core.
steps: Set up in a side plank on your forearm, top hand behind your head.
Lift your hips so your body is in line.
Bring your top elbow and knee together in a crunch.
Extend back to the side plank.
Keep your hips lifted throughout.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

items.name: 脉冲上抬
items.description: Small upward pulses with your legs raised, targeting the lower abs.
steps: Lie on your back with legs pointing to the ceiling.
Place your hands by your sides.
Lift your hips slightly with a small pulse.
Lower and repeat.
Keep movement small.
Do 15-20 pulses.

items.name: 脊柱(腰椎)伸展
items.description: Gently arching the lower back backward, working the muscles along the spine.
steps: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand with feet hip width apart and your hands on your hips.
Lean back gently, arching your lower back within a comfortable range.
Pause briefly, then return upright.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

items.name: 脊柱(腰椎)侧屈
items.description: Bending the trunk sideways, working the obliques and mobilising the spine.
steps: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand with feet hip width apart and your arms at your sides.
Slide one hand down the outside of your leg as you bend sideways.
Keep your hips level, return to upright, then bend to the other side.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

items.name: 脊柱(腰椎)屈曲
items.description: Curling the lower back forward, working the abs and mobilising the lumbar spine.
steps: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand with feet hip width apart and knees slightly soft.
Round your lower back forward and tuck your chin and pelvis in.
Pause briefly, then return upright.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

items.name: 脊柱(腰椎)旋转
items.description: Twisting the trunk to each side, working the obliques and mobilising the spine.
steps: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand with feet hip width apart and your arms crossed over your chest.
Rotate your torso to one side while keeping the hips facing forward.
Return to center, then rotate to the other side.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

items.name: 脊柱前屈拉伸
items.description: A seated pilates stretch where you round forward over your legs, one vertebra at a time. It mobilizes the spine and stretches the hamstrings.
steps: Sit tall with legs extended hip-width apart and arms reaching forward.
Flex your feet and lift your torso up out of your hips.
Curl your chin to your chest and round forward, reaching past your toes.
Hold for a breath, then stack your spine back up slowly.
Repeat for several slow reps.

items.name: 脊柱扭转
items.description: A seated torso rotation, twisting side to side. Loosens the spine and works the obliques.
steps: 坐在地上，双腿在身前伸展。
弯曲膝盖，将双脚平放在地面上，距离与臀部同宽。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，慢慢向右扭转躯干，将右肘拉向左膝盖。
扭转结束时暂停片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
向左侧重复扭转，将左肘拉向右膝盖。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

items.name: 脊柱扭转 v. 2
items.description: A seated Pilates twist that mobilises the spine and strengthens the obliques.
steps: Sit tall with your legs extended and arms reaching out to the sides.
Flex your feet and grow tall through the crown of your head.
Twist your torso to one side, pulsing gently for a small extra turn.
Return to center without sagging in the chest.
Twist to the other side and repeat.

items.name: 脚放凳上地面卷腹
items.description: A crunch with the calves resting on a bench, which keeps the hips bent and focuses the work on the abs.
steps: Lie on your back and rest your lower legs on a bench, knees bent at about 90 degrees.
Place your hands lightly behind your head or across your chest.
Curl your shoulders off the floor by squeezing your abs.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat without pulling on your neck.

items.name: 脚放凳上地面扭转卷腹
items.nameEn: floor twisting crunch feet on bench
items.description: A crunch with a rotation, with the legs on a bench, to train the abs and the obliques.
steps: Lie on your back with your calves on a bench and knees bent.
Place your hands lightly behind your head.
Curl up and rotate so one shoulder moves toward the opposite knee.
Lower with control.
Alternate sides on each rep.

items.name: 腹肌垫仰卧起坐
items.description: A sit-up on a shaped ab mat that supports the lower back and allows a fuller range of motion.
steps: Lie back on an ab mat with knees bent and feet flat.
Cross your arms over your chest or place your hands by your ears.
Curl your torso up until you are sitting tall.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower back down slowly.
Avoid pulling on your neck.

items.name: 腹股沟卷腹
items.description: A crunch that brings the knees and chest together. It targets the abs and the hip flexors.
steps: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，将双腿抬离地面，将膝盖靠近胸部。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 腹部四点支撑
items.description: A four-point hold on hands and knees where you engage the abs. A gentle way to learn core bracing.
steps: Start on hands and knees with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips.
Keep your back flat and neck neutral.
Draw your belly button toward your spine.
Hold for 15-30 seconds while breathing normally.
Relax and repeat.

items.name: 腹部拉伸
items.description: A stretch lengthening the front of the trunk and the abs.
steps: Lie face down with hands under your shoulders.
Press up, lifting your chest.
Keep your hips on the floor.
Look straight ahead and relax.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.

items.name: 腹部旋转拉伸
items.description: Combines a gentle lift of the chest with a twist to stretch the stomach muscles and the sides of the trunk.
steps: Lie face down and prop yourself up on your forearms or hands.
Keep your hips on the floor and lift your chest.
Slowly turn your head and shoulders toward one side.
Stay relaxed and avoid pushing into pain in the lower back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return to centre and rotate to the other side.

items.name: 腿搭凳侧桥
items.description: A side plank with the top leg resting on a bench. It hits the obliques and builds side-body stability.
steps: Lie on your side with your top leg resting on a bench.
Place your forearm on the floor under your shoulder.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.
Keep your hips stacked and your core tight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower and repeat on the other side.

items.name: 臀腿伸展机直臂仰卧起坐
items.nameEn: glute ham developer straight arms sit up
items.description: A sit-up on a glute ham developer with your arms extended. The longer range makes your abs work harder.
steps: Set up on the GHD with your feet secured and hips on the pad.
Extend your arms overhead and lean back.
Curl up, bringing your arms forward.
Reach your torso over your knees.
Lower slowly with control.

items.name: 臀部上抬
items.description: A lying move where the hips lift off the floor as the knees come toward the chest. It trains the lower abs.
steps: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在身体两侧，掌心朝下。
收紧腹肌，将双腿抬离地面，将膝盖靠近胸部。
在动作的最高点，挤压腹肌并暂停片刻。
慢慢地将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 自行车
items.description: A pedalling leg movement lying on your back that works the abs and hip flexors.
steps: Lie on your back with your hands behind your head.
Lift your legs and curl your shoulders up.
Extend one leg while bringing the opposite elbow toward the other knee.
Switch sides in a slow pedalling motion.
Keep your lower back pressed down.

items.name: 自行车卷腹
items.description: A pedalling crunch where you bring each elbow toward the opposite knee. It works the abs and obliques.
steps: Lie on your back with your hands by your head.
Lift your shoulders and bring your knees up.
Twist to bring one elbow to the opposite knee.
Extend the other leg.
Switch sides in a pedalling motion.
Keep your lower back pressed down.

items.name: 自行车扭转卷腹
items.description: A crunch where the knees pedal while the elbow reaches for the opposite knee. It works the abs and the obliques.
steps: Lie on your back with your hands behind your head and your legs lifted.
Bring one knee toward your chest and rotate to touch the opposite elbow to it.
Extend the other leg straight.
Switch sides in a pedalling motion.
Keep your lower back pressed to the floor.
Move at a steady pace without pulling on your neck.

items.name: 自重上斜侧平板支撑
items.description: A side plank held on an incline, resting on the forearm with the body in a straight line. It trains the obliques and core.
steps: 首先侧躺，双腿伸展并叠放在一起。
将前臂放在肩膀正下方的地面上，肘部弯曲成 90 度角。
启动你的核心并将臀部抬离地面，从头到脚形成一条直线。
保持此位置所需的时间。
将臀部放回到地面，然后在另一侧重复。

items.name: 自重风车
items.description: A standing side bend and twist that loosens the hips and trains the obliques.
steps: Stand with feet wider than shoulder-width and one arm overhead.
Turn your feet slightly outward.
Hinge at the hips and rotate your torso toward the floor.
Reach your free hand toward the opposite foot.
Return to standing with control.
Switch sides after your reps.

items.name: 船式拉伸
items.description: A seated stretch that opens up the front of the torso and abs. It leaves your midsection feeling long and loose.
steps: Lie on your stomach with your legs together.
Place your hands under your shoulders.
Press up, lifting your chest and straightening your arms.
Keep your hips on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower slowly and relax.

items.name: 船式瑜伽姿势
items.description: A seated yoga balance where you lift your legs and chest into a V shape. It builds core and hip flexor strength.
steps: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and your feet flat.
Lean back slightly while keeping your chest open.
Lift your feet off the floor and straighten your legs if you can.
Reach your arms forward alongside your knees.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
Lower your feet gently to rest.

items.name: 茧式
items.description: A floor ab move where you curl the upper body up while lying on your back. It targets the abs with controlled crunching.
steps: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，慢慢将上半身抬离地面，向前卷曲，直到躯干呈 45 度角。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 虎卷式
items.description: From hands and knees, you extend one leg back and curl the knee toward your nose. Works the abs and mobilizes the spine.
steps: Start on hands and knees with a neutral spine.
Extend one leg behind you and look slightly forward.
Round your back and draw the knee toward your nose.
Extend again and repeat for 6-8 reps.
Switch legs.

items.name: 蛙式仰卧起坐
items.description: A sit-up with the legs in a frog position that works the abs and hip flexors.
steps: Lie on your back with the soles of your feet together and knees falling out.
Place your hands behind your head or reach forward.
Curl up and sit all the way up.
Reach your hands toward your feet at the top.
Lower with control.
Avoid pulling on your neck.

items.name: 蛙式俯撑
items.description: A planche hold with the knees tucked in toward the arms. It builds shoulder, chest and wrist strength as a stepping stone to the full planche.
steps: 从俯卧撑位置开始，双手与肩同宽，双脚并拢。
弯曲肘部，将身体放低至地面，保持背部挺直。
当你降低身体时，将双脚抬离地面，并将膝盖靠近胸部。
保持这个姿势几秒钟，然后向后伸展双腿，并将自己推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 蛙式卷腹
items.description: A crunch that curls your upper body up with your knees bent. Works the abs.
steps: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，将上半身抬离地面，向前卷曲直到躯干呈 45 度角。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 蜘蛛平板支撑
items.description: A plank with alternating knee drives to the elbow, building core strength.
steps: Start in a high or forearm plank.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Bring one knee toward the same elbow.
Return to plank.
Alternate sides without letting your hips sag.

items.name: 蜘蛛登山者
items.description: Mountain climber where each knee drives toward the same-side elbow, adding side work for the core.
steps: Start in a high plank, hands under shoulders.
Drive one knee toward the outside of your elbow.
Return that foot and switch legs.
Keep your hips low and your core braced.
Move at a quick, controlled pace.

items.name: 蝎子式拉伸
items.description: A face-down rotational stretch that opens the hips, chest and lower back.
steps: Lie face down with your arms out to the sides.
Bend one knee and swing that foot up and across your body.
Reach toward the opposite hand and keep shoulders on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return and switch sides.

items.name: 螃蟹式
items.description: A rolling Pilates move in a seated crab shape that works the core and spine mobility.
steps: Sit with your legs crossed and hold your feet.
Roll back onto your shoulders.
Cross your legs the other way.
Roll back up.
Keep your movement smooth.

items.name: 螃蟹转体触脚尖
items.description: From a crab position you twist and reach one hand to the opposite foot. It works the abs and obliques and gets the shoulders moving.
steps: 首先坐在地上，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地板上。
将双手放在身后，手指指向脚部，并将臀部抬离地面。
将一条腿伸直到您面前，同时将另一只手伸向脚趾。
返回起始位置并在另一侧重复。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

items.name: 触膝卷腹
items.description: A crunch where the opposite hand reaches toward the knee on each rep. It trains the abs and obliques.
steps: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，将肩胛骨抬离地面，并将右手伸向左膝盖。
返回起始位置并重复，这次将左手伸向右膝盖。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

items.name: 跪姿地面侧弯
items.nameEn: lateral bend on floor by kneeling
items.description: A kneeling side bend where you reach along the floor to stretch the side of the waist.
steps: Kneel on a mat and extend one arm sideways along the floor.
Walk your hands to one side and sink your hips the other way until the side of the waist stretches.
Keep your hips over your knees.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

items.name: 跪姿平板支撑
items.description: A plank held on the knees. It's an easier version that builds core strength.
steps: Kneel and place your forearms on the floor under your shoulders.
Lift your hips so your body is in a line from your knees to your head.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Keep your neck neutral.
Hold for 20-45 seconds.
Lower and rest.

items.name: 跪姿平板支撑拍肩(男)
items.description: A kneeling plank where you tap the opposite shoulder with one hand at a time. It trains the abs and shoulder stability.
steps: 从跪姿开始，双手放在地上，与肩同宽。
将双腿伸到身后，用脚趾支撑，将身体抬起成平板支撑姿势。
保持核心参与并保持臀部稳定，将一只手抬离地面并拍打另一侧的肩膀。
将手放回地面并用另一只手重复此操作。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

items.name: 跪姿腹部内收
items.description: Pulling your belly in while kneeling. It teaches deep abdominal control.
steps: Kneel on all fours with your hands under your shoulders.
Relax your belly toward the floor.
Draw your navel up toward your spine.
Hold for 10-15 seconds while breathing normally.
Release slowly and repeat.

items.name: 跪姿腹部拉伸
items.description: A kneeling backbend that opens the front of the torso.
steps: Kneel with your knees hip width apart and place your hands on your lower back.
Push your hips forward and lean back until the abdominal muscles stretch.
Tuck your chin a little and avoid dropping your head back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

items.name: 跪姿触肩
items.description: A kneeling plank with alternating shoulder taps. Trains anti-rotation core control and shoulder stability.
steps: Start on hands and knees, then lift your knees slightly into a kneeling plank.
Keep a straight line from head to knees.
Lift one hand and tap the opposite shoulder.
Place it back down without rocking your hips.
Alternate sides at a steady pace.
Keep your abs tight throughout.

items.name: 身体锯平板支撑
items.description: A plank variation where you rock your body forward and back in small motions. It heavily challenges the abs and shoulders.
steps: Get into a forearm plank with elbows under your shoulders.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs.
Shift your body forward so your shoulders move past your elbows.
Rock back to the start in a slow, smooth motion.
Keep your hips level and avoid sagging.

items.name: 过头仰卧起坐(双腿放凳上)
items.nameEn: overhead sit up with legs on bench
items.description: Sit-up with arms overhead and calves on a bench for a longer lever on the abs.
steps: Lie on your back with your calves resting on a bench, knees bent.
Extend your arms overhead.
Curl your torso up, keeping your arms by your ears.
Reach toward your knees.
Lower slowly.

items.name: 铁十字平板支撑
items.description: A plank variation with arms and legs spread wide to challenge the core.
steps: Start in a plank position with hands under your shoulders.
Spread your arms and legs wide in an X shape.
Brace your core and keep your hips level.
Breathe steadily.
Hold for 20-40 seconds.

items.name: 错位腿侧桥
items.description: A side plank with the feet placed one in front of the other for a different base. It trains the obliques and hips.
steps: Lie on your side with your forearm under your shoulder.
Stagger your feet, top foot in front of the bottom one.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.
Hold the position while breathing steadily.
Keep the hips high and avoid rolling forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

items.name: 锯式
items.description: A seated twist that reaches toward the opposite foot, training the obliques and stretching the back of the legs.
steps: Sit with legs wide and arms out.
Rotate your torso to one side.
Reach your hand past your opposite foot.
Return to centre.
Switch sides.

items.name: 长杠杆下斜仰卧起坐
items.description: A decline sit-up with the arms extended overhead. The long lever makes it a tougher core exercise.
steps: Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured.
Extend your arms overhead.
Curl your torso up, raising your arms with it.
Sit up until your chest is over your thighs.
Lower slowly back down.
Keep your arms reaching forward the whole time.

items.name: 长臂卷腹
items.description: A crunch with the arms extended overhead, which lengthens the lever and makes it harder. It focuses on the abs.
steps: Lie on your back with arms straight overhead.
Bend your knees.
Crunch up reaching forward.
Lower slowly.
Keep your arms by your ears.

items.name: 雨刷式(直腿)
items.description: Swinging straight legs from side to side like windshield wipers. It is a tough one for the obliques and lower abs.
steps: Lie on your back with your arms out to the sides.
Raise your legs straight up over your hips.
Lower both legs to one side with control.
Lift them back to the middle and lower to the other side.
Keep your shoulders flat on the floor.

items.name: 靠墙卷腹
items.description: A crunch with your legs against a wall that keeps your hips steady and works the abs.
steps: Lie on your back with your feet and calves resting on a wall, knees bent about 90 degrees.
Place your hands lightly behind your head.
Curl your shoulders off the floor.
Pause at the top.
Lower with control.
Repeat for the planned reps.

items.name: 靠墙平板支撑
items.description: A standing plank against a wall, an easy way to learn core bracing.
steps: Stand facing a wall and place your forearms or hands on it.
Walk your feet back until your body is in a slanted line.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes.
Keep your head neutral.
Hold for 20-40 seconds.
Step in to finish.

items.name: 靠墙推举点脚跟
items.description: A lying core move with your feet pressed against a wall, tapping each heel alternately to challenge your lower abs.
steps: Lie on your back with your hips and knees bent at 90 degrees and feet flat on a wall.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Lower one heel to tap the floor while the other foot stays on the wall.
Return and tap with the other heel.
Move slowly without arching your back.

items.name: 面朝上雪天使
items.description: Lying face up, you sweep arms and legs out like a snow angel. It trains the abs and keeps your shoulders mobile.
steps: Lie on your back with arms by your sides and legs together.
Press your lower back toward the floor.
Sweep your arms overhead while opening your legs.
Bring them back together in the same arc.
Repeat at a steady pace.
Keep your abs braced and lower back flat.

items.name: 风中冲刺
items.description: Short, all-out runs followed by rest. They build speed, stamina and a strong cardio base.
steps: 找一个空地或跑道来进行练习。
首先站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
开始尽可能快地跑步，挥动手臂并抬起膝盖。
继续冲刺特定的距离或时间。
休息并重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 风吹式瑜伽体式
items.description: The wind-relieving pose, where you hug your knees to your chest while lying down. It stretches the hips and lower back.
steps: Lie on your back with your legs straight.
Bend your knees and draw them into your chest.
Wrap your arms around your shins and hug them in.
Keep your head and shoulders relaxed on the floor.
Breathe slowly and hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release and extend your legs.

items.name: 骆驼式
items.description: A kneeling backbend that opens the chest, abs and front of the hips.
steps: Kneel with knees hip-width apart and hands on your lower back.
Push your hips forward and lift your chest.
Lean back and reach for your heels if comfortable.
Let your head relax back gently.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing evenly.
Come up slowly, leading with your chest.

items.name: 骨盆后倾
items.description: A small rocking movement of the pelvis while lying on your back. It wakes up the abs and teaches you to control the position of your lower back.
steps: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在身体两侧。
收紧腹肌，向上倾斜骨盆，将下背部压入地面。
保持这个姿势几秒钟，专注于收缩腹肌。
释放倾斜并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

items.name: 髋部卷腹(屈膝)
items.description: A reverse-crunch style move lifting the hips off the floor with the knees bent. It works the lower abs.
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent and lifted over your hips.
Place your hands at your sides.
Curl your hips off the floor by bringing your knees toward your chest.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly back to the start.
Use your abs instead of swinging your legs.

items.name: 髋部滚动平板支撑
items.description: A plank with a rolling twist of the hips from side to side. It works the obliques and deep core muscles.
steps: Start in a forearm plank with feet slightly wider than hip-width.
Brace your abs and keep your shoulders stable.
Rotate your hips to one side, lowering them toward the floor.
Roll back through the middle to the other side.
Keep the movement controlled and breathe steadily.

items.name: 鳄鱼式瑜伽体式
items.description: A low plank-like yoga pose held just above the floor. It strengthens the core and arms.
steps: Lie face down with palms under your shoulders.
Tuck your toes and lift your body.
Lower into a low plank with elbows tucked in.
Keep your body straight and hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower to the floor.

items.name: 鸟狗平板支撑
items.description: A plank where you extend an opposite arm and leg to challenge balance. It builds trunk stability.
steps: Get into a plank on your hands or forearms with your body in a line.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Lift one arm forward and the opposite leg back.
Keep your hips level and do not twist.
Hold for a few seconds.
Return and switch sides.

items.name: 鸟狗式
items.description: From hands and knees, you extend opposite arm and leg. It builds core control and back stability.
steps: Start on all fours with hands under your shoulders and knees under your hips.
Extend your right arm forward and left leg back.
Keep your hips level and your back flat.
Hold for a moment, then return.
Repeat on the other side and alternate.

items.name: 鸟狗式 v. 2
items.description: A floor stability move reaching opposite arm and leg to train the back and core.
steps: Start on all fours with a neutral spine.
Extend one arm forward and the opposite leg back.
Keep your hips level and avoid arching your back.
Pause for a moment.
Return and switch sides.
